statement_ko: BMI 25 이상으로 비만에 해당하는 한국 성인 중 합병증이 하나도 없는 비율은 얼마였을까요? → 20.1%(5명 중 1명)
statement_en: Among Korean adults with BMI-defined obesity (≥25 kg/m²), what share had no complications? → 20.1% (one in five)
source: Choe, H. J., Després, J.-P., Wilding, J. P. H., Ryan, D. H., & Lim, S. (2026). Clinical and preclinical obesity in Korean adults from 2014 to 2023. Diabetes & Metabolism Journal, 50(1), 127–138. https://doi.org/10.4093/dmj.2025.0697

statement_ko: 반대로 BMI 23~24.9의 과체중(비만 전단계) 한국 성인 중 임상적 비만 기준을 충족한 비율은 얼마였을까요? → 19.4%
statement_en: Conversely, what share of overweight Korean adults (BMI 23.0–24.9 kg/m²) met the criteria for clinical obesity? → 19.4%
source: Choe, H. J., Després, J.-P., Wilding, J. P. H., Ryan, D. H., & Lim, S. (2026). Clinical and preclinical obesity in Korean adults from 2014 to 2023. Diabetes & Metabolism Journal, 50(1), 127–138. https://doi.org/10.4093/dmj.2025.0697

statement_en: What happened to the estimated prevalence of clinical obesity when Western waist-circumference cut-offs were applied to the Korean data? → It fell sharply to 13.1%

statement_ko: 나이가 들수록 한국 성인의 임상적 비만은 어떻게 변했을까요? → BMI는 안정적이어도 대사·기능 저하로 임상적 비만이 늘었다
statement_en: How did clinical obesity change with age among Korean adults? → It rose with age despite stable BMI, driven by metabolic and functional decline

statement_ko: 이 연구에서 임상적 비만은 어떻게 정의했을까요? → 과잉 지방에 비만 관련 합병증 1개 이상 또는 기능 제한이 있는 경우
statement_en: How did the study define clinical obesity? → Excess adiposity with at least one obesity-related complication or functional limitation

statement_ko: 한국 성인 임상적 비만 사례의 83.6%를 특징짓는 것은 무엇이었을까요? → 대사 이상(metabolic impairment)
statement_en: What characterised 83.6% of clinical-obesity cases among Korean adults? → Metabolic impairment

statement_ko: 이 연구가 강조한 임상적 비만 틀의 의의는 무엇일까요? → BMI만으로는 놓치는 고위험군을 찾아내고, 인종에 맞춘 기능 중심 정의를 지지한다
statement_en: What did the study conclude about the clinical-obesity framework? → It identifies high-risk people missed by BMI alone and supports functional, ethnically tailored definitions

statement_ko: 이 논문이 정리한 아시아인 비만 표현형의 특징은 무엇일까요? → 내장·이소성 지방이 많고 β세포 예비능이 적으며 근감소성 비만이 흔해 더 낮은 BMI에서도 위험이 높아요
statement_en: What features make up the distinctive Asian obesity phenotype described in this Perspective? → Excess visceral and ectopic fat, reduced β-cell reserve, sarcopenic obesity, and higher cardiometabolic risk at lower BMI
source: Lim, S., Ji, L., Tham, K. W., Misra, A., & Kadowaki, T. (2026). Clinical obesity in Asian people: Bridging the gap between adiposity and disease. Nature Reviews Endocrinology. Advance online publication. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41574-026-01239-8

statement_ko: 같은 BMI일 때 아시아인의 지방 분포는 어떻게 다를까요? → 내장지방이 더 많고 간과 췌장의 지방도 많으며 아디포넥틴은 더 낮아요
statement_en: At a given BMI, how does fat distribution differ in Asian people? → More visceral fat, more hepatic and pancreatic fat, and lower adiponectin levels
source: Lim, S., Ji, L., Tham, K. W., Misra, A., & Kadowaki, T. (2026). Clinical obesity in Asian people: Bridging the gap between adiposity and disease. Nature Reviews Endocrinology. Advance online publication. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41574-026-01239-8

statement_ko: 아시아인에게 BMI만으로 비만을 판단할 때 생기는 가장 큰 문제는 무엇일까요? → BMI가 정상이거나 조금만 높아도 과잉 지방과 대사 이상이 있는 사람이 많아 놓치게 돼요
statement_en: What is the main problem with relying on BMI alone in Asian people? → Many people with normal or only mildly raised BMI already have excess adiposity and metabolic dysfunction, so they are missed

statement_en: In a Korean population-based study, what share of people with a BMI of 18.5–22.9 kg/m² exceeded adiposity thresholds linked to metabolic syndrome risk? → 32%
source: Lim, S., Ji, L., Tham, K. W., Misra, A., & Kadowaki, T. (2026). Clinical obesity in Asian people: Bridging the gap between adiposity and disease. Nature Reviews Endocrinology. Advance online publication. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41574-026-01239-8

statement_en: At the same BMI, how much liver fat do Japanese individuals have compared with non-Hispanic white individuals? → Twofold to threefold more

statement_ko: 근감소성 비만(sarcopenic obesity)은 어떤 상태를 말할까요? → 근육량은 적은데 지방은 많은 상태예요
statement_en: What does sarcopenic obesity mean? → Low muscle mass together with excess adiposity

statement_en: What did the Commission emphasise about remission of clinical obesity? → It means resolution of the clinical manifestations, and it does not equate with cure

AASLD practice guidance on the clinical assessment and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 77(5), 1797–1835. https://doi.org/10.1097/HEP.0000000000000323

statement_ko: 지방간은 보통 어떻게 발견될까요? → 증상이 없어 다른 이유로 한 검사에서 우연히 발견된다
statement_en: How is fatty liver usually discovered? → Incidentally, on tests done for another reason, because it causes no symptoms
source: Rinella, M. E., Neuschwander-Tetri, B. A., Siddiqui, M. S., Abdelmalek, M. F., Caldwell, S., Barb, D., Kleiner, D. E., & Loomba, R. (2023). AASLD practice guidance on the clinical assessment and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 77(5), 1797–1835. https://doi.org/10.1097/HEP.0000000000000323 / European Association for the Study of the Liver, European Association for the Study of Diabetes, & European Association for the Study of Obesity. (2024). EASL–EASD–EASO clinical practice guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), 492–542. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhep.2024.04.031

statement_ko: 지방간에서 가장 흔한 혈액검사 소견은 무엇일까요? → ALT가 AST보다 높다
statement_en: What is the most common blood-test pattern in fatty liver? → ALT higher than AST
source: European Association for the Study of the Liver, European Association for the Study of Diabetes, & European Association for the Study of Obesity. (2024). EASL–EASD–EASO clinical practice guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), 492–542. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhep.2024.04.031

statement_ko: 염증·섬유화가 없는 단순 지방간이 간경변까지 진행하는 데 평균 얼마나 걸릴까요? → 약 57년(매우 느림)
statement_en: On average, how long does simple fatty liver without inflammation or fibrosis take to reach cirrhosis? → About 57 years (very slowly)
source: European Association for the Study of the Liver, European Association for the Study of Diabetes, & European Association for the Study of Obesity. (2024). EASL–EASD–EASO clinical practice guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), 492–542. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jhep.2024.04.031 / Rinella, M. E., Neuschwander-Tetri, B. A., Siddiqui, M. S., Abdelmalek, M. F., Caldwell, S., Barb, D., Kleiner, D. E., & Loomba, R. (2023). AASLD practice guidance on the clinical assessment and management of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 77(5), 1797–1835. https://doi.org/10.1097/HEP.0000000000000323

statement_ko: 간 지방·염증·섬유화를 확정 진단하는 검사는 무엇일까요? → 간 조직검사
statement_en: Which test gives the definitive diagnosis of liver fat, inflammation and fibrosis? → Liver biopsy
source: Alberti, K. G. M. M., Eckel, R. H., Grundy, S. M., Zimmet, P. Z., Cleeman, J. I., Donato, K. A., Fruchart, J.-C., James, W. P. T., Loria, C. M., & Smith, S. C., Jr. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: A joint interim statement. Circulation, 120(16), 1640–1645. https://doi.org/10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA.109.192644

statement_ko: 의학영양치료는 영양소나 식품 섭취를 조정해서 질환이나 상태를 치료하는 근거 기반 영양 관리예요.
statement_en: Medical nutrition therapy is an evidence-based application of nutritional care for the treatment of a disease or condition through the modification of nutrient or food intake.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 과체중과 비만을 합치면 전 세계 인구의 3분의 1이 넘는 사람이 영향을 받고 있어요.
statement_en: Overweight and obesity together affect over a third of the world's population.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만은 환경, 행동, 심리, 생리, 대사 요인이 함께 작용하는 복합 질환이면서 상당 부분 예방이 가능한 질환이에요.
statement_en: Obesity is a complex, multifactorial and largely preventable disease driven by environmental, behavioural, psychological, physiological and metabolic determinants.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만 연구에서 가장 크게 비어 있는 부분은 각 요인의 개별 영향이 아니라 요인들이 서로 어떻게 맞물리는가예요.
statement_en: The largest knowledge gap in obesity is not the individual impact of each determinant but how the determinants interact with one another.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만은 에너지 불균형에서 비롯되는데 균형에서 1~2% 정도만 어긋나도 장기적으로는 체중이 크게 달라져요.
statement_en: Obesity results from an energy imbalance, and very small deviations from energy balance (e.g. 1-2%) can result in large, long-term changes in body weight.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 3
refs: Uranga, R.M., Keller, J.N. (2019). The Complex Interactions Between Obesity, Metabolism and the Brain. Frontiers in Neuroscience, 13(513).

statement_ko: 비만을 밀어올린 에너지 불균형에는 값싸고 영양은 부실한 음식이 흔해진 환경과 산업화, 기계화된 이동수단, 도시화가 함께 얽혀 있어요.
statement_en: The energy imbalance behind rising obesity is attributed partly to the growing availability of abundant, inexpensive and often nutrient-poor food, industrialisation, mechanised transportation and urbanisation.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 3
refs: Uranga, R.M., Keller, J.N. (2019). The Complex Interactions Between Obesity, Metabolism and the Brain. Frontiers in Neuroscience, 13(513).

statement_ko: 식사 에너지 밀도를 끌어올리는 비만 유발 요인으로는 고열량 식품 접근성 증가, 전통 식단에서 현대 식단으로의 전환, 조리와 장보기 기술 부족, 패스트푸드와 단 음료 과다 섭취, 큰 1회 제공량, 배달과 테이크아웃 매장 급증이 꼽혀요.
statement_en: Obesogenic drivers of high dietary energy density include easier access to energy-dense food, transition from traditional to modern diets, poor cooking and shopping skills, high intake of fast foods and sugary drinks, large portion sizes, and growth in takeaway outlets.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 4
refs: Tackling Obesities: Future Choices – Project report

statement_ko: 필요한 학문적 준비와 훈련, 기술과 전문성을 두루 갖췄다는 점에서 의학영양치료는 영양사나 임상영양사가 맡는 편이 좋아요.
statement_en: The academic preparation, training, skills and expertise needed make the nutritionist or dietitian the preferred member of the healthcare team to provide medical nutrition therapy.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 다른 합병증 소견이 없다면 의학영양치료를 비만 예방의 일차 치료로 쓸 수 있어요.
statement_en: Medical nutrition therapy can be used as a first line of treatment for the prevention of obesity when no other complications are indicated.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 의학영양치료는 영양 전문가와 자주 만나며 꼼꼼히 관찰하는 방식이라 대사 조절이 좋아지고 합병증도 줄일 수 있어요.
statement_en: Medical nutrition therapy involves close monitoring and frequent contact with registered nutritionists or dietitians, which allows better metabolic control and reduction of complications.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만 의학영양치료의 목표에는 목표 체중 도달과 유지, 비만 합병증의 지연이나 예방, 비만에 흔히 따라오는 질환의 치료가 들어가요.
statement_en: Goals of medical nutrition therapy for obesity include achieving and maintaining body weight goals, delaying or preventing complications of obesity, and treating common diseases associated with obesity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 의학영양치료는 식품 선택에 긍정적인 메시지를 주면서 과학적 근거가 있을 때만 선택을 제한해 먹는 즐거움을 지키려고 해요.
statement_en: Medical nutrition therapy aims to maintain the pleasure of eating by giving positive messages about food choices and limiting food choices only when indicated by scientific evidence.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 의학영양치료의 첫 단계는 영양 평가이고 치료는 환자의 질환 상태나 생리적 조건에 맞춰 개별화해야 해요.
statement_en: The first step of medical nutrition therapy is the nutritional assessment, and therapy must be individualised to the patient's disease states or physiological conditions.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 에드먼턴 비만 병기 체계는 비만의 단계를 평가해서 가장 현실적이고 적절한 치료를 고르도록 도와줘요.
statement_en: The Edmonton Obesity Staging System is used to evaluate the stages of obesity so that the most pragmatic and relevant care can be given.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 식사 중재가 체중을 줄이려면 에너지 균형을 음의 방향으로 만들어야 하고 그러려면 에너지 제한이 필요해요.
statement_en: For a dietary intervention to produce weight loss it must create a negative energy balance, which requires energy restriction.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Introduction › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: Look AHEAD 연구는 체중 감량과 신체활동 증가를 함께 본 초기의 대규모 장기 무작위 대조 연구로 비만과 2형당뇨병을 가진 5,000명 넘는 사람이 참여했어요.
statement_en: The Look AHEAD study was one of the first, largest and longest randomised controlled trials of weight loss plus increased physical activity, enrolling more than 5,000 individuals with obesity and type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: Wadden, T.A. et al. (2011). Four-year weight losses in the Look AHEAD study. Obesity (Silver Spring), 19(10), pp. 1987-1998.

statement_ko: Look AHEAD에서 집중 생활습관 중재군 가운데 초기 체중의 10% 넘게 감량한 사람의 약 40%가 장기 추적에서도 그 감량을 유지했어요.
statement_en: In Look AHEAD, nearly 40% of intensive lifestyle intervention participants who lost more than 10% of initial weight maintained that loss over longer follow-up.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: Wadden, T.A. et al. (2011). Four-year weight losses in the Look AHEAD study. Obesity (Silver Spring), 19(10), pp. 1987-1998.

statement_ko: Look AHEAD의 4년 시점에서 초기 체중 감소율은 집중 생활습관 중재군 -4.7%, 당뇨병 지지·교육군 -1.1%였고 모든 연차에서 P < 0.0001이었어요.
statement_en: At four years in Look AHEAD, mean reduction in initial weight was -4.7% with intensive lifestyle intervention versus -1.1% with diabetes support and education (P < 0.0001 at all years).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: Wadden, T.A. et al. (2011). Four-year weight losses in the Look AHEAD study. Obesity (Silver Spring), 19(10), pp. 1987-1998.

statement_ko: Look AHEAD의 8년 시점 평균 체중 감소는 집중 생활습관 중재군 -4.7%, 당뇨병 지지·교육군 -2.1%였고 모든 연차에서 P < 0.001이었어요.
statement_en: At eight years in Look AHEAD, mean weight loss was -4.7% with intensive lifestyle intervention versus -2.1% with diabetes support and education (P < 0.001 at all years).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: Look AHEAD Research Group. (2014). Eight-year weight losses with an intensive lifestyle intervention: the Look AHEAD study. Obesity (Silver Spring), 22(1), pp. 5-13.

statement_ko: 체중 감량용 인기 식단은 저탄수화물, 저지방, 중등도 다량영양소라는 세 가지 유형으로 나뉘어요.
statement_en: Popular weight-loss diets are grouped into three macronutrient patterns: low-carbohydrate, low-fat and moderate macronutrient.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 모듈의 다량영양소 표를 보면 저탄수화물 식단은 열량의 약 30%를 단백질로, 30~55%를 지방으로 채워요.
statement_en: In the module's macronutrient table, low-carbohydrate diets supply approximately 30% of kcal as protein and 30 to 55% as fat.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 중등도 다량영양소 식단은 열량의 약 55~60%를 탄수화물로, 약 15%를 단백질로 구성해요.
statement_en: Moderate macronutrient diets supply approximately 55 to 60% of kcal as carbohydrate and approximately 15% as protein.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 저지방 식단은 열량의 약 60%를 탄수화물로 채우고 지방은 약 10~15%에 그쳐요.
statement_en: Low-fat diets supply approximately 60% of kcal as carbohydrate and only approximately 10 to 15% as fat.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: DIRECT 연구는 중등도 비만 대상자에게 지중해식, 저탄수화물, 저지방 식단을 2년간 비교했고 저지방 식단과의 두 비교 모두 P < 0.001이었어요.
statement_en: The DIRECT study compared Mediterranean, low-carbohydrate and low-fat diets over two years in subjects with moderate obesity, with P < 0.001 for both comparisons against the low-fat diet.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 4
refs: Shai, I. et al. (2008). Weight Loss with a Low-Carbohydrate, Mediterranean, or Low-Fat Diet. New England Journal of Medicine, 359(3), pp. 229-241.

statement_ko: DIRECT를 6년까지 추적했을 때 기저 대비 체중 감소는 지중해식군과 저탄수화물군에서만 유의했고 저지방군에서는 유의하지 않았어요.
statement_en: At six years of DIRECT follow-up, weight loss from baseline remained significant for the Mediterranean and low-carbohydrate groups but not for the low-fat group.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 5
refs: Schwarzfuchs, D., Golan, R., Shai, I. (2012). Four-year follow-up after two-year dietary interventions. New England Journal of Medicine, 367(14), pp. 1373-1374.

statement_ko: DIETFITS에서는 처음 8주 동안 총 지방이나 소화 가능한 탄수화물을 하루 20g까지 줄인 뒤 스스로 유지할 수 있다고 여기는 최소 수준까지 다시 늘려 갔어요.
statement_en: In DIETFITS, participants cut total fat or digestible carbohydrate to 20 grammes per day during the first eight weeks, then added them back to the lowest intake they believed they could maintain.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 6
refs: Guo, J. et al. (2019). Objective versus Self-Reported Energy Intake Changes During Low-Carbohydrate and Low-Fat Diets. Obesity (Silver Spring), 27(3), pp. 420-426.

statement_ko: DIETFITS에서 초기에 하루 1,000kcal 가까이 줄었던 섭취량은 두 식단군 모두 12개월에 걸쳐 기저 수준으로 되돌아갔어요.
statement_en: In DIETFITS, large early calorie reductions of up to about 1,000 kcal/day decayed back toward baseline over 12 months in both diet groups.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 6
refs: Guo, J. et al. (2019). Objective versus Self-Reported Energy Intake Changes During Low-Carbohydrate and Low-Fat Diets. Obesity (Silver Spring), 27(3), pp. 420-426.

statement_ko: 무작위 대조 연구 18건을 모은 메타분석에서 저탄수화물 중재는 저지방 중재보다 장기 체중 감량이 평균 1.15kg(95% CI 0.52~1.79) 더 컸고 이질성은 I2 = 10.4%(p = 0.33)로 낮았어요.
statement_en: A meta-analysis of 18 randomised controlled trials found low-carbohydrate weight-loss interventions produced on average 1.15 kg (95% CI 0.52 to 1.79) greater long-term weight loss than low-fat interventions, with I2 = 10.4% (p = 0.33).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 7
refs: Tobias, D.K. et al. (2015). Effect of low-fat diet interventions versus other diet interventions on long-term weight change in adults. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 3(12), pp. 968-979.

statement_ko: 12개월 무작위 연구에서 건강한 저지방 식단과 건강한 저탄수화물 식단의 체중 변화는 유의하게 다르지 않았고 저지방형·저탄수화물형 유전자 패턴으로도 예측되지 않았어요.
statement_en: In a 12-month randomised trial, weight change did not differ significantly between healthy low-fat and healthy low-carbohydrate diets, and it was not predicted by a low-fat or low-carbohydrate genotype pattern.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 8
refs: Gardner, C.D. et al. (2018). Effect of Low-Fat vs Low-Carbohydrate Diet on 12-Month Weight Loss in Overweight Adults and the Association With Genotype Pattern or Insulin Secretion: The DIETFITS Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA, 319(7), pp. 667-679.

statement_ko: 체중 감량 반응은 사람마다 크게 달라서 하나의 식단을 모두에게 권해서는 안 돼요.
statement_en: Because weight-loss response varies substantially between individuals, no single diet should be recommended universally.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 8
refs: Gardner, C.D. et al. (2018). Effect of Low-Fat vs Low-Carbohydrate Diet on 12-Month Weight Loss in Overweight Adults... JAMA, 319(7), pp. 667-679.

statement_ko: 대사병동 연구에서는 비만 성인 19명이 2주 동안 서로 다른 식사 제한을 받았는데 탄수화물 제한은 지방 산화를 늘렸지만 지방 제한은 그렇지 않았고 그럼에도 체지방은 지방 제한 쪽에서 더 빠졌어요.
statement_en: In a two-year metabolic ward study, 19 adults with obesity were confined for two weeks under different dietary restrictions: carbohydrate restriction increased fat oxidation while fat restriction did not, yet the fat-restricted condition lost more body fat.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 10
refs: Hall, K.D. et al. (2015). Calorie for Calorie, Dietary Fat Restriction Results in More Body Fat Loss than Carbohydrate Restriction in People with Obesity. Cell Metabolism, 22(3), pp. 427-436.

statement_ko: 열량을 맞춘 케토제닉 식단 연구에서는 과체중이나 비만인 남성이 고탄수화물 기저식을 4주 먹은 뒤 단백질을 고정한 케토제닉 식단을 4주 먹었고 에너지 소비는 대사챔버에서 이틀 연속, 체성분은 DEXA로 측정했어요.
statement_en: In an isocaloric ketogenic diet study, men with overweight or obesity ate a high-carbohydrate baseline diet for four weeks then an isocaloric ketogenic diet with clamped protein for four weeks, with energy expenditure measured in a metabolic chamber over two consecutive days and body composition by DEXA.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 1 › slide 11
refs: Hall, K.D. et al. (2016). Energy expenditure and body composition changes after an isocaloric ketogenic diet in overweight and obese men. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 104(2), pp. 324-333.

statement_ko: 무작위 대조 연구 121건과 참가자 약 2만 2,000명을 모은 네트워크 메타분석이 저탄수화물, 저지방, 중등도 다량영양소 세 가지 식사 패턴을 비교했어요.
statement_en: A systematic review with network meta-analysis of 121 randomised controlled trials among almost 22,000 participants compared low-carbohydrate, low-fat and moderate macronutrient dietary patterns.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 1
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes for weight and cardiovascular risk factor reduction in adults. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 낮음에서 중등도 확실성의 근거에서 세 가지 다량영양소 패턴 모두 평소 식사보다 체중과 혈압을 낮췄고 중등도 다량영양소 식단의 감소폭만 조금 작았어요.
statement_en: Evidence of low to moderate certainty showed all three macronutrient patterns reduced body weight and blood pressure versus the usual diet, with slightly smaller reductions for moderate macronutrient diets.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 1
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 인기 식단이 체중에 미치는 효과는 6개월보다 12개월에 더 작아서 어떤 식단을 골라도 되지만 효과가 오래 이어지리라 기대하기는 어려워요.
statement_en: Effects of popular diets on weight were smaller at 12 months than at six months, so any popular diet may be chosen for weight loss but a long-lasting effect should not be expected.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 1
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 이름이 알려진 14개 식단 가운데 6개월 시점에서 평소 식사 대비 체중과 혈압을 가장 크게 낮춘 것은 앳킨스, DASH, 존이었어요.
statement_en: Among 14 popular named diets, the largest effects on weight reduction and blood pressure versus the usual diet at six months were seen with Atkins, DASH and Zone.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 2
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 이름난 식단들 사이의 체중 결과 차이는 대체로 사소하거나 작아서 각자 선호하는 식단을 고르면 돼요.
statement_en: Differences in weight outcome between named diets are generally trivial to small, so people can choose the diet they prefer.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 2
refs: Ge, L. et al. (2020). Comparison of dietary macronutrient patterns of 14 popular named dietary programmes. BMJ, 369, m696.

statement_ko: 상업적 식단 네 가지를 1년간 비교한 연구에서 만족스러운 순응도를 보인 식단은 없었고 점점 떨어지는 평균 순응 점수는 네 식단이 사실상 똑같았어요.
statement_en: In a one-year trial of four commercial diets, no single diet produced satisfactory adherence rates and the progressively decreasing mean adherence scores were practically identical across all four.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 3
refs: Dansinger, M.L. et al. (2005). Comparison of the Atkins, Ornish, Weight Watchers, and Zone diets for weight loss and heart disease risk reduction: a randomized trial. JAMA, 293(1), pp. 43-53.

statement_ko: 모듈의 정의에 따르면 앳킨스 식단은 탄수화물을 2~3개월간 하루 20g 줄이고 이후에는 하루 50g 줄이는 매우 낮은 탄수화물 식단이에요.
statement_en: As defined in the module, the Atkins diet is very low in carbohydrate at 20 g/day less for 2-3 months and 50 g/day less for subsequent months.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 3
refs: Dansinger, M.L. et al. (2005). Comparison of the Atkins, Ornish, Weight Watchers, and Zone diets... JAMA, 293(1), pp. 43-53.

statement_ko: 오니시 식단은 탄수화물이 매우 높고 지방이 10%를 넘지 않는 채식 식단이라 비교된 네 가지 상업적 식단 가운데 지방이 가장 적어요.
statement_en: The Ornish diet is defined as very high in carbohydrates, a vegetarian diet with no more than 10% fats, and contains the lowest amount of dietary fat among the four commercial diets compared.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 3
refs: Dansinger, M.L. et al. (2005). Comparison of the Atkins, Ornish, Weight Watchers, and Zone diets... JAMA, 293(1), pp. 43-53.

statement_ko: 저탄수화물 식단과 저지방 식단을 비교한 여러 무작위 연구에서 단기 체중 감량은 저탄수화물 쪽이 더 컸고 때로는 두세 배까지 차이가 났어요.
statement_en: Numerous randomised trials comparing low-carbohydrate with low-fat diets show more short-term weight loss on low-carbohydrate diets, often two to three times as much.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 4
refs: Shai, I. et al. (2008). NEJM, 359(3); Sacks, F.M. et al. (2009). NEJM, 360(9); Gardner, C.D. et al. (2018). JAMA, 319(7).

statement_ko: 저탄수화물 식단에서 초기 감량이 큰 이유로는 식욕이 크게 줄고 첫 1~2주에 수분이 상당히 빠지며 단백질 비중이 높아 대사에 에너지가 더 드는 점이 꼽혀요.
statement_en: Mechanisms proposed for greater early weight loss on low-carbohydrate diets are a drastic reduction in appetite, significant water loss as excess bloat resolves in the first week or two, and the energy cost of metabolising the higher protein content.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 4
refs: Shai, I. et al. (2008). NEJM, 359(3); Sacks, F.M. et al. (2009). NEJM, 360(9); Gardner, C.D. et al. (2018). JAMA, 319(7).

statement_ko: 에너지 제한 식단과 저탄수화물 식단은 안전성 문제가 있을 수 있어 특히 특정 집단에서는 조심스럽게 적용해야 해요.
statement_en: Energy-restricted and low-carbohydrate diets need to be implemented with caution because there are potential safety concerns, particularly among certain groups.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: TEMPO 연구는 BMI 30~40인 45~65세 폐경 여성 101명을 심한 에너지 제한군과 중등도 제한군으로 무작위 배정했어요.
statement_en: The TEMPO study randomised 101 postmenopausal women aged 45-65 with a BMI of 30-40 to severe or moderate energy restriction.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 6
refs: Seimon, R.V. et al. (2019). Effect of Weight Loss via Severe vs Moderate Energy Restriction on Lean Mass and Body Composition Among Postmenopausal Women With Obesity: The TEMPO Diet Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA Network Open, 2(10), e1913733.

statement_ko: 비만인 폐경 여성에서 심한 에너지 제한은 중등도 제한보다 전신 제지방량 손실과 고관절 골밀도 손실을 뚜렷하게 더 많이 일으켰어요.
statement_en: Severe energy restriction was significantly associated with greater loss of whole-body lean mass and greater loss of total hip bone mineral density than moderate energy restriction in postmenopausal women with obesity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 6
refs: Seimon, R.V. et al. (2019). ... The TEMPO Diet Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA Network Open, 2(10), e1913733.

statement_ko: 심하게 열량을 제한하는 비만 치료에서 골밀도가 빠르게 줄어드는 현상은 골다공증과 취약골절 위험을 높이기 때문에 임상적으로 걱정스러운 부분이에요.
statement_en: Accelerated bone mineral density loss under severely energy-restricted obesity treatment is clinically concerning because it is linked to increased risk of osteoporosis and fragility fracture.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 6
refs: Steur, M. (2019). Very Low-Energy Diets - Opportunity for Greater Weight Loss, but Risk of Bone Loss. JAMA Network Open, 2(10), e1913752.

statement_ko: 한 체계적 문헌고찰은 50세를 넘긴 사람, 90일을 넘기는 사용, 하루 20g 이하 탄수화물 식단에 대해서는 저탄수화물 식단을 권할 근거가 부족하다고 결론지었어요.
statement_en: A systematic review concluded there is insufficient evidence to recommend low-carbohydrate diets among participants older than 50, for use longer than 90 days, or for diets of 20 g/day or less of carbohydrates.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 7
refs: Bravata, D.M. et al. (2003). Efficacy and safety of low-carbohydrate diets: a systematic review. JAMA, 289(14), pp. 1837-1850.

statement_ko: 저탄수화물 식단의 체중 감량은 탄수화물을 줄인 것 자체보다 열량 섭취가 줄고 식단을 오래 이어간 점과 주로 맞물려 있었어요.
statement_en: Weight loss on low-carbohydrate diets was principally associated with decreased calorie intake and increased diet duration, not necessarily with reduced carbohydrate content.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 7
refs: Bravata, D.M. et al. (2003). Efficacy and safety of low-carbohydrate diets: a systematic review. JAMA, 289(14), pp. 1837-1850.

statement_ko: 저탄수화물 식단은 식이섬유와 무기질, 비타민, 미량원소, 다불포화지방산 섭취를 줄이고 글리코겐 저장을 고갈시켜서 사망률 증가, 이상지질혈증, 뼈 건강 문제, 신결석으로 이어질 수 있어요.
statement_en: Low-carbohydrate diets can reduce intake of fibre, minerals, vitamins, trace elements and PUFA and deplete glycogen stores, with sequelae including increased mortality, dyslipidaemia, bone health problems and renal calculi.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Barber, T.M. et al. (2021). The Low-Carbohydrate Diet: Short-Term Metabolic Efficacy Versus Longer-Term Limitations. Nutrients, 13(4), p. 1187.

statement_ko: 저탄수화물 식단의 케톤증은 단기적으로 구토와 설사, 심한 변비, 위식도역류를 일으킬 수 있고 이론적으로는 신결석과 골다공증, 드물게 케톤산증까지 이어질 수 있어요.
statement_en: Ketosis on a low-carbohydrate diet can cause short-term vomiting, diarrhoea, obstipation and gastrointestinal reflux, with theoretical nephrolithiasis, osteoporosis and rare ketoacidosis.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Barber, T.M. et al. (2021). The Low-Carbohydrate Diet: Short-Term Metabolic Efficacy Versus Longer-Term Limitations. Nutrients, 13(4), p. 1187.

statement_ko: 저탄수화물 식단은 지방과 단백질 비중이 커지고 식이섬유가 모자라면서 장내 미생물 불균형을 일으켜 식욕과 면역, 염증, 대사에 영향을 남길 수 있어요.
statement_en: Low-carbohydrate diets can cause dysbiosis through a relative increase in fat and protein with deficient fibre, giving appetitive, immunomodulatory, inflammatory and dysmetabolic sequelae.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Barber, T.M. et al. (2021). The Low-Carbohydrate Diet: Short-Term Metabolic Efficacy Versus Longer-Term Limitations. Nutrients, 13(4), p. 1187.

statement_ko: 간헐적 단식은 열량 섭취를 아예 하지 않거나 아주 적게 하는 기간을 규칙적으로 두는 방식이에요.
statement_en: Intermittent fasting refers to regular periods with no or very limited caloric intake.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 3 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 흔히 쓰는 간헐적 단식 방식으로는 매일 16시간 단식, 격일로 24시간 단식, 주 2회 연속되지 않는 날에 단식하기가 있어요.
statement_en: Common intermittent fasting regimens include a daily fast for 16 hours, a 24-hour fast on alternate days, or a fast two days per week on non-consecutive days.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 3 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 간헐적 단식은 체중을 줄이는 데 도움이 되고 일차의료에서 적용하기도 쉽지만 배고픔 때문에 유지가 어렵고 장기 지속성과 건강 영향은 아직 잘 몰라요.
statement_en: Intermittent fasting appears to promote weight loss and is easy to apply in primary care, but associated hunger can make maintenance difficult and little is known about its long-term sustainability and health effects.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 3 › slide 2
refs: Johnstone, A. (2015). Fasting for weight loss: an effective strategy or latest dieting trend? International Journal of Obesity (London), 39(5), pp. 727-733.
Welton, S. et al. (2020). Intermittent fasting and weight loss: Systematic review. Canadian Family Physician, 66(2), pp. 117-125.

statement_ko: 식사 패턴은 식단에 들어가는 여러 식품과 음료의 양과 다양성, 조합 그리고 평소 먹는 빈도를 뜻해요.
statement_en: A dietary pattern is defined as the amount, variety or combination of different foods and beverages in a diet and the frequency with which they are usually consumed.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 12개월을 넘는 장기 감량을 본 지중해식 무작위 연구들의 체계적 고찰에서 감량 폭은 저지방이나 저탄수화물 식단과 비슷했어요.
statement_en: A systematic review of randomised trials of the Mediterranean diet for long-term weight loss beyond 12 months showed weight losses similar to low-fat or low-carbohydrate diets.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 2
refs: Esposito, K. et al. (2011). Mediterranean diet and weight loss: meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Metabolic Syndrome and Related Disorders, 9(1), pp. 1-12.

statement_ko: 지중해식과 대조 식단을 비교한 무작위 연구 메타분석에서 허리둘레와 내장지방이 줄었어요.
statement_en: A meta-analysis of randomised trials of the Mediterranean diet against control diets showed a reduction of waist circumference and visceral fat.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 2
refs: Esposito, K. et al. (2011). Mediterranean diet and weight loss: meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Metabolic Syndrome and Related Disorders, 9(1), pp. 1-12.

statement_ko: 고위험군을 대상으로 한 대표 무작위 연구 두 건이 지중해식을 검증했는데 완료된 PREDIMED는 제한 없는 지중해식을, 진행 중인 PREDIMED-Plus는 열량을 제한한 지중해식을 썼어요.
statement_en: Two landmark randomised trials in high-risk populations tested the Mediterranean diet: the completed PREDIMED study with an ad libitum Mediterranean diet and the ongoing PREDIMED-Plus study with an energy-restricted Mediterranean diet.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 2
refs: Estruch, R. et al. (2019). Effect of a high-fat Mediterranean diet on bodyweight and waist circumference: PREDIMED. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 7(5), e6-e17.

statement_ko: 지중해식의 핵심에는 채소 요리를 조리하고 무칠 때 넉넉히 쓰는 엑스트라버진 올리브유 중심의 높은 지방 섭취와 통곡물, 콩류, 견과, 과일, 채소처럼 혈당지수가 낮은 탄수화물 식품의 풍부한 섭취가 있어요.
statement_en: Main features of the Mediterranean diet include high fat intake mostly as extra virgin olive oil used generously to cook and dress vegetable dishes, and high consumption of low-glycaemic index carbohydrate-rich foods such as wholegrain cereals, legumes, nuts, fruits and vegetables.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지중해식은 생선을 중등도에서 높은 수준으로 먹고 가금류와 유제품은 적거나 중간 정도로 두며 붉은 고기와 육가공품은 적게 먹고 술은 주로 적포도주를 식사와 함께 적당히 마시는 구성이에요.
statement_en: The Mediterranean diet includes moderate to high fish consumption, moderate to small amounts of poultry and dairy, low consumption of red meat and meat products, and moderate alcohol intake mainly as red wine and always with meals.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 무작위 대조 연구 16건을 모은 메타분석에서 지중해식은 체중과 BMI에 유의한 효과를 보였고 열량 제한과 신체활동 증가, 6개월을 넘는 추적이 더해지면 효과가 더 커졌어요.
statement_en: A meta-analysis of 16 randomised controlled trials found the Mediterranean diet had a significant effect on weight and BMI, with greater effect under energy restriction, increased physical activity and follow-up longer than six months.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 4
refs: Esposito, K. et al. (2011). Mediterranean diet and weight loss: meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Metabolic Syndrome and Related Disorders, 9(1), pp. 1-12.

statement_ko: PREDIMED에서 체중과 허리둘레에 대한 장기 효과는 엑스트라버진 올리브유를 더한 지중해식군에서 가장 컸어요.
statement_en: In PREDIMED, long-term effects on body weight and waist circumference were greatest in the group assigned to a Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra virgin olive oil.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 5
refs: Estruch, R. et al. (2019). Effect of a high-fat Mediterranean diet on bodyweight and waist circumference: a prespecified secondary outcomes analysis of the PREDIMED randomised controlled trial. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 7(5), e6-e17.

statement_ko: 지방 비중이 높은 지중해식은 엑스트라버진 올리브유나 견과처럼 지방이 많은 식품을 더해도 체지방을 늘리지 않아요.
statement_en: A high-fat Mediterranean diet, even when enriched with fatty foods such as extra virgin olive oil and nuts, does not promote adiposity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 5
refs: Estruch, R. et al. (2019). ... PREDIMED randomised controlled trial. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 7(5), e6-e17.

statement_ko: PREDIMED에서 지중해식 패턴은 심혈관질환 일차예방에 도움이 된다고 확인됐어요.
statement_en: The Mediterranean pattern was shown in PREDIMED to be useful in the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 5
refs: Estruch, R. et al. (2019). ... PREDIMED randomised controlled trial. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 7(5), e6-e17.

statement_ko: 저지방과 저탄수화물, 지중해식 세 가지 식사 패턴은 체지방 변화와 혈압 변화가 서로 비슷해요.
statement_en: Changes in adiposity and in blood pressure are similar with the low-fat, low-carbohydrate and Mediterranean dietary patterns.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 6
refs: Estruch, R., Ros, E. (2020). The role of the Mediterranean diet on weight loss and obesity-related diseases. Reviews in Endocrine and Metabolic Disorders, 21(3), pp. 315-327.

statement_ko: 열량을 제한하면 저지방과 저탄수화물, 지중해식 모두 단기에는 비슷하게 완만한 감량과 심장대사 위험인자 개선을 보이지만 시간이 지나면 효과가 대체로 사라져요.
statement_en: When energy-restricted, the low-fat, low-carbohydrate and Mediterranean diets give similar modest weight loss and improvement in cardiometabolic risk factors in the short term, with the effect largely disappearing over time.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 6
refs: Estruch, R., Ros, E. (2020). The role of the Mediterranean diet on weight loss and obesity-related diseases. Reviews in Endocrine and Metabolic Disorders, 21(3), pp. 315-327.

statement_ko: DASH 패턴은 과일과 채소, 통곡물, 견과, 콩류, 씨앗, 저지방 유제품, 살코기를 권하고 나트륨과 카페인 음료, 술은 제한해요.
statement_en: The DASH pattern encourages fruits, vegetables, whole grains, nuts, legumes, seeds, low-fat dairy products and lean meats, and limits sodium and caffeinated and alcoholic beverages.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 8
refs: Chiavaroli, L. et al. (2019). DASH Dietary Pattern and Cardiometabolic Outcomes: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses. Nutrients, 11(2), p. 338.

statement_ko: 참가자 1,211명, 비교 11건을 합쳤을 때 DASH 식사 패턴은 체중을 -1.42kg(95% CI -2.03~-0.82) 낮췄어요.
statement_en: Pooled across 11 comparisons in 1,211 participants, the DASH dietary pattern lowered body weight by -1.42 kg (95% CI -2.03 to -0.82).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 8
refs: Chiavaroli, L. et al. (2019). DASH Dietary Pattern and Cardiometabolic Outcomes: An Umbrella Review. Nutrients, 11(2), p. 338.

statement_ko: DASH 패턴은 열량을 제한한 연구에서 체중을 -2.27kg(95% CI -2.65~-1.88) 낮췄지만 열량 제한이 없던 연구에서는 -0.85kg(95% CI -1.27~-0.43)에 그쳤어요.
statement_en: The DASH pattern lowered body weight by -2.27 kg (95% CI -2.65 to -1.88) in trials with energy restriction but only -0.85 kg (95% CI -1.27 to -0.43) in trials without energy restriction.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 8
refs: Chiavaroli, L. et al. (2019). DASH Dietary Pattern and Cardiometabolic Outcomes: An Umbrella Review. Nutrients, 11(2), p. 338.

statement_ko: DASH 식사 패턴은 수축기 혈압을 -5.20mmHg(95% CI -7.00~-3.40), 이완기 혈압을 -2.60mmHg(95% CI -3.50~-1.70) 낮췄어요.
statement_en: The DASH dietary pattern lowered systolic blood pressure by -5.20 mmHg (95% CI -7.00 to -3.40) and diastolic blood pressure by -2.60 mmHg (95% CI -3.50 to -1.70).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 8
refs: Chiavaroli, L. et al. (2019). DASH Dietary Pattern and Cardiometabolic Outcomes: An Umbrella Review. Nutrients, 11(2), p. 338.

statement_ko: DASH 우산형 고찰에서 당화혈색소는 -0.53%(95% CI -0.62~-0.43), 공복 인슐린은 -0.15uU/mL 낮아졌고 공복혈당 변화(-0.19mmol/L, P = 0.07)는 유의하지 않았어요.
statement_en: In the DASH umbrella review, HbA1c fell by -0.53% (95% CI -0.62 to -0.43) and fasting insulin by -0.15 uU/mL, while fasting glucose change (-0.19 mmol/L, P = 0.07) was not significant.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 8
refs: Chiavaroli, L. et al. (2019). DASH Dietary Pattern and Cardiometabolic Outcomes: An Umbrella Review. Nutrients, 11(2), p. 338.

statement_ko: 8~48주 중재를 모아 채식 식단과 비채식 식단을 비교한 메타분석에서 전체 체중 감소는 -2.02kg(95% CI -2.80~-1.23)이었어요.
statement_en: A meta-analysis of vegetarian versus non-vegetarian diets across interventions of 8-48 weeks found an overall weight reduction of -2.02 kg (95% CI -2.80 to -1.23).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 9
refs: Huang, R.Y. et al. (2016). Vegetarian Diets and Weight Reduction: a Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials. Journal of General Internal Medicine, 31(1), pp. 109-116.

statement_ko: 채식 식단의 감량 효과는 일반 인구 대상 연구(-2.61kg, 95% CI -3.54~-1.69)가 기저에 과체중이나 비만이 있던 사람만 모은 연구(-1.23kg, 95% CI -2.09~-0.37)보다 컸어요.
statement_en: Vegetarian diets gave greater weight reduction in general-population trials (-2.61 kg, 95% CI -3.54 to -1.69) than in trials restricted to people with overweight or obesity at baseline (-1.23 kg, 95% CI -2.09 to -0.37).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 4 › slide 9
refs: Huang, R.Y. et al. (2016). Vegetarian Diets and Weight Reduction: a Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials. Journal of General Internal Medicine, 31(1), pp. 109-116.

statement_ko: 캐나다당뇨병학회 영양치료 표에서 저혈당지수 식단과 고단일불포화지방 식단, 지중해식, DASH, 포트폴리오, 노르딕 패턴, 과일·채소 중심 접근은 단점 없음으로 정리돼요.
statement_en: In the Diabetes Canada nutrition therapy table, low-glycaemic-index diets, high-MUFA diets, the Mediterranean pattern, DASH, Portfolio, Nordic patterns and fruit-and-vegetable approaches are listed with no disadvantages.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 5 › slide 1
refs: Diabetes Canada Clinical Practice Guidelines Expert Committee et al. (2018). Nutrition Therapy. Canadian Journal of Diabetes, 42(1), S64-S79.

statement_ko: 고식이섬유 식단과 콩류, 통곡물은 일시적인 위장관 증상 정도만 단점으로 적혀 있어요.
statement_en: High-fibre diets, dietary pulses and legumes, and whole grains are listed as having transient gastrointestinal side effects as their only disadvantage.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 5 › slide 1
refs: Diabetes Canada Clinical Practice Guidelines Expert Committee et al. (2018). Nutrition Therapy. Canadian Journal of Diabetes, 42(1), S64-S79.

statement_ko: 성인 체중 감량에서 무작위 연구 근거가 뒷받침하는 중재는 가당음료 줄이기와 1회 제공량 조절, 저열량 식단, 식사대용식, 초저열량 식단, 저탄수화물 식단, 열량 제한을 겸한 고단백 식단 그리고 DASH와 지중해식이에요.
statement_en: Dietary interventions for adult weight loss with supportive randomised trial evidence are decreasing sugar-sweetened beverages, portion control, low-calorie diet, meal replacement, very low calorie diet, low-carbohydrate diet, high protein with energy restriction, and DASH and Mediterranean patterns.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 5 › slide 2
refs: Raynor, H.A., Champagne, C.M. (2016). Position of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics: Interventions for the Treatment of Overweight and Obesity in Adults. Journal of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics, 116(1), pp. 129-147.

statement_ko: 대규모 코호트 세 곳에서 전분류와 정제 곡물, 가공식품은 4년간 체중 증가와 뚜렷하게 맞물렸고 가당음료와 술, 100% 과일주스도 비슷한 양상을 보였어요.
statement_en: In three large cohorts, strong positive associations with four-year weight change were seen for starches, refined grains and processed foods, with similar findings for sugar-sweetened beverages, alcohol and 100% fruit juice.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 5 › slide 3
refs: Mozaffarian, D. et al. (2011). Changes in diet and lifestyle and long-term weight gain in women and men. New England Journal of Medicine, 364(25), pp. 2392-2404.

statement_ko: 채소와 견과, 과일, 통곡물 섭취를 늘린 사람은 4년마다 체중이 덜 늘었어요.
statement_en: Increased consumption of vegetables, nuts, fruits and whole grains was associated with less weight gain over each four-year period.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 5 › slide 3
refs: Mozaffarian, D. et al. (2011). Changes in diet and lifestyle and long-term weight gain in women and men. New England Journal of Medicine, 364(25), pp. 2392-2404.

statement_ko: 가당음료를 하루 한 잔 이상 마시는 사람에서 BMI와 비만 위험에 미치는 유전적 영향의 합은 한 달에 한 잔도 마시지 않는 사람의 약 두 배였어요.
statement_en: Combined genetic effects on BMI and obesity risk among people consuming one or more servings of sugar-sweetened beverages per day were approximately twice as large as among people consuming less than one serving per month.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 5 › slide 4
refs: Qi, Q. et al. (2012). Sugar-sweetened beverages and genetic risk of obesity. New England Journal of Medicine, 367(15), pp. 1387-96.

statement_ko: 가당음료 결과는 양방향으로 읽히는데 단 음료가 체지방에 대한 유전적 영향을 키울 수도 있고 반대로 유전적 소인이 단 음료의 해로운 영향을 더 크게 받게 만들 수도 있어요.
statement_en: The interpretation of the sugar-sweetened beverage finding is bidirectional: sugary drinks may increase susceptibility to genetic effects on adiposity, or genetic predisposition may increase susceptibility to the deleterious effects of sugary drinks on BMI.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 5 › slide 4
refs: Qi, Q. et al. (2012). Sugar-sweetened beverages and genetic risk of obesity. New England Journal of Medicine, 367(15), pp. 1387-96.

statement_ko: 체중 감량은 여러 만성질환을 예방하는 데 중요하고 코로나19의 중증도와 입원을 줄이는 데도 도움이 돼요.
statement_en: Weight loss is crucial for the prevention of various chronic diseases and to reduce the severity of COVID-19 outcomes and hospitalisations.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 의학영양치료의 핵심은 열량 부족분을 만드는 일이 중요하고 식사 관리가 치료의 주춧돌이라는 점이에요.
statement_en: The key points of medical nutrition therapy are that a calorie deficit is important and that dietary management is the cornerstone of care.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 건강한 식사 패턴이라면 어떤 것이든 열량 제한과 함께 처방했을 때 비만 치료에 도움이 될 수 있어요.
statement_en: Prescription of any of the healthful dietary patterns, together with energy restriction, may be useful for treating obesity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 첫 체중 감량 중재의 합리적인 목표는 기저 체중의 10%예요.
statement_en: A reasonable target for an initial weight loss intervention is 10% of baseline weight.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체중 감량의 주요 목표는 6개월 정도의 무리 없는 기간 안에 기저 체중의 약 10%를 줄이고 필요하다면 그다음 감량을 시도하는 거예요.
statement_en: The main goals for weight loss are to reduce body weight by approximately 10% from baseline within a reasonable time-frame such as six months, and then to attempt further weight loss if needed.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 6개월을 넘어서는 감량에는 기한을 두지 않는 체중 유지 전략이 함께 따라야 해요.
statement_en: Weight loss beyond six months usually needs to be accompanied by weight loss maintenance strategies, indefinitely.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 표적 체중 감량 표를 보면 감량이나 유지, 안내에 따른 열량 부족 전략, 1회 제공량 조절은 과체중 이전 단계부터 고도비만까지 모든 범주에 공통으로 적용돼요.
statement_en: In the targeted weight loss table, weight loss or maintenance, guided calorie deficit strategies and portion control apply across every category from pre-overweight to severe obesity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 4
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891. (Obesity Canada 2021)

statement_ko: 비만 관리에 모두에게 맞는 식사 패턴은 없어서 영양 권고는 각자의 가치관과 선호, 치료 목표에 맞춰 개별화해야 해요.
statement_en: There is no one-size-fits-all eating pattern for obesity management, so nutrition recommendations should be personalised to individual values, preferences and treatment goals.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 4
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891.

statement_ko: 저열량 식단은 소비하는 것보다 하루 약 500~1,000kcal 적게 먹는 방식이고 과체중에서는 주당 400g, 비만에서는 주당 1kg 정도 감량으로 이어져요.
statement_en: A hypocaloric diet means ingesting roughly 500-1,000 kcal/day fewer than expended, leading to weight loss of between 400 g/week in overweight and 1 kg/week in obesity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 5
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891. (Obesity Canada 2021)

statement_ko: 중등도 저열량 식단은 견디기 쉽고 의학영양치료를 이어가기 좋으며 균형이 무너진 극단적 제한 식단의 위험을 줄여 줘서 과체중과 비만 치료에 꼭 필요해요.
statement_en: Moderately hypocaloric diets are essential in the treatment of overweight and obesity because they are well tolerated, facilitate adherence to medical nutrition therapy and reduce the risks of unbalanced, highly restrictive diets.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 5
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891. (Obesity Canada 2021)

statement_ko: 모듈이 효과적이라고 꼽은 체지방 감량의 세 가지 요령은 열량 부족과 꾸준함 그리고 단순함이에요.
statement_en: The three fat loss 'hacks' named as effective in the module are a calorie deficit, consistency and simplicity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 근거 기반 식단 처방은 체중을 고려해 여성 하루 1,200~1,500kcal, 남성 하루 1,500~1,800kcal로 에너지 섭취를 잡아요(근거 수준 1, 권고 강도 A).
statement_en: An evidence-based diet prescription sets energy intake at 1,200-1,500 kcal/day for women and 1,500-1,800 kcal/day for men, adjusted for body weight (Category of evidence 1, Strength A).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 7
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891.

statement_ko: 근거 기반 식단 처방은 기저 체중에 따라 하루 500~1,000kcal의 열량 부족을 만들어요.
statement_en: An evidence-based diet prescription creates a 500-1,000 kcal/day calorie deficit depending on baseline body weight.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 7
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891.

statement_ko: 하루 800kcal 미만의 초저열량 식단은 제한된 상황에서만 처방하고 훈련받은 인력이 관리해야 해요(근거 수준 IIa, 권고 강도 A).
statement_en: A very low calorie diet of under 800 kcal/day should be prescribed only in limited circumstances and supervised by trained personnel (Category of evidence IIa, Strength A).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 7
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891.

statement_ko: 열량을 줄인 식단은 환자의 선호와 건강 상태, 사회경제적 여건, 문화적 적합성, 즐거움을 바탕으로 짜고 영양 전문가의 상담과 잦은 추적이 함께 가야 해요(근거 수준 1, 권고 강도 A).
statement_en: A reduced-calorie diet should be based on patient preferences, health status, socioeconomic status, cultural relevance and enjoyability, with counselling and frequent follow-up by nutrition professionals (Category of evidence 1, Strength A).
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 7
refs: Wharton, S. et al. (2020). Obesity in adults: a clinical practice guideline. CMAJ, 192(31), E875-E891.

statement_ko: 체중을 줄이는 일도 어렵지만 줄인 체중을 지키는 일은 더 힘들 수 있어서 한 체계적 고찰이 유지 행동을 좌우하는 주요 결정 요인을 정리했어요.
statement_en: Weight loss is challenging but weight loss maintenance can be even tougher, and a systematic review identified the main determinants influencing the behaviour associated with maintenance.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Section 6 › slide 8
refs: Varkevisser, R.D.M. et al. (2019). Determinants of weight loss maintenance: a systematic review. Obesity Reviews, 20(2), pp. 171-211.

statement_ko: 영양 평가에서는 신체계측을 측정하고 기록해야 해요.
statement_en: Anthropometry measurements should be taken and recorded as part of the nutritional assessment.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Assessment › item 3
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 활동량이 적은 비만인에게 감량 식단의 가장 중요한 특징은 다량영양소 구성이 아니라 에너지 섭취를 줄이는 일이에요.
statement_en: The most important characteristic of any weight-loss diet for sedentary individuals with obesity is the restriction of energy intake, not the macronutrient composition of the diet.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Assessment › item 6
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 콩류와 과일, 채소, 유제품은 균형 잡힌 식사의 한 부분으로 먹었을 때 체중 감량과 맞물려 있어요.
statement_en: Pulses, fruits and vegetables and dairy products have been associated with weight loss when consumed as part of a balanced diet.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Assessment › item 7
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지중해식처럼 지방 비중이 높은 식사 패턴은 심장질환 위험 증가와 연결되지 않아요.
statement_en: High-fat dietary patterns such as the Mediterranean diet are not associated with an increased risk for heart disease.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Assessment › item 8
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 식사 중재만으로는 대개 체중 감량에 이르기 어렵고 신체활동을 늘리는 등 다른 생활습관 중재와 함께 가야 해요.
statement_en: Dietary intervention alone is typically not an effective way of achieving weight loss and needs to be combined with other lifestyle interventions such as increased physical activity.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Assessment › item 9
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 신체활동은 모든 비만 관리 전략에 빠질 수 없는 요소이지만 체중 감량에서 가장 중요한 요인은 아니에요.
statement_en: Physical activity is an integral component of all obesity management strategies, but it is not the most important factor for weight loss.
source: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity › Assessment › item 10
refs: SCOPE Medical Nutrition Therapy for Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체중의 유전율, 그러니까 유전 요인의 차이로 설명되는 체중 변이의 비율은 40~70%예요.
statement_en: The heritability of body weight, meaning the amount of weight variation explained by variation in genetic factors, is 40% to 70%.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 같은 환경 안에서도 체중은 사람마다 크게 갈려서 어떤 사람은 고도비만이 되고 어떤 사람은 마른 상태를 유지하는데 그 차이가 유전에서 와요.
statement_en: Within any given environment body weight varies widely, with some people developing severe obesity while others stay thin, and that variation is genetic.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지난 30년 사이 고도비만이 늘어난 것은 비만을 부추기는 환경이 원래 숨어 있던 유전적 위험을 드러냈기 때문이에요.
statement_en: Over the last 30 years more people have developed severe obesity because the obesogenic environment unmasks underlying genetic risk.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만의 유전적 기여를 보여 주는 근거는 쌍둥이와 가족 연구에서 나오는데 태어나자마자 헤어져 다른 환경에서 자란 일란성 쌍둥이의 성인 체중이 매우 비슷했어요.
statement_en: Evidence for the genetic contribution to obesity comes from twin and family studies, in which identical twins separated at birth and raised in different environments have very similar adult body weight.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 1
refs: Stunkard, A.J. et al. (1990). The body-mass index of twins who have been reared apart. New England Journal of Medicine, 322(21), pp. 1483-1487.

statement_ko: 전장유전체연관분석은 BMI 상승과 연관된 흔한 변이를 수천 개 찾아냈는데 각 변이가 BMI 차이나 비만 위험에 더하는 몫은 아주 작아요.
statement_en: Genome-wide association studies have revealed thousands of common variants associated with increased BMI, each contributing only a small amount to differences in BMI or obesity risk.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만 관련 변이는 음식 섭취와 포만 반응, 기초대사량, 운동의 에너지 효과에 영향을 주는데 이 특성들은 모두 유전되는 형질이에요.
statement_en: Obesity-associated variants influence food intake, satiety response, basal metabolic rate and the energy effects of exercise, all of which are heritable traits.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만인 사람은 비만 위험 변이를 더 많이 갖고 마른 사람은 아주 적게 갖는데 일부는 BMI에 더 큰 영향을 주는 드문 변이를 지녀요.
statement_en: People with obesity carry a higher number of obesity risk variants while people who are thin carry a very low number, and some people carry rare variants with a larger effect on BMI.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 흔한 변이와 드문 변이의 효과를 합치면 다유전자 위험점수를 계산할 수 있고 고도비만인 사람은 그 점수가 더 높아요.
statement_en: The combined effect of common and rare variants can be used to calculate a polygenic risk score, and people with severe obesity have a higher polygenic risk score.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 다유전자 위험점수를 진료 현장에서 쓰는 방식은 아직 검증 단계이고 이 점수가 집단이 아니라 개인 수준의 위험을 예측할 수 있는지도 연구가 이어지고 있어요.
statement_en: Use of polygenic risk scores in clinical settings is currently being tested, and research continues into whether such scores predict risk at individual rather than population level.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전의 영향은 체중 스펙트럼 전체에 걸쳐 작용하고 고도비만인 사람의 유전적 위험이 가장 높아요.
statement_en: Genetic influences act right across the body weight spectrum, and the people with severe obesity have the highest genetic risk.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군은 하나 이상의 유전자 기능을 망가뜨리는 돌연변이 때문에 생기고 단일유전자 질환과 염색체 질환으로 나뉘어요.
statement_en: Genetic obesity syndromes are caused by mutations which disrupt the function of one or more genes, and are classified as monogenic and chromosomal disorders.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 단일유전자 비만 질환은 대개 한 유전자의 틀이동, 넌센스, 스플라이스 부위 돌연변이로 병원성으로 분류되고 미스센스 돌연변이는 기능 검사를 해봐야 병원성을 알 수 있어요.
statement_en: Monogenic obesity disorders usually involve a frameshift, nonsense or splice site mutation in a single gene, often termed pathogenic, while a missense mutation needs a test of function to determine pathogenicity.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 각인 질환은 유전자의 모계 사본이나 부계 사본 가운데 한쪽만 발현되기 때문에 생겨요.
statement_en: Imprinted disorders arise because only one copy of the gene, maternal or paternal, is expressed.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 염색체의 결실이나 중복은 유전자 사본 수를 바꾸는데 이를 복제수변이(CNV)라고 하고 하나 또는 여러 유전자에 영향을 줘요.
statement_en: Chromosomal deletions or duplications can change the number of copies of a gene, called copy number variants (CNVs), and can affect one or sometimes multiple genes.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 1 › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군은 비만만 보이기도 하고 학습 곤란이나 발달 지연, 신경행동 장애가 비만과 함께 나타나기도 해요.
statement_en: People with genetic obesity syndromes may present with obesity alone or with learning difficulties, developmental delay or neurobehavioural disorders as well as obesity.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만만 나타나는 유전성 비만 증후군에는 LEP, LEPR, POMC, PCSK1, CPE, SRC-1, SEMA3 계열과 MC4R, MRAP2, ADCY3, KSR2가 관여해요.
statement_en: Genetic obesity syndromes presenting with obesity alone involve LEP, LEPR, POMC, PCSK1, CPE, SRC-1 and the SEMA3 family, plus MC4R, MRAP2, ADCY3 and KSR2.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만에 발달 지연이나 학습 곤란, 행동 장애가 함께 오는 유전성 비만 증후군에는 SIM1, OTP, BDNF, TRKB, SH2B1, PHIP, HTR2C와 프래더윌리증후군, 가성부갑상선기능저하증, 바르데비들증후군, 알스트롬증후군, 터비증후군이 있어요.
statement_en: Genetic obesity syndromes presenting with obesity plus developmental delay, learning difficulties or behavioural disorders involve SIM1, OTP, BDNF, TRKB, SH2B1, PHIP and HTR2C, plus Prader-Willi syndrome, pseudohypoparathyroidism, Bardet-Biedl syndrome, Alstrom syndrome and Tubby syndrome.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리증후군처럼 특징이 뚜렷한 질환을 예전에는 증후군형 비만이라 불렀지만 증후군형과 비증후군형을 나누는 구분은 이제 그리 쓸모 있지 않아요.
statement_en: Conditions with distinctive clinical features such as Prader-Willi syndrome were historically called syndromic forms of obesity, but the syndromic versus non-syndromic distinction is no longer that useful.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 멜라노코르틴 4 수용체(MC4R) 결핍은 가장 흔한 비만의 유전적 원인이에요.
statement_en: Melanocortin 4 receptor (MC4R) deficiency is the most common genetic cause of obesity.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 2
refs: Farooqi, I.S. et al. (2003). Clinical Spectrum of Obesity and Mutations in the Melanocortin 4 Receptor Gene. New England Journal of Medicine, 348(12), pp. 1085-1095.

statement_ko: MC4R의 이형접합 기능상실 돌연변이는 고도비만 소아의 2~5%에서, 일반 인구에서는 300명 중 1명까지 발견돼요.
statement_en: Heterozygous loss-of-function mutations in MC4R are found in 2-5% of children with severe obesity and in up to one in 300 people in the population.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Farooqi, I.S. et al. (2003). Clinical Spectrum of Obesity and Mutations in the Melanocortin 4 Receptor Gene. New England Journal of Medicine, 348(12), pp. 1085-1095.

statement_ko: 체중 항상성의 핵심 기관은 시상하부이고 지방조직에서 오는 렙틴과 미주신경을 타고 오는 장의 신경 신호, 인슐린과 그렐린 같은 호르몬 신호를 받아요.
statement_en: The hypothalamus is the critical organ for body weight homeostasis, receiving leptin from adipose tissue, neural signals from the gut via the vagus nerve, and hormonal signals including insulin and ghrelin.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 3
refs: Zhang, Y. et al. (1994). Positional cloning of the mouse obese gene and its human homologue. Nature, 372(6505), pp. 425-432.

statement_ko: 렙틴은 렙틴 수용체를 발현하는 시상하부 신경, 곧 AGRP 신경과 POMC 신경에 작용하고 이 신경들은 MC4R을 가진 신경과 시냅스를 이뤄요.
statement_en: Leptin acts on hypothalamic neurons expressing the leptin receptor, namely AGRP-expressing and POMC-expressing neurons, which synapse onto neurons carrying MC4R.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 먹은 상태에서는 POMC에서 나온 펩타이드가 MC4R을 활성화해 그만 먹으라는 신호를 보내고 굶은 상태에서는 렙틴이 떨어지면서 MC4R 길항제인 AGRP가 나와 섭취가 늘어요.
statement_en: In the fed state, MC4R activation by POMC-derived peptides signals to stop eating, while in the fasted state leptin falls and AGRP, an MC4R antagonist, is released so food intake increases.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 렙틴 결핍과 렙틴 수용체 결핍은 상염색체 열성 질환으로 영아기부터 고도비만을 일으켜요.
statement_en: Leptin and leptin receptor deficiency are autosomal recessive conditions that result in severe obesity from infancy.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 5
refs: Montague, C.T. et al. (1997). Congenital leptin deficiency is associated with severe early-onset obesity in humans. Nature, 87(6636), pp. 903-908.
Clement, K. et al. (1998). A mutation in the human leptin receptor gene causes obesity and pituitary dysfunction. Nature, 392(6674), pp. 398-401.

statement_ko: 렙틴 결핍이 있는 소아는 대개 혈청 렙틴이 검출되지 않지만 렙틴 수용체 결핍에서는 대부분 BMI에 걸맞은 정상 렙틴 수치를 보여요.
statement_en: Most children with leptin deficiency have undetectable serum leptin levels, whereas in leptin receptor deficiency leptin levels are normal for BMI in most patients.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 5
refs: Farooqi, I.S. et al. (2007). Clinical and Molecular Genetic Spectrum of Congenital Deficiency of the Leptin Receptor. New England Journal of Medicine, 356(3), pp. 237-247.

statement_ko: 렙틴 결핍과 렙틴 수용체 결핍의 주요 임상 특징은 심한 과식증으로 배고픔이 계속되고 음식의 보상감이 커지며 포만감은 잘 오지 않아요.
statement_en: The main clinical feature of leptin and leptin receptor deficiency is severe hyperphagia, meaning persistent hunger with food being very rewarding and satiety impaired.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 5
refs: Montague, C.T. et al. (1997). Nature, 87(6636), pp. 903-908.
Farooqi, I.S. et al. (2007). NEJM, 356(3), pp. 237-247.

statement_ko: 렙틴 결핍과 렙틴 수용체 결핍은 경한 중추성 갑상선기능저하와 저성선자극호르몬성 성선저하증도 일으켜서 환자가 사춘기를 제대로 겪지 못해요.
statement_en: Leptin and leptin receptor deficiency also cause mild central hypothyroidism and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism, so patients fail to go through puberty.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 5
refs: Strobel, A. et al. (1998). A leptin missense mutation associated with hypogonadism and morbid obesity. Nature Genetics, 18(3), pp. 213-215.

statement_ko: 렙틴 결핍은 면역 기능을 떨어뜨려서 감염이 잦아지고 사망률이 높아지는데 감염병이 흔한 지역에서 특히 그래요.
statement_en: Leptin deficiency causes impaired immunity, which leads to frequent infections and high mortality, particularly where infectious disease is prevalent.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 5
refs: Ozata, M., Ozdemir, I.C., Licinio, J. (1999). Human leptin deficiency caused by a missense mutation. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 84(10), pp. 3686-3695.

statement_ko: 선천성 렙틴 결핍을 피하 재조합 렙틴으로 치료하면 과식증이 줄고 체중이 정상으로 돌아올 수 있으며 면역 기능이 회복되고 적절한 발달 시기에 사춘기가 시작돼요.
statement_en: Treatment of congenital leptin deficiency with subcutaneous recombinant leptin reduces hyperphagia, can normalise weight, corrects immune function and permits the onset of puberty at an appropriate developmental stage.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 5
refs: Farooqi, I.S. et al. (2002). Beneficial effects of leptin on obesity, T cell hyporesponsiveness, and neuroendocrine/metabolic dysfunction of human congenital leptin deficiency. Journal of Clinical Investigation, 110(8), pp. 1093-1103.

statement_ko: 렙틴의 생리적 역할은 굶주림을 막는 것이고 대부분의 사람에서 지방량이나 BMI가 늘면 렙틴 수치도 함께 올라가요.
statement_en: Leptin's physiological role is to prevent starvation, and in most people leptin levels increase as fat mass or BMI increases.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 6
refs: Ahima, R.S. et al. (1996). Role of leptin in the neuroendocrine response to fasting. Nature, 382(6588), pp. 250-252.

statement_ko: 렙틴은 혈중 수치가 낮을 때 생리에 영향을 주는데 선천성 렙틴 결핍, 단식이나 열량 제한 또는 감량 상태에서 렙틴이 떨어진 경우, 신경성 식욕부진증이나 지방이상증에서 만성적으로 낮은 경우가 여기 해당해요.
statement_en: Leptin affects physiology when serum levels are low, as in congenital leptin deficiency, a fall in leptin from fasting or caloric restriction or a weight-reduced state, and chronic low leptin from anorexia nervosa or lipodystrophy syndromes.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 6
refs: Rosenbaum, M. et al. (2005). Low-dose leptin reverses skeletal muscle, autonomic, and neuroendocrine adaptations to maintenance of reduced weight. Journal of Clinical Investigation, 115(12), pp. 3579-3586.

statement_ko: 렙틴은 정상이나 높은 BMI 구간에서는 큰 영향을 주지 않아서 렙틴 수치가 충분한 일반적인 비만 환자에게 재조합 렙틴은 효과적인 치료가 아니에요.
statement_en: Leptin does not have major effects within the healthy or high BMI range, so recombinant leptin is not an effective treatment for people with common forms of obesity who have sufficient leptin levels.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 6
refs: Rosenbaum, M. et al. (2002). Low dose leptin administration reverses effects of sustained weight-reduction on energy expenditure and circulating concentrations of thyroid hormones. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 87(5), pp. 2391-2394.

statement_ko: 체중을 줄이고 나면 렙틴이 떨어지면서 과식과 체중 반등이 이어지는데 이 요요 현상은 의지의 문제가 아니라 열량 부족에 대한 온전히 생리적인 반응이에요.
statement_en: After weight loss, falling leptin drives overeating and rebound weight gain, and this yo-yo pattern is an entirely physiological response to caloric deficit rather than a matter of willpower.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 6
refs: Rosenbaum, M. et al. (2005). Low-dose leptin reverses skeletal muscle, autonomic, and neuroendocrine adaptations to maintenance of reduced weight. Journal of Clinical Investigation, 115(12), pp. 3579-3586.

statement_ko: POMC 결핍은 열성 질환으로 과식증과 비만, 코티솔이 낮은 ACTH 결핍, 피부와 모발의 색소 감소를 일으켜요.
statement_en: POMC deficiency is a recessive disorder causing hyperphagia and obesity, ACTH deficiency with low cortisol, and hypopigmentation of skin and hair.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 7
refs: Krude, H. et al. (1998). Severe early-onset obesity, adrenal insufficiency and red hair pigmentation caused by POMC mutations in humans. Nature Genetics, 19(2), pp. 155-157.

statement_ko: PCSK1 결핍은 열성 질환으로 과식증과 비만, 신경내분비 이상을 동반한 ACTH 결핍, 프로인슐린 상승이 진단 단서가 되는 식후 저혈당, 신생아 장병증을 일으켜요.
statement_en: PCSK1 deficiency is a recessive disorder causing hyperphagia and obesity, ACTH deficiency with neuroendocrine abnormalities, postprandial hypoglycaemia in which high proinsulin is diagnostic, and neonatal enteropathy.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 7
refs: Jackson, R.S. et al. (1997). Obesity and impaired prohormone processing associated with mutations in the human prohormone convertase 1 gene. Nature Genetics, 16(3), pp. 303-306.

statement_ko: POMC는 프로호르몬 전환효소 1에 의해 잘려 멜라노코르틴 펩타이드가 되고 이들이 피부의 MC1R을 자극해 색소를 만들고 MC2 수용체로 코티솔 생산을 이끌며 뇌의 MC4R을 통해 식후 섭취를 줄여요.
statement_en: POMC is cleaved by prohormone convertase 1 into melanocortin peptides that activate MC1R in skin for pigmentation, MC2R for cortisol production and brain MC4R to reduce food intake after a meal.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: MC4R 결핍의 임상 특징으로는 정상 출생 체중과 발달, 수용체 기능 저하 정도와 비례하는 과식증, 늘어난 선형 성장과 제지방량이 있어요.
statement_en: Clinical features of MC4R deficiency include normal birth weight and development, hyperphagia whose severity correlates with severity of receptor dysfunction, and increased linear growth with increased lean mass.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Farooqi, I.S. et al. (2003). Clinical Spectrum of Obesity and Mutations in the Melanocortin 4 Receptor Gene. New England Journal of Medicine, 348(12), pp. 1085-1095.

statement_ko: MC4R 결핍은 체격에 비해 과한 고인슐린혈증과 이른 2형당뇨병을 일으키고 교감신경 긴장도가 떨어져서 고혈압 유병률과 수축기 혈압은 오히려 낮아요.
statement_en: MC4R deficiency causes disproportionate hyperinsulinaemia and early type 2 diabetes, together with a lower prevalence of hypertension and lower systolic blood pressures due to impaired sympathetic nervous system tone.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Farooqi, I.S. et al. (2003). Clinical Spectrum of Obesity and Mutations in the Melanocortin 4 Receptor Gene. New England Journal of Medicine, 348(12), pp. 1085-1095.

statement_ko: MC4R 돌연변이는 상염색체 우성이면서 발현과 침투도가 다양하고 동형접합이나 양대립 보인자는 매우 심한 비만을 보여요.
statement_en: MC4R mutations are autosomal dominant with variable expression and penetrance, and homozygous or bi-allelic carriers have very severe obesity.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Yeo, G.S. et al. (1998). A frameshift mutation in MC4R associated with dominantly inherited human obesity. Nature Genetics, 20(2), pp. 111-112.

statement_ko: MC4R 돌연변이의 75%는 고전적인 Gas 연결 경로를 통한 신호전달을 손상시켜요.
statement_en: 75% of MC4R mutations impair signalling through the classical Gas-coupled pathway.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Collet, T.H. et al. (2017). Evaluation of a melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) agonist (Setmelanotide) in MC4R deficiency. Molecular Metabolism, 6(10), pp. 1321-1329.

statement_ko: MC4R에는 기능획득 돌연변이도 있어서 비만과 2형당뇨병으로부터 보호해 주기도 해요.
statement_en: There are also gain-of-function MC4R mutations which can protect against obesity and type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 8
refs: Lotta, L.A. et al. (2019). Human Gain-of-Function MC4R Variants Show Signaling Bias and Protect against Obesity. Cell, 177(3), pp. 597-607.

statement_ko: SIM1은 시상하부 발달에 관여하는 전사인자이고 이형접합 결실이나 돌연변이는 과식증과 성장 증가, 제지방량 증가를 보이는 우성 유전 질환을 일으켜서 MC4R 결핍과 매우 닮았어요.
statement_en: SIM1 is a transcription factor involved in hypothalamic development, and heterozygous deletions or mutations cause a dominantly inherited disorder with hyperphagia, increased growth and increased lean mass closely resembling MC4R deficiency.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: SIM1 결핍이 있는 일부 소아는 말과 언어 지연, 학습 곤란, 자폐스펙트럼장애, 감정 기복을 보여요.
statement_en: Some children with SIM1 deficiency have speech and language delay, learning difficulties, autistic spectrum disorder and emotional lability.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: SIM1은 MC4R이 발현되는 시상하부 실방핵의 발달을 조절하고 이 실방핵에는 옥시토신 신경도 있어서 일부 행동 특징을 설명해 줄 수 있어요.
statement_en: SIM1 regulates development of the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus where MC4R is expressed, and the paraventricular nucleus also contains oxytocin neurons, which may explain some behavioural features.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: MC4R 신경이나 그 하류에서 작용하는 유전자로는 MRAP2, ADCY3, OTP, BDNF, NTRK2, SH2B1이 있어요.
statement_en: Genes acting on MC4R neurons or downstream of MC4R include MRAP2, ADCY3, OTP, BDNF, NTRK2 and SH2B1.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 여러 유전성 비만 증후군은 침투도가 일정하지 않고 멘델 방식으로 늘 분리되지도 않는 드문 변이 때문에 생겨서 보인자라고 항상 비만이 되지는 않아요.
statement_en: Several genetic obesity syndromes are caused by rare variants of variable penetrance that do not always segregate in a Mendelian manner, so carriers may not always have obesity.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군을 찾아내고 규명한 연구들은 먹는 행동에 강한 생물학적 바탕이 있어서 단순히 의지로만 조절되지 않는다는 사실을 보여 줘요.
statement_en: Discovery and characterisation of the genetic obesity syndromes shows that eating behaviour has a strong biological basis and is not simply under voluntary control.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 11
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 배고픔과 포만, 음식 보상을 알리는 뇌 중추는 음식의 모습과 냄새, 맛 같은 바깥 신호와 지방·장에서 나오는 호르몬 같은 안쪽 신호에 모두 반응해서 식욕은 타고나기도 하고 배우기도 해요.
statement_en: Brain centres which signal hunger, satiety and food reward respond to both external cues such as the sight, smell and taste of food and internal cues such as adipose- and gut-derived hormones, so appetite is both innate and learned.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 11
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군에 부적응 행동이 자주 따라오는 이유는 체중을 조절하는 시상하부 회로가 공포 반응과 위협에 대한 방어, 사회성, 각성과 경계를 담당하는 뇌 경로와 이어져 있기 때문이에요.
statement_en: Genetic obesity syndromes are often associated with maladaptive behaviour because hypothalamic weight-regulating circuits connect to brain pathways for fear response, defensive response to threats, socialisation, arousal and alertness.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: BDNF와 TrkB, SH2B1이 망가지면 공격성과 과잉행동이, SIM1과 OTP가 망가지면 자폐 성향과 감정 기복이, HTR2C가 망가지면 사회불안과 공격성, 과잉행동이 나타날 수 있어요.
statement_en: Disruption of BDNF, TrkB and SH2B1 can cause aggression and hyperactivity, SIM1 and OTP can cause autistic traits and emotional lability, and HTR2C can cause social anxiety, aggression and hyperactivity.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 이 시상하부 행동 경로를 겨냥한 체중 감량 약은 기분과 불안에 영향을 줄 수 있고 같은 경로를 겨냥하는 우울, 불안, 정신병 치료제는 식욕과 체중에 영향을 주는 경우가 많아요.
statement_en: Weight loss drugs which target hypothalamic behaviour pathways can affect mood and anxiety, and drugs for depression, anxiety and psychosis which target these pathways often affect appetite and weight.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리증후군은 상염색체 우성 질환으로 각인된 부계 15번 염색체의 15q11~q13 부위가 결실되면서 흔히 생겨요.
statement_en: Prader-Willi syndrome is an autosomal dominant disorder commonly caused by deletion of part of the paternal copy of chromosome 15, at 15q11 to q13, which is imprinted.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리증후군 환자의 20%까지는 부계 15번 염색체 전체가 없고 모계 사본만 두 개인 모계 단친이체성을 보여요.
statement_en: Up to 20% of patients with Prader-Willi syndrome have deletion of the entire paternal chromosome 15 with two maternal copies, known as uniparental maternal disomy.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리 부위는 부모에게서 온 대립유전자의 DNA 메틸화가 달라서 결실이 확인되지 않으면 메틸화 검사를 해야 해요.
statement_en: Because parental alleles differ in DNA methylation in the Prader-Willi region, DNA methylation studies should be performed where deletions are not identified.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리증후군의 영아기 징후는 낮은 출생 체중과 근긴장저하, 빨기와 수유의 어려움, 성장 부진, 얼굴 기형, 작은 손발이에요.
statement_en: Infancy signs of Prader-Willi syndrome are low birth weight, hypotonia, poor sucking and feeding, failure to thrive, facial dysmorphism and small hands and feet.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
