refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아기에 드러나는 프래더윌리증후군의 추가 특징은 과식증과 비만, 성장호르몬 결핍에 따른 성장 저하, 성선저하증, 학습 곤란, 감정 기복, 강박 행동이에요.
statement_en: Additional features of Prader-Willi syndrome emerging in childhood are hyperphagia, obesity, reduced growth in growth hormone deficiency, hypogonadism, learning difficulties, emotional lability and obsessive behaviours.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리증후군에서는 영아기에 잘 빨지 못하고 잘 먹지 못하던 아이가 생후 12개월부터 과식증을 뚜렷하게 보여요.
statement_en: In Prader-Willi syndrome, hyperphagia becomes prominent from 12 months of age after poor sucking and feeding in infancy.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지금의 프래더윌리증후군 관리는 철저한 감독 아래 저열량 식단과 음식 제한, 행동 상담에 초점을 두고 청소년과 성인은 그룹홈에서 지내는 경우가 많아요.
statement_en: Current management of Prader-Willi syndrome focuses on low-calorie diets with rigorous supervision, food restriction and behavioural counselling, often within group homes for adolescents and adults.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 성장호르몬 결핍이 동반된 프래더윌리증후군은 성장호르몬으로 치료할 수 있고 다른 여러 약제의 임상시험도 진행 중이에요.
statement_en: Prader-Willi syndrome due to growth hormone deficiency can be treated with growth hormone, and trials of several other medications are ongoing.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 모계에서 물려받은 GNAS 대립유전자의 돌연변이는 대개 과식증과 소아기 발병 비만을 동반하고 때로는 기초대사량 저하까지 보여서 고도비만 소아의 진단 평가에 GNAS 검사를 넣어야 해요.
statement_en: Mutations on the maternally inherited GNAS allele are usually associated with hyperphagia and childhood-onset obesity, sometimes with a low basal metabolic rate, so screening for GNAS mutations should be part of the diagnostic assessment of children with severe obesity.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: GNAS 질환에서 틀이동 돌연변이는 가성부갑상선기능저하증이라 부르는 여러 특징을 함께 일으키고 미스센스 돌연변이는 성장은 정상인 채 비만만 나타나기도 해요.
statement_en: In GNAS disorders, frameshift mutations often cause multiple features known as pseudohypoparathyroidism while missense mutations may cause obesity alone with normal growth.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: GNAS 질환의 비만은 Gas와 MC4R의 상호작용에서 비롯되고 비만과 연관된 미스센스 돌연변이는 MC4R 신호전달을 떨어뜨려요.
statement_en: Obesity in GNAS disorders is due to interaction of Gas with MC4R, and obesity-associated missense mutations impair MC4R signalling.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 섬모의 형성이나 기능을 망가뜨리는 드문 열성 질환이 비만을 일으킬 수 있는데 바르데비들증후군과 알스트롬증후군, 터비증후군이 여기 들어가요.
statement_en: Rare recessive disorders which disrupt the formation or function of cilia may cause obesity, and include Bardet-Biedl syndrome, Alstrom syndrome and Tubby syndrome.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 바르데비들증후군은 비만과 발달 지연, 손발 이상, 망막 이영양증, 성선저하증, 신장 이상이 특징이고 지금까지 26개 이상의 유전자 돌연변이가 보고됐어요.
statement_en: Bardet-Biedl syndrome is characterised by obesity, developmental delay, hand and foot abnormalities, retinal dystrophy, hypogonadism and renal abnormalities, and is caused by mutations in at least 26 genes reported to date.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 바르데비들증후군 환자는 야맹증이나 발달 지연으로 처음 찾아오기도 하고 이 증후군의 단백질은 렙틴 신호전달에 관여할 가능성이 있어요.
statement_en: Patients with Bardet-Biedl syndrome may present with night blindness or developmental delay, and Bardet-Biedl syndrome proteins may be involved in leptin signalling.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 알스트롬증후군은 영아기부터 심한 시각 장애를 보여서 광선공포와 안진, 간체-원추 망막 이영양증에 따른 중심시력 상실이 나타나고 바르데비들증후군과 겹치지만 다지증과 성선저하증은 전형적이지 않아요.
statement_en: Alstrom syndrome presents with severe visual difficulty from infancy including photophobia, nystagmus and loss of central vision from a rod-cone retinal dystrophy, and overlaps with Bardet-Biedl syndrome, though polydactyly and hypogonadism are not typical.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 알스트롬증후군에서는 청력 손실과 영아기 확장성 심근병증, 간과 신장 기능 이상, 갑상선기능저하, 저신장이 나타나고 지방조직이 잘 늘어나지 못해 생기는 심한 인슐린 저항성이 이른 2형당뇨병으로 이어져요.
statement_en: Alstrom syndrome features hearing loss, dilated cardiomyopathy in infancy, hepatic and renal dysfunction, hypothyroidism, short stature and severe insulin resistance from impaired adipose tissue expandability causing early type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만과 연관된 가장 흔한 복제수변이는 16p11.2 부위에서 나타나는데 BP2-3이라 부르는 약 220kB 크기의 작은 결실 안에 렙틴, 인슐린, BDNF 신호전달에 관여하는 SH2B1이 들어 있어요.
statement_en: The most common copy number variants associated with obesity involve chromosome 16p11.2, where a small deletion of about 220 kB known as BP2-3 includes SH2B1, a molecule involved in leptin, insulin and BDNF signalling.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 16
refs: Bochukova, E.G. et al. (2010). Large, rare chromosomal deletions associated with severe early-onset obesity. Nature, 463(7281), pp. 666-670.

statement_ko: 16p11.2 BP2-3 결실을 가진 사람은 보통 열 살 전에 비만이 시작되고 이른 2형당뇨병과 자폐스펙트럼 행동, 경한 학습 곤란을 보여요.
statement_en: Carriers of the 16p11.2 BP2-3 deletion have obesity with onset usually before age 10, early type 2 diabetes, autism spectrum behaviour and mild learning difficulties.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 2 › slide 16
refs: Bochukova, E.G. et al. (2010). Large, rare chromosomal deletions associated with severe early-onset obesity. Nature, 463(7281), pp. 666-670.

statement_ko: 지침은 비만이 심할 때, 어린 나이에 시작됐을 때, 과식증이나 발달 지연, 행동·내분비 특징, 관련 가족력 같은 임상 단서가 있을 때 유전자 검사를 하도록 권해요.
statement_en: Guidelines suggest genetic testing should be performed when obesity is severe, when it presents in early childhood, and when there are clinical clues such as hyperphagia, developmental delay, behavioural and endocrine features and a relevant family history.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 3 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 진단 알고리듬은 소아에서 BMI 표준편차 점수 3 초과, 성인에서 BMI 40kg/m2 초과로 정의한 고도비만이 다섯 살 이전에 시작된 경우에서 출발해요.
statement_en: The diagnostic algorithm starts from severe obesity defined as BMI more than 3 standard deviations in children or BMI more than 40 kg/m2 in adults, with early onset before five years of age.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 3 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만에 발달 지연이나 학습 곤란, 행동 장애가 함께 있는 소아는 표적 유전자 패널이나 전장엑솜분석과 더불어 핵형분석, 어레이 CGH, 메틸화 검사가 필요해요.
statement_en: Children with obesity plus developmental delay, learning difficulties or behavioural disorders need a targeted gene panel or whole exome sequencing together with karyotype, array CGH and methylation studies.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 3 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군을 의심하게 하는 가족력 단서로는 근친혼이나 다른 가족의 고도비만이 있고 어떤 검사를 쓸지는 지역의 자원과 접근성에 따라 정해져요.
statement_en: A key family history clue for genetic obesity syndromes is a consanguineous union or other family members with severe obesity, and the type of genetic testing chosen is determined by local resources and availability.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 3 › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군은 드물기 때문에 다학제 팀이 있는 전문 센터에서 관리하는 편이 좋고 건강한 식사 조언과 함께 견딜 수 있는 범위의 신체활동을 권해야 해요.
statement_en: Because genetic obesity syndromes are rare, patients should ideally be managed in specialist centres by multidisciplinary teams, with healthy-diet advice alongside encouragement to be physically active as tolerated.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 먹으려는 생물학적 충동이 강할 때 열량 제한은 무척 힘들고 효과를 보기 어려워서 짜인 식사·운동 프로그램도 유전성 비만 증후군에서는 영향이 미미해요.
statement_en: Caloric restriction is very challenging and seldom effective when there is a strong biological drive to eat, and structured diet and exercise programmes usually have minimal impact in genetic obesity syndromes.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: MC4R 결핍이 있는 소아는 MC4R 유전자가 정상인 소아와 달리 병원에서 하는 생활습관 중재로 체중이 줄지 않아요.
statement_en: Children with MC4R deficiency do not lose weight with clinic-based lifestyle interventions, in contrast to children with a normal MC4R gene.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 1
refs: Trier, C. et al. (2021). Obesity treatment effect in Danish children and adolescents carrying Melanocortin-4 Receptor mutations. International Journal of Obesity (London), 45(1), pp. 66-76.

statement_ko: 과식증과 비만이 생물학적 문제라는 점을 설명하면 환자와 가족이 자기 상태를 이해하는 데 도움이 되고 돌봄이나 교육에 관여하는 사람들의 낙인과 차별도 줄일 수 있어요.
statement_en: Explanation of the biological nature of hyperphagia and obesity can help patients and families understand their condition and can reduce weight stigma and discrimination from others involved in their care or education.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군 환자는 모두 비만 합병증을 평가받아야 하고 그 합병증은 진료 지침과 통상적인 진료에 맞춰 관리해야 해요.
statement_en: All patients with genetic obesity syndromes should be assessed for the complications of obesity, which should be managed according to clinical guidelines and accepted practice.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 재조합 렙틴은 렙틴 결핍에 허가된 매우 효과적인 치료이지만 일부 환자에서 중화항체가 생겨 사용이 제한되기도 해요.
statement_en: Recombinant leptin is a licensed and very effective treatment for leptin deficiency, though neutralising antibodies develop in some patients and can limit its use.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 2
refs: Kuhnen, P. et al. (2016). Proopiomelanocortin Deficiency Treated with a Melanocortin-4 Receptor Agonist. New England Journal of Medicine, 375(3), pp. 240-246.

statement_ko: 셋멜라노타이드 같은 MC4R 작용제는 렙틴 수용체 결핍과 POMC·PCSK1 결핍, 바르데비들증후군에 쓰이고 MC1 수용체 작용에 따른 색소침착이 주된 이상반응이에요.
statement_en: MC4R agonists such as setmelanotide are used in leptin receptor deficiency, POMC and PCSK1 deficiency and Bardet-Biedl syndrome, with pigmentation from MC1 receptor action as the main adverse effect.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 2
refs: Clement, K. et al. (2020). Efficacy and safety of setmelanotide, an MC4R agonist, in individuals with severe obesity due to LEPR or POMC deficiency: single-arm, open-label, multicentre, phase 3 trials. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 8(12), pp. 960-970.

statement_ko: GLP-1 수용체 작용제와 유사체는 MC4R 결핍에 허가되지는 않았지만 유전성 비만 증후군에서 효과가 있어 보이고 이상반응으로는 오심과 구토, 복부 불편감이 있어요.
statement_en: GLP-1 receptor agonists and analogues are not licensed for MC4R deficiency but appear effective in genetic obesity syndromes, with nausea, vomiting and abdominal discomfort as adverse effects.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 2
refs: Clement, K. et al. (2018). MC4R agonism promotes durable weight loss in patients with leptin receptor deficiency. Nature Medicine, 24(5), pp. 551-555.

statement_ko: 유전성 비만 증후군에는 과식증과 비만을 밀어붙이는 기전 자체를 겨냥한 치료가 여전히 필요해요.
statement_en: Therapies which target the mechanisms driving hyperphagia and obesity are still needed for genetic obesity syndromes.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만대사수술은 원인을 다루지 못하고 효과가 없거나 미미한 경우가 많으며 심한 과식증이 계속되면 상태를 악화시킬 수 있어서 유전성 비만 증후군 환자에게 일반적으로 권하지 않아요.
statement_en: Bariatric surgery is not generally recommended for patients with genetic obesity syndromes because it does not address the cause, often has minimal or no effect, and can worsen clinical condition when severe hyperphagia persists.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리증후군 환자가 비만대사수술 뒤 사망한 사례가 보고돼 있어요.
statement_en: Deaths in patients with Prader-Willi syndrome after bariatric surgery have been reported.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 수술 원칙의 예외는 MC4R 결핍인데 이형접합 돌연변이를 가진 사람에게는 위소매절제술과 루와이 우회술이 효과가 있고 MC4R 유전자가 정상인 사람과 비슷한 감량 반응을 보여요.
statement_en: The exception to the surgical rule is MC4R deficiency, where sleeve gastrectomy and Roux-en-Y bypass are effective in people with heterozygous mutations, who show a comparable weight loss response to those with a normal MC4R gene.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: MC4R 동형접합 돌연변이를 가진 사람은 루와이 우회술 뒤에도 체중이 줄지 않아서 이 수술은 권하지 않아요.
statement_en: People with homozygous mutations in MC4R do not lose weight after Roux-en-Y bypass, so this procedure is not recommended for them.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Section 4 › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만은 복잡한 질환이고 사회적 요인과 환경, 유전 요인이 서로 맞물리면서 생겨요.
statement_en: Obesity is complex and arises from the interaction of social factors, the environment and genetic factors.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 고도비만은 유전 요인이 강하게 이끌고 유전자는 체중 스펙트럼 전체를 조절하며 마른 체형 역시 유전돼요.
statement_en: Severe obesity is strongly driven by genetic factors, genes regulate weight across the whole spectrum, and thinness is also heritable.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만을 이끄는 가장 큰 요인은 식욕의 중추 조절이 무너지는 것이고 이 식욕은 타고난 행동이자 학습된 행동이에요.
statement_en: The principal driver of obesity is a failure of the central control of appetite, which is both an innate and a learned behaviour.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전자 검사가 널리 쓰이면서 유전성 비만 증후군의 종류와 유병률은 더 늘어날 가능성이 크고 새로운 치료가 나오는 만큼 전문 진료 체계도 필요해요.
statement_en: The number and prevalence of genetic obesity syndromes is likely to increase as genetic testing becomes more accessible, and specialist clinical services are needed particularly as new therapies emerge.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: BMI 유전율의 상당 부분은 아직 설명되지 않았고 흔한 변이와 드문 변이가 함께 비만에 기여하는 유전자가 더 발견될 가능성이 커요.
statement_en: A significant proportion of the heritability of BMI is still unexplained, and additional genes in which both common and rare variants contribute to obesity are likely to be identified.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전 연구의 발견은 환자에게 임상적 이득을 주는 동시에 질병 기전을 이해하게 해 주고 체중 감량 치료의 새로운 표적을 찾아 검증해 줘요.
statement_en: Alongside clinical benefits to patients, genetic discoveries provide insights into disease mechanisms and identify and validate new targets for weight loss therapy.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 염색체 질환은 여러 유전자를 한꺼번에 망가뜨리는 반면 흔한 유전 변이가 BMI에 주는 영향은 작고 드문 변이라고 침투도가 늘 완전하지도 않아요.
statement_en: Chromosomal disorders often disrupt multiple genes, whereas common genetic variants have only a small effect on BMI and rare genetic variants are not always fully penetrant.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Assessment › item 1
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프래더윌리증후군과 가성부갑상선기능저하증은 각인 증후군이지만 바르데비들증후군은 각인 질환이 아니에요.
statement_en: Prader-Willi syndrome and pseudohypoparathyroidism are imprinted syndromes, whereas Bardet-Biedl syndrome is not imprinted.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Assessment › item 2
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 성선저하증은 렙틴 결핍과 렙틴 수용체 결핍의 특징이고 16p11.2 결실 환자에게는 신경행동 특징이 흔하며 과식증은 대부분의 유전성 비만 증후군에서 주요 특징이에요.
statement_en: Hypogonadism is a feature of leptin and leptin receptor deficiency, neurobehavioural features are common in patients with chromosome 16p11.2 deletions, and hyperphagia is a major feature of most genetic obesity syndromes.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Assessment › item 3
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 선형 성장이 정상이라고 해서 가성부갑상선기능저하증을 배제할 수는 없어요.
statement_en: Normal linear growth does not exclude pseudohypoparathyroidism.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Assessment › item 3
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 일부 유전성 비만 증후군에서는 TSH가 높게 나올 수 있고 혈장 프로인슐린이 높으면 PCSK1 결핍을 의심할 수 있어요.
statement_en: A high TSH level may be seen in some genetic obesity syndromes, and high plasma proinsulin is suggestive of PCSK1 deficiency.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Assessment › item 4
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 위밴드술은 유전성 비만 질환에서 대체로 효과가 없어요.
statement_en: Gastric banding is usually not effective in genetic obesity disorders.
source: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity › Assessment › item 5
refs: SCOPE Genetics and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 2023년 NAFLD 명명법 합의그룹이 간 지방증의 모든 원인을 아우르는 상위 용어로 '지방간질환(SLD)'을 채택했어요.
statement_en: In 2023 the NAFLD Nomenclature Consensus Group adopted 'steatotic liver disease' (SLD) as the umbrella term covering all causes of hepatic steatosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 1
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

Kanwal, F. et al. (2023). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: Update and impact of new nomenclature on the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases practice guidance on nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 79(5), pp. 1212-1219.

statement_ko: 2023년 명명법 합의는 네 차례의 델파이 투표와 약 3,000건의 의견을 거쳐 나왔어요.
statement_en: The 2023 nomenclature consensus was reached after four Delphi voting rounds and nearly 3000 comments.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 1
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

statement_ko: 2023년 명명법에서 MASLD가 NAFLD를, MASH가 NASH를 대체해요.
statement_en: MASLD replaces NAFLD and MASH replaces NASH in the 2023 nomenclature.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 1
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

Kanwal, F. et al. (2023). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: Update and impact of new nomenclature on the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases practice guidance on nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 79(5), pp. 1212-1219.

statement_ko: 이름을 바꾼 이유는 대사적 기반을 앞세우고 '비알코올성'과 '지방'이라는 말이 주는 낙인을 걷어내기 위해서예요.
statement_en: The names were changed to foreground the metabolic underpinning and to drop the stigma carried by the words 'non-alcoholic' and 'fatty'.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 1
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

statement_ko: MetALD는 MASLD 기준을 만족하면서도 허용 음주량을 넘지만 알코올관련 간질환에는 못 미치는 사람을 담는 새 범주예요.
statement_en: MetALD is the new category for people who meet MASLD criteria but drink more than the allowable limit while still drinking less than would count as alcohol-related liver disease.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 1
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

statement_ko: SLD 분류 각주는 음주 기준을 주당 여성 140~350 g, 남성 210~420 g(하루 평균 여성 20~50 g, 남성 30~60 g)으로 적어 두었어요.
statement_en: The SLD subclassification footnote sets the alcohol limit at a weekly intake of 140-350 g for females and 210-420 g for males, i.e. an average daily intake of 20-50 g female and 30-60 g male.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 1
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

statement_ko: People-First Liver Charter는 3년의 논의를 거쳐 2025년에 나왔고, 전 세계 70개 넘는 단체가 지지했어요.
statement_en: The People-First Liver Charter was published in 2025 after three years of discussion and is endorsed by more than 70 organisations worldwide.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 3
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2025). The People-First Liver Charter. Nature Medicine, 31(7), pp. 2109-2116.

statement_ko: People-First Liver Charter는 'MASLD를 가지고 살아가는 사람', '비만을 가지고 살아가는 사람' 같은 표현을 권해요.
statement_en: The People-First Liver Charter recommends phrasing such as 'people living with MASLD' and 'people living with obesity'.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 3
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2025). The People-First Liver Charter. Nature Medicine, 31(7), pp. 2109-2116.

statement_ko: 사람 우선 언어란 질환보다 사람을 앞세우고, 꼬리표를 붙이지 않고, 중립적으로 말하고, 심각성을 부풀리지 않고, 한계보다 능력을 드러내는 걸 뜻해요.
statement_en: People-first language means putting people before their condition, avoiding labelling, using neutral language, not overstating severity and highlighting abilities over limitations.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 3
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2025). The People-First Liver Charter. Nature Medicine, 31(7), pp. 2109-2116.

statement_ko: 사람 우선 언어는 낙인과 차별을 줄이고, 의료 이용을 늘리고, 진료의 질을 높이고, 치료 시작과 지속 참여를 끌어올린다고 봐요.
statement_en: People-first language is expected to reduce stigma and discrimination, increase health service utilisation, improve quality of care and boost treatment uptake and ongoing engagement.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 3
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2025). The People-First Liver Charter. Nature Medicine, 31(7), pp. 2109-2116.

statement_ko: MASLD는 간 실질의 5% 넘는 부분이 지방증에 영향받고 염증은 없거나 경미할 때로 정의해요.
statement_en: MASLD is defined when greater than 5% of liver parenchyma is impacted by steatosis, in the absence of, or with only minor, inflammation.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 4
refs: Hagstrom, H. et al. (2024). Natural history and progression of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 9(10), pp. 944-956.

Taylor, R. S. et al. (2020). Association Between Fibrosis Stage and Outcomes of Patients With Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. Gastroenterology, 158(6), pp. 1611-1625.

statement_ko: MASH는 간 지방증에 염증과 간세포 팽윤이 함께 있는 상태로, 섬유화는 있어도 없어도 돼요.
statement_en: MASH is defined as hepatic steatosis in combination with inflammation and hepatocellular ballooning, with or without fibrosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 4
refs: Hagstrom, H. et al. (2024). Natural history and progression of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 9(10), pp. 944-956.

Taylor, R. S. et al. (2020). Association Between Fibrosis Stage and Outcomes of Patients With Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. Gastroenterology, 158(6), pp. 1611-1625.

statement_ko: 섬유화가 심할수록 간 합병증과 비대상성, 사망 가능성이 높아져요.
statement_en: A greater level of fibrosis is linked to a higher likelihood of liver complications, decompensation and death.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 4
refs: Taylor, R. S. et al. (2020). Association Between Fibrosis Stage and Outcomes of Patients With Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. Gastroenterology, 158(6), pp. 1611-1625.
Hagstrom, H. et al. (2024). Natural history and progression of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 9(10), pp. 944-956.

statement_ko: MASLD는 과도한 음주나 만성 바이러스간염, 지방증을 일으키는 약물 같은 경쟁 원인이 없는 상태에서 간에 지방이 과하게 쌓인 것을 말해요.
statement_en: MASLD is characterised by excessive fat accumulation in the liver in the absence of excess alcohol intake and other competing liver aetiologies such as chronic viral hepatitis and medications that induce steatosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 4
refs: Hagstrom, H. et al. (2024). Natural history and progression of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 9(10), pp. 944-956.

statement_ko: MASH의 중증도는 사람마다 달라서 섬유화, 간경변, 간세포암종의 정도도 제각각이에요.
statement_en: MASH severity varies between individuals, with varying levels of fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 4
refs: Hagstrom, H. et al. (2024). Natural history and progression of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 9(10), pp. 944-956.

statement_ko: 성인 MASLD의 심장대사 기준은 다섯 가지로, BMI와 허리둘레, 혈당, 혈압, 혈장 중성지방, 혈장 HDL 콜레스테롤이에요.
statement_en: There are five cardiometabolic criteria for MASLD in adults: BMI and waist circumference, glucose level, blood pressure, plasma triglycerides, and plasma HDL cholesterol.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 5
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

statement_ko: 간 지방증에 다섯 가지 심장대사 기준 중 하나만 있어도 MASLD로 진단해요.
statement_en: Hepatic steatosis plus any one of the five cardiometabolic criteria is enough to diagnose MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 5
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

statement_ko: MASLD에서 걱정스러운 점은 당뇨병·심혈관질환과 양방향으로 얽힌다는 것과 섬유화·간경변·간암으로 진행한다는 것이에요.
statement_en: The concern in MASLD is its bidirectional relationship with diabetes and cardiovascular disease, alongside progression to fibrosis, cirrhosis and liver cancer.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Introduction › slide 5
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

statement_ko: MASLD를 가진 사람 중 비만 유병률은 51%, MASH를 가진 사람 중에서는 82%로 추정돼요.
statement_en: The prevalence of obesity in people living with MASLD is estimated at 51%, and in people living with MASH at 82%.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Huang, D. Q. et al. (2025). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in adults. Nature Reviews Disease Primers, 11(1), p. 14.
Targher, G., Valenti, L., Byrne, C. D. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 393(7), pp. 683-698.
Younossi, Z. et al. (2019). Global Perspectives on Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis. Hepatology, 69(6), pp. 2672-2682.

statement_ko: 비만을 가진 사람에서 MASLD 유병률은 58~74% 범위예요.
statement_en: The prevalence of MASLD in individuals living with obesity ranges between 58% and 74%.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Huang, D. Q. et al. (2025). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in adults. Nature Reviews Disease Primers, 11(1), p. 14.
Targher, G., Valenti, L., Byrne, C. D. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 393(7), pp. 683-698.
Younossi, Z. et al. (2019). Global Perspectives on Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease and Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis. Hepatology, 69(6), pp. 2672-2682.

statement_ko: 마른 MASLD 환자 상당수는 '대사적으로 비만한 정상체중' 표현형에 속하고, 내장비만과 고지방·고과당 섭취, 선천대사결함과 연관돼요.
statement_en: A significant number of lean people with MASLD belong to the 'metabolically obese normal weight' phenotype, associated with visceral obesity, high fat and fructose intakes and congenital defects of metabolism.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Albhaisi, S., Chowdhury, A., Sanyal, A. J. (2019). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in lean individuals. JHEP Reports, 1(4), pp. 329-341.

statement_ko: 단면연구에서 마른 MASLD 유병률은 7~20%로 추정돼요.
statement_en: Cross-sectional studies estimate the prevalence of lean MASLD at 7-20%.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Albhaisi, S., Chowdhury, A., Sanyal, A. J. (2019). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in lean individuals. JHEP Reports, 1(4), pp. 329-341.
Younossi, Z. et al. (2018). Global burden of NAFLD and NASH: trends, predictions, risk factors and prevention. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 15(1), pp. 11-20.

statement_ko: 마른 MASLD 유병률은 아시아에서 가장 높아 25~30%에 이르러요.
statement_en: Lean MASLD prevalence is highest in Asia, reaching 25-30%.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Albhaisi, S., Chowdhury, A., Sanyal, A. J. (2019). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in lean individuals. JHEP Reports, 1(4), pp. 329-341.
Nomura, H. et al. (1988). Prevalence of fatty liver in a general population of Okinawa, Japan. Japanese Journal of Medicine, 27(2), pp. 142-149.

statement_ko: 미국 백인에서 마른 MASLD 유병률은 10~20%예요.
statement_en: In America, lean MASLD prevalence in Caucasians ranges from 10-20%.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Albhaisi, S., Chowdhury, A., Sanyal, A. J. (2019). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in lean individuals. JHEP Reports, 1(4), pp. 329-341.

statement_ko: 이탈리아에서 마른 MASLD 유병률은 16%로 추정됐어요.
statement_en: In Italy lean MASLD prevalence was estimated at 16%.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Bellentani, S. et al. (2000). Prevalence of and risk factors for hepatic steatosis in Northern Italy. Annals of Internal Medicine, 132(2), pp. 112-117.

statement_ko: 마른 MASLD 추정치가 크게 갈리는 이유는 진단법과 기준, 연구 설계의 차이, 그리고 실제 지역 차이 때문이에요.
statement_en: Differing diagnostic methods and criteria, study designs and true regional differences explain most of the variation in lean MASLD estimates.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 1
refs: Albhaisi, S., Chowdhury, A., Sanyal, A. J. (2019). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in lean individuals. JHEP Reports, 1(4), pp. 329-341.

statement_ko: MASLD는 전 세계 성인의 33% 넘게, 그러니까 성인 세 명 중 한 명 넘게 앓는 것으로 추정돼요.
statement_en: MASLD is estimated to affect more than 33% of adults globally, i.e. more than one in three adults.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 2
refs: Riazi, K. et al. (2022). The prevalence and incidence of NAFLD worldwide: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 7(9), pp. 851-861.

statement_ko: 전 세계 MASLD 유병률은 높고 계속 오르는 중이라, 예방과 치료·관리로 손대지 않으면 더 늘 것으로 전망돼요.
statement_en: Global MASLD prevalence is high and rising, and is projected to keep increasing unless addressed through prevention, treatment and care.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 7
refs: Riazi, K. et al. (2022). The prevalence and incidence of NAFLD worldwide: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 7(9), pp. 851-861.

statement_ko: HIV를 가진 사람의 MASLD 유병률은 일반 인구만큼 높거나 더 높아서, 다른 질환으로 이미 진료받는 집단도 간 위험이 크다는 걸 보여줘요.
statement_en: MASLD prevalence in people living with HIV is just as high or higher than in the general population, showing that groups already in care for another condition still carry high liver risk.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 7
refs: Manzano-Nunez, R. et al. (2023). Uncovering the NAFLD burden in people living with HIV from high- and middle-income nations: a meta-analysis with a data gap from Subsaharan Africa. Journal of the International AIDS Society, 26(3), e26072.

statement_ko: 비만을 가진 사람이라면 누구나 간섬유화나 MASH, 간경변이 있는지 비침습 검사로 확인해야 해요.
statement_en: Anyone living with obesity should have a non-invasive test to determine whether they have liver fibrosis, MASH or cirrhosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 7
refs: Riazi, K. et al. (2022). The prevalence and incidence of NAFLD worldwide: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 7(9), pp. 851-861.

statement_ko: MASLD는 비만의 대사 합병증 가운데 하나로 인정받고, 2024년 Lancet 세미나에서 비만 체계 안에 '대사 합병증'으로 들어갔어요.
statement_en: MASLD is recognised as one of the metabolic complications of obesity and was included in the obesity framework as a 'metabolic complication' in the 2024 Lancet seminar.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 3
refs: Lingvay, I. et al. (2024). Obesity in adults. Lancet, 404(10456), pp. 972-987.

statement_ko: 비만과 MASLD를 함께 가지면 삶의 질과 사회적 안녕감이 더 떨어져요.
statement_en: Having obesity together with MASLD further reduces quality of life and social well-being.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 3
refs: Lingvay, I. et al. (2024). Obesity in adults. Lancet, 404(10456), pp. 972-987.

statement_ko: 전문가들은 MASLD를 대사증후군의 간 발현으로 자주 설명하고, 인과관계는 논쟁 중이지만 MASLD와 다른 대사질환이 함께 나타난다는 건 분명해요.
statement_en: Experts often describe MASLD as the hepatic manifestation of metabolic syndrome, and although causality is debated, MASLD and the other metabolic conditions often occur together.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 4
refs: Yip, T. C. et al. (2022). Geographical similarity and differences in the burden and genetic predisposition of NAFLD. Hepatology, 77(4):1404-142

statement_ko: MASLD는 심혈관질환, 만성콩팥병, 일부 암, 내분비질환, 폐쇄성 수면무호흡, 정신질환, 갑상선기능저하증, 근감소증, 골다공증, 건선과 함께 잘 나타나요.
statement_en: MASLD is commonly found together with cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease, some cancers, endocrine disorders, obstructive sleep apnoea, psychiatric disorders, hypothyroidism, sarcopenia, osteoporosis and psoriasis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 4
refs: Yip, T. C. et al. (2022). Geographical similarity and differences in the burden and genetic predisposition of NAFLD. Hepatology, 77(4):1404-142

statement_ko: 체계적 문헌고찰·메타분석에서 2형당뇨병을 가진 사람의 65%가 MASLD를 갖고 있었어요.
statement_en: In a systematic review and meta-analysis of people living with type 2 diabetes, 65% had MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 5
refs: En Li Cho, E. et al. (2023). Global prevalence of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in type 2 diabetes mellitus: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis. Gut, 72(11), pp. 2138-2148.

statement_ko: 2형당뇨병을 가진 사람의 32%가 MASH를 갖고 있었어요.
statement_en: In people living with type 2 diabetes, 32% had MASH.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 5
refs: En Li Cho, E. et al. (2023). Global prevalence of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in type 2 diabetes mellitus: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis. Gut, 72(11), pp. 2138-2148.

statement_ko: 2형당뇨병을 가진 사람의 15%가 진행성 간섬유화를 갖고 있었어요.
statement_en: In people living with type 2 diabetes, 15% had advanced liver fibrosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 5
refs: En Li Cho, E. et al. (2023). Global prevalence of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in type 2 diabetes mellitus: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis. Gut, 72(11), pp. 2138-2148.

statement_ko: 앉아 지내는 생활, 과식, 비만, 당뇨병이 있는 사람은 단순 지방증에서 F1~F3 섬유화를 동반한 MASH를 거쳐 간경변까지 갈 위험이 가장 커요.
statement_en: People with a sedentary lifestyle, over-alimentation, obesity and diabetes carry the highest risk of progressing from simple steatosis to MASH with fibrosis stages F1 to F3 and on to cirrhosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 6
refs: Schulz, M., Tacke, F. (2020). Identifying High-Risk NASH Patients: What We Know so Far. Hepatic Medicine: Evidence and Research, 12, pp. 125-138.

statement_ko: 당뇨병은 MASLD·MASH를 가진 사람에서 간경변이나 간세포암종으로 진행하는 독립 위험인자예요.
statement_en: Diabetes is an independent risk factor for progression to cirrhosis or hepatocellular carcinoma in people living with MASLD and MASH.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 6
refs: Schulz, M., Tacke, F. (2020). Identifying High-Risk NASH Patients: What We Know so Far. Hepatic Medicine: Evidence and Research, 12, pp. 125-138.

statement_ko: MASLD가 있는 사람에게 혈당, 당화혈색소, 경구당부하검사로 당뇨병을 선별하는 일은 아주 중요해요.
statement_en: Screening for diabetes with a blood glucose, HbA1c or glucose tolerance test is crucial in people with MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 6
refs: Schulz, M., Tacke, F. (2020). Identifying High-Risk NASH Patients: What We Know so Far. Hepatic Medicine: Evidence and Research, 12, pp. 125-138.

statement_ko: 유전 위험인자와 고령, 남성이라는 점은 MASLD 진행 위험을 높이고, 여성이라는 점은 위험인자가 아니에요.
statement_en: Genetic risk factors, older age and male sex increase the risk of MASLD progression; being female is not a risk factor.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 6
refs: Schulz, M., Tacke, F. (2020). Identifying High-Risk NASH Patients: What We Know so Far. Hepatic Medicine: Evidence and Research, 12, pp. 125-138.

statement_ko: 고령과 철 과부하는 MASLD를 가진 사람에서 간세포암종의 소인이 될 수 있어요.
statement_en: Older age and iron overload may predispose to hepatocellular carcinoma in people living with MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 6
refs: Schulz, M., Tacke, F. (2020). Identifying High-Risk NASH Patients: What We Know so Far. Hepatic Medicine: Evidence and Research, 12, pp. 125-138.

statement_ko: 과음은 섬유화 진행을 빠르게 하고, 진행성 섬유화가 있는 사람은 중등도 음주만으로도 간암 위험이 올라갈 수 있어요.
statement_en: Heavy alcohol intake will likely accelerate fibrosis progression, and even moderate alcohol use may raise liver-cancer risk in people with advanced fibrosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 1: Prevalence, drivers and risks › slide 6
refs: Schulz, M., Tacke, F. (2020). Identifying High-Risk NASH Patients: What We Know so Far. Hepatic Medicine: Evidence and Research, 12, pp. 125-138.

statement_ko: 전 세계 250명 넘는 전문가가 권고안을 담은 MASLD 공중보건 합의문을 냈어요.
statement_en: More than 250 experts from around the world published a global MASLD Public Health Consensus Statement with a set of recommendations.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 1
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Advancing the global public health agenda for NAFLD: a consensus statement. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 19, pp. 60-78.

statement_ko: 국제 합의문은 NAFLD나 NASH 대신 새 용어인 MASLD와 MASH를 쓰라고 권해요.
statement_en: The global consensus recommends using the new MASLD and MASH terminology instead of NAFLD or NASH.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 1
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Advancing the global public health agenda for NAFLD: a consensus statement. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 19, pp. 60-78.

statement_ko: 합의 권고에는 국제 MASLD 로드맵을 위한 연합 구성, 학제 간 협력, 비만·당뇨병을 통합적으로 잇는 실행계획, 투자와 연구, 그리고 이 조용한 질환을 공중보건 위협으로 알리는 일이 담겨 있어요.
statement_en: The consensus recommendations include forming a coalition for a global MASLD roadmap, cross-disciplinary collaboration, action plans linking obesity and diabetes holistically, investment and research, and raising awareness of this silent condition as a public health threat.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 1
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Advancing the global public health agenda for NAFLD: a consensus statement. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 19, pp. 60-78.

statement_ko: 간질환, 당뇨비만, 비만, 암 등 여러 분야의 대표 환자단체가 함께하지 않으면 MASLD를 제대로 다루기 어려워요.
statement_en: Effectively tackling MASLD will not be possible without engaging representative patient groups from the liver field, diabesity, obesity, cancer and beyond.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 1
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Advancing the global public health agenda for NAFLD: a consensus statement. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 19, pp. 60-78.

statement_ko: 약물치료는 MASH 환자 일부에게만 듣고, 식사를 개선하면 결과가 더 좋아지는데 이걸 '영양 연계 약물 도입'이라고 불러요.
statement_en: Pharmacological treatment works in some but not all people with MASH, and outcomes can be improved with an improved diet - an approach called 'nutrition-aligned drug roll-out'.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 2
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2024). Opportunities and challenges following approval of resmetirom for MASH liver disease. Nature Medicine, 30(12), pp. 3402-3405.

statement_ko: MASH에서 당장 줄 수 있는 식사 조언은 당과 소금, 그 밖의 해로운 성분이 많은 초가공식품과 가공식품 섭취를 줄이는 것이에요.
statement_en: The immediate dietary advice for MASH is to cut intake of ultra-processed and even processed foods, which carry too much sugar, too much salt and other unhealthy ingredients.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 2
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2024). Opportunities and challenges following approval of resmetirom for MASH liver disease. Nature Medicine, 30(12), pp. 3402-3405.

statement_ko: 지방간을 가진 사람을 볼 때 최소한의 대사 검사에는 고혈당, 이상지질혈증, 고혈압, 비만 평가가 들어가야 해요.
statement_en: When a clinician sees someone with hepatic steatosis, the minimum metabolic work-up should include assessment of hyperglycaemia, dyslipidaemia, hypertension and obesity.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 3
refs: Huang, D. Q. et al. (2025). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in adults. Nature Reviews Disease Primers, 11(1), p. 14.

statement_ko: 진료지침은 비만이나 당뇨병을 가진 사람에게 MASLD 간섬유화를 정기적으로 평가하도록 인정하고 있어요.
statement_en: Clinical practice guidelines recognise routine assessment for MASLD liver fibrosis in people living with obesity and/or diabetes.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 3
refs: Huang, D. Q. et al. (2025). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in adults. Nature Reviews Disease Primers, 11(1), p. 14.

statement_ko: 간경변이 있으면 간암 선별검사도 도움이 돼요.
statement_en: In the case of cirrhosis there is also benefit from screening for liver cancers.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 3
refs: Huang, D. Q. et al. (2025). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in adults. Nature Reviews Disease Primers, 11(1), p. 14.

statement_ko: MASLD와 대사질환의 연관을 인정하는 것이 간과 동반 대사질환에 함께 도움이 되는 치료, 즉 집중 생활습관 중재와 간 특이·대사 약물, 비만대사수술을 권하는 근거예요.
statement_en: Recognising the MASLD-metabolic association is the basis for recommending treatments that benefit both the liver and the concurrent metabolic conditions: intensive lifestyle interventions, liver-specific and metabolic drugs, and bariatric surgery.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 3
refs: Huang, D. Q. et al. (2025). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in adults. Nature Reviews Disease Primers, 11(1), p. 14.

statement_ko: ADA 2025 MASLD 치료 알고리듬에서 F0와 F1은 경미하거나 없는 섬유화, F2는 중등도 섬유화, F3는 진행성 섬유화를 뜻해요.
statement_en: In the ADA 2025 MASLD treatment algorithm, F0 and F1 denote mild or no liver fibrosis, F2 moderate fibrosis and F3 advanced fibrosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 4
refs: Cusi, K. et al. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) in People With Diabetes: The Need for Screening and Early Intervention. A Consensus Report of the American Diabetes Association. Diabetes Care, 48(7), pp. 1057-1082.

statement_ko: 섬유화 2~3단계 MASLD에서 약물치료는 일부 나라에서만 가능하고, 미국과 유럽연합에서 두 개 약이 허가됐을 뿐 저·중소득국에서는 이 적응증으로 쓸 수 없어요.
statement_en: For MASLD with fibrosis stages 2 and 3, pharmacological treatment is available in some but not all countries; two drugs are approved in the US and the EU and are not available for this indication in low- and middle-income countries.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 4
refs: Cusi, K. et al. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) in People With Diabetes: The Need for Screening and Early Intervention. A Consensus Report of the American Diabetes Association. Diabetes Care, 48(7), pp. 1057-1082.

statement_ko: 대상성 간경변에서는 안전성 자료가 부족해 개별화된 진료와 면밀한 관찰이 필요해요.
statement_en: Individualised care and close monitoring are needed in compensated cirrhosis given the limited safety data available.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 4
refs: Cusi, K. et al. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) in People With Diabetes: The Need for Screening and Early Intervention. A Consensus Report of the American Diabetes Association. Diabetes Care, 48(7), pp. 1057-1082.

statement_ko: GLP-1 수용체작용제 가운데 MASH의 조직학적 결과를 본 3상 무작위대조시험에서 이득이 보고된 약은 세마글루타이드뿐이에요.
statement_en: Only semaglutide among GLP-1 receptor agonists has been reported to be of benefit in a phase 3 randomised controlled trial with histological outcomes in MASH.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 2: Approaches to treatment › slide 4
refs: Cusi, K. et al. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) in People With Diabetes: The Need for Screening and Early Intervention. A Consensus Report of the American Diabetes Association. Diabetes Care, 48(7), pp. 1057-1082.

statement_ko: 지방간지수(FLI)나 간지방증지수(HSI) 같은 지방증 점수는 간효소와 대사 위험인자로 계산하는데, 정확도가 잘해야 중등도라 개인 진단에는 부족하지만 대규모 역학연구에는 잘 맞아요.
statement_en: Steatosis scores such as the Fatty Liver Index and Hepatic Steatosis Index are calculated from liver enzymes and metabolic risk factors; their accuracy is moderate at best and may be insufficient for individual patients, but they suit large epidemiological studies.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 2
refs: Targher, G., Valenti, L., Byrne, C. D. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 393(7), pp. 683-698.

statement_ko: 복부 초음파는 임상에서 지방간을 진단할 때 가장 흔히 쓰는 방법이에요.
statement_en: Abdominal ultrasound is the most commonly used method in clinical practice to diagnose steatotic liver.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 2
refs: Targher, G., Valenti, L., Byrne, C. D. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 393(7), pp. 683-698.

statement_ko: 간 지방증을 정량하는 최신 기법으로는 감쇠계수(CAP)와 자기공명영상이 있어요.
statement_en: Newer techniques for quantifying hepatic steatosis are the Controlled Attenuation Parameter and magnetic resonance imaging.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 2
refs: Targher, G., Valenti, L., Byrne, C. D. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 393(7), pp. 683-698.

statement_ko: 간생검 조직검사는 간 지방량과 염증·섬유화 정도를 알려주고 다른 간질환도 배제하지만, 침습적이라 초기나 일상 평가에는 맞지 않아요.
statement_en: Histology by liver biopsy gives the amount of liver fat plus the degree of inflammation and fibrosis and can rule out other liver diseases, but it is invasive and unsuitable for initial or routine assessment.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 2
refs: Targher, G., Valenti, L., Byrne, C. D. (2025). Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 393(7), pp. 683-698.

statement_ko: 다른 만성 간질환처럼 MASLD도 아주 늦은 단계에 이르기 전까지는 대체로 증상이 없어요.
statement_en: Like many chronic liver diseases, MASLD is largely asymptomatic until it reaches a very late stage.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 3
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: 일차의료에서 MASLD는 대개 간기능검사 이상이나 영상에서 지방간이 우연히 발견되며 진단되고, 대사 위험인자에 근거한 표적 평가로 진단되는 경우도 늘고 있어요.
statement_en: In primary care, MASLD is commonly diagnosed through incidental findings of abnormal liver blood tests or fatty liver on imaging, and increasingly through targeted assessment based on metabolic risk factors.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 3
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: 황달, 우상복부 통증, 복부 팽만, 발목 부종은 흔히 간경변으로의 진행이나 간암 발생을 뜻해요.
statement_en: Jaundice, right upper quadrant pain, abdominal distension and ankle oedema often signify progression to liver cirrhosis or development of liver cancer.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 3
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: 정맥류 출혈이나 간성뇌증 같은 비대상성 간질환으로 급성으로 오는 경우도 있는데, 이때 이환율과 사망률이 높아요.
statement_en: People may present acutely with decompensated liver disease such as variceal haemorrhage and hepatic encephalopathy, which carry high morbidity and mortality.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 3
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: 검사실에서 자동으로 이어지는 반사검사인 '지능형 간기능검사'는 스코틀랜드에서 이미 돌아가고 있고 다른 곳에서도 시범사업을 준비 중이에요.
statement_en: Automated reflex testing in laboratories, called Intelligent Liver Function Testing, is already working in Scotland with pilots being prepared elsewhere.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 3
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: 단순 섬유화 점수는 전체 정확도는 보통이지만 음성예측도가 높아 특히 일차의료에서 권장되고, 예후 예측에도 쓰여요.
statement_en: Simple fibrosis scores have modest accuracy overall but high negative predictive values, so their use is especially recommended in primary care settings, and they are also prognostic.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 4
refs: Hagstrom, H. et al. (2020). Repeated FIB-4 measurements can help identify individuals at risk of severe liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 73(5), pp. 1023-1029.

statement_ko: 스웨덴 인구집단 연구에서 FIB-4가 계속 낮은 사람은 간 관련 합병증 위험이 가장 낮았고, 점수가 시간이 지나며 오른 사람은 중등도 위험이었어요.
statement_en: In a Swedish population study, patients with a persistently low FIB-4 had the lowest risk of liver-related complications, whereas those with increasing scores over time had intermediate risk.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 4
refs: Hagstrom, H. et al. (2020). Repeated FIB-4 measurements can help identify individuals at risk of severe liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 73(5), pp. 1023-1029.

statement_ko: 그 연구에서 중증 간질환은 새로 생긴 간경변, 간부전, 간세포암종, 간이식, 비대상성 간질환, 간 관련 사망으로 정의했어요.
statement_en: In that study severe liver disease was defined as incident cirrhosis, liver failure, hepatocellular carcinoma, liver transplantation, decompensated liver disease or liver-related death.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 4
refs: Hagstrom, H. et al. (2020). Repeated FIB-4 measurements can help identify individuals at risk of severe liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 73(5), pp. 1023-1029.

statement_ko: 단순 섬유화 점수는 35세 미만 환자에서 정확도가 떨어져요.
statement_en: Simple fibrosis scores are less accurate in patients younger than 35.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 5
refs: Sanyal, A. J., Castera, L., Wong, V. W. (2023). Noninvasive Assessment of Liver Fibrosis in NAFLD. Clinical Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 21(8), pp. 2026-2039.

statement_ko: FIB-4나 NAFLD 섬유화 점수처럼 나이를 변수로 쓰는 점수는 65세 초과 환자에서 특이도가 떨어져요.
statement_en: Fibrosis scores that include age as a component, such as FIB-4 and the NAFLD fibrosis score, are less specific in patients older than 65.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 5
refs: Sanyal, A. J., Castera, L., Wong, V. W. (2023). Noninvasive Assessment of Liver Fibrosis in NAFLD. Clinical Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 21(8), pp. 2026-2039.

statement_ko: 섬유화 점수는 간질환 평가를 위해 만들어졌기 때문에 간질환이 없는 사람에게 쓰면 위양성이 더 자주 나와요.
statement_en: False-positive fibrosis score results are more common in patients without liver diseases, because the scores were derived for assessing liver disease.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 5
refs: Sanyal, A. J., Castera, L., Wong, V. W. (2023). Noninvasive Assessment of Liver Fibrosis in NAFLD. Clinical Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 21(8), pp. 2026-2039.

statement_ko: 혈소판감소는 간경변과 문맥압항진의 표지지만, 혈소판 응집이나 혈액질환 같은 다른 원인도 함께 생각해야 해요.
statement_en: Thrombocytopaenia is a marker of cirrhosis and portal hypertension, but other causes such as platelet clumping and haematological conditions must be considered.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 5
refs: Sanyal, A. J., Castera, L., Wong, V. W. (2023). Noninvasive Assessment of Liver Fibrosis in NAFLD. Clinical Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 21(8), pp. 2026-2039.

statement_ko: 비ST분절상승 심근경색으로 입원한 급성 질환 상황에서는 FIB-4가 지나치게 높게 나와 진행성 간섬유화의 위양성 진단으로 이어질 수 있어요.
statement_en: An acute illness such as hospitalisation for non-ST elevation myocardial infarction can push the FIB-4 index too high and cause a false positive diagnosis of advanced liver fibrosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › Assessment Q6
refs: Sanyal, A. J., Castera, L., Wong, V. W. (2023). Noninvasive Assessment of Liver Fibrosis in NAFLD. Clinical Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 21(8), pp. 2026-2039.

statement_ko: 간 경직도 측정을 흔드는 교란요인으로는 음식 섭취, 활동성 간염, 담도 폐쇄, 울혈성 심부전, 아밀로이드증이 있어요.
statement_en: Potential confounding factors for liver stiffness measurement are food intake, active hepatitis, biliary obstruction, congestive heart failure and amyloidosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 6
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 음식을 먹으면 문맥 혈류가 늘어 간 경직도가 올라가므로, 검사 전 최소 2~3시간 금식하고 5분간 가만히 앉아 있어야 해요.
statement_en: Food intake increases portal blood flow and therefore liver stiffness, so patients should fast for at least 2-3 hours before the examination and sit still for five minutes before it.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 6
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: ALT와 GGT 수치는 MASLD의 중증도와 잘 맞아떨어지지 않아요.
statement_en: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT) levels correlate poorly with the severity of MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 7
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: MASLD를 가진 사람의 절반 넘게는 ALT가 정상일 수 있어요.
statement_en: Over half of people living with MASLD can have a normal ALT level.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 7
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: GGT는 음주로도 올라가고 대개 비특이적이에요.
statement_en: GGT can be induced by alcohol and is often non-specific.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 7
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: AST는 간세포의 미토콘드리아에 있어 진행성 간질환에서 유독 많이 올라가고, 그래서 여러 섬유화 점수가 AST를 넣어요.
statement_en: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) sits in the mitochondria of hepatocytes and is elevated disproportionately in advanced liver disease, which is why several fibrosis scores include it.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 7
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: 모듈이 든 AST 포함 섬유화 점수는 APRI, FIB-4, NAFLD 섬유화 점수예요.
statement_en: The AST-containing fibrosis scores named in the module are the AST-to-Platelet Ratio Index, the Fibrosis-4 index and the NAFLD Fibrosis Score.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 7
refs: Newsome, P. N. et al. (2018). Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests. Gut, 67(1), pp. 6-19.

statement_ko: 간 경직도 측정에서 킬로파스칼 값이 높을수록 간섬유화가 있을 가능성이 커요.
statement_en: The higher the kilopascal measurement on liver stiffness measurement, the more likely it is that there is liver fibrosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 8
refs: de Franchis R. et al. (2021). Baveno VII - Renewing consensus in portal hypertension. Journal of Hepatology, 76(4), pp. 959-974.

statement_ko: Baveno VII은 대상성 진행성 만성간질환(cACLD)과 임상적으로 유의한 문맥압항진(CSPH)을 비침습적으로 판정하는 알고리듬을 제시해요.
statement_en: Baveno VII provides an algorithm for the non-invasive determination of compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD) and clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH).
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 8
refs: de Franchis R. et al. (2021). Baveno VII - Renewing consensus in portal hypertension. Journal of Hepatology, 76(4), pp. 959-974.

statement_ko: 간의 지방은 크게 세 곳에서 와요. 음식 섭취, 지방조직에서 나오는 유리지방산, 그리고 새로운 지방생성이에요.
statement_en: Liver fat comes from three main sources: dietary intake, release of free fatty acids from adipose tissue, and de novo lipogenesis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 9
refs: Khan, R. S. et al. (2019). Modulation of Insulin Resistance in Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Hepatology, 70(2), pp. 711-724.

statement_ko: 간 지방의 가장 중요한 공급원은 지방조직에서 풀려나오는 유리지방산이고, 그래서 내장지방이 MASLD와 그 중증도에 큰 영향을 줘요.
statement_en: Release of free fatty acids from adipose tissue is the most important source of liver fat, which explains the impact of visceral adiposity on MASLD and its severity.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 9
refs: Khan, R. S. et al. (2019). Modulation of Insulin Resistance in Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Hepatology, 70(2), pp. 711-724.

statement_ko: 새로운 지방생성은 대부분의 사람에서 간 지방증에 기여하는 몫이 작지만, MASLD가 있는 사람에서는 조절이 풀려 있어요.
statement_en: De novo lipogenesis contributes relatively little to hepatic steatosis in most individuals but is unregulated in people with MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 9
refs: Khan, R. S. et al. (2019). Modulation of Insulin Resistance in Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Hepatology, 70(2), pp. 711-724.

statement_ko: 간에 지질독성 물질이 쌓이면 결국 염증세포가 활성화되면서 섬유화 진행을 밀어붙여요.
statement_en: Accumulation of lipotoxic species in the liver eventually activates inflammatory cells and drives fibrosis progression.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 9
refs: Khan, R. S. et al. (2019). Modulation of Insulin Resistance in Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Hepatology, 70(2), pp. 711-724.

statement_ko: 간섬유화는 주요 간 관련 나쁜 결과를 예측하는 핵심 예후 지표예요.
statement_en: Liver fibrosis is the main prognostic indicator of major adverse liver outcomes.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 9
refs: Khan, R. S. et al. (2019). Modulation of Insulin Resistance in Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Hepatology, 70(2), pp. 711-724.

statement_ko: MASLD를 진단한 뒤에는 간섬유화의 비침습 진단에 초점을 둬야 해요. 섬유화가 간질환과 간경변을 잇는 공통 경로이자 간암·간경변 합병증과 가장 강하게 연관된 조직 소견이기 때문이에요.
statement_en: After the diagnosis of MASLD the focus should be on non-invasive diagnosis of liver fibrosis, because fibrosis is the common pathway linking liver disease and cirrhosis and the histological feature most strongly associated with liver cancer and cirrhotic complications.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 10
refs: Wong, V. W. et al. (2018). Noninvasive biomarkers in NAFLD and NASH - current progress and future promise. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 15(8), pp. 461-478.

statement_ko: 제시된 단순 섬유화 점수는 APRI, FIB-4, AST/ALT 비예요.
statement_en: The simple fibrosis scores listed are the AST-to-Platelet Ratio Index (APRI), the Fibrosis-4 index (FIB-4) and the AST-to-ALT ratio.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 10
refs: Wong, V. W. et al. (2018). Noninvasive biomarkers in NAFLD and NASH - current progress and future promise. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 15(8), pp. 461-478.

statement_ko: 특이 섬유화 표지자로는 ELF 패널, Pro-C3, FibroMeter, FibroTest, WFA 양성 Mac-2 결합단백이 있어요.
statement_en: The specific fibrosis markers listed are the Enhanced Liver Fibrosis panel (ELF), Pro-C3, FibroMeter, FibroTest and Wisteria floribunda agglutinin-positive Mac-2 binding protein.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 10
refs: Wong, V. W. et al. (2018). Noninvasive biomarkers in NAFLD and NASH - current progress and future promise. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 15(8), pp. 461-478.

statement_ko: 섬유화 영상검사로는 초음파 탄성도검사(진동제어 일과성 탄성도검사 즉 FibroScan, 2D 전단파 탄성도, 점 전단파 탄성도)와 자기공명 탄성도검사가 있어요.
statement_en: The imaging tests for fibrosis listed are ultrasound elastography (vibration-controlled transient elastography or FibroScan, 2D-shear wave elastography, point-shear wave elastography) and magnetic resonance elastography.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 10
refs: Wong, V. W. et al. (2018). Noninvasive biomarkers in NAFLD and NASH - current progress and future promise. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 15(8), pp. 461-478.

statement_ko: ELF 검사는 영국과 일본 같은 나라에서 비교적 널리 쓰이고, 미국 FDA가 예후 바이오마커로 허가했어요.
statement_en: The Enhanced Liver Fibrosis test is more commonly available in countries such as the United Kingdom and Japan and has been approved by the US Food and Drug Administration as a prognostic biomarker.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 10
refs: Wong, V. W. et al. (2018). Noninvasive biomarkers in NAFLD and NASH - current progress and future promise. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 15(8), pp. 461-478.

statement_ko: 진동제어 일과성 탄성도검사는 두 가지 결과를 줘요. 초음파 감쇠를 재서 간 지방증을 반영하는 CAP와, 전단파 속도로 재서 간섬유화를 반영하는 간 경직도예요.
statement_en: Vibration-controlled transient elastography gives two results: the Controlled Attenuation Parameter, which measures ultrasound attenuation and reflects hepatic steatosis, and liver stiffness measured via shear wave velocity, which reflects liver fibrosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 11
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 일과성 탄성도검사는 피부에 댄 탐촉자가 간 실질을 가로지르는 전단파를 만들고 초음파로 그 파를 쫓아가는데, 딱딱한 매질일수록 파가 빨리 지나가기 때문에 간 경직도와 섬유화를 가늠할 수 있어요.
statement_en: In transient elastography a probe on the skin generates a shear wave across the liver parenchyma and then uses ultrasound to chase it; because waves travel faster in a stiffer medium, liver stiffness and therefore fibrosis can be estimated.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 11
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 0~4단계 척도에서 섬유화가 한 단계 진행하는 데 MASH 환자는 대략 7년, 단순 지방증 환자는 14년이 걸려요.
statement_en: On a scale of stage 0 to 4, it takes roughly seven years to progress one fibrosis stage in patients with MASH and 14 years in patients with simple steatosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 12
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: 섬유화 검사가 정상이지만 위험인자가 계속 있는 사람은 3년마다 검사를 다시 하는 게 합리적이에요.
statement_en: For people with normal fibrosis tests but persistent risk factors, it is reasonable to repeat the tests every three years.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 12
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: 비만이나 2형당뇨병 같은 지표 질환을 가진 사람에게는 해마다 섬유화 검사를 권해요.
statement_en: For people living with indicator conditions like obesity and/or type 2 diabetes, annual fibrosis testing is recommended.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Section 3: Diagnosis and assessment › slide 12
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: MASLD와 MASH의 진료모형을 어떻게 만들지에 대한 지침은 매우 부족해서, 체계적 문헌고찰에서 포괄적 진료모형 사례는 일곱 건밖에 확인되지 않았어요.
statement_en: There is a dearth of guidance on how to develop models of care for MASLD and MASH, and a systematic review identified only seven published examples of comprehensive models of care.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Defining comprehensive models of care for NAFLD. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 18(10), pp. 717-729.

statement_ko: 진료모형은 네 가지 질문에 답해야 해요. 어떤 서비스를, 어디서, 누가 제공하고, 보건의료체계 안에서 어떻게 조율·통합하느냐예요.
statement_en: Models of care should answer four key questions: what services are provided, where they are provided, who is offering them, and how they are coordinated and integrated within healthcare systems.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Defining comprehensive models of care for NAFLD. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 18(10), pp. 717-729.

statement_ko: 문헌고찰은 진료모형의 '무엇·어디서·누가·어떻게'에 맞춘 여덟 가지 권고로 정리됐고, 비침습 검사를 이용한 선별 지침과 질병 단계에 맞춘 환자 중심 경로가 들어 있어요.
statement_en: The review was synthesised into eight recommendations nested within the 'what, where, who and how' of models of care, including guidance on screening with non-invasive tests and patient-centred pathways tailored to disease stage.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Conclusions › slide 2
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Defining comprehensive models of care for NAFLD. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 18(10), pp. 717-729.

statement_ko: 간 진료는 결국 질병 중심에서 사람 중심으로 옮겨가야 하고, 비만이나 2형당뇨병 같은 흔한 동반질환과 건강 관련 삶의 질까지 함께 봐야 해요.
statement_en: Liver care ultimately needs to shift from a disease-centred focus to people-centred care that also considers common comorbidities such as obesity and type 2 diabetes along with health-related quality of life.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Conclusions › slide 3
refs: Lazarus, J. V. et al. (2021). Defining comprehensive models of care for NAFLD. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 18(10), pp. 717-729.

statement_ko: 파트 1 평가문항은 MASLD가 약 20%에서 NASH로 진행한다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The Part 1 assessment states that MASLD progresses to NASH in about 20% of cases.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Assessment › Q1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 간효소가 정상이어도 MASLD나 진행성 간질환을 배제할 수 없는데, BMI 33 kg/m2에 2형당뇨병이 있고 ALT 20 U/L, AST 25 U/L인 50세 여성 사례가 그 예예요.
statement_en: Normal liver enzyme levels cannot exclude MASLD or advanced liver disease, as illustrated by a 50-year-old woman with BMI 33 kg/m2, type 2 diabetes, ALT 20 U/L and AST 25 U/L.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Assessment › Q4
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: BMI 32 kg/m2인 60세 남성에서 CAP 380 dB/m(정상 <248)에 간 경직도 4.2 kPa(정상 <6.0)이면 MASLD는 있지만 진행성 섬유화는 없다는 뜻이라, 대사 관리에 초점을 둬야 해요.
statement_en: In a 60-year-old man with BMI 32 kg/m2, a controlled attenuation parameter of 380 dB/m (normal < 248) with a liver stiffness measurement of 4.2 kPa (normal < 6.0) indicates MASLD but no advanced liver fibrosis, so the focus should be metabolic management.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Assessment › Q7
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: FIB-4 지수는 나이, 혈소판 수, 혈청 AST와 ALT로 계산해요.
statement_en: The Fibrosis-4 index is calculated from age, platelet count, serum aspartate aminotransferase and alanine aminotransferase levels.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 1) › Assessment › Q6
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: MASLD를 가진 사람에서 체중이 늘면 간경변 합병증과 간암 위험이 커지고 연속 탄성도검사에서 간 경직도도 올라갔는데, 체중을 줄이면 그 흐름이 뒤집혔어요.
statement_en: Weight gain in people with MASLD was associated with increased risk of cirrhotic complications and liver cancer and with an increase in liver stiffness measurement on serial elastography, and the trend was reversed with weight reduction.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 1
refs: Shi, Y. et al. (2025). Association between longitudinal weight change and clinical outcome in individuals with MASLD. Hepatology, 10.1097/HEP.0000000000001557.

statement_ko: 비만과 시간이 지나며 늘어난 체중이 MASLD 및 간 관련 합병증과 연결되기 때문에, 생활습관 관리와 체중 감량이 MASLD 관리의 중심이에요.
statement_en: Lifestyle management and weight reduction are central in the management of MASLD, because obesity and weight gain over time are associated with MASLD and liver-related complications.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 1
refs: Shi, Y. et al. (2025). Association between longitudinal weight change and clinical outcome in individuals with MASLD. Hepatology, 10.1097/HEP.0000000000001557.

statement_ko: MASLD와 비만을 함께 가진 환자에서 MASH 관해와 섬유화 개선에는 체중의 7~10%를 넘는 감량이 필요하고, 감량 폭이 클수록 조직 소견도 좋아져요.
statement_en: In patients with MASLD and obesity, a greater than 7-10% reduction in body weight is needed for MASH resolution and fibrosis improvement, and the degree of weight reduction correlates with histological improvement.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 2
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: MASLD의 행동치료에는 스스로 기록하기, 의료진이 자기효능감과 동기를 북돋우기, 현실적이고 조정 가능한 목표 세우기, 장애물 넘기가 들어가요.
statement_en: Behavioural therapy for MASLD includes self-monitoring, clinicians providing self-efficacy and motivation, setting realistic negotiable goals and overcoming barriers.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 2
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: 생활습관 알고리듬이 든 비가공·최소가공 식품의 예는 채소, 과일(주스 말고), 저지방 유제품, 견과, 올리브유, 콩류, 가공하지 않은 생선과 가금류예요.
statement_en: Examples of unprocessed or minimally processed foods given in the lifestyle algorithm are vegetables, fruits (not juice), low-fat dairy, nuts, olive oil, legumes, and unprocessed fish and poultry.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 2
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: MASLD 생활습관 알고리듬에서 건강 체중은 BMI 25 미만(아시아인 23 미만), 과체중은 25~29.9(아시아인 23~24.9), 비만은 30 이상(아시아인 25 이상), 2단계 비만은 35 이상(아시아인 30 이상)이에요.
statement_en: In the MASLD lifestyle algorithm, healthy weight is BMI < 25 or < 23 (Asian), overweight 25-29.9 or 23-24.9 (Asian), obesity BMI >= 30 or >= 25 (Asian), and class II obesity BMI >= 35 or >= 30 (Asian).
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 2
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: 정상 체중인 MASLD 환자도 건강한 생활습관만으로 간 상태가 좋아지기 때문에, 감량 폭에 매달릴 필요는 없어요.
statement_en: In patients with MASLD and normal body weight a healthy lifestyle still improves the liver condition, and it is unnecessary to focus on the degree of weight reduction.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 2
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: MASH 간경변에서는 근감소증이 자주 발목을 잡고 그 자체가 사망 위험을 높이기 때문에, 단백질을 충분히 먹고 늦은 저녁 간식을 두며 규칙적인 활동으로 근육량을 지켜야 해요.
statement_en: MASH cirrhosis is often hampered by sarcopenia, which is itself associated with increased mortality, so patients should take adequate protein and late-evening snacks and maintain muscle mass with regular physical activity.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 2
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL); European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD); European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO). (2024). EASL-EASD-EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines on the management of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 492-542.

statement_ko: 유산소운동과 근력운동 모두 MASLD를 가진 사람에게 도움이 돼요.
statement_en: Both aerobic and resistance exercise are beneficial for people living with MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 3
refs: Hashida, R. et al. (2017). Aerobic vs. resistance exercise in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: A systematic review. Journal of Hepatology, 66(1), pp. 142-152.

statement_ko: 성인 신체활동 지침은 중강도 유산소운동을 주 150~300분, 또는 고강도를 주 75~150분 이상 하라고 권해요.
statement_en: Physical activity guidelines for adults recommend at least 150-300 minutes a week of moderate-intensity or 75-150 minutes a week of vigorous-intensity aerobic physical activity.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 3
refs: Piercy, K. L. et al. (2018). The Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans. JAMA, 320(19), pp. 2020-2028.

statement_ko: 중강도 활동에는 빠르게 걷기나 배구가, 고강도 활동에는 달리기나 힘든 피트니스 수업이 들어가요.
statement_en: Moderate-intensity activities include brisk walking and volleyball, while vigorous-intensity activities include running and a strenuous fitness class.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 3
refs: Piercy, K. L. et al. (2018). The Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans. JAMA, 320(19), pp. 2020-2028.
