statement_ko: 관절 통증이나 심폐기능 제한으로 유산소운동을 못 하는 환자에게는 근력운동도 MASLD에 도움이 된다고 말해 줄 수 있어요.
statement_en: Patients who cannot do aerobic exercise because of joint pain or limited cardiorespiratory function can be told that resistance exercise is also beneficial for MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 3
refs: Hashida, R. et al. (2017). Aerobic vs. resistance exercise in non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: A systematic review. Journal of Hepatology, 66(1), pp. 142-152.

statement_ko: 신체활동은 인슐린에 반응하는 세 장기, 곧 골격근과 지방조직과 간의 대사를 개선해서 포도당 흡수와 지방 산화를 늘리고 전반적인 인슐린 감수성을 높여요.
statement_en: Physical activity improves metabolism in the three insulin-responsive organs - skeletal muscle, adipose tissue and the liver - enhancing glucose uptake and fat oxidation and improving insulin sensitivity overall.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 5
refs: Razzak, I. et al. (2025). The Role of Exercise in Steatotic Liver Diseases: An Updated Perspective. Liver International, 45(1), e16220.

statement_ko: 간에서 운동은 인슐린 감수성과 포도당 흡수를 올리고, 산화 스트레스와 간내 중성지방, 염증, ALT, 간질환 진행, 간 관련 사망을 낮춰요.
statement_en: In the liver, exercise increases insulin sensitivity and glucose uptake and reduces oxidative stress, intrahepatic triglycerides, inflammation, ALT levels, liver disease progression and liver-related mortality.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 5
refs: Razzak, I. et al. (2025). The Role of Exercise in Steatotic Liver Diseases: An Updated Perspective. Liver International, 45(1), e16220.

statement_ko: 골격근에서 운동은 근육량과 포도당 흡수, 미토콘드리아 기능, 지방 산화를 늘려요.
statement_en: In skeletal muscle, exercise increases muscle mass, glucose uptake, mitochondrial function and fat oxidation.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 5
refs: Razzak, I. et al. (2025). The Role of Exercise in Steatotic Liver Diseases: An Updated Perspective. Liver International, 45(1), e16220.

statement_ko: 지방조직에서 운동은 인슐린 감수성과 지방분해를 올리고 내장지방과 GLP-1 저항을 줄여요.
statement_en: In adipose tissue, exercise increases insulin sensitivity and lipolysis and reduces visceral adiposity and GLP-1 resistance.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 5
refs: Razzak, I. et al. (2025). The Role of Exercise in Steatotic Liver Diseases: An Updated Perspective. Liver International, 45(1), e16220.

statement_ko: 현행 유럽 지침은 MASLD 환자에게 지중해식을 우선 권하되, 오래 따라갈 수 있게 지역 문화와 구할 수 있는 재료에 맞춰 조정하라고 해요.
statement_en: Current European guidelines recommend the Mediterranean diet as the preferred diet in patients with MASLD, with adaptation to local culture and availability so people can follow it long term.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 6
refs: Pekarska, K. et al. (2025). Nutrition in MASLD: a patient focused, evidence-guide. Frontline Gastroenterology, doi: 10.1136/flgastro-2025-103183.

statement_ko: MASLD에서 지중해식의 초점은 콩류와 다불포화지방, 식물성 기름 섭취에 있어요.
statement_en: The Mediterranean diet focus in MASLD is on consumption of legumes, polyunsaturated fat and plant-based oil.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 6
refs: Pekarska, K. et al. (2025). Nutrition in MASLD: a patient focused, evidence-guide. Frontline Gastroenterology, doi: 10.1136/flgastro-2025-103183.

statement_ko: MASLD를 가진 사람에게는 가당음료와 가공·초가공식품을 피하는 것이 강조되고, 최신 미국 지침은 '진짜 음식'을 먹으라고 권해요.
statement_en: For people living with MASLD there is an emphasis on the avoidance of sugar-sweetened beverages and processed and ultra-processed foods, and the latest American guidelines advocate consuming 'real food'.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 7
refs: Pekarska, K. et al. (2025). Nutrition in MASLD: a patient focused, evidence-guide. Frontline Gastroenterology, doi: 10.1136/flgastro-2025-103183.

statement_ko: 섭취한 과당은 거의 전부 간에서 대사되고 새로운 지방생성의 기질이 되어 곧바로 지방증으로 이어지기 때문에, 환자에게 과당 섭취를 줄이라고 권해야 해요.
statement_en: Patients should be advised to reduce fructose consumption because almost all consumed fructose is metabolised in the liver and is a substrate for de novo lipogenesis, leading directly to steatosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 8
refs: Vos, M. B., Lavine, J. E. (2013). Dietary fructose in nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 57(6), pp. 2525-2531.

statement_ko: 여기서 말하는 '과당'은 청량음료나 고과당 옥수수시럽에 든 아주 높은 과당을 뜻하지, 과일 섭취를 말하는 게 아니에요.
statement_en: By 'fructose' the module means the very high fructose content typically seen in soft drinks and high-fructose corn syrup, rather than consumption of fruits.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 8
refs: Vos, M. B., Lavine, J. E. (2013). Dietary fructose in nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 57(6), pp. 2525-2531.

statement_ko: 과당은 초회통과 효과가 큰 단순당이고, 포도당과 달리 그 대사가 인슐린의 조절을 받지 않아요.
statement_en: Fructose is a simple sugar with a high first-pass effect and, unlike glucose, its metabolism is not controlled by insulin.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 1: Lifestyle management › slide 8
refs: Vos, M. B., Lavine, J. E. (2013). Dietary fructose in nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 57(6), pp. 2525-2531.

statement_ko: MASH 약이 신속승인을 받으려면 대개 짝지은 간생검을 쓴 3상 중간분석에서 조직학적 반응, 곧 섬유화 악화 없는 MASH 관해와 MASH 악화 없는 섬유화 개선을 보여야 해요.
statement_en: For accelerated approval a MASH drug typically needs to show a histological response - MASH resolution with no worsening of fibrosis, and fibrosis improvement with no worsening of MASH - at an interim analysis of a Phase 3 programme using paired liver biopsies.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 규제기관이 보는 주요 간 관련 나쁜 결과는 간경변으로의 진행, 간 비대상화, MELD 점수 악화, 간이식, 사망이고, 일부 연구는 새로 생긴 고위험 정맥류도 사건으로 세요.
statement_en: The major adverse liver outcomes of regulatory interest are progression to cirrhosis, hepatic decompensation, progression of the MELD score, liver transplantation and death, and some studies also count development of new high-risk varices.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: THR-베타 작용제인 레스메티롬이 3상 MAESTRO-NASH 중간분석을 근거로 2024년 MASH 치료제로 처음 신속승인을 받았어요.
statement_en: Resmetirom, a THR-beta agonist, became the first drug to receive accelerated approval in 2024 for the treatment of MASH, based on the interim analysis of the Phase 3 MAESTRO-NASH study.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 2
refs: Harrison, S. A. et al. (2024). A Phase 3, Randomized, Controlled Trial of Resmetirom in NASH with Liver Fibrosis. New England Journal of Medicine, 390(6), pp. 497-509.

statement_ko: 레스메티롬 100 mg 매일 투여에서 1년 시점에 섬유화 악화 없는 MASH 관해가 30%에서 나타났고 위약군은 10%였어요.
statement_en: At 100 mg daily, resmetirom produced MASH resolution with no worsening of fibrosis in 30% of patients at one year versus 10% on placebo.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 2
refs: Harrison, S. A. et al. (2024). A Phase 3, Randomized, Controlled Trial of Resmetirom in NASH with Liver Fibrosis. New England Journal of Medicine, 390(6), pp. 497-509.

statement_ko: MAESTRO-NASH에서 MASH 악화 없는 섬유화 개선은 레스메티롬군 26%, 위약군 14%였어요.
statement_en: In MAESTRO-NASH, fibrosis improvement with no worsening of MASH occurred in 26% on resmetirom versus 14% on placebo.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 2
refs: Harrison, S. A. et al. (2024). A Phase 3, Randomized, Controlled Trial of Resmetirom in NASH with Liver Fibrosis. New England Journal of Medicine, 390(6), pp. 497-509.

statement_ko: 갑상선호르몬이 과하면 손떨림과 두근거림, 고혈압이 생겨서 비만이나 MASH 치료로는 쓸 수 없지만, THR-베타는 간에 국한돼 있어 THR-알파 부작용 없이 간 대사를 바꿀 수 있어요.
statement_en: Excessive thyroid hormone can cause hand tremors, palpitations and high blood pressure, so it is not an acceptable treatment for obesity or MASH, but THR-beta is restricted to the liver so THR-beta agonism can alter liver metabolism without THR-alpha side effects.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 4
refs: Sinha, R. A., Yen, P. M. (2016). Thyroid hormone-mediated autophagy and mitochondrial turnover in NAFLD. Cell & Bioscience, 6, p. 46.

statement_ko: 레스메티롬은 식사·운동과 함께 중등도에서 진행성 간섬유화를 동반한 비간경변 MASH 성인에게 조건부 허가됐고, 비대상성 간경변에서는 쓰지 말아야 해요.
statement_en: Resmetirom is conditionally approved in conjunction with diet and exercise for adults with non-cirrhotic MASH with moderate to advanced liver fibrosis, and use should be avoided in decompensated cirrhosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 5
refs: FDA (2024) [reference printed on slide]

statement_ko: 레스메티롬 용량은 체중 100 kg 미만이면 하루 80 mg, 100 kg 이상이면 하루 100 mg 경구이고, 간독성과 담낭 관련 이상반응 경고가 있어요.
statement_en: Resmetirom dosing is 80 mg daily orally for body weight under 100 kg and 100 mg daily for body weight of 100 kg or more, with warnings for hepatotoxicity and gallbladder-related adverse reactions.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 5
refs: FDA (2024) [reference printed on slide]

statement_ko: 레스메티롬은 젬피브로질, 소라페닙, 엘로티닙 같은 강한 CYP2C8 억제제와 함께 쓰면 안 되고, 클로피도그렐 같은 중등도 억제제와 쓸 때는 용량을 줄이며, 사이클로스포린 같은 OATP1B1·OATP1B3 억제제와도 피해야 해요.
statement_en: Resmetirom should not be used with strong CYP2C8 inhibitors such as gemfibrozil, sorafenib and erlotinib, needs dose reduction with moderate inhibitors such as clopidogrel, and should be avoided with OATP1B1/OATP1B3 inhibitors such as cyclosporine.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 6
refs: FDA (2024) [reference printed on slide]

statement_ko: 레스메티롬은 약한 CYP2C8 억제제라서 함께 처방할 때 아토르바스타틴, 프라바스타틴, 로수바스타틴, 심바스타틴의 용량을 줄여야 해요.
statement_en: Because resmetirom is a weak CYP2C8 inhibitor, the dosage of atorvastatin, pravastatin, rosuvastatin and simvastatin should be reduced when it is co-prescribed.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 6
refs: FDA (2024) [reference printed on slide]

statement_ko: GLP-1 수용체작용제는 중추와 위장관 양쪽에서 작용해 식욕과 음식 섭취를 줄이고, 여러 대사 장기에도 이로운 영향을 줘요.
statement_en: GLP-1 receptor agonists work both centrally and at the gastrointestinal tract to reduce appetite and food consumption, and also have beneficial effects on various metabolic organs.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 7
refs: Nauck, M. A. et al. (2026). Glucagon-like receptor agonists and next-generation incretin-based medications: metabolic, cardiovascular, and renal benefits. Lancet, 407(10531), pp. 892-908.

Kristensen, S. L. et al. (2020). Cardiovascular, mortality, and kidney outcomes with GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of cardiovascular outcome trials. Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology, 7(10), pp. 776-785.

statement_ko: 비만과 2형당뇨병 연구에서 GLP-1 수용체작용제가 주요 심혈관 사건과 모든 원인 사망을 줄일 수 있다는 점이 확인됐어요.
statement_en: Studies in obesity and type 2 diabetes have shown that GLP-1 receptor agonists could reduce major adverse cardiovascular events and all-cause mortality.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 7
refs: Kristensen, S. L. et al. (2020). Cardiovascular, mortality, and kidney outcomes with GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of cardiovascular outcome trials. Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology, 7(10), pp. 776-785.
Nauck, M. A. et al. (2026). Glucagon-like receptor agonists and next-generation incretin-based medications: metabolic, cardiovascular, and renal benefits. Lancet, 407(10531), pp. 892-908.

statement_ko: 3상 ESSENCE 시험에서 주 1회 세마글루타이드를 72주 투여한 뒤 섬유화 악화 없는 MASH 관해가 63%, 위약군은 34%였어요.
statement_en: In the Phase 3 ESSENCE trial, after 72 weeks of once-weekly semaglutide, MASH resolution with no worsening of fibrosis occurred in 63% versus 34% on placebo.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 9
refs: Sanyal, A. J. et al. (2025). Phase 3 Trial of Semaglutide in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis. New England Journal of Medicine, 392(21), pp. 2089-2099.

statement_ko: ESSENCE에서 MASH 악화 없는 섬유화 개선은 세마글루타이드군 37%, 위약군 22%였어요.
statement_en: In ESSENCE, fibrosis improvement with no worsening of MASH occurred in 37% on semaglutide versus 22% on placebo.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 9
refs: Sanyal, A. J. et al. (2025). Phase 3 Trial of Semaglutide in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis. New England Journal of Medicine, 392(21), pp. 2089-2099.

statement_ko: ESSENCE에서 세마글루타이드를 받은 환자의 최대 36%가 메스꺼움을, 19%가 구토를 겪었고 4분의 1 정도가 설사나 변비를 호소했는데, 위장관 부작용은 대체로 경도에서 중등도이고 시간이 지나면 나아졌어요.
statement_en: In ESSENCE, nausea occurred in up to 36% of patients receiving semaglutide, 19% reported vomiting, and around a quarter complained of diarrhoea or constipation, with gastrointestinal side effects generally mild to moderate and improving over time.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 10
refs: Sanyal, A. J. et al. (2025). Phase 3 Trial of Semaglutide in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis. New England Journal of Medicine, 392(21), pp. 2089-2099.

statement_ko: 본인이나 가족에게 갑상선수질암 병력이 있거나 제2형 다발성내분비선종증이 있는 환자에게는 세마글루타이드가 금기로 봐요.
statement_en: People with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma, or patients with multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome type 2, are considered contraindicated for semaglutide.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 10
refs: Sanyal, A. J. et al. (2025). Phase 3 Trial of Semaglutide in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis. New England Journal of Medicine, 392(21), pp. 2089-2099.

statement_ko: GLP-1 수용체작용제를 잘 시작하는 열쇠는 신중한 증량이라, 가장 낮은 용량으로 시작해 4주마다 올려 주 2.4 mg이나 견딜 수 있는 최대 용량까지 가요.
statement_en: The key to successful introduction of GLP-1 receptor agonists is careful titration: start at the lowest dose and increase every 4 weeks until 2.4 mg weekly or the maximum tolerable dose.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 11
refs: FDA (2024) [reference printed on slide]

statement_ko: GIP나 글루카곤 수용체까지 겨냥하는 인크레틴 치료제가 개발 중이고, 비만·2형당뇨병에 이미 허가된 GLP-1·GIP 이중작용제 티르제파타이드는 직접 비교에서 세마글루타이드보다 체중 감량이 우수했어요.
statement_en: Incretin therapies that also target glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide or glucagon receptors are under development, and tirzepatide, a GLP-1 and GIP dual receptor agonist already registered for obesity and type 2 diabetes, showed superior weight reduction versus semaglutide in a head-to-head comparison.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 12
refs: Loomba, R. et al. (2024). Tirzepatide for Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis with Liver Fibrosis. New England Journal of Medicine, 391(4), pp. 299-310.
Sanyal, A. J. et al. (2024). A Phase 2 Randomized Trial of Survodutide in MASH and Fibrosis. New England Journal of Medicine, 391(4), pp. 311-319.

statement_ko: AASLD 지침은 레스메티롬과 세마글루타이드가 F2~F3 섬유화를 동반한 MASH에 허가됐고 치료를 시작할 때 간생검이 필요하지 않으며 비침습 검사로 환자를 고른다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: AASLD guidance says resmetirom and semaglutide are approved for MASH with F2 to F3 fibrosis and that liver biopsy is not required for treatment initiation, with non-invasive tests used to select patients.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 13
refs: Chen, V. L. et al. (2024). Resmetirom therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: October 2024 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 81(1), pp. 312-320.
Bansal, M. B. et al. (2025). Semaglutide therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis: November 2025 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 10.1097/HEP.0000000000001608.

statement_ko: 치료 대상을 고를 때 쓸 수 있는 비침습 검사는 진동제어 일과성 탄성도검사나 자기공명 탄성도검사로 잰 간 경직도와 ELF 점수 같은 혈액 섬유화 표지자이고, 유의한 섬유화는 찾되 간경변은 배제해야 해요.
statement_en: Acceptable non-invasive tests for treatment selection are liver stiffness measurement by vibration-controlled transient elastography or magnetic resonance elastography and blood fibrosis biomarkers such as the enhanced liver fibrosis score, and clinicians should identify significant fibrosis while excluding cirrhosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 13
refs: Chen, V. L. et al. (2024). Resmetirom therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: October 2024 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 81(1), pp. 312-320.
Bansal, M. B. et al. (2025). Semaglutide therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis: November 2025 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 10.1097/HEP.0000000000001608.

statement_ko: MRI로 잰 간 지방분율이 30% 이상 상대적으로 줄고 ALT가 17 U/L 절대적으로 떨어지면 조직학적 MASH 활성도 개선과 상관을 보여요.
statement_en: A 30% or greater relative reduction in liver fat fraction measured by MRI and a 17 U/L absolute reduction in ALT correlate with an improvement in histological MASH activity.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 14
refs: Tincopa, M. A., Loomba, R. (2023). Non-invasive diagnosis and monitoring of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(7), pp. 660-670.

statement_ko: MRI 양성자밀도 지방분율은 대부분의 임상 현장에서 일상 검사가 아니라, 이 반응 기준을 실제로 적용하기는 어려워요.
statement_en: MRI proton density fat fraction is not a routine test in most clinical settings, which makes these response criteria hard to apply in the real world.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 14
refs: Tincopa, M. A., Loomba, R. (2023). Non-invasive diagnosis and monitoring of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(7), pp. 660-670.

statement_ko: 간 경직도와 ALT, ELF 점수가 뚜렷이 줄면 좋은 치료 반응으로 보고, 간 상태가 나빠질 때만 치료 중단을 고려해요.
statement_en: A significant reduction in liver stiffness, ALT and enhanced liver fibrosis score counts as a favourable treatment response, and treatment cessation is only considered if the liver condition deteriorates.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 15
refs: Chen, V. L. et al. (2024). Resmetirom therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: October 2024 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 81(1), pp. 312-320.
Bansal, M. B. et al. (2025). Semaglutide therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis: November 2025 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 10.1097/HEP.0000000000001608.

statement_ko: 진동제어 일과성 탄성도검사에서 간 경직도가 40% 상대적으로 줄면 섬유화 개선을 시사하고 앞으로의 주요 간 사건 위험도 낮아진다고 봐요.
statement_en: A 40% relative reduction in liver stiffness measurement by vibration-controlled transient elastography is suggestive of fibrosis improvement and is associated with a reduced risk of future major adverse liver outcomes.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › Assessment Q5
refs: Chen, V. L. et al. (2024). Resmetirom therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: October 2024 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 81(1), pp. 312-320.

statement_ko: 진동제어 일과성 탄성도검사에서 간 경직도가 11.1 kPa로 진행성 간섬유화를 시사하면, MASLD 환자에게 레스메티롬 치료를 시작할 근거가 충분해요.
statement_en: A liver stiffness measurement of 11.1 kPa by vibration-controlled transient elastography, suggestive of advanced liver fibrosis, can sufficiently justify initiation of resmetirom treatment in a patient with MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › Assessment Q4
refs: Chen, V. L. et al. (2024). Resmetirom therapy for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: October 2024 updates to AASLD Practice Guidance. Hepatology, 81(1), pp. 312-320.

statement_ko: FGF21은 췌장에서 베타세포 기능을 높이고, 간에서는 지질독성과 새로운 지방생성, 산화 스트레스, 염증, 섬유화를 줄이면서 지방산 산화를 늘려요.
statement_en: FGF21 enhances beta-cell function in the pancreas and in the liver reduces lipotoxicity, de novo lipogenesis, oxidative stress, inflammation and fibrosis while increasing fatty acid oxidation.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 16
refs: Harrison, S. A. et al. (2024). FGF21 agonists: An emerging therapeutic for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis and beyond. Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 562-576.

statement_ko: 세 가지 FGF21 유사체가 2상에서 MASH 관해와 섬유화 개선에 좋은 반응을 보였고, 프로토콜 준수 분석에서 에프룩시퍼민을 받은 환자의 75%가 2년 안에 섬유화 개선에 도달해 지금까지 보고된 가장 높은 반응률을 남겼어요.
statement_en: Three different FGF21 analogues have demonstrated favourable response in MASH resolution and fibrosis improvement in Phase 2 studies, and 75% of patients receiving efruxifermin achieved fibrosis improvement in two years in a per-protocol analysis - the highest response rate ever reported.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 17
refs: Noureddin, M. et al. (2025). Safety and efficacy of once-weekly efruxifermin versus placebo in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (HARMONY): 96-week results from a multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 2b trial. Lancet, 406(10504), pp. 719-730.
Harrison, S. A. et al. (2024). FGF21 agonists: An emerging therapeutic for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis and beyond. Journal of Hepatology, 81(3), pp. 562-576.

statement_ko: 에프룩시퍼민은 대상성 MASH 간경변에서 효과를 보인 첫 약으로, SYMMETRY 시험은 36주 1차 평가변수를 놓쳤지만 주 50 mg을 2년간 쓴 군에서 MASH 악화 없는 섬유화 개선이 29%, 위약군은 11%였어요.
statement_en: Efruxifermin was the first drug to demonstrate an effect in compensated MASH cirrhosis: the SYMMETRY trial missed its primary endpoint at 36 weeks but reached fibrosis improvement without MASH worsening in 29% on efruxifermin 50 mg weekly for two years versus 11% on placebo.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 18
refs: Noureddin, M. et al. (2025). Efruxifermin in Compensated Liver Cirrhosis Caused by MASH. New England Journal of Medicine, 392(24), pp. 2413-2424.

statement_ko: 인크레틴은 상당한 체중 감량과 심장대사 이득까지 주기 때문에 MASH 치료의 뼈대가 될 가능성이 크고, FGF21 유사체는 일관되고 강한 항섬유화 효과를 보였어요.
statement_en: Incretins are likely the backbone of MASH treatment because they also give substantial weight reduction and cardiometabolic benefit, while FGF21 analogues have shown consistent potent anti-fibrotic effects.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 2: Pharmacotherapy › slide 3
refs: Huang, D. Q. et al. (2025). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in adults. Nature Reviews Disease Primers, 11(1), p. 14.

statement_ko: 비만대사수술은 고도비만에 가장 효과적인 치료이고, 관찰연구에서는 수술 뒤 환자의 3분의 2 넘게 MASH 관해와 섬유화 개선에 이르렀어요.
statement_en: Metabolic and bariatric surgery is the most effective treatment for severe obesity, and in observational studies over two-thirds of patients achieve MASH resolution and fibrosis improvement after surgery.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 3: Metabolic and bariatric surgery › slide 1
refs: Mummadi, R. R. et al. (2008). Effect of Bariatric Surgery on Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. Clinical Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 6(12), pp. 1396-1402.

statement_ko: 현행 유럽 지침은 BMI 기준으로 비만대사수술을 권하고 비만 관련 동반질환이 있으면 더 낮은 BMI에서도 고려하는데, 유의한 간섬유화를 동반한 MASH도 그런 동반질환으로 봐야 해요.
statement_en: Current European guidelines recommend metabolic and bariatric surgery based on BMI thresholds, with surgery also considered at a lower BMI if obesity-related comorbidities are present, and MASH with significant liver fibrosis should be considered such a comorbidity.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 3: Metabolic and bariatric surgery › slide 2
refs: Di Lorenzo, N. et al. (2020). Clinical practice guidelines of the European Association for Endoscopic Surgery (EAES) on bariatric surgery: update 2020 endorsed by IFSO-EC, EASO and ESPCOP. Surgical Endoscopy, 34(6), pp. 2332-2358.

statement_ko: 2023년에 발표된 BRAVES 시험은 루와이 위우회술이든 위소매절제술이든 비만대사수술이 MASH 관해율과 섬유화 개선율을 유의하게 높인다는 1등급 근거를 냈고, 대상자의 기저 BMI는 30~55 kg/m2였어요.
statement_en: The BRAVES trial published in 2023 provided Level 1 evidence that metabolic and bariatric surgery, by either Roux-en-Y gastric bypass or sleeve gastrectomy, significantly increases the rates of MASH resolution and fibrosis improvement, in patients with baseline BMI 30-55 kg/m2.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 3: Metabolic and bariatric surgery › slide 4
refs: Verrastro, O. et al. (2023). Bariatric-metabolic surgery versus lifestyle intervention plus best medical care in non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (BRAVES): a multicentre, open-label, randomised trial. Lancet, 401(10390), pp. 1786-1797.

statement_ko: 생검으로 확인된 MASH 환자에서 비만대사수술은 주요 간 사건과 주요 심혈관 사건 발생을 크게 줄였고, 간 결과에 미친 영향이 심혈관 결과보다 더 커 보였어요.
statement_en: In patients with biopsy-proven MASH, metabolic and bariatric surgery was associated with a dramatic reduction in the incidence of major adverse liver outcomes and major adverse cardiovascular events, with the impact on liver outcomes appearing even greater than on cardiovascular outcomes.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 3: Metabolic and bariatric surgery › slide 5
refs: Aminian, A. et al. (2021). Association of Bariatric Surgery With Major Adverse Liver and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients With Biopsy-Proven Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis. JAMA, 326(20), pp. 2031-2042.

statement_ko: 같은 연구진의 더 최근 보고는 비만대사수술이 대상성 MASH 간경변 환자에서도 주요 간 사건을 줄였다고 밝혔어요.
statement_en: A more recent report by the same group showed that metabolic and bariatric surgery also reduced major adverse liver outcomes in patients with compensated MASH cirrhosis.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 3: Metabolic and bariatric surgery › slide 5
refs: Aminian, A. et al. (2021). Association of Bariatric Surgery With Major Adverse Liver and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Patients With Biopsy-Proven Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis. JAMA, 326(20), pp. 2031-2042.

statement_ko: 지방간질환은 심장대사 위험인자와 음주량에 따라 MASLD, MetALD, 알코올관련 간질환으로 나뉘어요.
statement_en: Steatotic liver disease is divided into MASLD, MetALD and alcohol-related liver disease based on cardiometabolic risk factors and alcohol consumption.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 4: Alcohol consumption › slide 1
refs: Rinella, M. E. et al. (2023). A multisociety Delphi consensus statement on new fatty liver disease nomenclature. Hepatology, 78(6), pp. 1966-1986.

Kanwal, F. et al. (2023). Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: Update and impact of new nomenclature on the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases practice guidance on nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Hepatology, 79(5), pp. 1212-1219.

statement_ko: 환자는 회상 편향과 부정확한 추정, 낙인, 문화·종교적 이유로 음주량을 의도적으로든 아니든 적게 말할 수 있어요.
statement_en: Alcohol consumption may be intentionally or unintentionally underreported by patients because of recall bias, inaccurate estimation, stigma, and cultural and religious reasons.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 4: Alcohol consumption › slide 2
refs: Staufer, K. et al. (2022). Ethyl glucuronide in hair detects a high rate of harmful alcohol consumption in presumed non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 77(4), pp. 918-930.

statement_ko: 모발 에틸글루쿠로나이드를 이용한 연구에서 처음에 MASLD로 진단됐던 환자의 25%에서 중등도 이상의 음주가 확인됐어요.
statement_en: A study using ethyl glucuronide in hair identified moderate-to-high alcohol consumption in 25% of patients originally diagnosed with MASLD.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 4: Alcohol consumption › slide 2
refs: Staufer, K. et al. (2022). Ethyl glucuronide in hair detects a high rate of harmful alcohol consumption in presumed non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 77(4), pp. 918-930.

statement_ko: 전혈 포스파티딜에탄올이 20 ng/mL 미만이면 유의한 음주를 배제하고, 200 ng/mL를 넘으면 알코올관련 간질환 범위의 과음을 시사해요.
statement_en: Whole blood phosphatidylethanol below 20 ng/mL excludes significant alcohol consumption and a level over 200 ng/mL suggests excessive alcohol consumption in the range of alcohol-related liver disease.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 4: Alcohol consumption › slide 3
refs: Torp, N. et al. (2025). Phosphatidylethanol and self-reported alcohol intake to subclassify individuals at risk of steatotic liver disease: an analysis of data from a prospective cohort study. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 10(11), pp. 975-985.

statement_ko: 포스파티딜에탄올은 GGT나 평균적혈구용적 같은 덜 특이적인 표지자보다 낫고 지난 2~4주의 음주를 반영하기 때문에, 채혈 직전의 단기 변화에 덜 흔들려요.
statement_en: Phosphatidylethanol is superior to less specific markers such as GGT and mean cell volume and reflects alcohol consumption in the past 2-4 weeks, so it is less affected by short-term changes before blood taking.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 4: Alcohol consumption › slide 3
refs: Torp, N. et al. (2025). Phosphatidylethanol and self-reported alcohol intake to subclassify individuals at risk of steatotic liver disease: an analysis of data from a prospective cohort study. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 10(11), pp. 975-985.

statement_ko: 포스파티딜에탄올은 인지질분해효소 D가 적혈구 바깥막의 포스파티딜콜린을 바꿔 놓으면서 만들어져요.
statement_en: Phosphatidylethanol is formed when phospholipase D converts phosphatidylcholine on the outer membrane of red blood cells.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 4: Alcohol consumption › slide 3
refs: Torp, N. et al. (2025). Phosphatidylethanol and self-reported alcohol intake to subclassify individuals at risk of steatotic liver disease: an analysis of data from a prospective cohort study. Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 10(11), pp. 975-985.

statement_ko: AUDIT-C는 음주 빈도와 양, 폭음 여부를 묻는 간단한 3문항 설문으로, 해로운 음주를 배제하는 선별검사로 시작하기 좋아요.
statement_en: AUDIT-C is a simple 3-item questionnaire covering the frequency and amount of drinking and any episode of binge drinking, and can be a good start as a screening test to exclude harmful drinking.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Section 4: Alcohol consumption › slide 4
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 생활습관 교정은 여전히 MASLD와 MASH 관리의 주춧돌이에요.
statement_en: Lifestyle modification remains the cornerstone for the management of MASLD and MASH.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 미국에서는 레스메티롬과 세마글루타이드가, 유럽연합에서는 레스메티롬이 F2~F3 섬유화를 동반한 MASH 치료제로 조건부 허가됐어요.
statement_en: Resmetirom and semaglutide have been conditionally approved for the treatment of MASH with F2-F3 fibrosis in the US, and resmetirom in the EU.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: MASH에서는 치료 대상을 가려낼 때도, 치료 반응을 볼 때도 비침습 검사를 써야 해요.
statement_en: Non-invasive tests should be used both to identify patients for treatment and to monitor treatment response in MASH.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 음주량은 자주 축소 보고되기 때문에 지방간질환에서는 늘 조심스럽게 확인해야 해요.
statement_en: Alcohol use is often underreported and should be carefully and routinely examined in steatotic liver disease.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: MASLD 환자는 MASLD로 인한 대상성 간경변이 있는 경우에도 단백질 섭취를 제한하면 안 돼요.
statement_en: Patients with MASLD, including those with compensated cirrhosis secondary to MASLD, should not limit their protein intake.
source: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity › MASLD and MASH (Part 2) › Assessment › Q1
refs: SCOPE NAFLD/NASH and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 대사증후군과 연관된 인자는 내장지방, 높은 중성지방, 낮은 HDL 콜레스테롤, 상승한 혈압, 고혈당이에요.
statement_en: The factors associated with the metabolic syndrome are visceral adipose tissue, high triglycerides, low HDL cholesterol, elevated blood pressure and hyperglycaemia.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 1
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 당뇨병과 이상지질혈증, 고혈압 말고도 대사증후군은 지방간, 담낭질환, 폐질환과 천식 악화, 폐쇄성 수면무호흡과 저환기와도 연관돼요.
statement_en: Besides diabetes, dyslipidaemia and hypertension, the metabolic syndrome is associated with fatty liver, gall bladder disease, pulmonary disease and exacerbation of asthma, obstructive sleep apnoea and hypoventilation.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Weaver, J.U. (2017). Practical Guide to Obesity Medicine. St. Louis. Elsevier.

statement_ko: 비만은 불임과 다낭성난소증후군을 비롯한 부인과·내분비 이상, 그리고 골관절염 같은 역학적 문제와도 이어져요.
statement_en: Obesity is linked to gynaecological and endocrine abnormalities including infertility and polycystic ovarian syndrome, and to mechanical problems such as osteoarthritis.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Weaver, J.U. (2017). Practical Guide to Obesity Medicine. St. Louis. Elsevier.

statement_ko: 대사증후군과 2형당뇨병은 유방, 자궁, 자궁경부, 대장, 전립선 같은 지방 민감성 암의 위험을 이끄는 주된 동력이에요.
statement_en: The metabolic syndrome and type 2 diabetes are principal drivers of risk for the fat-sensitive cancers - breast, uterus, cervix, colon and prostate among others.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Weaver, J.U. (2017). Practical Guide to Obesity Medicine. St. Louis. Elsevier.

statement_ko: 정상상태 혈장포도당으로 잰 인슐린 저항성 삼분위별 임상사건을 그린 연구에서 혈당이 오를수록 고혈압, 암, 관상동맥질환, 2형당뇨병, 뇌혈관사고가 모두 늘었어요.
statement_en: In a study plotting clinical events against insulin resistance tertile measured by steady state plasma glucose, hypertension, cancer, coronary heart disease, type 2 diabetes and cerebrovascular accident all increased as plasma glucose rose.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 3
refs: Facchini, F.S. et al. (2001). Insulin resistance as a predictor of age-related diseases. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 86(8), pp. 3574-8.

statement_ko: 대사증후군 정의는 WHO, EGIR, NCEP-ATP3, IDF 등 여럿인데, 당뇨병·인슐린 저항성·지질·국제 당뇨병이라는 서로 다른 출발점에서 왔으면서도 결국 거의 같은 인자를 짚었어요.
statement_en: There are a number of definitions of the metabolic syndrome, from WHO, EGIR, NCEP-ATP3 and the IDF, which came from different perspectives (diabetes, insulin resistance, lipids and international diabetes) yet identified essentially the same factors.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: WHO 정의는 허리엉덩이비 남성 0.9 초과·여성 0.85 초과, BMI 30 초과, 중성지방 1.70 mmol/L 초과, 혈압 140/90 mmHg 초과, 미세알부민뇨 20 mg/min 초과를 써요.
statement_en: The WHO definition of metabolic syndrome uses waist-hip ratio > 0.9 in men and > 0.85 in women, BMI > 30, triglycerides > 1.70 mmol/L, blood pressure > 140/90 mmHg and microalbuminuria > 20 mg/min.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: EGIR 정의는 허리둘레 남성 94 cm 초과·여성 80 cm 초과, HDL-C 1.00 mmol/L 미만, 중성지방 2.00 mmol/L 초과, 혈당 6.1 mmol/L 초과, 75백분위를 넘는 고인슐린혈증을 써요.
statement_en: The EGIR definition uses waist circumference > 94 cm in men and > 80 cm in women, HDL-C < 1.00 mmol/L, triglycerides > 2.00 mmol/L, glucose > 6.1 mmol/L and hyperinsulinaemia above the 75th centile.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: NCEP-ATP3 정의는 허리둘레 남성 102 cm 초과·여성 95 cm 초과, HDL-C 남성 1.03·여성 1.29 mmol/L 미만, 중성지방 1.70 mmol/L 초과, 수축기혈압 130 mmHg 초과, 혈당 5.6 mmol/L 초과를 써요.
statement_en: The NCEP-ATP3 definition uses waist circumference > 102 cm in men and > 95 cm in women, HDL-C < 1.03 mmol/L in men and < 1.29 mmol/L in women, triglycerides > 1.70 mmol/L, systolic blood pressure > 130 mmHg and glucose > 5.6 mmol/L.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 모듈에 실린 IDF 표에서 허리둘레 기준은 백인 남성 95 cm 초과·아시아 남성 85 cm 초과, 백인 여성 90 cm 초과·아시아 여성 80 cm 초과예요.
statement_en: In the IDF table printed in the module, waist circumference cut-offs are > 95 cm for Caucasian men and > 85 cm for Asian men, and > 90 cm for Caucasian women and > 80 cm for Asian women.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 국제 합의 정의는 중심비만에 나머지 네 인자 가운데 두 가지가 더해질 때 대사증후군으로 진단해요.
statement_en: The International Consensus Definition diagnoses the metabolic syndrome as central obesity plus two of the remaining four risk factors.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 국제 합의 정의의 허리둘레 기준은 남성이 미국 102 cm 초과·유럽 94 cm·아시아 90 cm, 여성이 미국 88 cm 초과·유럽 80 cm·아시아 80 cm예요.
statement_en: In the International Consensus Definition the waist circumference cut-offs are USA > 102 cm, Europe 94 cm and Asia 90 cm for men, and USA > 88 cm, Europe 80 cm and Asia 80 cm for women.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 국제 합의 정의의 HDL-C 기준은 남성 0.9 mM(40 mg/dL) 미만, 여성 1.1 mM(50 mg/dL) 미만이거나 HDL-C에 대한 특정 치료를 받는 경우예요.
statement_en: In the International Consensus Definition the HDL-C thresholds are < 0.9 mM (40 mg/dL) for men and < 1.1 mM (50 mg/dL) for women, or specific treatment for HDL-C.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 대사증후군의 중성지방 기준은 1.7 mmol/L, 곧 150 mg/dL를 넘는 값인데, 그 지점부터 소형 조밀 LDL이 나타나기 때문이에요.
statement_en: The triglyceride threshold for the metabolic syndrome is over 1.7 mmol/L, 150 mg/dL, because that is where small dense LDL appears.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: HDL 기준은 남녀 각각의 낮은 백분위에서 잡고 폐경 뒤에는 남성 기준 범위를 적용하는데, 이 역시 소형 조밀 LDL과 관련돼요.
statement_en: The HDL thresholds are the lower centiles for men and for women, and after menopause the male reference ranges apply; these thresholds are again related to small dense LDL.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 혈압은 조금이라도 올라가 있으면 대사증후군 인자로 세기 때문에 전고혈압도 충분하고, 혈당 이상도 어떤 형태든 인정돼요.
statement_en: Any raised blood pressure counts towards the metabolic syndrome, so prehypertension is enough, and any aspect of dysglycaemia counts.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 1: Defining the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 대사증후군은 관상동맥질환 사망과 2형당뇨병 발병을 예측하는 지표예요.
statement_en: The metabolic syndrome is a predictor of death from coronary heart disease and of the onset of type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 1
refs: Sattar, N. et al. (2003). Metabolic syndrome with and without C-reactive protein as a predictor of coronary heart disease and diabetes in the West of Scotland Coronary Prevention Study. Circulation, 108(4), pp. 414-419.

statement_ko: WOSCOPS에서 대사증후군 인자 수(0, 1, 2, 3, 4~5개)에 따른 관상동맥질환 사망 또는 비치명적 심근경색의 상대위험은 1.00, 1.79, 2.25, 3.19, 3.65였어요.
statement_en: In WOSCOPS the relative risk of coronary heart disease death or nonfatal myocardial infarction by number of metabolic syndrome factors (0, 1, 2, 3, 4/5) was 1.00, 1.79, 2.25, 3.19 and 3.65.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 2
refs: Sattar, N. et al. (2003). Metabolic syndrome with and without C-reactive protein as a predictor of coronary heart disease and diabetes in the West of Scotland Coronary Prevention Study. Circulation, 108(4), pp. 414-419.

statement_ko: WOSCOPS에서 대사증후군 인자 수(0, 1, 2, 3, 4~5개)에 따른 새 2형당뇨병 발생의 상대위험은 1.00, 2.36, 4.50, 7.26, 24.40이었어요.
statement_en: In WOSCOPS the relative risk of new type 2 diabetes by number of metabolic syndrome factors (0, 1, 2, 3, 4/5) was 1.00, 2.36, 4.50, 7.26 and 24.40.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 2
refs: Sattar, N. et al. (2003). Metabolic syndrome with and without C-reactive protein as a predictor of coronary heart disease and diabetes in the West of Scotland Coronary Prevention Study. Circulation, 108(4), pp. 414-419.

statement_ko: 스코틀랜드 중년 남성에서 대사증후군 위험인자가 0개에서 4~5개로 늘면 2형당뇨병 발생 위험이 25배로 뛰었어요.
statement_en: Going from zero metabolic syndrome risk factors to four or five gave a 25-fold increased risk of developing type 2 diabetes in middle-aged Scottish men.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 2
refs: Sattar, N. et al. (2003). Metabolic syndrome with and without C-reactive protein as a predictor of coronary heart disease and diabetes in the West of Scotland Coronary Prevention Study. Circulation, 108(4), pp. 414-419.

statement_ko: WOSCOPS에서 관상동맥질환 위험은 대사증후군 인자 수에 따라 거의 선형으로 계단처럼 올랐고, 당뇨병 위험은 기하급수적으로 올랐어요.
statement_en: In WOSCOPS coronary heart disease risk rose in a roughly linear stepwise manner with the number of metabolic syndrome factors, while diabetes risk rose exponentially.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 2
refs: Sattar, N. et al. (2003). Metabolic syndrome with and without C-reactive protein as a predictor of coronary heart disease and diabetes in the West of Scotland Coronary Prevention Study. Circulation, 108(4), pp. 414-419.

statement_ko: WOSCOPS 코호트는 평균 BMI 29인 스코틀랜드 중년 남성이었고, 연구가 끝날 무렵 약 10%가 2형당뇨병에 걸렸어요.
statement_en: The WOSCOPS cohort was middle-aged Scottish men with an average BMI of 29, and by study end about 10% of the population had developed type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 2
refs: Sattar, N. et al. (2003). Metabolic syndrome with and without C-reactive protein as a predictor of coronary heart disease and diabetes in the West of Scotland Coronary Prevention Study. Circulation, 108(4), pp. 414-419.

statement_ko: 내장지방 측정은 대사 위험의 지표로 쓸 수 있는데, 손쉬운 도구는 허리둘레이고 기준 표준은 MRI나 CT로 복강 내 지방을 재는 방법이에요.
statement_en: Visceral adipose tissue measurements can be used as an index of metabolic risk, with waist circumference the easily available tool and MRI or CT measurement of intra-abdominal fat the reference standard.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 3
refs: Wajchenberg, B.L. (2000). Subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue: their relation to the metabolic syndrome. Endocrine Reviews, 21(6), pp. 697-738.

statement_ko: 허리둘레(104.0 cm와 104.5 cm)와 허리엉덩이비(0.91과 0.92)가 거의 같은 두 CT 사례에서도 내장지방 CT 면적은 92.7 cm2 대 149.4 cm2, 초음파는 6.2 cm 대 8.4 cm로 크게 달랐어요.
statement_en: In two example CT scans with almost identical waists (104.0 cm and 104.5 cm) and waist-hip ratios (0.91 and 0.92), the visceral fat CT surface differed greatly at 92.7 cm2 versus 149.4 cm2 and ultrasound 6.2 cm versus 8.4 cm.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 3
refs: Wajchenberg, B.L. (2000). Subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue: their relation to the metabolic syndrome. Endocrine Reviews, 21(6), pp. 697-738.

statement_ko: '살 한 줌 집어보기'는 내장지방이 아니라 피하지방을 재는 방법이에요.
statement_en: 'Pinch an inch' measures subcutaneous, not visceral, adipose tissue.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 3
refs: Wajchenberg, B.L. (2000). Subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue: their relation to the metabolic syndrome. Endocrine Reviews, 21(6), pp. 697-738.

statement_ko: 남성에서는 배가 앞으로 나온 정도가 내장지방을 가늠하는 가장 좋은 지표이고, 여성에서는 허리와 엉덩이의 일치 정도가 더 나아요.
statement_en: In men the degree of overhang is probably the best index of visceral tissue, while in women the degree of waist-hip concordance is better.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 3
refs: Wajchenberg, B.L. (2000). Subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue: their relation to the metabolic syndrome. Endocrine Reviews, 21(6), pp. 697-738.

statement_ko: 인도계 아시아인처럼 개발도상국 인구는 겉보기에 뚜렷한 중심비만이 없어도 내장지방이 많고 당뇨병 위험이 아주 높을 수 있어요.
statement_en: Populations in developing countries such as Indian Asians can lack gross central obesity yet carry large amounts of visceral fat and have very high diabetes risk.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 3
refs: Wajchenberg, B.L. (2000). Subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue: their relation to the metabolic syndrome. Endocrine Reviews, 21(6), pp. 697-738.

statement_ko: 공복 인슐린과 혈당으로 QUICKI 방식으로 계산한 인슐린 저항성은 한 인종집단 안에서도 뚜렷한 이봉 분포를 보여서, 특정 인종이 그냥 더 인슐린 저항성이 크다는 생각은 지나친 단순화예요.
statement_en: Insulin resistance calculated from fasting insulin and glucose by the QUICKI method showed a clear bimodal distribution within one ethnic group, so the idea that some ethnic groups are simply more insulin resistant than others is a simplification.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 4
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. et al. (2008) Insulin resistance phenotypes and coronary artery disease in a native Pakistani cohort. International Journal of Clinical Practice, 62(5), pp. 701-707.

statement_ko: Sandwell 코호트에서 인도계 아시아인이 영국으로 이주한 뒤 영양과 생활습관이 바뀌며 BMI가 3~4점쯤 올랐고, 비에스테르화 지방산이 위로 이동했으며, 콜레스테롤 특히 중성지방이 늘었지만 ApoB 변화는 비교적 적었어요.
statement_en: In the Sandwell cohort, migration of Indian Asians to Britain was associated with about a three- to four-point increase in BMI from changes in nutrition and lifestyle, an upward shift in non-esterified fatty acids, and increases in cholesterol - particularly triglycerides - but relatively little in ApoB.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 5
refs: Patel, J.V. et al. (2006). Impact of migration on coronary heart disease risk factors: comparison of Gujaratis in Britain and their contemporaries in villages of origin in India. Atherosclerosis, 185(2), pp. 297-306.

statement_ko: 나이와 흡연, 총콜레스테롤, IDF 대사증후군 복합 정의까지 보정해도 남아시아 남성의 초과 관상동맥질환 사망은 남아서, 모델 1의 위험비가 2.04(95% CI 1.47~2.84, p<0.001)였어요.
statement_en: After adjustment for age, smoking, total cholesterol and the composite IDF metabolic syndrome definition, the excess CHD mortality in South Asian men remained, with a hazard ratio of 2.04 (95% CI 1.47-2.84, p < 0.001) in model 1.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 6
refs: Forouhi, N.G. et al. (2006). Do known risk factors explain the higher coronary heart disease mortality in South Asian compared with European men? Prospective follow-up of the Southall and Brent studies, UK. Diabetologia, 49(11), pp. 2580-8.

statement_ko: 심혈관 위험인자와 대사증후군 구성요소, 인슐린 저항성 지표를 모두 보정해도 인도계 아시아인의 초과 관상동맥질환 위험은 사라지지 않아서, 염증이나 지단백 같은 다른 요소를 가리켜요.
statement_en: Adjusting for cardiovascular risk factors, metabolic syndrome components and insulin resistance measures all fail to remove the excess CHD risk in Indian Asians, which points to other components such as inflammation or lipoprotein.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 6
refs: Forouhi, N.G. et al. (2006). Do known risk factors explain the higher coronary heart disease mortality in South Asian compared with European men? Prospective follow-up of the Southall and Brent studies, UK. Diabetologia, 49(11), pp. 2580-8.

statement_ko: 영국은 QRISK-2, 미국은 ASCVD 계산기, 유럽은 SCORE를 쓰는데, 모두 10년 심혈관 사건 위험을 구해요.
statement_en: The UK uses QRISK-2, America the ASCVD calculator and Europe SCORE, and all derive a 10-year cardiovascular risk of events.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 7
refs: Hippisley-Cox, J. et al. (2008). Predicting cardiovascular risk in England and Wales: prospective derivation and validation of QRISK2. British Medical Journal, 336, pp. 1475-82.

statement_ko: QRISK의 두드러진 점은 여러 인종집단에 대해 민족을 보정 인자로 넣는다는 것이고, BMI도 비교적 작은 비중이지만 함께 넣어요.
statement_en: QRISK's distinguishing feature is that it includes ethnicity as a modifier for a number of ethnic groups, and it also includes BMI, though as a relatively minor component.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 7
refs: Hippisley-Cox, J. et al. (2008). Predicting cardiovascular risk in England and Wales: prospective derivation and validation of QRISK2. British Medical Journal, 336, pp. 1475-82.

statement_ko: QDiabetes는 민족과 성별, 흡연 상태, BMI를 주된 예측 인자로 삼아 향후 10년 당뇨병 위험을 계산하고, NICE가 2형당뇨병 예방의 위험평가 도구로 승인했어요.
statement_en: QDiabetes uses ethnicity, gender, smoking status and BMI as principal predictors of future diabetes risk over ten years and is approved by NICE as a risk assessment tool in the prevention of type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 2: Metabolic risk › slide 7
refs: Hippisley-Cox, J. et al. (2009). Predicting risk of type 2 diabetes in England and Wales: prospective derivation and validation of QDScore. British Medical Journal, 338, b880.

statement_ko: 대사증후군의 치료 선택지는 생활습관 교정, 비만대사수술, 약물치료이고 지방흡입은 여기에 들지 않아요.
statement_en: Treatment options for the metabolic syndrome are lifestyle modification, bariatric surgery and pharmacotherapy; liposuction is not one of them.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 당뇨병예방프로그램(DPP)에서는 약 1,000명씩 세 군, 곧 안내문과 조언만 주는 표준진료군, 2형당뇨병에 쓰는 통상 용량의 메트포르민군, 집중 생활습관 중재군에 무작위 배정했어요.
statement_en: In the Diabetes Prevention Program roughly 1,000 patients were randomised to each of three groups: standard care with leaflets and advice only, metformin at doses typical for type 2 diabetes, and intensive lifestyle intervention.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: DPP의 집중 생활습관 중재는 하루 400칼로리를 덜 먹고, 하루 30분 이상 유산소운동을 하는 짜인 프로그램이었어요.
statement_en: The DPP intensive lifestyle intervention comprised a 400 calorie per day cut in intake and a structured programme of at least 30 minutes of aerobic exercise per day.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: DPP에서 집중 생활습관군은 처음 7 kg을 뺀 뒤 4년 시점에 그 절반을 유지했고, 메트포르민군은 1년에 약 3 kg을 뺐다가 4년에는 약 1.5 kg으로 줄었어요.
statement_en: In the DPP the intensive lifestyle group initially lost 7 kg and maintained half of that at four years, while the metformin arm lost about 3 kg at one year falling to about 1.5 kg at four years.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: DPP에서 위약군의 체중 변화는 거의 없었는데, 보통이라면 해마다 1~2 kg씩 늘어나는 흐름에 견주면 그렇다는 뜻이에요.
statement_en: In the DPP the placebo group changed weight little, against a usual background gain of 1-2 kg per year.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: DPP에서 위약군은 해마다 10%씩 당뇨병전단계에서 당뇨병으로 넘어갔는데, 집중 생활습관 중재로 약 3분의 2, 메트포르민으로 약 3분의 1이 줄었어요.
statement_en: In the DPP the placebo group converted from prediabetes to diabetes at 10% per year, and this was reduced by about two thirds with intensive lifestyle and about one third with metformin.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: DPP의 효과는 10년까지 유지됐고 핀란드, 인도계 아시아, 중국 인구에서도 재현됐어요.
statement_en: The DPP benefits have been maintained to 10 years and reproduced in Finnish, Indian Asian and Chinese populations.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Herman, W.H. et al. (2017). Impact of Lifestyle and Metformin Interventions on the Risk of Progression to Diabetes and Regression to Normal Glucose Regulation in Overweight or Obese People With Impaired Glucose Regulation. Diabetes Care, 40(12), pp. 1668-1677.

statement_ko: DPP에서 기저 위험 사분위를 보면 위약군은 가장 낮은 사분위의 10%에서 가장 높은 사분위의 60%까지 4년 안에 2형당뇨병으로 진행했고, 메트포르민은 아래 두 사분위에서는 이득이 거의 없었어요.
statement_en: Within quartiles of baseline risk in the DPP, the placebo group ranged from 10% in the lowest-risk quartile to 60% progressing to type 2 diabetes in four years in the highest, and metformin showed little benefit in the lowest two quartiles.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Herman, W.H. et al. (2017). Impact of Lifestyle and Metformin Interventions on the Risk of Progression to Diabetes and Regression to Normal Glucose Regulation in Overweight or Obese People With Impaired Glucose Regulation. Diabetes Care, 40(12), pp. 1668-1677.

statement_ko: DPP는 공복혈당장애와 내당능장애가 있으면서 당뇨병은 없는 3,242명을 등록했고, 위약 대비 p<0.001이었어요.
statement_en: The DPP enrolled n = 3242 participants with impaired fasting glucose and impaired glucose tolerance but without diabetes, with p < 0.001 versus placebo.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 2
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: 여성의 식이 체중감량 연구에서 6개월 체중 변화와의 상관은 총콜레스테롤 0.336, LDL 0.333, 중성지방 0.248, 이완기혈압 0.287이었고 HDL 콜레스테롤은 0.29/0.025로 낮았어요.
statement_en: In dietary weight loss in women, the correlation with weight change over six months was 0.336 for total cholesterol, 0.333 for LDL, 0.248 for triglycerides, 0.287 for diastolic blood pressure and only 0.29/0.025 for HDL cholesterol.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 3
refs: Han, T.S. et al. (1997). Waist circumference reduction & cardiovascular benefits during weight loss in women. International Journal of Obesity and Related Metabolic Disorders, 21(2), pp.127-34.

statement_ko: 체중감량과 HDL의 상관이 약한 이유는 이 연구가 장기가 아니라 단기 감량 연구였기 때문으로 보여요.
statement_en: The correlation of weight loss with HDL is weak, probably because this was an acute rather than long-term weight-loss study.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 3
refs: Han, T.S. et al. (1997). Waist circumference reduction & cardiovascular benefits during weight loss in women. International Journal of Obesity and Related Metabolic Disorders, 21(2), pp.127-34.

statement_ko: 체중감량은 고지혈증에 대한 중재로 검증됐고, 과한 탄수화물·지방 섭취가 이끄는 비알코올지방간질환과 과잉 VLDL 생산을 통해 작동하는 것으로 보여요.
statement_en: Weight loss is validated as an intervention against hyperlipidaemia, probably working through non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and excess VLDL production driven by excess dietary carbohydrate and fat.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 3
refs: Han, T.S. et al. (1997). Waist circumference reduction & cardiovascular benefits during weight loss in women. International Journal of Obesity and Related Metabolic Disorders, 21(2), pp.127-34.

statement_ko: 예전에 비교적 효과가 좋았던 체중감량 약제인 리모나반트(심한 우울증으로 철수)와 시부트라민(빈맥과 일부 심장사로 철수)은 약 10%의 체중감량을 냈어요.
statement_en: The more effective older weight-loss agents - rimonabant, withdrawn because it caused severe depression, and sibutramine, withdrawn because it caused tachycardia and some cardiac death - gave about a 10% weight loss.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. et al. Rimonabant improves cholesterol, insulin resistance and markers of non-alcoholic fatty liver in morbidly obese patients: a retrospective cohort study. International Journal of Clinical Practice, 65(6), pp. 713-5.

statement_ko: 고도비만인 사람을 본 연구에서 리모나반트는 항상성모델지수로 잰 인슐린 저항성을 크게 낮추고 중성지방에도 상당한 효과를 냈으며 총콜레스테롤을 15% 줄였어요.
statement_en: In a study of people with morbid obesity, rimonabant produced large reductions in insulin resistance measured by homeostasis index, a substantial effect on triglycerides, and a 15% reduction in total cholesterol.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 4
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. et al. Rimonabant improves cholesterol, insulin resistance and markers of non-alcoholic fatty liver in morbidly obese patients: a retrospective cohort study. International Journal of Clinical Practice, 65(6), pp. 713-5.

statement_ko: '심장대사 위험 치료' 표에서 생활습관 중재는 체중·허리 7% 감소, HDL-C 1% 증가, 중성지방 4% 감소, 수축기혈압 15% 감소, 당화혈색소 4% 감소, 새 당뇨병 발생 9~58% 감소를 냈어요.
statement_en: In the 'Treating cardiometabolic risk' table, lifestyle intervention gives 7% weight/waist reduction, 1% HDL-C increase, 4% triglyceride reduction, 15% systolic blood pressure reduction, 4% HbA1c reduction and a 9-58% reduction in new diabetes cases.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 5
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. (2006 updated 2011). Low HDL-cholesterol: Common and under-treated, but which drug to use? International Journal of Clinical Practice, 60(10), pp. 1149-53.

statement_ko: 스타틴은 2형당뇨병을 약 10% 늘리는데 이는 당화혈색소가 약 0.3% 오르는 것과 맞먹고, 체중에는 영향이 없으면서 심혈관 사건은 강하게 줄여요.
statement_en: Statins increase type 2 diabetes by about 10%, an effect equivalent to about a 0.3% rise in HbA1c, while reducing cardiovascular events strongly and having no effect on weight.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 5
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. (2006 updated 2011). Low HDL-cholesterol: Common and under-treated, but which drug to use? International Journal of Clinical Practice, 60(10), pp. 1149-53.

statement_ko: 위 리파아제 억제제인 오르리스타트는 잘 견디면 약 6%의 체중감량을 내고(보통 평균은 2~3%), XENDOS에서는 4년간 새 당뇨병 발생을 거의 40% 줄였는데 심혈관 자료는 없어요.
statement_en: Orlistat, the gastric lipase inhibitor, gives about a 6% weight reduction if tolerated (the more normal average being about 2-3%) and in XENDOS produced almost a 40% reduction in new diabetes cases over four years, with no cardiovascular data.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 5
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. (2006 updated 2011). Low HDL-cholesterol: Common and under-treated, but which drug to use? International Journal of Clinical Practice, 60(10), pp. 1149-53.

statement_ko: 이 예전 비교표에서 GLP-1 작용제는 허리둘레를 3~5% 정도만 줄이고 중성지방도 그에 맞춰 줄이며 당화혈색소 효과는 비교적 약했고, LEADER 연구에서 심혈관 사건을 줄였어요.
statement_en: In this older comparison table, GLP-1 agonists reduce waist circumference by only about 3-5%, reduce triglycerides in parallel, have a relatively weak HbA1c effect, and reduced cardiovascular events in the LEADER study.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 5
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. (2006 updated 2011). Low HDL-cholesterol: Common and under-treated, but which drug to use? International Journal of Clinical Practice, 60(10), pp. 1149-53.

statement_ko: 티아졸리딘디온은 체중을 늘리지만 내장지방을 피하지방으로 옮기고, 혈당이 좋아지면서 중성지방과 2형당뇨병, 심혈관 위험을 낮춰요.
statement_en: Thiazolidinediones cause weight gain but shift visceral fat to subcutaneous fat and, through improved glucose, drop triglycerides, type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular risk.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 5
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. (2006 updated 2011). Low HDL-cholesterol: Common and under-treated, but which drug to use? International Journal of Clinical Practice, 60(10), pp. 1149-53.

statement_ko: 스웨덴 비만대상자 연구에서 대조군은 15년간 체중이 거의 변하지 않았고, 위우회술은 약 30%, 위소매절제술은 약 25%, 수직밴드위성형술은 약 20%, 위밴드는 약 15%의 체중을 줄였어요.
statement_en: In the Swedish Obese Subjects study, controls changed weight little over 15 years while gastric bypass reduced weight by about 30%, sleeve gastrectomy about 25%, vertical banded gastroplasty about 20% and gastric bands about 15%.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 6
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (2007). Effects of bariatric surgery on mortality in Swedish obese subjects. New England Journal of Medicine, 357(8), pp. 741-52.

statement_ko: 스웨덴 비만대상자 연구에서 당뇨병은 2년에 걸쳐 3분의 2가 줄었고, 10년 시점에도 절반으로 줄어든 상태가 유지됐어요.
statement_en: In the Swedish Obese Subjects study diabetes fell by two thirds over two years and the halved diabetes rate was still maintained at 10 years.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 6
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (2007). Effects of bariatric surgery on mortality in Swedish obese subjects. New England Journal of Medicine, 357(8), pp. 741-52.

statement_ko: 스웨덴 비만대상자 연구에서 고혈압은 2년이든 10년이든 약 3분의 1 줄었고 고요산혈증은 약 40% 줄었어요.
statement_en: In the Swedish Obese Subjects study hypertension fell by about one third at 2 or 10 years and hyperuricaemia by about 40%.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 6
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (2007). Effects of bariatric surgery on mortality in Swedish obese subjects. New England Journal of Medicine, 357(8), pp. 741-52.

statement_ko: 스웨덴 비만대상자 연구에서 치명적 심혈관 사건의 위험비는 0.56(95% CI 0.35~0.88, 로그순위 p=0.01), 전체 심혈관 사건은 0.83(95% CI 0.69~1.00, 로그순위 p=0.05)이었어요.
statement_en: In the Swedish Obese Subjects study, fatal cardiovascular events gave a hazard ratio of 0.56 (95% CI 0.35-0.88, log-rank p = 0.01) and total cardiovascular events a hazard ratio of 0.83 (95% CI 0.69-1.00, log-rank p = 0.05).
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 6
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (2012). Bariatric surgery and long-term cardiovascular events. Journal of the American Medical Association, 307(1), pp. 56-65.

statement_ko: 고도비만에서 비만대사수술은 15년 시점에 치명적 심혈관 사건을 약 50%, 전체 사건을 약 20% 줄여서, 암을 빼면 사망률을 낮춘다고 밝혀진 몇 안 되는 비응급 수술이에요.
statement_en: Bariatric surgery in morbid obesity delivers a reduction in fatal cardiovascular events of about 50% at 15 years and about 20% of total events, making it one of the few types of non-acute surgery outside cancer ever shown to reduce mortality.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 6
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (2012). Bariatric surgery and long-term cardiovascular events. Journal of the American Medical Association, 307(1), pp. 56-65.

statement_ko: 스웨덴 비만대상자 연구의 원자료에서 총콜레스테롤은 위우회술군에서 12%, 다른 군에서 5% 떨어졌고, 2012년 발표에서도 심혈관 사망은 44% 줄어 있었어요(p=0.01).
statement_en: In the original Swedish Obese Subjects data, total cholesterol dropped by 12% in the gastric bypass group compared with 5% in other groups, and a 2012 publication still found a 44% reduction in cardiovascular mortality (p = 0.01).
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 6
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (2012). Bariatric surgery and long-term cardiovascular events. Journal of the American Medical Association, 307(1), pp. 56-65.

statement_ko: 비만대사수술 뒤 BMI는 복강경 조절형 위밴드에서 5.7±6.3 kg/m2, 복강경 위소매절제술에서 10.8±4.6, 루와이 위우회술에서 13.3±5.7 떨어졌어요(모두 p<0.001).
statement_en: After bariatric surgery, BMI fell by 5.7 +/- 6.3 kg/m2 with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding, 10.8 +/- 4.6 with laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy and 13.3 +/- 5.7 with Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (all p < 0.001).
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 7
refs: Schauer, P.R. et al. (2012). Bariatric Surgery versus Intensive Medical Therapy in Obese Patients with Diabetes. New England Journal of Medicine, 366, pp. 1567-1576.

Brethauer, S. A. et al. (2013). Can diabetes be surgically cured? Long-term metabolic effects of bariatric surgery in obese patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus. Annals of Surgery, 258(4), pp. 628-36.

statement_ko: 비만대사수술 뒤 당화혈색소는 위밴드에서 -0.2±1.8%(p=0.64), 위소매절제술에서 -0.8±1.8%(p=0.049), 루와이 위우회술에서 -1.4±1.6%(p<0.001) 변했어요.
statement_en: After bariatric surgery HbA1c changed by -0.2 +/- 1.8% with gastric banding (p = 0.64), -0.8 +/- 1.8% with sleeve gastrectomy (p = 0.049) and -1.4 +/- 1.6% with Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (p < 0.001).
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 7
refs: Schauer, P.R. et al. (2012). Bariatric Surgery versus Intensive Medical Therapy in Obese Patients with Diabetes. New England Journal of Medicine, 366, pp. 1567-1576.

Brethauer, S. A. et al. (2013). Can diabetes be surgically cured? Long-term metabolic effects of bariatric surgery in obese patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus. Annals of Surgery, 258(4), pp. 628-36.

statement_ko: 루와이 위우회술 환자 대부분은 첫 3년 동안 당뇨병이 거의 완전 관해에 이르고 상당수가 6년째에도 부분 관해를 유지하며, 위소매절제술 환자 대부분은 부분 관해에 이르고, 위밴드는 혈당 목표에는 더 많이 도달하게 하지만 부분 관해조차 드물게 줘요.
statement_en: Most Roux-en-Y patients have almost complete diabetes remission for the first three years and many remain in partial remission at six years, most sleeve gastrectomy patients reach partial remission, and gastric bands let more people reach glucose targets but rarely deliver partial or complete remission.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 7
refs: Brethauer, S. A. et al. (2013). Can diabetes be surgically cured? Long-term metabolic effects of bariatric surgery in obese patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus. Annals of Surgery, 258(4), pp. 628-36.

statement_ko: BMI 36에서 150명을 본 STAMPEDE 비교에서 전통적 약물치료는 BMI 2점쯤의 가벼운 감량을 냈지만 위우회술은 약 10점, 위소매절제술은 약 8점을 줄였어요.
statement_en: In the STAMPEDE comparison at BMI 36 with N = 150, traditional medical therapies gave a slight weight reduction of about two BMI points versus about 10 BMI points with gastric bypass and about eight with sleeve gastrectomy.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 8
refs: Schauer, P.R. et al. (2012). Bariatric Surgery versus Intensive Medical Therapy in Obese Patients with Diabetes. New England Journal of Medicine, 366, pp. 1567-1576.
Schauer, P.R. et al. (2014). Bariatric Surgery versus Intensive Medical Therapy for Diabetes - 3-Year Outcomes. New England Journal of Medicine, 370, pp. 2002-2013.

statement_ko: STAMPEDE에서 수술 치료는 모든 시점에서 기저 당화혈색소 변화가 약물치료보다 좋았고, 시작 BMI가 35 미만인 사람에게도 35 초과인 사람만큼 효과가 컸어요.
statement_en: In STAMPEDE, surgical therapy beat medical therapy on change in baseline HbA1c at all time points, and the effect was as great for people with a starting BMI below 35 as for those above 35.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Section 3: Managing the metabolic syndrome › slide 8
refs: Schauer, P.R. et al. (2014). Bariatric Surgery versus Intensive Medical Therapy for Diabetes - 3-Year Outcomes. New England Journal of Medicine, 370, pp. 2002-2013.

statement_ko: 지질은 대사증후군과 그 핵심인 인슐린 저항성을 통해 비만과 이어지고, 그 주된 관계는 중성지방과 HDL-C에서 나타나요.
statement_en: Lipids are related to obesity via the metabolic syndrome and core insulin resistance, and the principal relationship is for triglycerides and HDL-C.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. (2006 updated 2011). Low HDL-cholesterol: Common and under-treated, but which drug to use? International Journal of Clinical Practice, 60(10), pp. 1149-53.

statement_ko: 총콜레스테롤과 LDL-C, apoB에는 이차적 관계가 있는데, 아마 VLDL 생산을 거쳐 비알코올지방간으로 드러나며 감마GT 상승이나 간 초음파에서 보이는 지방증으로 나타나요.
statement_en: A secondary relationship exists for total cholesterol, LDL-C and apoB, probably through very low density lipoprotein production manifesting as non-alcoholic fatty liver - either a raised gamma GT or visible steatosis on hepatic ultrasound.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. (2006 updated 2011). Low HDL-cholesterol: Common and under-treated, but which drug to use? International Journal of Clinical Practice, 60(10), pp. 1149-53.

statement_ko: 운동과 체중감량은 당뇨병예방프로그램이 보여준 대로 대사증후군에 가장 좋고 효과적인 예방 치료예요.
statement_en: Exercise and weight loss are the best and most effective preventive therapies for the metabolic syndrome, as shown by the Diabetes Prevention Programs.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: 비만대사수술은 고도 병적비만(BMI 50 초과)과, 2형당뇨병이 있으면서 BMI가 35를 넘는 환자의 심장대사질환에 쓸 수 있는 선택지예요.
statement_en: Bariatric surgery is an option for severe morbid obesity (BMI > 50 kg/m2) and for cardiometabolic disease in patients with type 2 diabetes and BMI > 35 kg/m2.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: Schauer, P.R. et al. (2014). Bariatric Surgery versus Intensive Medical Therapy for Diabetes - 3-Year Outcomes. New England Journal of Medicine, 370, pp. 2002-2013.

statement_ko: 당뇨병에서 비만대사수술의 이득은 BMI 35 언저리에서도, 아마 28 범위까지도 나타나기 때문에 체중만이 아니라 당뇨병을 조절하는 대사 중재로 봐야 해요.
statement_en: In diabetes the benefits of bariatric surgery occur even around a BMI of 35 and probably down to BMIs in the range of 28, so it should be considered a metabolic intervention for controlling diabetes, not just weight.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Conclusions › slide 1
refs: Schauer, P.R. et al. (2014). Bariatric Surgery versus Intensive Medical Therapy for Diabetes - 3-Year Outcomes. New England Journal of Medicine, 370, pp. 2002-2013.

statement_ko: LDL 콜레스테롤은 대사증후군의 국제 합의 정의에 들어가는 요소가 아니에요.
statement_en: LDL-cholesterol is not a feature of the International Consensus Definition of the metabolic syndrome.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Assessment › Q1
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 대사증후군이 있는지 볼 때 허리둘레는 성별과 인종에 따라 다른 기준을 써야 해요.
statement_en: When assessing presence of the metabolic syndrome, gender- and ethnicity-specific cut-offs must be used for waist circumference.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Assessment › Q7
refs: Alberti, K.G., Zimmet, P., Shaw, J., IDF Epidemiology Task Force Consensus Group (2005). The metabolic syndrome--a new worldwide definition. Lancet, 366(9491), pp. 1059-62.

statement_ko: 내장지방이 늘면 BMI와 상관없이 언제나 대사 위험과 강하게 연관된다는 말은 틀렸어요.
statement_en: It is false that an increase in visceral adipose tissue is always strongly associated with metabolic risk regardless of BMI level.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Assessment › Q9
refs: Wajchenberg, B.L. (2000). Subcutaneous and visceral adipose tissue: their relation to the metabolic syndrome. Endocrine Reviews, 21(6), pp. 697-738.

statement_ko: 같은 BMI라도 인도 출신 인구는 백인 인구보다 인슐린 저항성 유병률이 높아요.
statement_en: For a given BMI level, populations from India have a higher prevalence of insulin resistance compared with Caucasian populations.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Assessment › Q11
refs: Wierzbicki, A.S. et al. (2008) Insulin resistance phenotypes and coronary artery disease in a native Pakistani cohort. International Journal of Clinical Practice, 62(5), pp. 701-707.

statement_ko: 중등도 비만인 여성에서 식이 체중감량은 HDL 콜레스테롤 개선과 약하게만 상관을 보였어요.
statement_en: In women with moderate obesity, dietary weight loss was only weakly correlated with improvements in HDL-cholesterol.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Assessment › Q3
refs: Han, T.S. et al. (1997). Waist circumference reduction & cardiovascular benefits during weight loss in women. International Journal of Obesity and Related Metabolic Disorders, 21(2), pp.127-34.

statement_ko: 비만대사수술은 2형당뇨병과 고혈압·이상지질혈증의 유병률 및 치료 필요, 고요산혈증을 모두 개선한다고 밝혀졌어요.
statement_en: Bariatric surgery has been demonstrated to improve type 2 diabetes, the prevalence and need for treatment of hypertension and of dyslipidaemia, and hyperuricaemia.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Assessment › Q5
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (2007). Effects of bariatric surgery on mortality in Swedish obese subjects. New England Journal of Medicine, 357(8), pp. 741-52.

statement_ko: 비만 환자의 대사증후군과 고지혈증을 다루는 가장 좋은 치료는 운동과 체중감량이에요.
statement_en: The best therapy for the treatment of metabolic syndrome and hyperlipidaemia in patients with obesity is exercise and weight loss.
source: SCOPE Lipids, the Metabolic Syndrome and Obesity › Module 1 › Assessment › Q8
refs: Diabetes Prevention Program Research Group (2002). Reduction in the incidence of type 2 diabetes with lifestyle intervention or metformin. The New England Journal of Medicine, 346(6), pp. 393-403.

statement_ko: 성인의 체중은 하루하루 먹는 양과 활동량이 크게 달라져도 시간이 지나도록 놀랍게 일정하게 유지돼요.
statement_en: Adult body weight remains remarkably stable over time despite large day-to-day variation in food intake and physical activity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Overview
refs: Pasquet, P., Apfelbaum, M. (1994). Recovery of initial body weight and composition after long-term massive overfeeding in men. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 60, pp. 861-3.

statement_ko: 장기간 대량 과식 실험에서 체중은 약 5개월간의 과식 기간이 끝날 무렵 기준선보다 약 +17.5 kg 늘었다가, 35개월쯤에는 +0.2 kg 수준으로 되돌아왔어요.
statement_en: After a period of long-term massive overfeeding, body weight rose about +17.5 kg by the end of the roughly 5-month overfeeding period and returned to about +0.2 kg above baseline by around 35 months.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Charts and diagrams page 1
refs: Pasquet, P., Apfelbaum, M. (1994). Recovery of initial body weight and composition after long-term massive overfeeding in men. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 60, pp. 861-3.

statement_ko: 같은 과식 실험에서 체지방량은 2개월째 약 +11 kg까지 늘었다가 35개월쯤에는 약 +1.3 kg으로 돌아왔어요.
