statement_en: In the same overfeeding study fat mass rose about +11 kg at 2 months and had fallen back to about +1.3 kg by around 35 months.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Charts and diagrams page 1
refs: Pasquet, P., Apfelbaum, M. (1994). Recovery of initial body weight and composition after long-term massive overfeeding in men. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 60, pp. 861-3.

statement_ko: 체중의 항상성 조절은 주로 시상하부에서 이뤄지고, 단기 섭취량과 장기 에너지 저장량에 대한 말초 신호를 통합해요.
statement_en: Homeostatic regulation of body weight occurs primarily in the hypothalamus, which integrates peripheral signals about short-term intake and long-term energy stores.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Proietto, J. (2011). Why is treating obesity so difficult? Justification for the role of bariatric surgery. Medical Journal of Australia, 195, p. 144.

statement_ko: 궁상핵은 음식 섭취의 항상성 조절을 담당하는 핵심 뇌 부위이고, 서로 연결된 두 갈래의 상반된 신경세포 집단을 품고 있어요.
statement_en: The arcuate nucleus is the primary brain region for homeostatic control of food intake and contains two interconnected, opposing neuron groups.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Hahn, T.M. et al. (1998). Coexpression of Agrp and NPY in fasting-activated hypothalamic neurons. Nature Neuroscience, 1, p. 271.

statement_ko: 신경펩타이드 Y(NPY)와 아구티관련펩타이드(AgRP)를 함께 발현하는 신경세포는 음식 섭취를 자극해요.
statement_en: Neurons co-expressing neuropeptide Y (NPY) and agouti-related peptide (AgRP) stimulate food intake.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Hahn, T.M. et al. (1998). Coexpression of Agrp and NPY in fasting-activated hypothalamic neurons. Nature Neuroscience, 1, p. 271.

statement_ko: 프로오피오멜라노코르틴(POMC)을 발현하는 신경세포는 알파-멜라닌세포자극호르몬(alpha-MSH)으로 잘려 나가면서 음식 섭취를 억제해요.
statement_en: Neurons expressing proopiomelanocortin (POMC), which is cleaved to alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone (alpha-MSH), inhibit food intake.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Schwartz, M.W. et al. (1997). Leptin increases hypothalamic pro-opiomelanocortin mRNA expression in the rostral arcuate nucleus. Diabetes, 46, p. 2119.

statement_ko: 궁상핵의 두 신경세포 집단은 모두 실방핵과 외측시상하부의 2차 신경세포로 신호를 보내요.
statement_en: Both arcuate neuron populations project to second-order neurons in the paraventricular nucleus and the lateral hypothalamus.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Proietto, J. (2011). Why is treating obesity so difficult? Justification for the role of bariatric surgery. Medical Journal of Australia, 195, p. 144.

statement_ko: 에너지 저장량을 알리는 장기 신호는 렙틴과 인슐린이고, 끼니마다 오가는 단기 신호로는 그렐린, 콜레시스토키닌(CCK), GLP-1, 펩타이드 YY(PYY), 아밀린 등이 있어요.
statement_en: Long-term signals of energy stores are leptin and insulin, while short-term meal-to-meal signals include ghrelin, cholecystokinin (CCK), GLP-1, peptide YY (PYY) and amylin.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Wren, A.M., Small, C.J., Ward, H.L. et al. (2000). The novel hypothalamic peptide ghrelin stimulates food intake and growth hormone secretion. Endocrinology, 141, pp. 4325-8.
Moran, T.H. et al. (1998). Disordered food intake and obesity in rats lacking cholecystokinin A receptors. American Journal of Physiology, 274, R618.
Tang-Christensen, M. et al. (1996). Central administration of GLP-1-(7-36) amide inhibits food and water intake in rats. American Journal of Physiology, 271, R848.
Batterham, R.L. et al. (2002). Gut hormone PYY(3-36) physiologically inhibits food intake. Nature, 418, p. 650.

statement_ko: 혈중 호르몬은 혈류와 미주신경 두 경로를 통해 시상하부와 후뇌에 도달해요.
statement_en: Circulating hormones reach the hypothalamus and hindbrain both through the bloodstream and through the vagus nerve.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Proietto, J. (2011). Why is treating obesity so difficult? Justification for the role of bariatric surgery. Medical Journal of Australia, 195, p. 144.

statement_ko: 렙틴은 주로 지방세포에서 체지방량에 비례해 분비되고 혈액뇌장벽을 건너 운반돼요.
statement_en: Leptin is secreted mainly by adipocytes in proportion to fat mass and is transported across the blood-brain barrier.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Zhang, Y. et al. (1994). Positional cloning of the mouse obese gene and its human homologue. Nature, 372, p. 425.
Considine, R.V. et al. (1996). Serum immunoreactive-leptin concentrations in normal-weight and obese humans. New England Journal of Medicine, 334, p. 292.

statement_ko: 시상하부에서 렙틴은 AgRP와 NPY 발현을 줄이고 POMC를 자극해서, 음식 섭취를 억제하고 에너지 소비를 늘려요.
statement_en: In the hypothalamus leptin reduces AgRP and NPY expression and stimulates POMC, inhibiting food intake and increasing energy expenditure.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Schwartz, M.W. et al. (1997). Leptin increases hypothalamic pro-opiomelanocortin mRNA expression in the rostral arcuate nucleus. Diabetes, 46, p. 2119.

statement_ko: 사람에서 선천성 렙틴 결핍은 과식과 조기 발병 고도비만을 일으키는데, 비만의 드문 원인이에요.
statement_en: Congenital leptin deficiency in humans causes hyperphagia and severe early-onset obesity, and is a rare cause of obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Montague, C.T. et al. (1997). Congenital leptin deficiency is associated with severe early- onset obesity in humans. Nature, 387, p. 903.

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 사람 대부분은 체지방량이 많은 만큼 혈중 렙틴이 오히려 높은데, 이는 렙틴 저항성이거나 렙틴의 본래 역할이 에너지 고갈 신호일 가능성을 시사해요.
statement_en: In most people with obesity circulating leptin is elevated, reflecting high fat mass, which suggests leptin resistance or a primary role in signalling energy depletion.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: Considine, R.V. et al. (1996). Serum immunoreactive-leptin concentrations in normal-weight and obese humans. New England Journal of Medicine, 334, p. 292.

statement_ko: 시상하부는 대뇌피질과 변연계 보상회로에서도 신호를 받는데, 이런 쾌락 경로는 항상성 조절을 눌러 버릴 수 있어요.
statement_en: The hypothalamus also receives input from cortical and limbic reward circuits, and these hedonic pathways can override homeostatic regulation.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Homeostatic regulation
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 이 모듈에서 쓰인 인과 순환 지도는 Foresight: Tackling Obesities 프로젝트를 위해 만들어졌어요.
statement_en: The causal loop map used in the module was developed for the Foresight: Tackling Obesities project.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Contributing factors
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: NHMRC 체계적 문헌고찰은 체중 감량이 6~12개월에 최대에 이르고, 대부분 2년 안에 되돌아오며, 5년이 지나면 다수가 중재 전 체중으로 돌아간다고 결론지었어요.
statement_en: The NHMRC systematic review concluded that weight loss is maximal at six to 12 months, most weight is regained within two years, and by five years the majority of people are back at their pre-intervention body weight.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Difficulties
refs: Australian Government National Health and Medical Research Council (2013). Clinical practice guidelines for the management of overweight and obesity in adults, adolescents and children in Australia. 16 Marcus Clarke Street, Canberra.

statement_ko: 식이로 체중의 10%를 줄이면 총에너지소비량이 체질량·체성분 변화로 예상되는 값보다 15% 더 낮아지는데, 마른 사람과 비만인 사람 모두에서 그래요.
statement_en: Diet-induced loss of 10% of body weight reduces total energy expenditure by 15% below what would be expected for the change in body mass and composition, in both lean people and people with obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Energy
refs: Leibel, R.L. et al. (1995). Changes in energy expenditure resulting from altered body weight. New England Journal of Medicine, 332(10), pp. 621-8.
Rosenbaum, M., Leibel, R.L. (2016). Models of energy homeostasis in response to maintenance of reduced body weight. Obesity, 24, pp. 1620-1629.

statement_ko: 10% 감량 뒤에는 휴식 에너지소비량과 비휴식 에너지소비량이 모두 예측치 아래로 떨어지고, 비휴식 감소는 골격근의 일 효율이 높아진 탓으로 봐요.
statement_en: Both resting and non-resting energy expenditure fall below predicted after 10% weight loss, and the non-resting decline is attributed to increased work efficiency of skeletal muscle.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Energy
refs: Rosenbaum, M. et al. (2003). Effects of experimental weight perturbation on skeletal muscle work efficiency in human subjects. American Journal of Physiology, 285, R183.

statement_ko: "The Biggest Loser" 6년 추적에서 30주 대회가 끝났을 때 참가자들은 평균 58 kg을 감량했고, 측정된 휴식대사율은 예측치보다 하루 275 kcal 낮았어요.
statement_en: In the six-year follow-up of "The Biggest Loser", measured resting metabolic rate was 275 kcal per day lower than predicted at the end of the 30-week competition, when contestants had lost a mean of 58 kg.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Energy
refs: Fothergill, E. et al. (2016). Persistent metabolic adaptation 6 years after "The Biggest Loser" competition. Obesity, 24(8), pp. 1612-9.

statement_ko: 6년 뒤 같은 참가자들은 평균 41 kg을 다시 찌웠는데도 휴식대사율 격차는 예측치보다 하루 499 kcal 낮은 수준으로 더 벌어졌어요.
statement_en: Six years later, despite regaining a mean of 41 kg, the same contestants' resting metabolic rate gap had widened to 499 kcal per day below predicted.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Energy
refs: Fothergill, E. et al. (2016). Persistent metabolic adaptation 6 years after "The Biggest Loser" competition. Obesity, 24(8), pp. 1612-9.

statement_ko: 대사 적응 그래프는 30주째 평균 약 -270 kcal/일, 6년째 약 -500 kcal/일을 보여주고, p=0.0075라는 통계값이 함께 인쇄돼 있어요.
statement_en: The metabolic adaptation chart shows group mean adaptation of about -270 kcal/d at 30 weeks and about -500 kcal/d at 6 years, with a printed statistic of p=0.0075.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Charts and diagrams page 3
refs: Fothergill, E. et al. (2016). Persistent metabolic adaptation 6 years after "The Biggest Loser" competition. Obesity, 24(8), pp. 1612-9.
Rosenbaum, M., Leibel, R.L. (2016). Models of energy homeostasis in response to maintenance of reduced body weight. Obesity, 24, pp. 1620-1629.
Rosenbaum, M. et al. (2003). Effects of experimental weight perturbation on skeletal muscle work efficiency in human subjects. American Journal of Physiology, 285, R183.

statement_ko: 식이로 체중을 줄이면 포만 호르몬인 펩타이드 YY, 콜레시스토키닌, 아밀린, 인슐린, 렙틴이 줄고 그렐린은 늘어나요.
statement_en: After diet-induced weight loss the satiety hormones peptide YY, cholecystokinin, amylin, insulin and leptin fall while ghrelin rises.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Hormones and appetite (1)
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2011). Long-Term Persistence of Hormonal Adaptations to Weight Loss. New England Journal of Medicine, 365, pp. 1597-1604.
Cummings, D.E. et al. (2002). Plasma Ghrelin Levels after Diet-Induced Weight Loss or Gastric Bypass Surgery. New England Journal of Medicine, 346, pp. 1623-1630.

Wadden, T.A. et al. (1998). Short- and long-term changes in serum leptin dieting obese women: effects of caloric restriction and weight loss. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 83(1), pp. 214-8.

statement_ko: 호르몬 변화 슬라이드에서는 감량 뒤 췌장폴리펩타이드는 증가, GLP-1은 변화 없음으로 표시돼 있어요.
statement_en: On the hormonal change slide pancreatic polypeptide is shown as increased and GLP-1 as unchanged after weight loss.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Charts and diagrams page 4
refs: Chearskul, S. et al. (2008). Effect of weight loss and ketosis on postprandial cholecystokinin and free fatty acid concentrations. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 87, p. 1238.

Adam, T.C., Lejeune, M.P., Westerterp-Plantenga, M.S. (2006). Nutrient-stimulated glucagon- like peptide 1 release after body-weight loss and weight maintenance in human subjects. British Journal of Nutrition, 95, pp. 160-167.

statement_ko: 에너지 제한은 시상하부-뇌하수체-갑상선 축을 억눌러 삼요오드티로닌(T3)을 줄이고 비활성인 역T3를 늘려요.
statement_en: Energy restriction suppresses the hypothalamic-pituitary-thyroid axis, reducing triiodothyronine (T3) and increasing inactive reverse T3.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Hormones and appetite (1)
refs: Weinsier, R.L. et al. (2000). Do adaptive changes in metabolic rate favor weight regain in weight-reduced individuals? An examination of the set-point theory. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 72, pp. 1088-94.

statement_ko: 혈장 GLP-1 곡선하면적은 기준선 약 12.8 pmol/L·h에서 6주 감량 뒤 약 6.7로 떨어졌다가, 3개월 유지 기간을 거치며 약 11.1로 회복됐어요.
statement_en: Plasma GLP-1 area under the curve fell from about 12.8 pmol/L·h at baseline to about 6.7 after a six-week weight loss period, then rose to about 11.1 after a three-month maintenance period.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Charts and diagrams page 4
refs: Adam, T.C., Lejeune, M.P., Westerterp-Plantenga, M.S. (2006). Nutrient-stimulated glucagon- like peptide 1 release after body-weight loss and weight maintenance in human subjects. British Journal of Nutrition, 95, pp. 160-167.

statement_ko: 시작 체중의 13%를 감량하고 12개월이 지난 뒤에도 아밀린, PYY, CCK, 췌장폴리펩타이드, 그렐린은 기준선으로 돌아오지 않았어요.
statement_en: Twelve months after losing 13% of starting weight, amylin, PYY, CCK, pancreatic polypeptide and ghrelin had still not returned to baseline.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Hormones and appetite (1)
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2011). Long-Term Persistence of Hormonal Adaptations to Weight Loss. New England Journal of Medicine, 365, pp. 1597-1604.

statement_ko: 배고픔과 먹고 싶은 정도는 0에서 100 mm까지의 시각아날로그척도로 재고, 숫자가 클수록 더 배고프거나 더 먹고 싶다는 뜻이에요.
statement_en: Ratings of hunger and desire to eat were measured on a visual-analogue scale from 0 to 100 mm, with higher numbers indicating greater hunger or desire.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Charts and diagrams page 5
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2011). Long-Term Persistence of Hormonal Adaptations to Weight Loss. New England Journal of Medicine, 365, pp. 1597-1604.

statement_ko: 공복 시 배고픔 점수는 기준선에서 약 32 mm였는데 감량 뒤 10주와 62주 모두 약 42 mm였어요.
statement_en: Fasting hunger was about 32 mm at baseline and about 42 mm at both week 10 and week 62 after weight loss.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Charts and diagrams page 5
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2011). Long-Term Persistence of Hormonal Adaptations to Weight Loss. New England Journal of Medicine, 365, pp. 1597-1604.

statement_ko: 평소 체중인 사람에게 렙틴을 주면 체중과 식욕에 거의 영향이 없지만, 감량 뒤 감량 전 농도로 되돌려 주면 갑상선호르몬·식욕·에너지소비의 적응 변화가 상당 부분 되돌아가요.
statement_en: Leptin given to people at usual weight has little effect on body weight and appetite, but given after weight loss to restore pre-loss concentrations it reverses many adaptive changes in thyroid hormones, appetite and energy expenditure.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Hormones and appetite (2)
refs: Rosenbaum, M. et al. (2005). Low-dose leptin reverses skeletal muscle, autonomic, and neuroendocrine adaptations to maintenance of reduced weight. Journal of Clinical Investigation, 115, pp. 3579-3586.

statement_ko: 감량 뒤 나타나는 적응 변화는 얼마나 빨리 뺐느냐가 아니라 얼마나 많이 뺐느냐와 관련이 있어요.
statement_en: The adaptive changes after weight loss relate to the amount of weight lost rather than the rate at which it was lost.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 2 Hormones and appetite (2)
refs: Purcell, K. et al. (2014). The effect of rate of weight loss on long-term weight management: a randomised controlled trial. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 2(12), pp. 954-62.
Rosenbaum, M., Leibel, R.L. (2016). Models of energy homeostasis in response to maintenance of reduced body weight. Obesity, 24, pp. 1620-1629.

statement_ko: 이 모듈의 학습목표는 비만이 의지 부족 때문이 아니라는 점, 체중이 유전 요인의 강한 영향을 받는다는 점, 체중이 항상성으로 조절된다는 점, 감량이 지속적인 생리 적응으로 상쇄된다는 점이에요.
statement_en: The module's stated learning objectives are that obesity is not caused by lack of willpower, that body weight is strongly influenced by genetic factors, that body weight is homeostatically regulated, and that weight loss is counteracted by sustained physiological adaptations.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page 1 Learning objectives
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 렙틴의 주된 공급원이 간·신장·췌장이 아니라 지방세포임을 확인해요.
statement_en: The module assessment confirms that adipocytes are the main source of leptin, not the liver, kidney or pancreas.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page Assessment Q2
refs: Zhang, Y. et al. (1994). Positional cloning of the mouse obese gene and its human homologue. Nature, 372, p. 425.

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 그렐린이 음식 섭취를 억제하는 게 아니라 배고픔을 자극한다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that ghrelin stimulates hunger rather than inhibiting food intake.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page Assessment Q4
refs: Wren, A.M., Small, C.J., Ward, H.L. et al. (2000). The novel hypothalamic peptide ghrelin stimulates food intake and growth hormone secretion. Endocrinology, 141, pp. 4325-8.

statement_ko: 모듈 요약은 지속적인 체중 변화에 맞서는 생리 적응으로 에너지소비 감소, 식욕·갑상선 호르몬 프로파일 변화, 식욕 증가를 꼽아요.
statement_en: The module summary lists reduced energy expenditure, an altered profile of appetite-mediating and thyroid hormones, and increased appetite as the physiological adaptations that oppose sustained weight change.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 1 › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 쌍둥이 쌍 내 BMI 상관계수는 함께 자란 일란성 쌍둥이에서 약 0.7, 함께 자란 이란성 쌍둥이에서 약 0.3이에요.
statement_en: Intrapair BMI correlation is about 0.7 in monozygotic twins reared together versus about 0.3 in dizygotic twins reared together.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 A strong predisposition
refs: Stunkard, A.J. et al. (1990). The Body-Mass Index of Twins Who Have Been Reared Apart. New England Journal of Medicine, 322, pp. 1483-1487.

statement_ko: 표에 실린 쌍 내 BMI 상관계수는 함께 자란 일란성 남 0.74·여 0.66, 떨어져 자란 일란성 0.70·0.66, 함께 자란 이란성 0.33·0.27, 떨어져 자란 이란성 0.15·0.25예요.
statement_en: Exact intrapair BMI correlations were monozygotic reared together 0.74 (men) and 0.66 (women), reared apart 0.70 and 0.66; dizygotic reared together 0.33 and 0.27, reared apart 0.15 and 0.25.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 6
refs: Stunkard, A.J. et al. (1990). The Body-Mass Index of Twins Who Have Been Reared Apart. New England Journal of Medicine, 322, pp. 1483-1487.

statement_ko: 태어나면서부터 떨어져 자란 쌍둥이도 함께 자란 쌍둥이와 같은 쌍 내 BMI 상관을 보였어요.
statement_en: Twins reared apart from birth showed the same intrapair BMI correlation as twins reared together.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 A strong predisposition
refs: Stunkard, A.J. et al. (1990). The Body-Mass Index of Twins Who Have Been Reared Apart. New England Journal of Medicine, 322, pp. 1483-1487.

statement_ko: 일란성 쌍둥이 12쌍(24명)이 임상연구병동에 입원해 100일 동안 하루 약 1,000칼로리씩 초과 섭취했어요.
statement_en: Twelve pairs of identical twins (24 individuals) were admitted to a clinical research unit and overfed by approximately 1,000 calories in excess daily for 100 days.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 Overfeeding in identical twins
refs: Bouchard, C. et al. (1990). The response to long-term overfeeding in identical twins. New England Journal of Medicine, 322(21), pp. 1477-82.

statement_ko: 입양아 연구는 3,580명 중에서 고른 덴마크 성인 입양아 540명을 마름·중간체중·과체중·비만의 네 체중군으로 나눠 살폈어요.
statement_en: The adoption study examined 540 adult Danish adoptees selected from a population of 3,580 and divided into four weight classes: thin, median weight, overweight, and obese.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 An adoption study
refs: Stunkard, A.J. et al. (1986). An adoption study of human obesity. New England Journal of Medicine, 314(4), pp. 193-8.

statement_ko: 입양아의 체중군은 생물학적 부모의 BMI와 강하게 상관했고(어머니 p < 0.0001, 아버지 p < 0.02) 양부모의 BMI와는 전혀 상관이 없었어요.
statement_en: Adoptees' weight class correlated strongly with their biological parents' BMI (p < 0.0001 for mothers, p < 0.02 for fathers) and not at all with their adoptive parents' BMI.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 An adoption study
refs: Stunkard, A.J. et al. (1986). An adoption study of human obesity. New England Journal of Medicine, 314(4), pp. 193-8.

statement_ko: 호주의 비만 유병률은 1980년 7.1%에서 2000년 18.4%로 올랐는데, 유전자 돌연변이로 설명하기에는 너무 빠른 변화예요.
statement_en: Obesity prevalence in Australia was 7.1% in 1980 and had risen to 18.4% by 2000, which is too fast to be explained by gene mutation.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 How can it be genetics?
refs: Cameron, A.J. et al. (2003). Overweight and obesity in Australia: the 1999-2000 Australian Diabetes, Obesity and Lifestyle Study (AusDiab). Medical Journal of Australia, 178 (9), pp. 427- 432.

statement_ko: 후성유전은 환경 요인이 유전자를 켜거나 끄게 하는데, 하룻밤 사이에도 일어날 수 있어요.
statement_en: Epigenetics allows a gene to be switched on or off by an environmental factor, potentially overnight.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 Epigenetics
refs: Rodenhiser, D., Mann M. (2006). Epigenetics and human disease: translating basic biology into clinical applications. Canadian Medical Association Journal, 174(3), pp. 341-8.

statement_ko: 후성유전 기전에는 유전자 프로모터의 메틸화, 그리고 DNA를 묶는 히스톤의 메틸화·아세틸화·인산화가 있어요.
statement_en: Epigenetic mechanisms include methylation of the gene promoter and methylation, acetylation and phosphorylation of the histones that bind DNA.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 Epigenetics
refs: Rodenhiser, D., Mann M. (2006). Epigenetics and human disease: translating basic biology into clinical applications. Canadian Medical Association Journal, 174(3), pp. 341-8.

statement_ko: 후성유전 그림에서 켜진 유전자는 열린 염색질에 비메틸화 시토신과 아세틸화 히스톤을, 꺼진 유전자는 응축된 염색질에 메틸화 시토신과 탈아세틸화 히스톤을 보여줘요.
statement_en: On the epigenetics diagram a gene switched on shows open chromatin with unmethylated cytosines and acetylated histones, while a switched-off gene shows condensed chromatin with methylated cytosines and deacetylated histones.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 8
refs: Rodenhiser, D., Mann M. (2006). Epigenetics and human disease: translating basic biology into clinical applications. Canadian Medical Association Journal, 174(3), pp. 341-8.

statement_ko: 1976년부터 알려진 사실로, 임신 첫 3개월에 산모의 영양결핍을 감지한 태아는 더 배고프고 연료를 아끼는 쪽으로 뇌가 설정되고, 이런 사람들은 자라서 비만이 됐어요.
statement_en: It has been known since 1976 that a foetus sensing maternal malnourishment in the first three months in the womb is wired to be hungrier and more fuel-efficient, and such individuals grew up to have obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 Studies on epigenetics
refs: Ravelli, G.P., Stein, Z.A., Susser, M.W. (1976). Obesity in Young Men after Famine Exposure in Utero and Early Infancy. New England Journal of Medicine, 295, pp. 349-353.

statement_ko: 설정점 실험에서 정상 C57 Black 6 생쥐는 평균 약 28 g인데, 3일간 먹이를 제한했다가 자유롭게 먹이면 매번 정확히 이전 체중으로 돌아와요.
statement_en: In the set-point mouse experiment normal C57 Black 6 mice average about 28 grammes and return exactly to that weight after three days of food restriction followed by ad libitum feeding, repeatedly.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 A set point for weight
refs: Butler, A.A. et al. (2001). Melanocortin-4 receptor is required for acute homeostatic responses to increased dietary fat. Nature Neuroscience, 4, pp. 605-611.

statement_ko: 뇌에서 멜라노코르틴 4 수용체가 제거된 생쥐도 먹이 제한 뒤 원래대로 돌아오는데, 자기의 더 높은 체중으로 돌아와서 설정점이 올라간 것처럼 보여요.
statement_en: Mice with the melanocortin 4 receptor deleted in the brain also bounce back after food restriction, but to their own higher weight, illustrating an apparently raised set point.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 1 A set point for weight
refs: Butler, A.A. et al. (2001). Melanocortin-4 receptor is required for acute homeostatic responses to increased dietary fat. Nature Neuroscience, 4, pp. 605-611.

statement_ko: MCR4 결손 생쥐는 0일차 약 39.3 g에서 3일차 33.4 g으로 떨어졌다가 16일차 약 40.1 g으로 돌아왔고, 정상 생쥐는 약 28.4 g에서 23.1 g으로 떨어졌다가 약 29 g으로 돌아왔어요.
statement_en: In the knockout experiment MCR4 knockout mice weighed about 39.3 g at day 0, fell to 33.4 g by day 3 and rebounded to about 40.1 g by day 16, while normal mice went from about 28.4 g to 23.1 g and back to about 29 g.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 9
refs: Butler, A.A. et al. (2001). Melanocortin-4 receptor is required for acute homeostatic responses to increased dietary fat. Nature Neuroscience, 4, pp. 605-611.

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 체중에 영향을 주는 비유전 요인 아홉 가지로 건조환경, 질환, 장내미생물, 바이러스, 약물, 수면부족, 스트레스, 폐경, 환경독소를 들어요.
statement_en: The module lists nine non-genetic influences on body weight: the built environment, medical conditions, gut microbiota, viruses, medications, sleep deprivation, stress, the menopause and environmental toxins.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Factors that influence body weight
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유전적으로 마른 사람은 체지방을 약 6~8 kg만 늘려도 렙틴이 충분히 올라가 배고픔을 억누르고 더 이상의 증가를 막아요.
statement_en: A genetically lean individual can gain only about 6-8 kg of fat before leptin rises enough to inhibit hunger and brake further gain.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 The built environment
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 5리터 냄비와 50리터 냄비를 빗속에 두면 둘 다 가득 차지만 큰 냄비가 더 많이 담는다는 비유로, 비만에는 유전적 소인과 환경이 모두 필요하다고 설명해요.
statement_en: The module's analogy is that a 5-litre and a 50-litre pot left in the rain both fill up, but the larger pot holds more because of how it was made, so obesity needs both genetic predisposition and a facilitating environment.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 The built environment
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체중 증가를 일으킬 수 있는 질환으로는 쿠싱병, 시상하부 질환(두개인두종, 수술이나 외상, 프뢸리히 증후군), 로렌스-문-비들 증후군, 프래더-윌리 증후군이 있어요.
statement_en: Medical conditions that can cause weight gain include Cushing's disease, hypothalamic disorders (craniopharyngioma, surgery or trauma, Froehlich's Syndrome), Laurence-Moon Biedl Syndrome and Prader-Willi Syndrome.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Medical conditions
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만인 사람은 마른 사람보다 박테로이데테스가 적고 퍼미큐테스가 많은데, 균종에 따라 칼로리를 뽑아내는 정도가 다를 수 있어요.
statement_en: People with obesity have fewer bacteroidetes and more firmicutes than lean subjects, and different bacteria may extract calories differently.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Gut microbiota
refs: DiBaise, J.K. et al. (2008). Gut microbiota and its possible relationship with obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 83(4), pp. 460-469.

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 장내세균이 체중에 영향을 줄 수는 있어도 소인 유전자가 만든 비만 경향을 뒤집지는 못한다고 봐요. 함께 살았는데도 입양아와 양부모 사이에 체중 관련성이 거의 없었기 때문이에요.
statement_en: The module argues that gut bacteria can influence weight but cannot override the tendency to obesity conferred by predisposing genes, because adoptees showed almost no weight relationship with adoptive parents despite a shared life.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Gut microbiota
refs: Stunkard, A.J. et al. (1986). An adoption study of human obesity. New England Journal of Medicine, 314(4), pp. 193-8.
DiBaise, J.K. et al. (2008). Gut microbiota and its possible relationship with obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 83(4), pp. 460-469.

statement_ko: 동물 바이러스 다섯 종과 사람 바이러스 세 종이 체중에 영향을 준다고 밝혀졌어요.
statement_en: Five animal viruses and three human viruses have been shown to influence body weight.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Viruses
refs: Atkinson, R.L. (2007). Viruses as an etiology of obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 82(10), pp. 1192-8.

statement_ko: 체중과 연결된 사람 바이러스 세 종은 아데노바이러스 36(2000년 보고), 37(2002년), 5(2005년)예요.
statement_en: The three human viruses linked to body weight are Adenovirus 36 (reported 2000), Adenovirus 37 (2002) and Adenovirus 5 (2005).
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 10
refs: Atkinson, R.L. (2007). Viruses as an etiology of obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 82(10), pp. 1192-8.

statement_ko: Ad-36는 지금까지 사람 비만과 연결된 유일한 아데노바이러스로, 비만인 사람의 30%, 비만이 아닌 사람의 11%에서 검출됐어요.
statement_en: Ad-36 is the only adenovirus to date linked with human obesity and was present in 30% of humans with obesity versus 11% of humans without obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Viruses
refs: Atkinson, R.L. (2007). Viruses as an etiology of obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 82(10), pp. 1192-8.

statement_ko: 이 바이러스들은 중성지방 축적을 일으키고 전지방세포가 성숙 지방세포로 분화하도록 돕는 효소와 전사인자를 자극해요.
statement_en: These viruses stimulate enzymes and transcription factors that cause triglyceride accumulation and enhance differentiation of pre-adipocytes into mature adipocytes.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Viruses
refs: Atkinson, R.L. (2007). Viruses as an etiology of obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 82(10), pp. 1192-8.

statement_ko: Ad-36 감염 여부가 서로 다른 쌍둥이에서는 감염된 쪽이 형제자매보다 더 무겁고 체지방이 많았어요.
statement_en: In twins discordant for Ad-36 infection, the infected twins were heavier and fatter than their co-twins.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Viruses
refs: Atkinson, R.L. (2007). Viruses as an etiology of obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 82(10), pp. 1192-8.

statement_ko: 체중을 늘리는 약물로는 인슐린, 설포닐유레아, 티아졸리딘디온, 항정신병약, 일부 항우울제, 글루코코르티코이드가 있어요.
statement_en: Medications that increase weight include insulin, sulphonylureas and thiazolidenediones, antipsychotics, some antidepressants and glucocorticoids.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Medications
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: BMI가 가장 낮은 수면 시간은 약 7~8시간이고, 6~7시간의 짧은 수면과 9~10시간의 긴 수면 모두 BMI가 더 높은 쪽과 연결돼요.
statement_en: The lowest BMI occurs at a sleep duration of about seven to eight hours, and both shorter sleep of six or seven hours and longer sleep of nine or 10 hours are associated with higher BMI.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Sleep deprivation
refs: Taheri, S. et al. (2004). Short Sleep Duration Is Associated with Reduced Leptin, Elevated Ghrelin, and Increased Body Mass Index. PloS Medicine, 1, pp. 210-217.

statement_ko: 수면 그래프에서 보정 BMI는 수면 6시간에 약 32.1, 약 7.6시간에서 최저 약 31.1, 약 9.1시간에 약 31.65였어요.
statement_en: On the sleep chart adjusted BMI was about 32.1 at six hours of sleep with a nadir of about 31.1 at around 7.6 hours and about 31.65 at around 9.1 hours.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 11
refs: Taheri, S. et al. (2004). Short Sleep Duration Is Associated with Reduced Leptin, Elevated Ghrelin, and Increased Body Mass Index. PloS Medicine, 1, pp. 210-217.

statement_ko: 수면 시간이 6시간에서 9시간으로 늘수록 보정 렙틴은 약 14.9에서 19.4 ng/ml로 올라가고 보정 그렐린은 내려갔는데, 슬라이드는 이 효과의 기전이 분명하지 않다고 적어 놨어요.
statement_en: As sleep duration increased from six to nine hours adjusted leptin trended up from about 14.9 to 19.4 ng/ml and adjusted ghrelin trended down, and the slide states that the mechanism for this effect is not clear.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 12
refs: Taheri, S. et al. (2004). Short Sleep Duration Is Associated with Reduced Leptin, Elevated Ghrelin, and Increased Body Mass Index. PloS Medicine, 1, pp. 210-217.

statement_ko: 렙틴 3마이크로그램을 뇌실에 한 번 주사하면 정상 쥐에서는 체중과 섭취량이 조금만 줄었지만 부신을 제거한 쥐에서는 아주 강하고 오래가는 효과가 났고, 글루코코르티코이드를 보충하니 그 강한 효과가 억제됐어요.
statement_en: Leptin injected intracerebroventricularly as a bolus of 3 microgrammes produced only modest reductions in body weight and food intake in normal rats but very potent and long-lasting effects in adrenalectomised rats, and glucocorticoid supplementation inhibited those potent effects.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Stress
refs: Zakrzewska, K.E. et al. (1997). Glucocorticoids as counterregulatory hormones of leptin: toward an understanding of leptin resistance. Diabetes, 46, pp. 717-9.

statement_ko: 일부 사람은 스트레스를 받으면 식욕이 떨어지는데, 시상하부-뇌하수체-부신 축이 POMC 유전자를 올리고 거기서 강력한 식욕 억제물질인 alpha-MSH가 잘려 나오기 때문이에요.
statement_en: A subset of people become anorectic when stressed because the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis up-regulates the proopiomelanocortin gene, from which alpha-MSH, a potent inhibitor of food intake, is cleaved.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Stress
refs: Zakrzewska, K.E. et al. (1997). Glucocorticoids as counterregulatory hormones of leptin: toward an understanding of leptin resistance. Diabetes, 46, pp. 717-9.

statement_ko: 대부분의 여성은 폐경기에 체중이 조금 늘고, 젊을 때 엉덩이·허벅지에 살이 붙던 여성도 폐경기에는 배 쪽으로 살이 붙어요.
statement_en: Most women gain a modest amount of weight at menopause, and even women with gynoid fat distribution when younger deposit weight centrally at menopause.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Menopause
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 쥐 난소절제 모델에서 체중 증가의 주된 원인은 일시적인 섭취량 증가였는데, 2주째 하루 244 kJ 대 가짜수술군 210 kJ이었고 7주와 12주에는 차이가 사라졌어요.
statement_en: In the rat oophorectomy model the main cause of weight gain was a transient increase in energy intake, 244 kJ/day versus 210 in sham at two weeks, which had gone by seven and 12 weeks.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 15
refs: Ainslie, D.A. et al. (2001). Estrogen deficiency causes central leptin insensitivity and increased hypothalamic neuropeptide Y. International Journal of Obesity and Related Metabolic Disorders, 25, pp. 1680-8.

statement_ko: 난소절제 뒤 자발 활동량이 크게 떨어졌고 12주가 지나도 회복되지 않아서, 하루 17,362회 대 가짜수술군 23,049회였어요.
statement_en: Spontaneous activity fell substantially after oophorectomy and did not recover even at 12 weeks, 17,362 moves per day versus 23,049 in sham animals.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 15
refs: Ainslie, D.A. et al. (2001). Estrogen deficiency causes central leptin insensitivity and increased hypothalamic neuropeptide Y. International Journal of Obesity and Related Metabolic Disorders, 25, pp. 1680-8.

statement_ko: 에스트라디올은 마지막 월경보다 약 3년 앞서 떨어지기 시작하고 가속도계로 잰 활동량도 함께 줄어드는데, 폐경 뒤 활동량은 폐경 전보다 뚜렷하게 낮아요.
statement_en: Estradiol begins to decline about three years before the last menstrual period and accelerometer-measured activity declines with it, being significantly lower after menopause than before.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Menopause (3)
refs: Lovejoy, J.C. et al. (2008). Increased visceral fat and decreased energy expenditure during the menopausal transition. International Journal of Obesity, 32, pp. 949-958.

statement_ko: 폐경 이행기 그래프에서 에스트라디올은 폐경 4년 전 약 315%에서 폐경 시점 약 105%로 떨어졌고, 3축 가속도계 활동량은 약 220%에서 약 103%로 떨어졌어요.
statement_en: On the menopausal transition chart estradiol fell from about 315% of the first menopausal evaluation four years before menopause to about 105% at menopause, while triaxial accelerometer activity fell from about 220% to about 103%.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 16
refs: Lovejoy, J.C. et al. (2008). Increased visceral fat and decreased energy expenditure during the menopausal transition. International Journal of Obesity, 32, pp. 949-958.

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 폐경기 체중 증가의 주된 원인이 자발적 움직임, 곧 꼼지락거림의 감소라고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that weight gain at the menopause is predominantly caused by reduced spontaneous activity, that is fidgeting.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page Assessment Q2
refs: Ainslie, D.A. et al. (2001). Estrogen deficiency causes central leptin insensitivity and increased hypothalamic neuropeptide Y. International Journal of Obesity and Related Metabolic Disorders, 25, pp. 1680-8.
Lovejoy, J.C. et al. (2008). Increased visceral fat and decreased energy expenditure during the menopausal transition. International Journal of Obesity, 32, pp. 949-958.

statement_ko: 배아 8~14일에 비스페놀-A, 프탈산디에틸헥실, 프탈산디부틸 혼합물에 노출된 암컷 쥐는 F3 세대에서 성인기 비만이 늘었어요.
statement_en: Female rats exposed to a mixture of bisphenol-A, bis(2-ethylhexyl)phthalate and dibutyl phthalate during embryonic days 8-14 showed increased adult-onset obesity in the F3 generation.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page 2 Environmental toxins
refs: Manikkam, M. et al. (2013). Plastics Derived Endocrine Disruptors (BPA, DEHP and DBP) Induce Epigenetic Transgenerational Inheritance of Obesity, Reproductive Disease and Sperm Epimutations. PLoS ONE 8(1): e55387. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0055387.

statement_ko: F3 세대에서 저용량 플라스틱 계통은 암컷 52마리 중 5마리(약 9.9%), 수컷 58마리 중 5마리(약 8.8%)가 비만이었고, F1 세대에서는 어느 군에서도 비만이 없었어요.
statement_en: In the F3 generation the lower-dose plastics lineage showed obesity in 5 of 52 females (about 9.9%) and 5 of 58 males (about 8.8%), with no obesity in any F1 group.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Charts and diagrams page 17
refs: Manikkam, M. et al. (2013). Plastics Derived Endocrine Disruptors (BPA, DEHP and DBP) Induce Epigenetic Transgenerational Inheritance of Obesity, Reproductive Disease and Sperm Epimutations. PLoS ONE 8(1): e55387. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0055387.

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 여러 요인이 체중에 영향을 줄 수 있지만 비만으로 이끄는 주된 요인은 조력하는 환경 속에서 작동하는 유전적 소인, 곧 고전적 유전자 돌연변이나 후성유전적 발현 변화라고 결론지어요.
statement_en: The module concludes that while many factors can influence body weight, the predominant factors leading to obesity are genetic predisposition, either classical genetic mutations or epigenetic modification of gene expression, in the presence of a facilitating environment.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 스트레스가 늘 체중 증가로 이어지지는 않는다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that stress does not always lead to weight gain.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page Assessment Q3
refs: Zakrzewska, K.E. et al. (1997). Glucocorticoids as counterregulatory hormones of leptin: toward an understanding of leptin resistance. Diabetes, 46, pp. 717-9.

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 여러 바이러스 감염이 체중에 영향을 준다는 근거로, 가벼운 체중 증가가 전염될 수도 있다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that mild weight gain can be contagious, because various viral infections have been shown to influence body weight.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 2 › Page Assessment Q5
refs: Atkinson, R.L. (2007). Viruses as an etiology of obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 82(10), pp. 1192-8.

statement_ko: 비만의 통상적인 의학적 평가는 포괄적인 병력 청취, 신체검진, 그리고 선별된 검사로 동반질환을 찾고 평가하는 일로 이뤄져요.
statement_en: Routine medical evaluation for obesity consists of a comprehensive history, a physical examination, and identifying and evaluating co-morbid conditions with selected laboratory and diagnostic tests.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page Introduction
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 장기별 동반질환의 수와 중증도는 대체로 비만 정도가 심할수록 늘고, 모든 장기 계통에 영향을 줄 수 있어요.
statement_en: The number and severity of organ-specific co-morbidities usually rise with increasing levels of obesity and can affect all organ systems.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page Introduction
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지각이상성 대퇴신경통은 외측대퇴피신경이 눌려 허벅지 바깥쪽에 저림·감각저하·타는 듯한 통증이 생기는 상태예요.
statement_en: Meralgia paresthetica is a condition characterised by tingling, numbness and burning pain in the outer thigh caused by compression of the lateral femoral cutaneous nerve.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Comorbidities of five organ systems
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 특발두개내압상승은 가성뇌종양이라고도 부르는 비만 관련 질환으로, 확인하려면 추가 검사나 전문 시술이 필요해요.
statement_en: Idiopathic intracranial hypertension, also called pseudotumor cerebri, is an obesity-related condition that needs extra tests or specialised procedures to identify.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Comorbidities of five organ systems
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 정신건강 문제는 비만과 서로 영향을 주고받을 수 있고, 쿠싱증후군은 비만의 결과가 아니라 비교적 드문 원인이에요.
statement_en: Psychological conditions may be bi-directional with obesity, and Cushing's syndrome is a relatively uncommon cause of obesity rather than a consequence of it.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Comorbidities of five organ systems
refs: Nieman, L.K. et al. (2008). The diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome: an Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 93(5), pp. 1526-1540.

statement_ko: 비만 진료지침은 대체로 모든 환자에게 공복 지질검사와 혈당검사를 하도록 권해요.
statement_en: Obesity clinical guidelines generally recommend that all patients have a fasting lipid panel and blood glucose measured.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Metabolic syndrome
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 중성지방 상승, HDL 콜레스테롤 저하, 혈당 상승은 대사증후군 다섯 구성요소 가운데 셋에 해당해요.
statement_en: Elevated triglycerides, low HDL cholesterol and elevated blood glucose comprise three of the five components of the metabolic syndrome.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Metabolic syndrome
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 대사증후군의 비만 구성요소는 체질량지수가 아니라 늘어난 허리둘레예요.
statement_en: The obesity component of the metabolic syndrome is increased waist circumference, not body mass index.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Metabolic syndrome
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 통합 대사증후군 표는 허리둘레 상승 기준을 여성 80 cm(35인치) 이상, 남성 94 cm(40인치) 이상으로 두면서, 인구집단·국가별 정의가 따로 있다고 덧붙여요.
statement_en: The harmonised metabolic syndrome table gives an elevated waist circumference cut-point of at least 80 cm (35 in) in females and at least 94 cm (40 in) in males, with a note that population and country-specific definitions apply.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 19
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 대사증후군의 중성지방 기준은 1.7 mmol/L(150 mg/dl) 이상이거나 중성지방 상승에 대한 약물치료를 받는 경우예요.
statement_en: The metabolic syndrome triglyceride cut-point is at least 1.7 mmol/L (150 mg/dl), or drug treatment for elevated triglycerides.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 19
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 대사증후군의 HDL 콜레스테롤 저하 기준은 남성 1.0 mmol/L(40 mg/dl) 미만, 여성 1.3 mmol/L(50 mg/dl) 미만이에요.
statement_en: The metabolic syndrome reduced HDL cholesterol cut-point is below 1.0 mmol/L (40 mg/dl) in males and below 1.3 mmol/L (50 mg/dl) in females.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 19
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 대사증후군의 혈압 상승 기준은 수축기 130 mmHg 이상이거나 이완기 85 mmHg 이상, 또는 고혈압 병력이나 약물치료가 있는 경우예요.
statement_en: The metabolic syndrome elevated blood pressure cut-point is systolic of at least 130 and/or diastolic of at least 85 mmHg, or a history of hypertension or drug treatment.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 19
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 슬라이드에 실린 대사증후군의 공복혈당 상승 기준은 5.5 mmol/L(100 mg/dl) 이상이거나 고혈당에 대한 약물치료를 받는 경우예요.
statement_en: The metabolic syndrome elevated fasting glucose cut-point printed on the slide is at least 5.5 mmol/L (100 mg/dl), or drug treatment for hyperglycaemia.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 19
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 대사증후군은 표에 실린 다섯 위험요인 가운데 셋 이상이 있을 때 진단해요.
statement_en: The metabolic syndrome is diagnosed when three or more of the five listed risk factors are present.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 19
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 폐쇄성 수면무호흡, 지방간, 작고 조밀한 LDL 입자, CRP 같은 염증표지자는 대사증후군과 연관되지만 진단기준은 아니에요.
statement_en: Obstructive sleep apnoea, fatty liver disease, small dense LDL particles and inflammatory markers such as CRP are associated with the metabolic syndrome but are not diagnostic criteria.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Metabolic syndrome
refs: Alberti, K.G. et al. (2009). Harmonizing the metabolic syndrome: a joint interim statement of the International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention; National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute; American Heart Association; World Heart Federation; International Atherosclerosis Society; and International Association for the Study of Obesity. Circulation, 120, pp. 1640-1645.

statement_ko: 혈당 이상은 당화혈색소, 공복혈장혈당, 2시간 경구당부하검사로 찾을 수 있고, 당화혈색소는 금식이 필요 없어서 더 편해요.
statement_en: Glucose abnormalities can be detected with haemoglobin A1c, fasting plasma glucose, or a 2-hour oral glucose tolerance test, and HbA1c does not require fasting so is more convenient.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Prediabetes and type 2 diabetes
refs: American Diabetes Association (2017). Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care Jan, 40 (Supplement 1), S1-S2.

statement_ko: 기준값 표에서 당화혈색소 5.7~6.4%는 공복혈당장애나 내당능장애, 6.5% 이상은 2형당뇨병, 5.7% 미만은 정상이에요.
statement_en: On the cut-off table A1C of 5.7-6.4% indicates impaired fasting glucose or impaired glucose tolerance, at least 6.5% indicates type 2 diabetes, and below 5.7% is normal.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 20
refs: American Diabetes Association (2017). Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care Jan, 40 (Supplement 1), S1-S2.

statement_ko: 기준값 표에서 공복혈장혈당 5.6~6.9 mmol/L(100~125 mg/dL)는 공복혈당장애, 7.0 mmol/L(126 mg/dL) 이상은 2형당뇨병, 5.6 mmol/L 미만은 정상이에요.
statement_en: On the cut-off table fasting plasma glucose of 5.6-6.9 mmol/L (100-125 mg/dL) indicates impaired fasting glucose, at least 7.0 mmol/L (126 mg/dL) indicates type 2 diabetes, and below 5.6 mmol/L is normal.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 20
refs: American Diabetes Association (2017). Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care Jan, 40 (Supplement 1), S1-S2.

statement_ko: 기준값 표에서 2시간 경구당부하 수치 7.8~11.0 mmol/L(140~199 mg/dL)는 내당능장애, 11.1 mmol/L(200 mg/dL) 이상은 2형당뇨병, 7.8 mmol/L 미만은 정상이에요.
statement_en: On the cut-off table a 2-hour OGTT value of 7.8-11.0 mmol/L (140-199 mg/dL) indicates impaired glucose tolerance, at least 11.1 mmol/L (200 mg/dL) indicates type 2 diabetes, and below 7.8 mmol/L is normal.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 20
refs: American Diabetes Association (2017). Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care Jan, 40 (Supplement 1), S1-S2.

statement_ko: 무작위 혈장혈당이 11.1 mmol/L(200 mg/dl)를 넘는 것처럼 임상적으로 당뇨병이 분명한 경우가 아니라면, 확진에는 대체로 두 번째 검사가 필요해요.
statement_en: Unless there is a clear clinical diagnosis of diabetes, such as a random plasma glucose above 11.1 mmol/L (200 mg/dl), a second test is generally required for confirmation.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Prediabetes and type 2 diabetes
refs: American Diabetes Association (2017). Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care Jan, 40 (Supplement 1), S1-S2.

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 공복혈장혈당이 정상 범위여도 당화혈색소 측정이 진단에 도움이 된다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that measuring HbA1c does add diagnostic value even when fasting plasma glucose is in the normal range.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page Assessment Q4
refs: American Diabetes Association (2017). Standards of Medical Care in Diabetes. Diabetes Care Jan, 40 (Supplement 1), S1-S2.

statement_ko: 다낭성난소증후군은 가임기 여성에게 가장 흔한 내분비질환이고, 이 증후군이 있는 여성의 50~80%가 비만이에요.
statement_en: Polycystic ovary syndrome is the most common endocrinopathy of women of reproductive age, and 50 to 80% of women with PCOS have obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Polycystic ovary syndrome
refs: Azziz, R. et al. (2006). Positions statement: criteria for defining polycystic ovary syndrome as a predominantly hyperandrogenic syndrome: an Androgen Excess Society guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 91, pp. 4237-4245.

statement_ko: 다낭성난소증후군 슬라이드에서 배란·월경 장애는 75%, 고안드로겐혈증은 60~80%, 다모증은 60%, 여드름은 15~25%, 다낭성 난소는 75%에서 나타나요.
statement_en: On the PCOS slide ovulatory and menstrual dysfunction occurs in 75%, hyperandrogenaemia in 60-80%, hirsutism in 60%, acne in 15-25%, and polycystic ovaries in 75%.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Polycystic ovary syndrome
refs: Azziz, R. et al. (2006). Positions statement: criteria for defining polycystic ovary syndrome as a predominantly hyperandrogenic syndrome: an Androgen Excess Society guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 91, pp. 4237-4245.

statement_ko: 다낭성난소증후군은 대사증후군, 2형당뇨병, 자궁내막암 위험을 높이므로 모든 환자에게 2형당뇨병 선별검사를 해야 해요.
statement_en: PCOS carries an increased risk for metabolic syndrome, type 2 diabetes and endometrial cancer, and all patients should be screened for type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 PCOS diagnostic criteria
refs: Azziz, R. et al. (2009). The Androgen Excess and PCOS Society criteria for the polycystic ovary syndrome: the complete task force report. Fertility and Sterility, 91, pp. 456-488.

statement_ko: 다낭성난소증후군 진단지침은 세 가지로, 1990년 미국 국립보건원 기준(두 항목 모두), 2003년 로테르담 기준(세 항목 중 둘), 2009년 안드로겐과잉·다낭성난소증후군학회 기준(두 항목 모두)이에요.
statement_en: The three published PCOS diagnostic guidelines are the 1990 National Institutes of Health criteria (both criteria required), the 2003 Rotterdam criteria (two of three required) and the 2009 Androgen Excess & PCOS Society criteria (both criteria required).
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 21
refs: Rotterdam ESHRE/ASRM-Sponsored PCOS Consensus Workshop Group (2004). Revised 2003 consensus on diagnostic criteria and long-term health risks related to polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). Human Reproduction 19, pp. 41-47.
Azziz, R. et al. (2009). The Androgen Excess and PCOS Society criteria for the polycystic ovary syndrome: the complete task force report. Fertility and Sterility, 91, pp. 456-488.
Dunaif et al. (1992) [slide credit, PCOS diagnostic criteria table]

statement_ko: 고안드로겐혈증의 일차 검사는 혈청 총테스토스테론이고, 총테스토스테론 대 성호르몬결합글로불린 비는 고안드로겐혈증을 민감하게 잡아내요.
statement_en: For hyperandrogenism the first-line measurement is total serum testosterone, and the ratio of total testosterone to sex hormone binding globulin is a sensitive measure of hyperandrogenaemia.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 21
refs: Azziz, R. et al. (2009). The Androgen Excess and PCOS Society criteria for the polycystic ovary syndrome: the complete task force report. Fertility and Sterility, 91, pp. 456-488.

statement_ko: 다낭성난소증후군의 배란 장애는 보통 21일 미만이나 35일 초과 간격의 불규칙한 월경으로 나타나고, 많은 여성이 난임 병력으로 찾아와요.
statement_en: Ovulatory dysfunction in PCOS typically means unpredictable menses occurring at less than 21-day or greater than 35-day intervals, and many women present with a history of infertility.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 PCOS diagnostic criteria
refs: Azziz, R. et al. (2009). The Androgen Excess and PCOS Society criteria for the polycystic ovary syndrome: the complete task force report. Fertility and Sterility, 91, pp. 456-488.

statement_ko: 쿠싱증후군은 내인성 글루코코르티코이드 과잉으로 생기는 고코르티솔 상태예요.
statement_en: Cushing's syndrome is a state of hypercortisolism that results from endogenous glucocorticoid excess.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Cushing's syndrome
refs: Nieman, L.K. et al. (2008). The diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome: an Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 93(5), pp. 1526-1540.

statement_ko: 쿠싱증후군을 가장 잘 가려내는 소견은 쉽게 드는 멍, 얼굴 홍조, 근위부 근병증, 특히 붉은 자주색이고 폭 1 cm를 넘는 선조, 그리고 소아에서 성장속도가 느려지면서 체중이 느는 양상이에요.
statement_en: The features that best discriminate Cushing's syndrome are easy bruising, facial plethora, proximal myopathy, striae especially if reddish purple and more than 1 cm wide, and in children weight gain with decreasing growth velocity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 22
refs: Nieman, L.K. et al. (2008). The diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome: an Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 93(5), pp. 1526-1540.

statement_ko: 쿠싱증후군의 주요 일차 선별검사는 24시간 소변 유리코르티솔 2회 측정, 하룻밤 1 mg 덱사메타손 억제검사, 또는 늦은 밤 타액 코르티솔 2회 측정이에요.
statement_en: The three major initial screening tests for Cushing's syndrome are two measurements of 24-hour urinary free cortisol, an overnight 1-mg dexamethasone suppression test, or two measurements of late-night salivary cortisol.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Testing for Cushing's syndrome
refs: Nieman, L.K. et al. (2008). The diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome: an Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 93(5), pp. 1526-1540.

statement_ko: 쿠싱증후군 진단 알고리듬은 선별검사에 앞서 외인성 글루코코르티코이드 노출을 먼저 배제하는 데서 출발해요.
statement_en: The Cushing's syndrome diagnostic algorithm begins by excluding exogenous glucocorticoid exposure before any screening test is performed.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 23
refs: Nieman, L.K. et al. (2008). The diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome: an Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology & Metabolism, 93(5), pp. 1526-1540.

statement_ko: 과체중은 폐쇄성 수면무호흡 전체 사례의 40%, 중등도~중증 사례의 거의 60%를 설명해요.
statement_en: Excess weight is responsible for 40% of all cases of obstructive sleep apnoea and nearly 60% of moderate-to-severe cases.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Obstructive sleep apnoea
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: 폐쇄성 수면무호흡 평가가 필요한 고위험군에는 비만(BMI 35 초과), 울혈성 심부전, 심방세동, 치료저항성 고혈압, 2형당뇨병, 야간 부정맥, 뇌졸중, 폐고혈압, 고위험 운전 직군, 비만대사수술 전 환자가 들어가요.
statement_en: Patients at high risk who should be evaluated for obstructive sleep apnoea include those with obesity (BMI over 35), congestive heart failure, atrial fibrillation, treatment-refractory hypertension, type 2 diabetes, nocturnal dysrhythmias, stroke, pulmonary hypertension, a high-risk driving occupation, and those being prepared for bariatric surgery.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Obstructive Sleep Apnoea
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: 말람파티 분류는 연구개·목젖·인두·구개궁이 모두 보이는 1등급부터 경구개만 보이는 4등급까지 나뉘어요.
statement_en: The Mallampati classes run from Class I, where soft palate, uvula, fauces and pillars are visible, to Class IV, where only the hard palate is visible.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Evaluation for OSA
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: 중등도나 중증 폐색과 연결되는 말람파티 3등급이나 4등급은 폐쇄성 수면무호흡을 특히 의심하게 만들어요.
statement_en: A Mallampati score of Class III or Class IV, associated with moderate or severe obstruction, should particularly raise suspicion for obstructive sleep apnoea.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Evaluation for OSA
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: 엡워스 졸음척도는 여덟 가지 상황을 3점 척도로 묻고, 10점을 넘으면 과도한 주간 졸림에 해당해 추가 평가를 해야 해요.
statement_en: The Epworth Sleepiness Scale asks about eight situations rated on a 3-point scale, and a score of more than 10 is consistent with excessive daytime sleepiness and should prompt further clinical evaluation.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Screening for OSA
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: STOP-BANG은 코골이, 피로감, 목격된 호흡정지, 고혈압, BMI 35 초과, 나이 50세 초과, 목둘레 40 cm 초과, 남성을 뜻해요.
statement_en: STOP-BANG stands for Snoring, feeling Tired, Observed stopping breathing, high blood Pressure, BMI above 35, Age over 50, Neck circumference over 40 cm and male Gender.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Screening for OSA
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: STOP-BANG 점수가 3점 이상이면 어떤 형태의 폐쇄성 수면무호흡이든 예측하는 민감도가 84%예요.
statement_en: A STOP-BANG score of 3 or more has an 84% sensitivity for predicting any obstructive sleep apnoea.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Screening for OSA
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: 폐쇄성 수면무호흡의 확진에는 수면검사가 필요한데, 휴대형 감시장치를 쓰는 가정 수면검사나 수면검사실의 수면다원검사를 하고, 수면의학 클리닉 의뢰도 합리적인 대안이에요.
statement_en: Definitive diagnosis of obstructive sleep apnoea requires a sleep study, either a home sleep test with a portable monitor or polysomnography in a sleep lab, and referral to a sleep medicine clinic is a reasonable alternative.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 1 Screening for OSA
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 폐쇄성 수면무호흡 발생을 예측하는 가장 중요한 인자가 비만이라고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that obesity is the most important predictor for the development of obstructive sleep apnoea.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page Assessment Q1
refs: Adult Obstructive Sleep Apnea Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine (2009). Clinical Guideline for the Evaluation, Management and Long-term Care of Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Adults. Journal of Clinical Sleep Medicine, Jun 15, 5(3), pp. 263- 276.

statement_ko: 나머지 네 장기 계통의 동반질환은 근골격계, 소화기계, 피부계, 비뇨생식기계로 다뤄져요.
statement_en: The comorbidities of the other four organ systems covered are musculoskeletal, gastrointestinal, integument and genitourinary.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Comorbidities of the other four organ systems
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만의 의학적 합병증 인체도는 비만 관련 암으로 유방, 자궁, 자궁경부, 대장, 식도, 췌장, 신장, 전립선을 들어요.
statement_en: The body map of medical complications of obesity lists obesity-related cancers of the breast, uterus, cervix, colon, oesophagus, pancreas, kidney and prostate.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 18
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 인체도는 폐질환, 특발두개내압상승, 뇌졸중, 백내장, 관상동맥질환, 담낭질환, 중증 췌장염, 부인과 이상, 골관절염, 정맥염, 정맥울혈, 피부 문제, 통풍도 함께 표시해요.
statement_en: The body map also lists pulmonary disease, idiopathic intracranial hypertension, stroke, cataracts, coronary heart disease, gall bladder disease, severe pancreatitis, gynaecological abnormalities, osteoarthritis, phlebitis, venous stasis, skin problems and gout.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Charts and diagrams page 18
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비알코올지방간질환은 일반 인구에서 간효소가 지속적으로 오르는 가장 흔한 원인으로 여겨져요.
statement_en: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease is considered the most common cause of persistently elevated liver enzymes in the general population.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: 비알코올지방간질환의 임상 스펙트럼은 단순 지방증에서 비알코올지방간염으로, 다시 간경변과 간세포암종으로 이어져요.
statement_en: The clinical spectrum of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease runs from simple steatosis to non-alcoholic steatohepatitis, then cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: 지방증은 비만 인구의 3분의 2 이상, 고도비만인 사람의 90% 이상에서 발견돼요.
statement_en: Steatosis is found in over two thirds of the population with obesity and in more than 90% of people with severe obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: 지방간 환자 대부분은 특이한 징후나 증상이 없고, 흔히 알라닌아미노전달효소와 아스파르트산아미노전달효소가 가볍거나 중간 정도로 올라가요.
statement_en: Most patients with fatty liver have no specific signs or symptoms and commonly show mild-to-moderate elevations of alanine aminotransferase and aspartate aminotransferase.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: 지방간질환에서 가장 흔한 생화학 소견은 ALT/AST 비의 상승인데, 민감도와 특이도가 낮아 추가 평가가 필요해요.
statement_en: An elevated ALT/AST ratio is the most common biochemical observation in fatty liver disease, but its low sensitivity and specificity mean further evaluation is needed.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 NAFLD diagnostic workup
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL). European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD). European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO) (2016). EASL-EASD- EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the management of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 64, pp. 1388-1402.

statement_ko: 섬유화는 염증이 있는 간에 생기는 흉터로, 흉터의 범위와 분포에 따라 0~4단계 또는 경도·중등도·진행으로 나눠요.
statement_en: Fibrosis is scarring in an inflamed liver, categorised by stage 0 to 4 or as mild, moderate or advanced, based on the extent and distribution of scarring.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: 지방간염이나 섬유화가 없는 비알코올지방간은 간경변까지 진행하는 데 평균 57년이 걸리는데, 진행을 바꿀 수 있는 중재는 이 계산에 들어가 있지 않아요.
statement_en: Non-alcoholic fatty liver without steatohepatitis or fibrosis takes on average 57 years to progress to cirrhosis, though this does not take account of interventions that may modify progression.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: NAFLD 섬유화 점수는 나이, BMI, 고혈당, 혈소판수, 알부민, ALT/AST 비라는 손쉽게 구할 수 있는 여섯 변수로 계산해요.
statement_en: The NAFLD Fibrosis Score is based on six readily available variables: age, BMI, hyperglycaemia, platelet count, albumin and the ALT/AST ratio.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 NAFLD diagnostic workup
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL). European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD). European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO) (2016). EASL-EASD- EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the management of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 64, pp. 1388-1402.

statement_ko: ELF 패널은 혈장 내 기질 교체 단백 세 가지, 곧 히알루론산, 3형 프로콜라겐 아미노말단 펩타이드, 메탈로프로테이나제 조직억제인자 1로 이뤄져요.
statement_en: The enhanced liver fibrosis panel consists of plasma levels of three matrix turnover proteins: hyaluronic acid, procollagen III amino terminal peptide and tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinase 1.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 NAFLD diagnostic workup
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL). European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD). European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO) (2016). EASL-EASD- EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the management of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 64, pp. 1388-1402.

statement_ko: 지방간의 전형적인 초음파 소견은 간 크기 증가, 미만성 고에코 간실질, 혈관 음영의 둔화이고, 지방증 단계가 높을수록 민감도가 올라가요.
statement_en: Characteristic ultrasound findings in fatty liver are increased liver size, diffuse hyperechoic liver parenchyma and vascular blunting, and sensitivity is higher at higher stages of hepatic steatosis.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 NAFLD diagnostic workup
refs: Shen, F.F., Lu, L.G. (2016). Advances in noninvasive methods for diagnosing nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Digestive Diseases, 17, pp. 565-571.

statement_ko: 일과성 탄성초음파는 낮은 진폭·저주파 진동을 보내는 초음파 탐촉자로 간의 딱딱함을 재고, 미리 정한 기준값을 쓰면 특이도 90%가 넘게 진행 섬유화나 간경변을 가려내요.
statement_en: Transient elastography measures liver stiffness using an ultrasound transducer transmitting mild-amplitude, low-frequency vibration and, with a prespecified cut-off, is a reliable indicator of advanced fibrosis or cirrhosis with a specificity of over 90%.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 NAFLD diagnostic workup
refs: Shen, F.F., Lu, L.G. (2016). Advances in noninvasive methods for diagnosing nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Digestive Diseases, 17, pp. 565-571.

statement_ko: 자기공명영상과 양성자 자기공명분광법은 간 조직의 화학 조성, 곧 물과 지방을 가려내는 데 도움을 줘요.
statement_en: MRI and proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy help detect the chemical composition of liver tissue, that is water and fat.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 NAFLD diagnostic workup
refs: Shen, F.F., Lu, L.G. (2016). Advances in noninvasive methods for diagnosing nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Digestive Diseases, 17, pp. 565-571.

statement_ko: 간생검은 지방간과 그 스펙트럼을 확진하는 방법이고, 검사를 진행하면서 간전문의 자문을 받아야 해요.
statement_en: Liver biopsy gives the definitive diagnosis of fatty liver and its spectrum, and hepatologist consultation should be sought as the workup proceeds.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 NAFLD diagnostic workup
refs: European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL). European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD). European Association for the Study of Obesity (EASO) (2016). EASL-EASD- EASO Clinical Practice Guidelines for the management of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease. Journal of Hepatology, 64, pp. 1388-1402.

statement_ko: 슬라이드가 지방간질환과 연관이 확립됐다고 든 상태는 비만, 2형당뇨병, 이상지질혈증, 대사증후군이에요.
statement_en: The conditions with established associations with fatty liver disease listed on the slide are obesity, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidaemia and the metabolic syndrome.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 지방간 환자가 우상복부 불편감을 호소하기보다 대체로 증상이 없다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that patients with fatty liver are typically free of symptoms rather than presenting with right upper quadrant discomfort.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page Assessment Q9
refs: Glen, J. et al. (2016). Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD): summary of NICE guidance. British Medical Journal, 153, pp.1025-30.

statement_ko: 남성 성선기능저하증은 성욕 감소, 발기부전, 아침 발기 빈도 감소, 성기능 저하, 우울한 기분, 수면장애가 있는 남성에서 생각해 봐야 해요.
statement_en: Male hypogonadism should be considered in men with decreased libido, erectile dysfunction, decreased frequency of morning erections, decreased sexual performance, depressed mood or sleep disturbance.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Hypogonadism
refs: Morales, A. et al. (2015). Canadian Men's Health Foundation Multidisciplinary Guidelines Task Force on Testosterone Deficiency. Diagnosis and management of testosterone deficiency syndrome in men: clinical practice guideline. Canadian Medical Association Journal, 187, pp. 1369-77.

statement_ko: 테스토스테론 결핍이 의심되면 아침 총테스토스테론부터 재고, 낮으면 FSH, LH, 성호르몬결합글로불린, 프로락틴까지 포함한 정밀검사로 일차성인지 이차성인지 가려요.
statement_en: Laboratory evaluation of suspected testosterone deficiency begins with a morning total testosterone, and if low, a fuller evaluation including FSH, LH, sex hormone binding globulin and prolactin distinguishes primary from secondary hypogonadism.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page 2 Hypogonadism
refs: Morales, A. et al. (2015). Canadian Men's Health Foundation Multidisciplinary Guidelines Task Force on Testosterone Deficiency. Diagnosis and management of testosterone deficiency syndrome in men: clinical practice guideline. Canadian Medical Association Journal, 187, pp. 1369-77.

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 무리하지 않고 이룰 수 있는 정도의 감량만으로도 비만 동반질환이 좋아진다는 점을 결론으로 짚어요.
statement_en: The module concludes that modest and achievable weight loss has been shown to improve the comorbidities of obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 3 › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만 관리의 5A는 먼저 허락을 구하고(Ask), 어떤 조언보다 앞서 전면적인 평가를 하고(Assess), 치료 계획을 환자와 합의하고(Agree), 환자를 돕는(Assist) 순서예요.
statement_en: The 5As of Obesity Management are to Ask for permission, Assess with a complete assessment before offering any advice, Agree with the patient on the treatment plan, and Assist the patient.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 1 Using the 5As of Obesity Management
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만의 4M은 정신건강(Mental), 기계적 문제(Mechanical), 대사(Metabolic), 경제적 건강(Monetary)이에요.
statement_en: The 4Ms of obesity are Mental health, Mechanical, Metabolic and Monetary health.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 The '4Ms' of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 4M 평가에서 가장 먼저 살펴야 할 M은 늘 정신건강 상태예요.
statement_en: Mental health status is always the first M to explore in the 4Ms assessment.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 The '4Ms' of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 기계적 M에는 관절염, 수면무호흡, 역류질환, 요실금 같은 문제가 들어가는데, 이들은 체중 증가를 부추기기도 하고 과체중의 결과이기도 하며 체중 관리의 걸림돌이 되기도 해요.
statement_en: The Mechanical M covers arthritis, sleep apnoea, reflux disease, urinary incontinence and other mechanical issues, which can promote weight gain, be consequences of excess weight, or be barriers to weight management.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 The '4Ms' of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 대사 M에는 당뇨병, 고혈압, 지방간질환, 통풍, 다낭성난소증후군, 일부 암이 들어가고, 체중을 늘리는 약물을 점검하는 일까지 포함돼요.
statement_en: The Metabolic M covers diabetes, high blood pressure, fatty liver disease, gout, polycystic ovary syndrome and some cancers, and includes reviewing medications that promote weight gain.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 The '4Ms' of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 경제적 M은 체중 증가의 사회경제적 이유를 다뤄요. 돈이 부족하면 건강한 식사를 못 하고, 과체중은 소득에 영향을 줄 수 있으며, 감당 못 할 만큼 비싼 치료는 그 환자에게 통하지 않아요.
statement_en: The Monetary M covers socioeconomic reasons for weight gain: not having enough money can stop a patient eating a healthy diet, excess weight can affect income, and unaffordable treatments will not work for that patient.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 The '4Ms' of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체질량지수는 환자가 얼마나 큰지를 알려줄 뿐이고, 얼마나 아픈지를 알려면 다른 도구가 필요해요.
statement_en: Body mass index tells you how big your patient is, but another tool is needed to determine how sick the patient is.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 BMI knowledge check
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 에드먼턴 비만 병기 체계는 환자가 얼마나 아픈지를 신체 건강, 정신 건강, 기능적 건강으로 가늠하도록 만들어졌어요.
statement_en: The Edmonton Obesity Staging System is designed to show how sick the patient is, assessed through physical health, mental health and functional health.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 Assess
refs: Padwal, R.S. et al. (2011). Using the Edmonton Obesity Staging System to predict mortality in a population-representative cohort of people with overweight and obesity. Canadian Medical Association Journal, Oct 4, 183(14), E1059-66.

statement_ko: 과체중을 평가할 때는 실행 가능한 치료 계획을 세우기 위해 체중 증가의 가능한 원인, 그로 인한 결과, 환자가 마주한 장벽을 모두 살펴야 해요.
statement_en: Any assessment of excess weight must look for the possible causes of weight gain, the consequences of weight gain and the barriers the patient faces, in order to build a workable treatment plan.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 3 Assessment framing
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 권장하는 접근은 먼저 환자가 호소한 문제를 다루고, 그다음 체중을 관찰한 사실로 꺼내며 허락을 구하고, 가능하면 체중 이야기를 호소 문제와 연결하는 거예요.
statement_en: The recommended approach is to deal with the presenting complaint first, then raise weight as an observation and ask permission, linking the weight question to the presenting problem where possible.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 2 Ask
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 역할극 속 환자는 창고에서 하루 약 400개의 상자를 옮기는 일을 하는데, 환자가 활동하지 않는다고 넘겨짚으면 안 된다는 점을 보여줘요.
statement_en: In the role-play the patient works in a warehouse moving about 400 boxes a day, illustrating that clinicians must not assume patients are inactive.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 1 Right approach
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 역할극 속 환자는 점심을 거르고 아침은 아예 안 먹으며 지난달보다 5파운드를 뺐다고 말하는데, 의사는 감량을 인정하면서도 끼니를 거르는 방식이 체중 관리에 최선은 아닐 수 있다고 짚어요.
statement_en: The patient in the role-play reports being down five pounds since last month by skipping lunch and never eating breakfast, and the doctor affirms the loss while noting that skipping meals may not be the best way to manage weight.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page 2 Ask
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 호소 증상이 생명을 위협하지 않더라도 비만 이야기를 하려고 그것을 제쳐 두어서는 안 된다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that if the presenting complaint is not life threatening it should still not be put aside in order to discuss obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page Assessment Q2
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 과체중 이야기를 꺼내기 전에 환자의 이전 감량 시도를 아는 일이 중요하다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that knowing the patient's previous weight loss attempts is important before raising the issue of excess weight.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 4 › Page Assessment Q3
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 병력 청취의 첫 질문은 어린 시절부터 비만이었는지인데, 이 비만이 유전일 가능성이 높은지를 가늠하기 위해서예요.
statement_en: The first history question is whether the patient was obese in early childhood, which establishes whether the obesity has a high probability of being genetic.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 History of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 멜버른 클리닉에서 여성 비만의 가장 흔한 촉발 사건은 임신이었고, 여성의 30%에 가까운 수가 이를 꼽았어요.
statement_en: In the Melbourne clinic the most common precipitating event for obesity in women was pregnancy, named by close to 30% of women.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 History of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 재태연령에 비해 작게 태어난 아기는 성인이 되어 체중이 과하게 느는 경우가 많아서, 출생 체중을 물어봐야 해요.
statement_en: Small-for-gestational-age babies often put on excess weight when they are adults, so birth weight should be asked about.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 History of obesity
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 환자가 기록한 가장 무거웠던 체중은 그 사람의 설정점을 가늠하게 해줘요.
statement_en: The patient's heaviest ever weight gives an idea of the patient's set point.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 Heaviest weight
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 가장 가벼웠던 체중을 물을 때 성인기는 만 17세부터로 잡아요.
