statement_en: For the lowest weight question, adulthood is defined as from the age of 17 years.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 Lowest weight and weight loss efforts
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 가족력은 부모와 형제자매뿐 아니라 조부모, 삼촌, 이모 같은 확대 가족까지 아우르고, 당뇨병·고혈압·이상지질혈증·혈관질환의 가족력도 함께 물어요.
statement_en: Family history should include not only parents and siblings but the extended family such as grandparents, uncles and aunts, plus family history of diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidaemia and vascular disease.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 Family history
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 배 모양 체형은 여성형 비만, 사과 모양 체형은 남성형 비만인데, 남성은 언제나 남성형 비만이라 굳이 물을 필요가 없다고 강의록은 적어 놨어요.
statement_en: Pear-shaped fat distribution is gynoid obesity and apple-shaped is android obesity, and the transcript notes there is no need to ask about the males because men always have android obesity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 Family history
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 약물을 물을 때는 항우울제를 먹고 있는지가 특히 중요한데, 여러 항우울제가 체중 증가에 영향을 주기 때문이에요.
statement_en: When asking about medications it is particularly important to know whether the patient is taking any antidepressants, as various antidepressants can affect weight gain.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 Medications
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 역류는 복부비만이 있는 환자에게 더 흔해서, 복부 계통 문진에서 속쓰림을 물어봐야 해요.
statement_en: Reflux is more common in patients with central obesity, so heartburn should be asked about in the abdominal systems review.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 1 Systems review
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 측정 전에는 환자가 신발과 겉옷을 벗어야 하고, 체중·키·허리둘레·엉덩이둘레를 모두 재서 기록해야 해요.
statement_en: Before measurement the patient should take off their shoes and coat, and weight, height, waist circumference and hip circumference should all be measured and recorded.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Measurements
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 허리둘레는 갈비뼈 아래 끝과 골반뼈 위쪽의 중간 지점에 줄자를 두르고 줄자를 수평으로 유지한 채 재요.
statement_en: To measure waist circumference, place the tape measure around the waist halfway between the lower end of the ribs and the top of the pelvis, keeping the tape horizontal.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Measurements
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 손을 볼 때는 손금 창백, 흑색가시세포증을 시사하는 손등 관절 색소침착, 손바닥 홍반을 확인하고 이어서 혈압을 재요.
statement_en: On examining the hands, look for palmar crease pallor, darkening of the knuckles suggesting acanthosis nigricans, and palmar erythema, then take the blood pressure.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Hands and eyes
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 손등 관절이 검게 변해 있으면 목과 겨드랑이에서 피부 색소침착이나 쥐젖을 확인해야 하는데, 모두 인슐린 저항성의 징후예요.
statement_en: If darkening of the knuckles is present, check the neck and axillae for skin darkening or skin tags, which are all signs of insulin resistance.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Hands and eyes
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 손바닥 홍반이 보이면 거미모양혈관종이나 황달처럼 만성 간질환을 시사하는 다른 말초 소견을 함께 찾아야 해요.
statement_en: Palmar erythema should prompt a check for other peripheral evidence of chronic liver disease such as spider naevi and jaundice.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Hands and eyes
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 눈을 볼 때는 결막 창백과, 황달을 시사할 수 있는 공막 황달 소견을 확인해요.
statement_en: On examining the eyes, check for conjunctival pallor and for scleral icterus, which might suggest jaundice.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Hands and eyes
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 갑상선종과 목의 지방을 구분하려면 검지와 엄지를 목에 가볍게 두르고 삼키게 하는데, 지방은 삼킬 때 올라가지 않고 커진 갑상선은 목을 따라 뚜렷하게 올라가요.
statement_en: To distinguish a goitre from neck fat, put index finger and thumb gently around the neck and ask the patient to swallow: fat will not move up on swallowing, but an enlarged thyroid will clearly move up the neck.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Neck
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 새 환자에게는 항상 심잡음을 들어야 하는데, 과거에 쓰이던 일부 비만 치료 약물이 판막 병변을 일으킬 수 있었기 때문이에요.
statement_en: Always listen for cardiac murmurs in a new patient with obesity, because some previously taken medications for obesity were capable of causing valvular pathology.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Neck
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 병력에서 운동 시 호흡곤란, 기좌호흡, 발목 부종처럼 심부전이 의심되면 경정맥 박동을 확인하고 3심음을 들어야 해요.
statement_en: If the history suggested heart failure with exertional dyspnoea, orthopnoea or ankle swelling, check the jugular venous pulse and listen for a third heart sound.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Neck
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지방 앞치마가 있는지 확인하고, 크다면 환자의 동의를 얻어 들어 올려 아래쪽 면에 감염이나 피부 손상이 있는지 살펴요.
statement_en: Check for the presence of a fatty apron and, if it is large, with the patient's permission lift it and inspect the under surface for infection or broken skin.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Lungs, abdomen and legs
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 다리를 볼 때는 정맥부전과 다리 궤양을 살피고 맥박과 발목반사를 확인해요.
statement_en: When examining the legs look for venous insufficiency and leg ulcers, and check the pulses and the ankle reflex.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 2 Lungs, abdomen and legs
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 검사는 공복혈당, 지질, 간기능검사, 전해질과 요소질소, 전혈구검사, 요산을 포함할 수 있고, 소견에 따라 코르티솔이나 갑상선기능검사를 더해요.
statement_en: Investigations may include fasting glucose, lipids, liver function tests, electrolytes and urea, full blood examination and uric acid, with cortisol or thyroid function tests depending on findings.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 3 Investigations
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 병력과 검진에서 얻은 문제 목록을 만들어 두어야 하는데, 특히 복잡한 환자에서 중요한 동반질환을 놓치지 않기 위해서예요.
statement_en: A problem list should be made from the history and examination, especially for complicated patients, so that significant comorbidities are not forgotten.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 3 Problem list
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 전략을 이야기하기에 앞서 환자에게 비만에 강한 유전적 소인이 있고, 몸이 에너지 소비를 줄이고 배고픔을 키우며 체중을 완강히 지키려 하며, 치료가 평생 이어져야 한다는 점을 설명해요.
statement_en: Before discussing strategy, explain to the patient that there is a strong genetic predisposition to obesity, that body weight is vigorously defended by reduced energy expenditure and increased hunger, and that treatment will need to be life-long.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 3 Explain the condition
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 제시된 세 가지 감량 전략 가운데 에너지 섭취를 살짝 줄이는 방법이 가장 효과를 보기 어려워요.
statement_en: Of the three weight loss strategies presented, a gentle reduction in energy intake is the least likely to work.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page 3 Weight loss strategies
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 모듈 평가는 계통 문진에 들어갈 질문으로 호흡곤란, 발목 부종, 천식, 코골이를 들면서, 건강하게 먹는다고 생각하는지는 여기 속하지 않는다고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The module assessment states that the questions belonging in a systems review include shortness of breath, ankle swelling, asthma and snoring, but not whether the patient thinks they eat healthily.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 5 › Page Assessment Q3
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 에드먼턴 비만 병기 체계에서 0기는 뚜렷한 위험인자가 없는 상태, 1기는 경계성 고혈압처럼 아직 임상 이전 단계의 비만 관련 위험인자가 있는 상태예요.
statement_en: In the Edmonton Obesity Staging System, stage 0 means no apparent risk factors and stage 1 means obesity-related sub-clinical risk factors such as borderline hypertension.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Introduction
refs: Padwal, R.S. et al. (2011). Using the Edmonton Obesity Staging System to predict mortality in a population-representative cohort of people with overweight and obesity. Canadian Medical Association Journal, Oct 4, 183(14), E1059-66.

statement_ko: 에드먼턴 비만 병기 체계에서 2기는 고혈압이나 2형당뇨병처럼 확립된 비만 관련 만성질환, 3기는 심근경색이나 심부전 같은 표적장기 손상, 4기는 말기에 가까운 중증 장애를 뜻해요.
statement_en: Edmonton Obesity Staging System stage 2 means established obesity-related chronic disease such as hypertension or type 2 diabetes, stage 3 means end-organ damage such as myocardial infarction or heart failure, and stage 4 means severe, potentially end-stage disability.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Introduction
refs: Padwal, R.S. et al. (2011). Using the Edmonton Obesity Staging System to predict mortality in a population-representative cohort of people with overweight and obesity. Canadian Medical Association Journal, Oct 4, 183(14), E1059-66.

statement_ko: 생존 비교에서 비만 1·2·3단계는 생존 비율을 제대로 예측하지 못했지만 에드먼턴 비만 병기 체계는 예측했어요.
statement_en: In the survival comparison, obesity class I, II and III did not really predict the proportion surviving, whereas the Edmonton Obesity Staging System did.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Charts and diagrams page 24
refs: Padwal, R.S. et al. (2011). Using the Edmonton Obesity Staging System to predict mortality in a population-representative cohort of people with overweight and obesity. Canadian Medical Association Journal, Oct 4, 183(14), E1059-66.

statement_ko: NHANES III 추적 종료 시점의 생존율은 EOSS 0기 약 0.97, 1기 0.91, 2기 0.76, 3기 0.55였는데, BMI 분류 네 곡선은 모두 약 0.72~0.83 사이에 몰려 있었어요.
statement_en: At the end of follow-up in NHANES III, survival was about 0.97 for EOSS stage 0, 0.91 for stage 1, 0.76 for stage 2 and 0.55 for stage 3, while all four BMI classification curves clustered between about 0.72 and 0.83.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Charts and diagrams page 24
refs: Padwal, R.S. et al. (2011). Using the Edmonton Obesity Staging System to predict mortality in a population-representative cohort of people with overweight and obesity. Canadian Medical Association Journal, Oct 4, 183(14), E1059-66.

statement_ko: 에너지 소비량은 기초대사율에 식후 열발생과 신체활동으로 쓰는 에너지를 더한 값이에요.
statement_en: Energy expenditure equals basal metabolic rate plus post-prandial thermogenesis plus energy expenditure from physical activity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 1 Energy expenditure Overview
refs: Harris, J.A., Benedict, F.G. (1918). A Biometric Study of Human Basal Metabolism. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, 4(12), pp. 370-3.

statement_ko: 에너지 소비량은 해리스-베네딕트 공식으로 계산하는데, 나이·키·체중·활동 수준 추정치가 필요하고 남녀 공식이 따로 있어요.
statement_en: Energy expenditure is calculated with the Harris-Benedict Equations, which require age, height, weight and an estimate of activity level, with separate formulae for men and women.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 1 Calculating energy expenditure
refs: Harris, J.A., Benedict, F.G. (1918). A Biometric Study of Human Basal Metabolism. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, 4(12), pp. 370-3.

statement_ko: 환자의 체중이 일주일 넘게 그대로였다면 섭취량과 소비량이 같다는 뜻이라, 소비량을 계산하면 그 사람의 섭취량을 알 수 있어요.
statement_en: If a patient's weight has been steady for longer than one week, energy intake must equal energy expenditure, so calculating expenditure tells you the patient's intake.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 1 Energy expenditure Overview
refs: Harris, J.A., Benedict, F.G. (1918). A Biometric Study of Human Basal Metabolism. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, 4(12), pp. 370-3.

statement_ko: 지방 1 kg에는 30,800 킬로줄, 곧 7,000 칼로리가 들어 있어서, 예상 감량 속도를 가늠하고 순응도를 짐작할 수 있어요.
statement_en: One kilogram of fat holds 30,800 kilojoules, or 7,000 calories, which allows a reasonable estimate of the expected rate of weight loss and hence of adherence.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 1 Energy expenditure Overview
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 활동 계수는 침상 안정 1.2, 현대 도시 생활에 흔한 가벼운 활동 1.3, 하루 한 시간쯤 규칙적으로 운동하는 사람 1.4~1.5, 아주 힘든 육체노동 1.75예요.
statement_en: The activity level multipliers are 1.2 for someone confined to bed, 1.3 for light activity typical of modern city life, 1.4 to 1.5 for someone who exercises about one hour each day, and 1.75 for very heavy physical jobs.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 1 Calculating energy expenditure
refs: Harris, J.A., Benedict, F.G. (1918). A Biometric Study of Human Basal Metabolism. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, 4(12), pp. 370-3.

statement_ko: 예시 사례에서 체중 140 kg, 키 1.65 m, 활동 계수 1.3인 40세 여성의 계산된 에너지 소비량은 하루 11,475 kJ, 약 2,800 칼로리였어요.
statement_en: In the worked case a 40-year-old woman weighing 140 kg and 1.65 m tall with an activity factor of 1.3 has a calculated energy expenditure of 11,475 kJ per day, approximately 2,800 calories.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 1 A case
refs: Harris, J.A., Benedict, F.G. (1918). A Biometric Study of Human Basal Metabolism. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America, 4(12), pp. 370-3.

statement_ko: 빠르게 체중을 줄이려면 하루 섭취량을 약 3,280 kJ, 곧 800칼로리까지 낮춰야 해요.
statement_en: To lose weight rapidly, energy intake needs to be reduced to around 3,280 kJ, or 800 calories, daily.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 1 How much do we need to reduce intake to?
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 최소 1년 추적한 감량 연구들을 모은 Franz 메타분석은 80개 연구, 총 26,455명을 검토한 결과예요.
statement_en: The Franz meta-analysis of weight loss trials with a minimum one-year follow-up was based on a review of 80 studies with N=26,455.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Charts and diagrams page 25
refs: Franz, M.J. et al. (2007). Weight-loss outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of weight-loss clinical trials with a minimum 1-year follow-up. Journal of the American Dietetic Association, 107, pp. 1755-67.

statement_ko: 그 메타분석에서 감량 폭이 가장 컸던 것은 6개월째의 초저열량식이었고, 그 뒤로는 약물 없이는 체중이 다시 늘었어요.
statement_en: In that meta-analysis the greatest weight losses were with very low energy diets at six months, beyond which there was regain without medication.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Weight loss outcomes
refs: Franz, M.J. et al. (2007). Weight-loss outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of weight-loss clinical trials with a minimum 1-year follow-up. Journal of the American Dietetic Association, 107, pp. 1755-67.

statement_ko: 감량 성적이 가장 좋은 방법은 케톤 생성 초저열량식이고, 한 무작위 연구에서는 참가자의 78%가 15% 감량에 도달했어요.
statement_en: The best weight-loss results are achieved with ketogenic very low energy diets, and in a randomised study 15% weight loss was achieved in 78% of volunteers.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLEDs
refs: Purcell, K. et al. (2014). The effect of rate of weight loss on long-term weight management: a randomised controlled trial. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 2(12), pp. 954-62.

statement_ko: 빠른 감량군의 성공률이 높았던 이유는 베타하이드록시부티레이트가 올라가며 케톤증에 이르렀기 때문일 가능성이 높아요.
statement_en: The higher success rate in the rapid weight loss arm was most likely because that arm achieved ketosis, with elevation of beta-hydroxybutyrate.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLEDs
refs: Purcell, K. et al. (2014). The effect of rate of weight loss on long-term weight management: a randomised controlled trial. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 2(12), pp. 954-62.

statement_ko: 체중을 얼마나 빨리 뺐는지는 다시 찌는 속도에 영향을 주지 않았어요.
statement_en: The rate of weight loss had no impact on the rate of weight regain.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLEDs
refs: Purcell, K. et al. (2014). The effect of rate of weight loss on long-term weight management: a randomised controlled trial. Lancet Diabetes and Endocrinology, 2(12), pp. 954-62.

statement_ko: 약 3,280 kJ(800칼로리) 수준의 빠른 감량은 평소 식단을 줄이는 방식으로는 이룰 수 없어요. 필요한 비타민과 미량영양소를 얻으려면 4,920~6,150 kJ(1,200~1,500칼로리)는 먹어야 하기 때문이에요.
statement_en: Rapid weight loss at around 3,280 kJ (800 cal) cannot be achieved by restricting the usual diet, because obtaining the necessary vitamins and micronutrients requires an intake of between 4,920 and 6,150 kJ (1,200-1,500 cal).
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Achieving rapid weight loss
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 저자는 하루 세 끼를 모두 대체하기보다 두 끼만 대체하는 부분 초저열량식이 낫다고 봐요. 저녁 식사를 기대할 수 있어 순응도가 올라갈 수 있기 때문이에요.
statement_en: The author's opinion is that a partial very low energy diet replacing two meals only is preferable to replacing three meals a day, because the patient can look forward to an evening meal, potentially improving compliance.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Achieving rapid weight loss
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 초저열량식의 저녁은 보통 크기 접시 하나에 다 담기게 하고, 더 먹지 않고 탄수화물도 넣지 않으며, 단백질에 서로 다른 채소 세 가지를 곁들이고 샐러드는 허용해요.
statement_en: On a very low energy diet the dinner must all fit one normal sized plate, with no seconds and no carbohydrates, made up of protein plus three different vegetables, and a salad is allowed.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLEDs - Day 1
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 샐러드 드레싱의 기름처럼 하루에 소량의 지방은 필요한데, 담낭을 비워 담석이 생기지 않게 하려는 목적이에요.
statement_en: A small quantity of fat each day, such as oil in salad dressing, is necessary to empty the gall bladder in an effort to avoid gallstone formation.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLEDs - Day 1
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 허용되는 단백질 양은 BMI 30에서 40 사이면 손바닥 크기, BMI 40을 넘으면 손 전체 크기예요.
statement_en: The allowed protein portion size is the size of the palm for someone with a BMI between 30 and 40, and the size of the whole hand for a BMI greater than 40.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Allowed proteins
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 초저열량식 사흘째가 되면 케톤증이 생기기 시작해서 단백질을 더 채워 먹고 싶은 충동이 줄어요.
statement_en: By the third day on a very low energy diet the patient has less urge to top up with extra protein because they are developing ketosis.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLEDs - Day 3
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: BMI가 45 미만이면 초저열량식 제품 두 개에 저녁 한 끼로 하루 약 800칼로리가 되고, BMI가 45를 넘으면 제품을 하나 더해 1,000칼로리로 올리고 미량영양소도 보충해요.
statement_en: For patients with a BMI below 45 two very low energy diet products per day plus dinner supplies around 800 calories, while for a BMI above 45 an extra product takes intake to 1000 calories with extra micronutrients.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Very large patients
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 보고된 사례로, 한 남성이 거의 12개월 동안 초저열량식을 이어가며 1년에 72 kg을 감량했고 끝날 때 모든 측정 지표가 정상 범위였어요.
statement_en: A reported case describes a man who lost 72 kg over a year on a very low energy diet for nearly 12 months, with all measured parameters in the normal range at the end.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLED contraindications
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 초저열량식은 당뇨병, 특히 인슐린이나 설포닐유레아로 치료 중인 경우, 와파린 복용자나 심장·간·신장 질환자에게는 주의하거나 전문 클리닉의 감독이 필요하고, 임신 중에는 써서는 안 돼요.
statement_en: Very low energy diets need caution or specialist supervision in diabetes, especially if treated with insulin or sulphonylureas, and in people taking warfarin or with heart, liver or kidney disease, and must not be used in pregnancy.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 VLED contraindications
refs: Sumithran, P. et al. (2008). Safe year-long use of a very-low-calorie diet for the treatment of severe obesity. Medical Journal of Australia, 188, pp. 366-8.

statement_ko: 저열량식은 보통 평소 추정 섭취량보다 약 2,500 kJ(600칼로리) 적게 처방하는데, 잘 지키면 일주일에 약 0.5 kg이 빠져요.
statement_en: Reduced energy diets usually prescribe an intake around 2,500 kJ (600 cal) less than the patient's estimated usual intake, which if adhered to results in a weight loss of around 0.5 kg per week.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Alternative strategies
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 다량영양소 시험에서는 과체중 성인 811명이 지방 20% 또는 40%, 단백질 15% 또는 25%, 탄수화물 35~65%로 짜인 네 식단 중 하나에 무작위 배정돼 2년간 교육을 받았어요.
statement_en: In the macronutrient trial 811 overweight adults were randomly assigned to one of four diets with 20% or 40% fat, 15% or 25% protein and carbohydrate ranging from 35% to 65%, with instruction over two years.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Reduced energy diets - macronutrients
refs: Sacks, F.M. et al. (2009). Comparison of Weight-Loss Diets with Different Compositions of Fat, Protein, and Carbohydrates. New England Journal of Medicine, 360, pp. 859-873.

statement_ko: 그 시험에서 평균 감량은 식단과 상관없이 약 5~6 kg이어서, 어떤 다량영양소를 강조하든 열량을 줄인 식단은 임상적으로 의미 있는 감량을 가져와요.
statement_en: Average weight loss in that trial was around 5-6 kg regardless of diet, so reduced calorie diets result in clinically meaningful weight loss whichever macronutrient they emphasise.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Reduced energy diets - macronutrients
refs: Sacks, F.M. et al. (2009). Comparison of Weight-Loss Diets with Different Compositions of Fat, Protein, and Carbohydrates. New England Journal of Medicine, 360, pp. 859-873.

statement_ko: 저탄수화물 식단은 가벼운 케톤증을 만들어 배고픔을 눌러 주고, 한 연구에서는 열량을 제한하지 않은 저탄수화물 식단이 열량을 제한한 저지방 식단만큼은 효과가 있었어요.
statement_en: A low carbohydrate diet induces mild ketosis, which suppresses hunger, and one study found a low carbohydrate diet that was not energy restricted at least as effective as a low fat energy restricted diet.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Low carbohydrate diets
refs: Nordmann, A.J. et al. (2006). Effects of low-carbohydrate vs low-fat diets on weight loss and cardiovascular risk factors: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Archives of Internal Medicine, Feb 13, 166(3), pp. 285-93.

statement_ko: 고도비만 성인에서 저탄수화물 식단은 6개월째 감량이 더 크고 중성지방이 더 낮았지만, 1년이 되자 감량 차이는 사라지고 이상지질혈증과 혈당 조절만 더 좋았어요.
statement_en: In severely obese adults a low carbohydrate diet gave greater weight loss and lower triglycerides at six months, but by one year there was no difference in weight loss although dyslipidaemia and glycaemic control were better.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Low carbohydrate diets
refs: Stern, L. et al. (2004). Effects of Low-Carbohydrate versus Conventional Weight Loss Diets in Severely Obese Adults: One year follow-up of a randomized trial. Annals of Internal Medicine, 140, pp. 778-785.

statement_ko: 5:2 간헐적 식단은 연달지 않은 이틀 동안 섭취를 크게 줄이고 나머지 닷새는 평소대로 먹는데, 지속적인 제한보다 나은 점은 없지만 어떤 환자에게는 생활에 잘 맞아요.
statement_en: In the 5:2 intermittent diet intake is reduced significantly on two non-sequential days with normal intake on the other five days, and such diets have no advantages over continuous restriction but may suit some patients' lifestyles.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 Intermittent diets
refs: Harvie, M.N. et al. (2011). The effects of intermittent or continuous energy restriction on weight loss and metabolic disease risk markers: a randomized trial in young overweight women. International Journal of Obesity, 35, pp. 714-727.

statement_ko: 감량에서 운동은 열량 섭취를 줄이는 것보다 덜 중요해요. 기초대사율이 시간당 약 368 kJ이라 하루 8,832 kJ인데, 30분 조깅은 약 1,538 kJ, 한 시간 걷기는 약 1,000 kJ에 그치기 때문이에요.
statement_en: For weight loss exercise is less important than reducing calorie intake, because basal metabolic rate of about 368 kJ per hour gives 8,832 kJ a day while half an hour of jogging gives about 1,538 kJ and an hour of walking around 1,000 kJ.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 What about exercise?
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 감량 프로그램에서 운동을 권하는 중요한 이유는 근육 손실을 줄이기 위해서이고, 운동의 양과 종류는 나이, 심혈관·호흡기 건강, 류마티스 질환을 고려해 정해야 해요.
statement_en: The important reason to encourage exercise in a weight loss regime is to reduce the amount of muscle lost, and the amount and type must take account of age, cardiovascular and respiratory health and rheumatological pathologies.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 What about exercise?
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 케톤을 만들지 않는 식단에서는 처음부터 약물을 써야 하는데, 감량이 배고픔을 키우는 호르몬 변화를 부르기 때문이고, 그래서 생활습관 중심 치료는 보통 5~6 kg 감량에 그쳐요.
statement_en: On a non-ketogenic diet medications should be used from the start, because weight loss brings hormone changes that increase hunger, which is why lifestyle-based therapies usually achieve only 5-6 kg of weight loss.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 What about medications?
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 감량 뒤의 생리 변화가 오래가기 때문에 비만 약물치료는 평생 이어져야 해요.
statement_en: Because the physiological changes after weight loss are long lasting, pharmacotherapy for obesity will need to be life-long.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 What about medications?
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 자연은 배고픔을 누르는 데 호르몬 아홉 가지와 영양소 두 가지를 쓰기 때문에, 한 가지 약을 고용량으로 쓰기보다 여러 약을 각각 최대용량 아래로 조합하는 편이 합리적이라고 이 모듈은 말해요.
statement_en: Since nature uses nine hormones and two nutrients to suppress hunger, the module argues it makes sense to combine medications at submaximal doses of each rather than use one agent at a high dose.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 2 What about medications?
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 현재로서는 수술이 가장 좋은 장기 성적을 내고, 가장 많이 쓰이는 세 가지 술식은 조절형 위밴드술, 위소매절제술, 루와이 위우회술이에요.
statement_en: At present surgical approaches give the best long-term outcomes, and the three most commonly used procedures are adjustable gastric banding, sleeve gastrectomy and Roux-en-Y bypass.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 3 Surgical approaches
refs: O'Brien, P.E. et al. (2013) Long-Term Outcomes After Bariatric Surgery: Fifteen-Year Follow-Up of Adjustable Gastric Banding and a Systematic Review of the Bariatric Surgical Literature. Annals of Surgery, 257(1), pp. 87-94.

statement_ko: 조절형 위밴드술은 침습이 가장 적지만 추적과 재수술이 가장 많이 필요해 사용이 줄고 있고, 위소매절제술은 빠르게 가장 인기 있는 술식이 되고 있으며, 루와이 위우회술은 역사가 가장 길고 2형당뇨병 개선에 특히 유용하다는 근거가 있어요.
statement_en: Adjustable gastric banding is the least invasive but requires the most follow-up and revision and its use is declining, sleeve gastrectomy is rapidly becoming the most popular operation, and Roux-en-Y bypass has the longest history and some evidence of particular usefulness in improving type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page 3 Surgical approaches
refs: O'Brien, P.E. et al. (2013) Long-Term Outcomes After Bariatric Surgery: Fifteen-Year Follow-Up of Adjustable Gastric Banding and a Systematic Review of the Bariatric Surgical Literature. Annals of Surgery, 257(1), pp. 87-94.

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 감량 여정에서 어려운 부분이 뺀 체중을 오래 유지하는 일이고, 어떻게 뺐는지는 크게 중요하지 않다고 결론지어요.
statement_en: The module concludes that the difficult part of the weight loss journey is keeping the weight off long term and that it does not really matter how the weight is lost.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 비만을 평생 관리가 필요한 만성질환으로 봐야 하고, 선택지와 예상 결과를 설명한 뒤 환자가 스스로 정할 수 있게 접근 방식을 함께 논의해야 한다고 결론지어요.
statement_en: The module concludes that obesity should be considered a chronic condition that requires lifelong care, and that the approach used should be discussed with each patient so they can decide after the options and likely outcomes are explained.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 6 (Global Management of Obesity in Adults) › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 제니칼이라는 이름으로 판매되는 오르리스타트는 췌장 리파아제 억제제로, 섭취한 식이지방의 약 30% 흡수를 막아요.
statement_en: Orlistat, marketed as Xenical, is a pancreatic lipase inhibitor that blocks absorption of approximately 30% of ingested dietary fat.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Orlistat
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (1998). Randomised placebo-controlled trial of orlistat for weight loss and prevention of weight regain in obese patients. European Multicentre Orlistat Study Group. Lancet, 352(9123), pp. 167-72.

statement_ko: 날트렉손 서방형과 부프로피온 서방형 복합제는 유럽에서 미짐바, 미국에서 콘트라브로 판매되고, 멜라노코르틴 4 수용체를 자극하는 POMC 신경세포에 작용해 섭취를 줄이는 것으로 봐요.
statement_en: Naltrexone SR / bupropion SR is marketed as Mysimba in the EU and Contrave in the US, and is thought to reduce food intake by acting on POMC neurons which stimulate the melanocortin 4 receptor.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Naltrexone SR / Bupropion SR
refs: Greenway, F.L. et al. (2010). COR-I Study Group. Effect of naltrexone plus bupropion on weight loss in overweight and obese adults (COR-I): a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial. Lancet, 376, pp. 595-605.

Apovian, C.M. et al. (2013). COR-II Study Group. A randomized, phase 3 trial of naltrexone SR/bupropion SR on weight and obesity-related risk factors (COR-II). Obesity (Silver Spring), 21, pp. 935-943.

statement_ko: 부프로피온은 도파민과 노르에피네프린의 약한 재흡수 억제제로 우울증과 금연 치료에 단일제로 허가돼 있고, 날트렉손은 오피오이드 수용체 길항제로 중독 치료에 단일제로 허가돼 있어요.
statement_en: Bupropion is a mild reuptake inhibitor of dopamine and norepinephrine approved as a single agent for depression and smoking cessation, and naltrexone is an opioid receptor antagonist approved as a single agent for addiction.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Naltrexone SR / Bupropion SR
refs: Greenway, F.L. et al. (2010). COR-I Study Group. Effect of naltrexone plus bupropion on weight loss in overweight and obese adults (COR-I): a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial. Lancet, 376, pp. 595-605.

statement_ko: 삭센다로 판매되는 리라글루타이드 3.0 mg은 GLP-1 작용제로, 뇌에 중추적으로 작용해 섭취를 줄여요.
statement_en: Liraglutide 3.0 mg, marketed as Saxenda, is a GLP-1 agonist which acts centrally in the brain to reduce food intake.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Liraglutide 3.0 mg
refs: Astrup, A. et al. (2012). Safety, tolerability and sustained weight loss over 2 years with the once-daily human GLP-1 analog, liraglutide. International Journal of Obesity (London), 36, pp. 843-854.

statement_ko: 벨빅으로 판매된 로카세린은 미국에서만 허가됐고, 시상하부에서 섭취를 조절하는 세로토닌 2C 수용체에 매우 선택적으로 결합해요.
statement_en: Lorcaserin, marketed as Belviq, was approved in the US but not Europe and has highly specific affinity for the serotonin 2C receptor, which regulates food intake in the hypothalamus.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Lorcaserin
refs: Smith, S.R. et al. (2010). Behavioral Modification and Lorcaserin for Overweight and Obesity Management (BLOOM) Study Group. Multicenter placebo-controlled trial of lorcaserin for weight management. New England Journal of Medicine, 363, pp. 245-256.

Fidler, M.C. et al. (2011). BLOSSOM Clinical Trial Group. A one-year randomized trial of lorcaserin for weight loss in obese and overweight adults: the BLOSSOM trial. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 96, pp. 3067-3077.

statement_ko: 과거의 세로토닌계 비만 약물인 펜플루라민과 덱스펜플루라민은 심장판막의 세로토닌 2B 수용체에도 작용해 판막병증과 연관됐어요.
statement_en: Older serotonergic weight drugs, fenfluramine and dexfenfluramine, also targeted the serotonin 2B receptor on heart valves and were associated with valvulopathy.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Lorcaserin
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 큐시미아로 판매되는 펜터민·토피라메이트 서방 복합제는 미국에서만 쓸 수 있고, 허가된 복합제는 두 약을 각각 다른 적응증에 단독으로 쓸 때보다 훨씬 낮은 용량으로 담아요.
statement_en: Phentermine / topiramate ER, marketed as Qsymia, is available in the US only, and the approved combination uses doses of both drugs much lower than when either is used singly for other indications.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Phentermine / Topiramate ER
refs: Gadde, K.M. et al. (2011). Effects of low-dose controlled-release, phentermine plus topiramate combination on weight and associated comorbidities in overweight and obese adults (CONQUER): a randomized, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial. Lancet, 377, pp. 1341- 1352.
Allison, D.B. et al. (2012). Controlled-release phentermine/topiramate in severely obese adults: a randomized controlled trial (EQUIP). Obesity (Silver Spring), 20, pp. 330-342.

statement_ko: 미국 FDA의 유효성 기준은 약물군과 위약군의 평균 감량 차이가 통계적으로 유의하게 5% 이상일 것, 그리고 약물군의 35% 이상이 5% 이상 감량에 도달해 위약군의 약 두 배가 될 것이에요.
statement_en: The FDA efficacy benchmarks are a 5% or greater statistically significant difference in mean weight loss between medication and placebo groups, and 35% or more of medication-treated patients achieving 5% or more weight loss, approximately double the placebo proportion.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction FDA benchmarks
refs: Jensen, M. D. et al. (2014). Guidelines (2013) for managing overweight and obesity in adults. Obesity, 22(S2), S1-S410.

statement_ko: 유럽 EMA는 5~10% 감량에 도달한 비율을 평가하고, 약물군의 평균 감량이 위약군보다 5%를 넘기를 원하며, 위약군과 견줘 10% 이상 감량에 도달한 비율도 보고 싶어 해요.
statement_en: The EMA evaluates the proportion who achieve 5-10% weight loss, wants greater than 5% mean weight loss with medication versus placebo, and wants a proportion achieving 10% or greater weight loss compared with placebo.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction EMA benchmarks
refs: National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence: Guidance. (2014). Obesity: Identification, Assessment and Management of Overweight and Obesity in Children, Young People and Adults: Partial Update of CG43. National Clinical Guideline Centre (UK). London: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (UK).

statement_ko: 두 규제기관 모두 심혈관질환 위험인자와 다른 동반질환이 좋아졌다는 근거를 요구해요.
statement_en: Both regulatory agencies want evidence of improvement in cardiovascular disease risk factors and other comorbidities.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Both agencies
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 유효성 비교 그래프에서 1년째 위약 보정 감량은 오르리스타트가 2형당뇨병군 -3.2%·비당뇨군 -4%, 로카세린 -3.5·-3.6, 리라글루타이드 -3.9·-5.4, 날트렉손/부프로피온 -3.2·-5.2, 펜터민/토피라메이트 -4.9·-6.6이었어요.
statement_en: On the efficacy comparison chart placebo-subtracted weight loss at one year was -3.2% with type 2 diabetes and -4% without for orlistat, -3.5 and -3.6 for lorcaserin, -3.9 and -5.4 for liraglutide, -3.2 and -5.2 for naltrexone/bupropion, and -4.9 and -6.6 for phentermine/topiramate.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 27
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (1998). Randomised placebo-controlled trial of orlistat for weight loss and prevention of weight regain in obese patients. European Multicentre Orlistat Study Group. Lancet, 352(9123), pp. 167-72.

Smith, S.R. et al. (2010). Behavioral Modification and Lorcaserin for Overweight and Obesity Management (BLOOM) Study Group. Multicenter placebo-controlled trial of lorcaserin for weight management. New England Journal of Medicine, 363, pp. 245-256.
Astrup, A. et al. (2012). Safety, tolerability and sustained weight loss over 2 years with the once-daily human GLP-1 analog, liraglutide. International Journal of Obesity (London), 36, pp. 843-854.

Greenway, F.L. et al. (2010). COR-I Study Group. Effect of naltrexone plus bupropion on weight loss in overweight and obese adults (COR-I): a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial. Lancet, 376, pp. 595-605.

Gadde, K.M. et al. (2011). Effects of low-dose controlled-release, phentermine plus topiramate combination on weight and associated comorbidities in overweight and obese adults (CONQUER): a randomized, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial. Lancet, 377, pp. 1341- 1352.

statement_ko: 유효성 비교 슬라이드는 이 값들이 직접 비교가 아니며, 위약을 보정한 뒤 필요한 경우 kg 단위 감량에서 근사한 값이라고 밝혀요.
statement_en: The efficacy comparison slide states that these are not head-to-head comparisons and that values are placebo-subtracted and approximated from kg weight reductions where applicable.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 27
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 2형당뇨병이 있는 환자는 비만 약물치료에서 당뇨병이 없는 환자보다 평균적으로 체중이 덜 빠져요.
statement_en: Patients with type 2 diabetes generally lose less weight on average with anti-obesity medication than patients without diabetes.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction An efficacy comparison
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만 약물은 그 자체로 효과를 내지 않아요. 섭취를 줄이려는 환자의 의지를 뒷받침하는, 행동 변화의 생물학적 보조 수단이에요.
statement_en: Anti-obesity medications do not work by themselves; they reinforce the patient's intention to reduce food intake and are biologic adjuncts to behaviour change.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Medication and behavioural interventions
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: COR/BMOD 시험의 생활습관 처방은 여성 1,200 kcal, 남성 1,400 kcal의 고정 열량이었고, 90분짜리 집단 상담을 첫해에 28회 진행했어요.
statement_en: In the COR/BMOD trial the lifestyle prescription was a fixed calorie level of 1,200 kcal for women and 1,400 kcal for men, with counselling in 90-minute group sessions and 28 sessions in the first year.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 The COR/BMOD Trial
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2013). COR-II Study Group. A randomized, phase 3 trial of naltrexone SR/bupropion SR on weight and obesity-related risk factors (COR-II). Obesity (Silver Spring), 21, pp. 935-943.

statement_ko: COR/BMOD 완료자 집단에서 평균 감량은 위약과 행동수정을 함께한 군이 7.3%, 날트렉손/부프로피온과 행동수정을 함께한 군이 11.5%였어요.
statement_en: In the COR/BMOD completer population average weight loss was 7.3% on placebo plus behaviour modification and 11.5% on naltrexone/bupropion plus behaviour modification.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 28
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2013). COR-II Study Group. A randomized, phase 3 trial of naltrexone SR/bupropion SR on weight and obesity-related risk factors (COR-II). Obesity (Silver Spring), 21, pp. 935-943.

statement_ko: COR/BMOD의 더 보수적인 수정 ITT-LOCF 분석에서 감량은 위약+행동수정 -5.1%, NB32+행동수정 -9.3%였고, 대상자의 평균 BMI는 36.5 ± 4.2 kg/m2였어요.
statement_en: In the more conservative modified-ITT-LOCF analysis of COR/BMOD, weight loss was -5.1% for placebo plus behaviour modification and -9.3% for NB32 plus behaviour modification, in a population with a mean BMI of 36.5 plus or minus 4.2 kg/m2.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 28
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2013). COR-II Study Group. A randomized, phase 3 trial of naltrexone SR/bupropion SR on weight and obesity-related risk factors (COR-II). Obesity (Silver Spring), 21, pp. 935-943.

statement_ko: SCALE Maintenance 연구의 도입기는 4~12주 동안 하루 세 번 액상 식사대체제를 쓰며 1,200~1,400 kcal 저열량식을 하는 기간이었고, 무작위 배정에는 5% 이상 감량이 필요했는데 참여자의 75%가 이를 달성했어요.
statement_en: In the SCALE Maintenance study the run-in was a low-calorie diet of 1,200-1,400 kcal with daily use of three liquid meal replacements over 4-12 weeks, and randomisation required at least 5% weight loss, which 75% of entrants achieved.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 The SCALE Maintenance Study
refs: Wadden, T.A. et al. (2013). Weight maintenance and additional weight loss with liraglutide after low-calorie-diet-induced weight loss: the SCALE Maintenance randomized study. International Journal of Obesity (London), 37, pp. 1443-1451.

statement_ko: SCALE Maintenance에서 56주 뒤 리라글루타이드군은 평균 6.1%를 더 뺐고 위약군은 뺀 체중을 유지하는 데 그쳐, 도입기 시작 시점부터의 총 감량은 각각 12%를 조금 넘는 수준과 6%였어요.
statement_en: After 56 weeks in SCALE Maintenance, liraglutide-treated patients lost an average of an additional 6.1% while placebo-treated patients only maintained lost weight, giving total weight loss from start of run-in of slightly more than 12% versus 6%.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 The SCALE Maintenance Study
refs: Wadden, T.A. et al. (2013). Weight maintenance and additional weight loss with liraglutide after low-calorie-diet-induced weight loss: the SCALE Maintenance randomized study. International Journal of Obesity (London), 37, pp. 1443-1451.

statement_ko: SCALE Maintenance의 무작위 배정 시점 평균 체중은 99.6 ± 21.0 kg이었고, 도입기 -12주 시점에는 105.9 ± 22.1 kg이었어요.
statement_en: At randomisation in SCALE Maintenance mean weight was 99.6 plus or minus 21.0 kg, having been 105.9 plus or minus 22.1 kg at run-in week -12.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 29
refs: Wadden, T.A. et al. (2013). Weight maintenance and additional weight loss with liraglutide after low-calorie-diet-induced weight loss: the SCALE Maintenance randomized study. International Journal of Obesity (London), 37, pp. 1443-1451.

statement_ko: SCALE Maintenance에서 56주에 약을 끊자 체중이 다시 늘었는데, 약은 쓰는 동안 효과를 내고 끊으면 다시 찌기 쉽다는 점을 보여줘요.
statement_en: After medication was stopped at 56 weeks in SCALE Maintenance, weight regain occurred, illustrating that medications work when they are used and that regain is likely when they are stopped.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 The SCALE Maintenance Study
refs: Wadden, T.A. et al. (2013). Weight maintenance and additional weight loss with liraglutide after low-calorie-diet-induced weight loss: the SCALE Maintenance randomized study. International Journal of Obesity (London), 37, pp. 1443-1451.

statement_ko: 비만 약물은 12~16주 뒤에 효과를 평가하고, 반응이 만족스럽지 않으면 중단해야 해요.
statement_en: Anti-obesity medication should be evaluated for efficacy after 12-16 weeks, and if there is not a satisfactory response it should be stopped.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Not for every patient
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 감량이 잘 되다가 정체기에 이르는 것은 내성이나 효과 소실의 신호가 아니에요. 임상시험에서 약을 끊으면 다시 찌기 때문에, 뺀 체중을 유지하는 것 자체가 성공의 신호예요.
statement_en: When satisfactory weight loss occurs and then plateaus this is not a sign of tolerance or loss of efficacy, because in clinical trials drug withdrawal produces regain, so maintenance of lost weight is a sign of success.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Not for every patient
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 오르리스타트는 120 mg 캡슐로 매 끼니 전에 복용하는데, 식이지방 흡수를 막는 약이라 반드시 식사와 함께 묶어 써야 해요.
statement_en: Orlistat is given as 120 mg capsules by mouth before each meal and must be linked to the meal since its action is to block dietary fat absorption.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Dosing
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (1998). Randomised placebo-controlled trial of orlistat for weight loss and prevention of weight regain in obese patients. European Multicentre Orlistat Study Group. Lancet, 352(9123), pp. 167-72.

statement_ko: 날트렉손/부프로피온 캡슐 하나에는 날트렉손 8 mg과 부프로피온 90 mg이 들어 있고, 1주차부터 4주차까지 하루 한 알·두 알·세 알·네 알로 올리며, 고지방 식사와 함께 먹으면 안 돼요.
statement_en: Naltrexone/bupropion capsules each contain 8 mg naltrexone and 90 mg bupropion, titrated as one, two, three then four capsules a day over weeks 1 to 4, and should not be taken with a high-fat meal.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Dosing
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2013). COR-II Study Group. A randomized, phase 3 trial of naltrexone SR/bupropion SR on weight and obesity-related risk factors (COR-II). Obesity (Silver Spring), 21, pp. 935-943.

statement_ko: 리라글루타이드는 하루 중 아무 때나 팔, 허벅지, 배에 피하주사하는데, 0.6 mg으로 시작해 매주 0.6 mg씩 올려 5주차에 3 mg에 이르러요.
statement_en: Liraglutide is injected subcutaneously in the arm, thigh or abdomen at any time of day, starting at 0.6 mg and increasing weekly by 0.6 mg to reach 3 mg at week 5.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Dosing
refs: Astrup, A. et al. (2012). Safety, tolerability and sustained weight loss over 2 years with the once-daily human GLP-1 analog, liraglutide. International Journal of Obesity (London), 36, pp. 843-854.

statement_ko: 반응 평가 규칙은 날트렉손/부프로피온을 최대용량 12주째에 5% 감량이 없으면 중단하고, 리라글루타이드는 치료 16주째에 감량이 4% 미만이면 중단하는 것이에요.
statement_en: The response evaluation rules are to stop naltrexone/bupropion if there is not 5% weight loss at 12 weeks of the full dose and to stop liraglutide if weight loss is less than 4% at 16 weeks of therapy.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Response evaluation
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 용량 표에서 NICE는 오르리스타트를 3개월에 감량이 5% 미만이면 중단하라고 하고, 로카세린은 12주에 5% 미만이면, 펜터민/토피라메이트는 최고용량 13주째에 5% 미만이면 중단해요.
statement_en: On the dosing table NICE advises stopping orlistat if there is less than 5% weight loss in 3 months, lorcaserin is stopped if less than 5% at 12 weeks, and phentermine/topiramate is stopped if less than 5% loss at 13 weeks on the top dose.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 30
refs: National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence: Guidance. (2014). Obesity: Identification, Assessment and Management of Overweight and Obesity in Children, Young People and Adults: Partial Update of CG43. National Clinical Guideline Centre (UK). London: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (UK).

statement_ko: 오르리스타트는 매우 안전한 약으로 소개되고 절반 용량인 60 mg으로 일반의약품으로도 살 수 있는데, 지용성 비타민이 흡수되지 않아 종합비타민을 권해요.
statement_en: Orlistat is described as a remarkably safe drug, available over the counter at one half dose of 60 mg, but a multivitamin is generally recommended because fat-soluble vitamins are not absorbed.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Safety and contraindications
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (1998). Randomised placebo-controlled trial of orlistat for weight loss and prevention of weight regain in obese patients. European Multicentre Orlistat Study Group. Lancet, 352(9123), pp. 167-72.

statement_ko: 오르리스타트는 만성 흡수장애가 있으면 처방하지 말아야 하고, 사이클로스포린 노출을 늘릴 수 있으며, 담낭질환이 늘었다는 보고와 드물게 간부전 사례가 보고됐어요.
statement_en: Orlistat should not be prescribed in chronic malabsorption, may increase cyclosporine exposure, is associated with increased cases of gall bladder disease, and rare cases of liver failure have been reported.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Safety and contraindications
refs: Sjostrom, L. et al. (1998). Randomised placebo-controlled trial of orlistat for weight loss and prevention of weight regain in obese patients. European Multicentre Orlistat Study Group. Lancet, 352(9123), pp. 167-72.

statement_ko: 날트렉손/부프로피온은 미국 라벨에 자살 위험에 대한 박스 경고가 있고, 발작 역치를 낮추며, 특히 치료 초기에 평균 혈압과 맥박을 올리고, MAOI 복용 후 14일 이내에는 쓰면 안 돼요.
statement_en: Naltrexone/bupropion carries a boxed warning on its US label regarding suicidality, lowers the seizure threshold, increases mean blood pressure and pulse especially early in treatment, and must not be given within 14 days of an MAOI.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Safety and contraindications
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2013). COR-II Study Group. A randomized, phase 3 trial of naltrexone SR/bupropion SR on weight and obesity-related risk factors (COR-II). Obesity (Silver Spring), 21, pp. 935-943.

statement_ko: 날트렉손/부프로피온을 시작하면 첫 2주 동안 혈압과 맥박을 지켜봐야 하고, 만성적으로 오피오이드가 필요한 환자는 복용하면 안 돼요.
statement_en: Blood pressure and pulse should be monitored during the first two weeks of naltrexone/bupropion, and patients requiring chronic opioids should not take it.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Safety and contraindications
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2013). COR-II Study Group. A randomized, phase 3 trial of naltrexone SR/bupropion SR on weight and obesity-related risk factors (COR-II). Obesity (Silver Spring), 21, pp. 935-943.

statement_ko: 리라글루타이드는 갑상선수질암이나 2형 다발내분비선종증의 본인 또는 가족력이 있는 환자에게 처방하면 안 되고, 모든 GLP-1 수용체 작용제는 설치류에서 갑상선수질종양을 일으켜요.
statement_en: Liraglutide must not be prescribed to patients with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2, and all GLP-1 receptor agonists cause medullary thyroid tumours in rodents.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Safety and contraindications
refs: Astrup, A. et al. (2012). Safety, tolerability and sustained weight loss over 2 years with the once-daily human GLP-1 analog, liraglutide. International Journal of Obesity (London), 36, pp. 843-854.

statement_ko: GLP-1 계열은 췌장염 위험을 높여서 췌장염 병력이 있으면 리라글루타이드를 쓰면 안 되고, 췌장염이 생기면 중단하고 다시 시작하지 말아야 해요.
statement_en: The GLP-1 class is associated with increased risk of pancreatitis, so liraglutide must not be given with a history of pancreatitis, and if pancreatitis occurs it should be stopped and not restarted.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Safety and contraindications
refs: Astrup, A. et al. (2012). Safety, tolerability and sustained weight loss over 2 years with the once-daily human GLP-1 analog, liraglutide. International Journal of Obesity (London), 36, pp. 843-854.

statement_ko: 리라글루타이드는 담낭질환 증가, 특히 인슐린분비촉진제를 쓰는 당뇨병 환자에서의 저혈당, 구역·구토·탈수와 연결된 신부전, 평균 분당 1~2회의 심박수 증가와도 연관돼요.
statement_en: Liraglutide is also associated with increased gall bladder disease, hypoglycaemia especially in diabetic patients on insulin secretagogues, renal failure linked to nausea, vomiting and dehydration, and heart rate increases averaging 1-2 beats per minute.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 1 Safety and contraindications
refs: Astrup, A. et al. (2012). Safety, tolerability and sustained weight loss over 2 years with the once-daily human GLP-1 analog, liraglutide. International Journal of Obesity (London), 36, pp. 843-854.

statement_ko: 내약성 프로파일은 오르리스타트가 지방변 관련 증상, 펜터민/토피라메이트가 감각이상·미각이상·어지럼·구강건조, 로카세린이 두통·어지럼·피로, 날트렉손/부프로피온이 구역·구토·두통·어지럼·불면, 리라글루타이드가 구역·구토·설사·변비·소화불량·복통이에요.
statement_en: Tolerability profiles are steatorrhoea symptoms for orlistat; paresthesias, dysgeusia, dizziness and dry mouth for phentermine/topiramate; headache, dizziness and fatigue for lorcaserin; nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness and insomnia for naltrexone/bupropion; and nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, dyspepsia and abdominal pain for liraglutide.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 32
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체중 관리 약물은 임신했거나 임신할 가능성이 있는 환자에게 절대 처방하면 안 되고, 수유 중에도 처방하지 않아요.
statement_en: A weight management medication should never be prescribed to a patient who is pregnant or could become pregnant, and would not be prescribed while breastfeeding.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 Matching medication to patient
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 처방 금기 정리는 갑상선수질암 본인·가족력이나 췌장염 병력에 리라글루타이드, 만성 흡수장애나 담즙정체에 오르리스타트, 만성 오피오이드 사용·발작·조절되지 않는 고혈압에 날트렉손/부프로피온, 녹내장이나 갑상선기능항진증에 펜터민/토피라메이트를 금한다고 정리해요.
statement_en: The do-not-prescribe recap lists liraglutide with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or a history of pancreatitis, orlistat with chronic malabsorption or cholestasis, naltrexone/bupropion with chronic opioid use, seizures or uncontrolled hypertension, and phentermine/topiramate with glaucoma or hyperthyroidism.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 33
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 날트렉손/부프로피온과 펜터민/토피라메이트는 둘 다 MAOI 사용 후 14일 이내에는 금기예요.
statement_en: Naltrexone/bupropion and phentermine/topiramate are both contraindicated within 14 days of MAOI use.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Charts and diagrams page 33
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 중등도 간장애에서는 날트렉손/부프로피온의 감량이 권고되고 리라글루타이드는 주의가 권고되며, 중등도 신장애에서는 만성 체중 관리 약물을 모두 처방할 수 있어요.
statement_en: In moderate hepatic impairment a dose reduction with naltrexone/bupropion is recommended and caution is recommended with liraglutide, while in moderate renal impairment all medications for chronic weight management can be prescribed.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 Matching medication to patient
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 펜터민/토피라메이트를 빼면 이 약들의 임상시험은 우울증 환자와 항우울제 복용자를 제외했고, 이미 부프로피온을 쓰는 환자에게 날트렉손/부프로피온을 더해서는 안 돼요.
statement_en: Except for phentermine/topiramate, clinical trials of these medications excluded patients with depression and those on anti-depressants, and naltrexone/bupropion must not be added to patients already taking bupropion.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 With depression
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 오르리스타트는 65세 미만에서만 연구됐고 최신 약물들의 연구 대상에도 고령자가 적어서, 65세를 넘는 환자에게는 주의가 필요해요.
statement_en: Orlistat was only studied in patients less than 65 years and the newer medications' study populations have limited numbers of older individuals, so caution is advised in patients aged over 65.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 Aged over 65
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 미국내분비학회 지침은 높은 수준의 근거에 바탕해, 스스로 감량과 유지에 실패하고 라벨 적응증에 맞는 BMI 30 이상 또는 동반질환이 있는 BMI 27 이상인 사람에게 식사·운동·행동수정의 보조로 약물을 처방하라고 강하게 권고해요.
statement_en: Endocrine Society guidelines make a strong recommendation on high-quality evidence that medications be prescribed as an adjunct to diet, exercise and behaviour modification for individuals with a BMI of 30 or greater, or 27 with a comorbidity, who are unable to lose and successfully maintain weight and who meet label indications.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 Who qualifies for obesity medications?
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 낮은 수준의 근거에 바탕한 약한 권고로, 첫 3개월은 매달, 그 뒤로는 3개월마다 효과와 안전성을 평가하도록 제안해요.
statement_en: A weak recommendation on low-quality evidence suggests assessing efficacy and safety at monthly intervals for the first three months, then every three months thereafter.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 When do you monitor?
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 높은 수준의 근거에 바탕한 등급 1의 강한 권고는 3개월째 평가해서 감량이 5% 이상이면 이어가고, 아니면 중단하고 다른 접근을 찾으라는 것이에요.
statement_en: A strong Grade 1 recommendation on high-quality evidence is to evaluate patients at three months and continue if weight loss is 5% or more, otherwise discontinue and seek alternative approaches.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 When do you monitor?
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 낮은 수준의 근거에 바탕한 등급 2의 약한 권고는 적합한 환자에게 장기 체중 유지를 위해 약물을 쓰라는 것, 그리고 효과와 내약성에 따라 용량을 올리되 허가된 상한을 넘기지 말라는 것이에요.
statement_en: A Grade 2 weak recommendation on low-quality evidence is that medications should be used in eligible patients to promote long-term weight loss maintenance, and that prescribers should escalate the dose based on efficacy and tolerability without exceeding the upper approved dose boundaries.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 How long / What dose
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 2015년 미국내분비학회는 체중을 늘리는 약물과 만성 체중 관리에 허가된 약물을 중심으로 체계적 근거 검토 문서를 냈고, 체중을 늘리는 항우울제나 당뇨병약을 바꾸는 일을 감량의 가장 손쉬운 열매라고 표현해요.
statement_en: In 2015 the US Endocrine Society published a document based on a systematic evidence review focusing on medications which cause weight gain and medications approved for chronic weight management, and switching patients off weight-gaining antidepressants or antidiabetic medications is described as the low-hanging fruit of weight loss.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page 2 Best practices in prescribing medications
refs: Apovian, C.M. et al. (2015). Pharmacological Management of Obesity: An Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism, 100(2), pp. 342-62.

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 약물 사용의 목표가 미용이 아니라 건강 개선이고, 이상적인 약은 없으며, 처방자의 일은 환자의 프로필을 약의 안전성·내약성 프로필과 맞추는 것이라고 결론지어요.
statement_en: The module concludes that the goal of medication use is health improvement, not cosmetics, that no ideal medication exists, and that the prescriber's job is to match the patient profile to the medication's safety and tolerability profile.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 이 모듈은 행동 접근이 집중적일수록 감량이 커지고, 힘들게 얻은 감량을 지키려면 약물을 장기적으로 써야 한다고 결론지어요.
statement_en: The module concludes that more weight loss is observed with more intensive behavioural approaches and that medications should be used over the long term to sustain hard-won weight losses.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 1950년대에 단기 사용으로 허가된 여러 교감신경흥분제는 이 모듈에서 다루지 않는데, 여기서 다루는 약들의 허가사항은 만성 사용을 전제로 하기 때문이에요.
statement_en: Several sympathomimetic drugs approved in the 1950s for short-term use are not discussed in the module, whose prescribing information indicates chronic use.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 7 (Pharmacotherapy for Obesity) › Introduction Medications and how they work
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 과체중이나 비만이 있는 아동·청소년은 건강 체중인 또래보다 의료기관을 더 자주 찾는데도, 정작 과체중이나 비만 자체를 치료받는 경우는 드물어요.
statement_en: Children and young people with overweight and obesity present more frequently to clinical services than healthy-weight peers, yet are only infrequently treated for the overweight or obesity itself.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Introduction Background
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 소아비만 치료의 장벽으로는 가족이나 의사의 인식 부족, 보건의료체계의 빈약한 자원, 의료진 교육 부족, 충분하지 않은 수가 보상, 의뢰 경로의 부재가 꼽혀요.
statement_en: The listed barriers to treating childhood obesity are lack of recognition by family or doctor, poor resourcing of health systems, lack of health professional training, lack of adequate reimbursement, and lack of referral pathways.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Introduction Background
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 유병률이 높은 상황에서는 눈으로 보아 과체중이나 비만을 늘 알아챌 수 없기 때문에, 키와 체중을 정기적으로 재고 BMI와 함께 성장도표에 그려야 해요.
statement_en: With a high background prevalence, overweight or obesity cannot always be seen by looking, so height and weight should be measured routinely and plotted, along with BMI, on growth charts.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 1 Which child has obesity?
refs: Barlow, S.E. and the Expert Committee (2007). Expert Committee Recommendations Regarding the Prevention, Assessment, and Treatment of Child and Adolescent Overweight and Obesity: Summary Report. Pediatrics, 120(4), S164-S192.

statement_ko: 미국 CDC 성장도표에서 연령별 BMI가 95백분위수를 넘으면 비만 범위이고, 연령별 10백분위수에 있으면 건강 체중이에요.
statement_en: On the U.S. CDC growth charts a BMI greater than the 95th centile for age is in the obesity range, while a BMI on the 10th centile for age is healthy weight.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 1 Which child has obesity?
refs: Barlow, S.E. and the Expert Committee (2007). Expert Committee Recommendations Regarding the Prevention, Assessment, and Treatment of Child and Adolescent Overweight and Obesity: Summary Report. Pediatrics, 120(4), S164-S192.

statement_ko: 소아 사례에서 6세 여아는 키 120 cm에 체중 33 kg, BMI 22.9 kg/m2로 연령별 95백분위수를 훌쩍 넘는 비만 범위였어요.
statement_en: In the paediatric case a girl aged six years weighed 33 kg at 120 cm with a BMI of 22.9 kg/m2, well above the 95th centile for age and in the obesity range.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 34
refs: Barlow, S.E. and the Expert Committee (2007). Expert Committee Recommendations Regarding the Prevention, Assessment, and Treatment of Child and Adolescent Overweight and Obesity: Summary Report. Pediatrics, 120(4), S164-S192.

statement_ko: 가족 중심 생활습관 중재를 받고 6개월 뒤 같은 여아의 체중은 33 kg 그대로였지만 키가 3 cm 자라 123 cm가 되면서 BMI가 떨어졌는데, 자라는 아이에서는 체중 유지만으로도 BMI에 큰 영향을 줄 수 있다는 뜻이에요.
statement_en: Six months after a family-focused lifestyle intervention the same girl's weight was unchanged at 33 kg while her height had grown 3 cm to 123 cm, so her BMI fell, showing that weight maintenance may have an important impact on BMI in growing children.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 34
refs: Barlow, S.E. and the Expert Committee (2007). Expert Committee Recommendations Regarding the Prevention, Assessment, and Treatment of Child and Adolescent Overweight and Obesity: Summary Report. Pediatrics, 120(4), S164-S192.

statement_ko: BMI는 유아기부터 청소년기까지 생리적으로 변하면서 대략 4세에서 7세 사이에 가장 낮아지기 때문에, 아이에게 성인 BMI 기준값을 그대로 쓸 수 없어요.
statement_en: BMI changes normally and physiologically from early childhood through adolescence with a nadir between about four and seven years of age, so the standard adult cut-points for BMI cannot be used in children.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 1 Recognising the child
refs: Barlow, S.E. and the Expert Committee (2007). Expert Committee Recommendations Regarding the Prevention, Assessment, and Treatment of Child and Adolescent Overweight and Obesity: Summary Report. Pediatrics, 120(4), S164-S192.

statement_ko: 가능하면 연령별 허리둘레 도표를 쓰고, 허리둘레(cm)를 키(cm)로 나눈 허리키비는 아동·청소년의 심장대사 위험 지표로 점점 널리 쓰여요.
statement_en: Waist-for-age charts should be used where available, and waist-to-height ratio, waist in centimetres divided by height in centimetres, is increasingly used as an indicator of cardio-metabolic risk in children and adolescents.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 1 Waist measurements
refs: Garnett, S.P., Baur, L.A., Cowell, C.T. (2008). Waist-to-height ratio: a simple option for determining excess central adiposity in young people. International Journal of Obesity, 32, pp. 1028-1030.

McCarthy, H.D., Ashwell, M. (2006). A study of central fatness using waist-to-height ratios in UK children and adolescents over two decades supports the simple message - 'keep your waist circumference to less than half your height'. International Journal of Obesity, 30, pp.988-992.

statement_ko: 일반적으로 허리키비가 0.5를 넘으면 심장대사 위험이 커지는데, 허리둘레가 키의 절반을 넘으면 위험이 올라간 상태라고 봐요.
statement_en: In general a waist-to-height ratio above 0.5 is associated with increased cardio-metabolic risk: if the patient's waist is more than half the patient's height, that patient is at increased risk.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 1 Waist measurements
refs: McCarthy, H.D., Ashwell, M. (2006). A study of central fatness using waist-to-height ratios in UK children and adolescents over two decades supports the simple message - 'keep your waist circumference to less than half your height'. International Journal of Obesity, 30, pp.988-992.

statement_ko: 가족이 마침내 소아비만 치료를 찾는 가장 흔한 이유는 괴롭힘이나 놀림 같은 심리적 고통이에요.
statement_en: The most common reason families finally seek treatment for childhood obesity is psychological distress such as bullying or teasing.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 2 Clinical history
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 아이의 생활습관 병력에서 물어야 할 네 영역은 신체활동, TV와 화면, 식사 이력, 수면이에요.
statement_en: The four areas of lifestyle history to enquire about in children are physical activity, TV and screens, dietary history, and sleep.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 2 Lifestyle history
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 수면 병력에서는 잠자리에 든 시각만이 아니라 실제로 잠든 시각과 깬 시각을, 평일과 주말로 나눠 묻는 일이 중요해요.
statement_en: In the sleep history it matters to ask the time of going to sleep, not just the time of going to bed, and of waking, on weekdays versus weekends.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 2 Lifestyle history
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 흑색가시세포증은 목 아래쪽 접히는 부위의 피부가 두꺼워지고 색소가 짙어지는 소견으로, 특히 아동·청소년에서 인슐린 저항성의 특징이고 치료가 잘 되면 옅어질 수 있어요.
statement_en: Acanthosis nigricans is the thickened, pigmented skin in the flexures of the base of the neck that is characteristic of insulin resistance, particularly in children and young people, and it can decrease with successful treatment.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 2 Acanthosis nigricans
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이에서 추가 평가가 필요한 경고 소견은 저신장, 이상 신체 소견, 발달장애, 시야 이상이나 두통이에요.
statement_en: The red-flag findings requiring further assessment in a child with obesity are short stature, abnormal physical stigmata, developmental disability, and visual disturbance or headache.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 2 Findings requiring further assessment
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이의 저신장은 고코르티솔증, 갑상선기능저하증 같은 내분비 문제를 시사할 수 있고, 이상 신체 소견이나 발달장애는 증후군성 원인을, 시야 이상이나 두통은 양성두개내압상승을 시사할 수 있어요.
statement_en: Short stature in a child with obesity may indicate other conditions such as hypercortisolism, hypothyroidism or other endocrine problems, while abnormal physical stigmata or developmental disability could indicate a syndromal cause and visual disturbance or headache could indicate benign intracranial hypertension.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 2 Findings requiring further assessment
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 검사는 나이가 많을수록, 비만이 심할수록, 2형당뇨병·조기 심장질환·수면무호흡의 고위험 가족력이 있을수록, 위험이 높은 인종집단일수록, 흑색가시세포증처럼 동반질환을 시사하는 소견이 있을수록 더 필요해요.
statement_en: Investigation is more likely for older patients, more severe obesity, a high-risk family history of type 2 diabetes, premature heart disease or sleep apnoea, a higher-risk ethnic group, and any clinical suggestion of comorbidities such as acanthosis nigricans.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 3 When to investigate
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이의 일차 공복 혈액검사는 공복혈당, 간기능검사, 지질검사이고, 필요하면 공복 인슐린과 갑상선기능검사를 더해요.
statement_en: Initial fasting blood tests in a child with obesity are fasting glucose, liver function tests and a lipid profile, possibly with fasting insulin and thyroid function tests.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 3 What to investigate
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 아이에서 추가 검사는 폐쇄성 수면무호흡이 의심되면 수면 평가 의뢰, 경구당부하검사, 생식호르몬 평가, 간 초음파를 포함할 수 있어요.
statement_en: Further investigations in children may include referral for sleep assessment if obstructive sleep apnoea is suspected, an oral glucose tolerance test, reproductive hormone assessment, or a liver ultrasound.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 3 What to investigate
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 청소년 사례의 피터는 그리스계 15세 남아로 BMI 36 kg/m2, 허리둘레 110 cm, 허리키비 0.62이고 흑색가시세포증이 있어요.
statement_en: In the adolescent case study Peter is a 15-year-old boy of Greek ethnic origin with a BMI of 36 kg/m2, waist circumference 110 cm and waist-to-height ratio 0.62, with acanthosis nigricans.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 35
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 피터의 지질은 중성지방 2.2 mmol/L(정상 1.7 미만), 총콜레스테롤 5.1 mmol/L(5.5 미만), HDL 콜레스테롤 0.7 mmol/L(0.9 초과)로, 복부비만과 인슐린 저항성에서 전형적인 이상지질혈증이에요.
statement_en: Peter's lipids were triglycerides 2.2 mmol/L (normal range below 1.7), total cholesterol 5.1 mmol/L (below 5.5) and HDL cholesterol 0.7 mmol/L (above 0.9), characteristic of the dyslipidaemia of central obesity and insulin resistance.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 35
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 피터의 혈당 지표는 인슐린 247 pmol/L(약 40 mU/L), 혈당 4.8 mmol/L, 인슐린:혈당 비 51.5였고, 경구당부하검사에서 내당능장애는 없었어요.
statement_en: Peter's glycaemia showed insulin 247 pmol/L (about 40 mU/L) with glucose 4.8 mmol/L and an insulin:glucose ratio of 51.5, with no impaired glucose tolerance on OGTT.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 35
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 피터의 간기능검사는 ALT 85 U/L(정상 10~50)만 올라 있었고, 초음파에서는 지방간에 합당한 미만성 증가가 보였으며 담낭과 총담관은 정상이었어요.
statement_en: Peter's liver tests were normal apart from a raised ALT of 85 U/L (normal range 10-50), and ultrasound showed a diffuse increase consistent with fatty liver with a normal gall bladder and common bile duct.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 35
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 2009년 코크란 리뷰는 행동 프로그램을 곁들인 가족 기반 생활습관 중재가 아동과 청소년 모두에서 과체중을 줄인다고 결론지었고, 이어진 체계적 문헌고찰은 LDL 콜레스테롤, 중성지방, 공복 인슐린도 뚜렷하게 좋아졌음을 보여줬어요.
statement_en: The 2009 Cochrane Review concluded that family-based lifestyle interventions with a behavioural programme lead to decreases in overweight in both children and adolescents, and a subsequent systematic review also showed significant improvements in LDL cholesterol, triglycerides and fasting insulin.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 4 Evidence for lifestyle interventions
refs: Oude Luttikhuis, H. et al. (2009). Interventions for treating obesity in children. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 1, CD001872. doi: 10.1002/14651858.CD001872.pub2.
Ho, M. et al. (2012). Effectiveness of lifestyle interventions in child obesity: systematic review with meta-analysis. Pediatrics, 130(6), e1647-71.

statement_ko: 12~17세 청소년의 식사·신체활동·행동 중재를 모은 메타분석은 중재군 1,599명, 대조군 1,175명에서 평균 BMI 차이 -1.18 kg/m2(95% 신뢰구간 -1.67~-0.69)를 보였어요.
statement_en: The pooled meta-analysis of diet, physical activity and behavioural interventions in adolescents aged 12-17 gave a mean BMI difference of -1.18 kg/m2 (95% CI -1.67 to -0.69) with 1,599 intervention and 1,175 control participants.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams pages 36-37
refs: Al-Khudairy, L. et al. (2017). Diet, physical activity and behavioural interventions for the treatment of overweight or obese adolescents aged 12 to 17 years. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 6, CD012691. doi: 10.1002/14651858.CD012691.

statement_ko: 6~11세 아동을 모은 메타분석은 중재군 1,422명, 대조군 1,363명에서 평균 BMI 차이 -0.53 kg/m2(95% 신뢰구간 -0.82~-0.24)를 보였는데, 크지는 않아도 유의한 결과로 설명돼요.
statement_en: The pooled meta-analysis in children aged 6-11 gave a mean BMI difference of -0.53 kg/m2 (95% CI -0.82 to -0.24) with 1,422 intervention and 1,363 control participants, described as a modest but still significant outcome.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 38
refs: Mead, E. et al. (2017). Diet, physical activity and behavioural interventions for the treatment of overweight or obese children from the age of 6 to 11 years. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 6, CD012651. DOI: 10.1002/14651858.CD012651.

statement_ko: 아이를 위한 생활습관·행동 중재의 구성요소는 가족 참여, 발달 단계에 맞춘 접근, 장기적인 행동 변화 지원, 그리고 장기 체중 유지 전략이에요.
statement_en: The elements within lifestyle and behavioural intervention for children are family involvement, being developmentally appropriate, supporting long-term behaviour change, and strategies for longer-term weight maintenance.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 4 Basic principles of treatment
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 7~12세를 대상으로 한 8개월 중재를 5년간 추적한 고전 연구에서 2개월·8개월·21개월에는 군 간 차이가 거의 없었지만, 5년째에는 부모와 아이가 함께한 군의 체중 성적이 아이 단독군이나 비특이 중재군보다 훨씬 좋았어요.
statement_en: In a classic eight-month intervention in seven- to 12-year-olds followed to five years, there was little difference between groups at two, eight and 21 months, but by five years the parent-plus-child group had far better weight outcomes than child-alone or non-specific intervention.
