source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 4 Parental involvement and long-term outcomes
refs: Epstein, L.H. et al. (1987). Long-term effects of family-based treatment of childhood obesity. Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, 55(1), pp. 91-95.

statement_ko: 그 연구에서 60개월째 과체중 백분율은 부모와 아이 함께가 약 23.3, 아이 단독이 39.7, 비특이 중재가 48.5였어요.
statement_en: In that study percentage overweight at 60 months was about 23.3 for parent plus child, 39.7 for child alone and 48.5 for the non-specific intervention.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 39
refs: Epstein, L.H. et al. (1987). Long-term effects of family-based treatment of childhood obesity. Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, 55(1), pp. 91-95.

statement_ko: 부모를 변화의 주체로 삼은 연구에서 과체중 백분율은 부모만 참여한 군이 기준선 39.6에서 1년 25.1, 7년 10.4로 떨어졌고, 아이만 참여한 군은 39.1에서 31.5, 18.9로 떨어졌어요.
statement_en: In the parents-as-agents-of-change study, percentage overweight fell from 39.6 at baseline to 25.1 at one year and 10.4 at seven years in the parents-only arm, versus 39.1 to 31.5 to 18.9 in the children-only arm.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 40
refs: Golan, M. (2006). Parents as agents of change in childhood obesity - from research to practice. International Journal of Pediatric Obesity, 1(2), pp. 66-76.

statement_ko: 그 연구의 아이 단독군에서는 중도 탈락이 더 많았고 중재에 대한 걱정과 스트레스를 호소하는 아이도 더 많았는데, 열 살짜리가 음식 선택을 책임져야 할 이유가 있느냐는 물음을 남겨요.
statement_en: The children-only arm of that study had more drop-outs and more children reporting concern and stress about the intervention, raising the question of why a 10-year-old should feel responsible for food choices.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 4 Parents as the agents of change
refs: Golan, M. (2006). Parents as agents of change in childhood obesity - from research to practice. International Journal of Pediatric Obesity, 1(2), pp. 66-76.

statement_ko: 8~12세를 대상으로 신체활동 강도 두 가지와 좌식행동 중재 강도 두 가지를 조합한 6개월 중재에서 모든 군이 2년까지 과체중 백분율이 좋아졌는데, 좌식행동 중재도 중요할 수 있음을 보여줘요.
statement_en: In a six-month intervention in eight- to 12-year-olds with two intensities of physical activity and two levels of sedentary behaviour intervention, all arms improved percentage overweight out to two years, showing that sedentary behaviour interventions might be important.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 4 Targeting sedentary behaviour
refs: Epstein, L.H. et al. (2000). Decreasing sedentary behaviors in treating pediatric obesity. Archives of Pediatrics and Adolescent Medicine, 154(3), pp. 220-226.

statement_ko: 5개월간의 가족 기반 생활습관 중재를 마친 뒤, 행동기술 유지와 사회적 촉진 유지 모두 대조군보다 뺀 체중을 더 잘 지키게 했어요.
statement_en: After a five-month family-based lifestyle intervention, both behavioural skills maintenance and social facilitation maintenance led to improved maintenance of weight lost compared with control.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 4 Maintenance-targeted therapy
refs: Wilfley, D.E. et al. (2007). Efficacy of maintenance treatment approaches for childhood overweight: a randomized controlled trial. Journal of the American Medical Association, 298(14), pp. 1661-1673.

statement_ko: 아이를 위한 실질적인 식사 권고는 규칙적인 식사, 가족과 함께 먹기, 1회 제공량 줄이기, 아침 먹기, 열량과 혈당지수가 낮은 음식 고르기, 채소 늘리기, 더 나은 간식 고르기, 단 음료 줄이기, 물 마시기예요.
statement_en: Practical food recommendations for children are regular meals, eating together as a family, decreased portion sizes, eating breakfast, choosing foods lower in energy and glycaemic index, more vegetables, healthier snacks, reducing sugary drinks and drinking water.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 5 Changes in food intake
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 가족 전체의 생활습관 변화를 목표로 삼아 장을 보고 요리하는 사람을 참여시켜야 하고, 부모의 본보기가 무엇보다 중요해요.
statement_en: Whole-of-family lifestyle change should be the aim, engaging the person who buys and cooks the food, and parental role-modelling is vital.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 5 Changes in food intake
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 여러 나라의 국가 지침은 5세를 넘으면 자유재량 화면 시간을 하루 두 시간 미만으로 두라고 하지만, 아이들은 학교에서 쓰는 시간 말고도 하루 대여섯 시간 넘게 화면을 볼 수 있어요.
statement_en: Several countries have national guidelines indicating less than two hours per day of discretionary screen time for people over the age of five, yet children may spend five or six hours or more per day in addition to school screen time.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 5 Physical activity and sedentary behaviours
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 화면에 관한 권고는 하루 두 시간 미만으로 제한하기, TV와 다른 기기를 침실에서 치우기, 활동과 화면 시간 모두에서 부모가 본보기를 보이기예요.
statement_en: The screen recommendations are to limit screen time to less than two hours per day, get the TV and other devices out of the bedroom, and use parental role modelling for both activity and screen time.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 5 Physical activity and sedentary behaviours
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 단면연구와 종단연구 모두 짧은 수면 시간이 아동·청소년·성인의 과체중과 비만 발생과 연관된다고 보여줘요.
statement_en: Cross-sectional and longitudinal studies show an association between short sleep duration and the development of overweight and obesity in children, young people and adults.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 5 Sleep behaviours
refs: Fatima, Y., Doi, S.A., Mamun, A.A. (2015). Longitudinal impact of sleep on overweight and obesity in children and adolescents: a systematic review and bias-adjusted meta-analysis. Obesity Reviews, 16(2), pp. 137-149.

statement_ko: 가르치는 핵심 행동 변화 전략은 체중보다 행동을 목표로 삼는 편이 분명한 목표 설정, 자극 조절, 그리고 식사일지·화면사용일지·매일 만보계·주 1회 체중 측정으로 하는 자기관찰이에요.
statement_en: The key behavioural change strategies taught are goal setting, where targeting behaviours is clearer than targeting weight, stimulus control, and self-monitoring with a food diary, screen use diary, daily pedometer measurement and weekly weighing.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 5 Key behavioural change strategies
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 청소년의 고도비만은 사실상 새로운 질환으로 설명돼요. 보건의료체계가 이를 인식하지 못했고, 대부분의 의료진이 관리 훈련을 제대로 받지 못했으며, 어디에도 서비스가 갖춰져 있지 않고 지침도 거의 없어요.
statement_en: Severe obesity in young people is described as essentially a new disease: health systems have not recognised it, most health professionals are poorly trained in its management, services are not set up for it almost anywhere, and guidelines are almost non-existent.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Severe obesity in young people
refs: Alexander, S. et al. (2009). When Does Severe Childhood Obesity Become a Child Protection Issue? Medical Journal of Australia, 190, pp. 136-139.

statement_ko: 초저열량식은 청소년에서 안전한 감량과 연결될 수 있어서 3~12주에 최대 15 kg까지 빠지기도 하는데, 보통 영양적으로 완전한 제품을 써서 영양사의 감독 아래 짧게 시행해요.
statement_en: Very low energy diets can be associated with safe weight loss in adolescents, sometimes up to 15 kg weight loss over 3-12 weeks, typically for short periods under the supervision of a dietitian with nutritionally complete formulas.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Intensive dietary interventions
refs: Sothern, M.S. et al. (2007). Weight loss and growth velocity in obese children after very low calorie diet, exercise, and behavior modification. Acta Paediatrica, 89, pp. 1036-1043.

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 청소년 50명을 중등도 생활습관 중재와 복강경 조절형 위밴드술로 나눈 무작위 시험에서, 생활습관군의 일부 청소년은 15~20 kg을 감량했지만 전체로는 수술보다 성적이 완만했어요.
statement_en: In a randomised trial of 50 adolescents with obesity comparing a moderate-intensity lifestyle intervention with laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding, some young people in the lifestyle arm achieved 15-20 kg of weight loss although overall the lifestyle results were more modest than surgery.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Laparoscopic banding vs. lifestyle
refs: O'Brien, P.E. et al. (2010). Laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding in severely obese adolescents: a randomized trial. Journal of the American Medical Association, 303(6), pp. 519-526.

statement_ko: Teen-LABS 연구는 미국 다섯 개 센터에서 비만대사수술을 받은 청소년 240명 이상을 등록했고, 대개 루와이 위우회술이나 위소매절제술이었어요.
statement_en: The Teen Longitudinal Assessment of Bariatric Surgery study enrolled over 240 adolescents undergoing bariatric surgery in five US centres, generally Roux-en-Y gastric bypass or sleeve gastrectomy.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Teen-LABS
refs: Inge, T.H. et al. (2016). Weight Loss and Health Status 3 Years after Bariatric Surgery in Adolescents. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(2), pp. 113-123.

statement_ko: 청소년에서 두 가지 비만대사수술은 3년째 기준 체중의 약 30% 감소를 만들어 대체로 3년까지 유지됐고, 위소매절제술 -25.7%, 위우회술 -29.2%였으며 이상지질혈증도 줄었어요.
statement_en: At three years both bariatric procedures in adolescents produced an approximately 30% drop in weight from baseline, largely maintained out to three years, with weight change of -25.7% for sleeve and -29.2% for bypass and a decrease in dyslipidaemia.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Charts and diagrams page 44
refs: Inge, T.H. et al. (2016). Weight Loss and Health Status 3 Years after Bariatric Surgery in Adolescents. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(2), pp. 113-123.

statement_ko: Teen-LABS와 위밴드 시험 모두에서 일부 청소년은 합병증 때문에 재수술이 필요했어요.
statement_en: In both Teen-LABS and the banding trial some young people needed revision surgery because of complications.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Teen-LABS
refs: Inge, T.H. et al. (2016). Weight Loss and Health Status 3 Years after Bariatric Surgery in Adolescents. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(2), pp. 113-123.
O'Brien, P.E. et al. (2010). Laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding in severely obese adolescents: a randomized trial. Journal of the American Medical Association, 303(6), pp. 519-526.

statement_ko: 청소년 비만대사수술의 합의 권고는 BMI 35나 40을 넘는 고도비만, 사춘기 후반이거나 최종 성인 신장에 가까운 상태, 충분한 설명에 근거한 동의, 지지적인 가족 환경, 그리고 다학제 체중관리팀과 장기 추적을 갖춘 센터에서의 수술이에요.
statement_en: Consensus recommendations for bariatric surgery in adolescents are severe obesity such as a BMI greater than either 35 or 40, late puberty or near final adult height, informed consent, a supportive family environment, and surgery in centres with multidisciplinary weight management teams and long-term follow-up.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Recommendations for bariatric surgery
refs: Baur, L.A. et al. (2010). Recommendations for bariatric surgery in adolescents in Australia and New Zealand. Journal of Paediatrics and Child Health, 46(12), pp. 707-704.
Inge, T.H. et al. (2016). Weight Loss and Health Status 3 Years after Bariatric Surgery in Adolescents. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(2), pp. 113-123.

statement_ko: 2016년 청소년 비만 약물치료 코크란 리뷰는 메트포민과 오르리스타트 모두 약 2 kg의 감량을 가져왔고, 청소년 시험의 탈락률이 성인 시험보다 높았다고 보고했어요.
statement_en: The 2016 Cochrane Review on drug therapy for obesity in adolescents showed that metformin and orlistat both resulted in weight reduction of about 2 kg, with greater attrition in adolescent trials than in adult trials.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Pharmacotherapy
refs: Mead, E. et al. (2016). Drug interventions for the treatment of obesity in children and adolescents. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 11, CD012436. DOI: 10.1002/14651858.CD012436.

statement_ko: 청소년에게 쓸 수 있는 비만 약물은 종류와 공급이 제한적이고 정부가 급여하는 경우도 드물며, 청소년 대상 임상시험이 적어 실제로는 허가 외 사용이 잦아요.
statement_en: Current anti-obesity agents for adolescents are limited in number and availability with few subsidised by government agencies, there are few trials in adolescents, and clinical use is often off-label.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page 6 Pharmacotherapy
refs: Mead, E. et al. (2016). Drug interventions for the treatment of obesity in children and adolescents. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 11, CD012436. DOI: 10.1002/14651858.CD012436.

statement_ko: 치료 제공의 장벽으로는 빈곤, 문화·언어적으로 다양한 배경, 학습장애나 발달장애, 낮은 문해력, 위기 상황의 가족, 정신질환이 꼽히고, 각각에 맞는 대응이 제시돼요.
statement_en: The barriers to providing treatment listed are poverty, culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, learning disabilities or developmental disorders, low literacy, families in crisis, and psychiatric disorders, each with its own recommended response.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page Conclusions Barriers to providing treatment
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 위기 상황의 가족이나 정신질환이 있는 경우에는 상황이 안정될 때까지 위기 개입과 사례 관리를 먼저 하고, 체중 관리는 뒤로 미룰 수 있어요.
statement_en: For families in crisis or with psychiatric disorders, crisis intervention and case management come first until the situation stabilises, and weight management may take a back seat.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page Conclusions Barriers to providing treatment
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 모듈 요약은 아동·청소년 평가에서 연령별 BMI 도표를 일상적으로 쓰라고 권하고, 허리키비가 성인뿐 아니라 아동·청소년에서도 복부 지방을 재는 유용한 지표라고 짚어요.
statement_en: The module summary recommends routinely using BMI-for-age charts in the assessment of children and young people, and notes that waist-to-height ratio is a useful measure of central adiposity in children and young people as well as in adults.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Module 8 (Management of Obesity in Children and Adolescents) › Page Conclusions Summary
refs: Baur, L.A., Hazelton, B., Shrewsbury, V.A. (2011). Assessment and management of obesity in childhood and adolescence. Nature Reviews Gastroenterology & Hepatology, 8(11), pp.635- 645.

statement_ko: 비만 인과 순환 지도는 "Foresight Obesity System Map"이라는 제목으로 인쇄돼 있고, 108개의 변수를 열 개 군집으로 묶어 놨어요.
statement_en: The obesity causal loop map is printed with the title "Foresight Obesity System Map" and contains 108 variables grouped into ten clusters.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Map legend and nodes
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도의 열 개 변수 군집은 인쇄된 순서대로 미디어, 사회, 심리, 경제, 식품, 활동, 기반시설, 발달, 생물, 의료예요.
statement_en: The map's ten variable clusters, in printed order, are Media, Social, Psychological, Economic, Food, Activity, Infrastructure, Developmental, Biological and Medical.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Legend - variable clusters
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도에서 화살촉이 채워진 실선은 양의 영향, 끝이 채워진 사각형인 점선은 음의 영향을 뜻해요.
statement_en: On the map a solid line with a filled arrowhead means Positive Influence and a dotted line ending in a filled square means Negative Influence.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Legend - link types
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도의 중심 허브는 ENERGY BALANCE로 표시돼 있고, 주황색 고리가 축적의 의식적 통제, 신체적 필요의 중요성, 에너지 획득 노력, 에너지 보존 경향, 가용 에너지 수준, 에너지 축적 고착의 강도, 식습관의 힘, 신체활동을 이어요.
statement_en: The central hub of the map is labelled ENERGY BALANCE, and the orange ring links Conscious Control of Accumulation, Importance of Physical Need, Effort to Acquire Energy, Tendency to Preserve Energy, Level of Available Energy, Strength of Lock-in to Accumulate Energy, Force of Dietary Habits and Physical Activity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Central hub
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도에서 강조된 네 허브 변수는 신체활동, 식습관의 힘, 일차 식욕 조절의 정도, 심리적 양가감정이에요.
statement_en: The four highlighted hub variables on the map are Physical Activity, Force of Dietary Habits, Degree of Primary Appetite Control and Psychological Ambivalence.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Highlighted hub variables
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도에서 가장 큰 군집은 변수 19개의 경제, 각각 16개인 식품과 생물이고, 가장 작은 군집은 4개인 발달이에요.
statement_en: The largest clusters on the map are Economic with 19 variables, Food with 16 and Biological with 16, while the smallest is Developmental with 4.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Cluster node counts
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도에서 신체활동과 기능적 체력은 화살표 두 개로 이뤄진 되먹임 고리를 만들고, 에너지 보존 경향은 신체활동에 음의 영향을 줘요.
statement_en: On the map Physical Activity and Functional Fitness form a two-arrow feedback loop, and Tendency to Preserve Energy exerts a negative influence on Physical Activity.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Activity cluster links
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도에서 자동차 교통의 지배력과 생활환경의 보행 친화성은 서로 음의 영향을 주고받으며 음의 되먹임 쌍을 이뤄요.
statement_en: On the map Dominance of Motorised Transport and Walkability of Living Environment negatively influence each other, forming a negative feedback pair.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Activity cluster links
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: 지도에서 심리적 양가감정은 축적의 의식적 통제에 음의 영향을 주고 긴장 해소 욕구를 키우며, 그 욕구가 다시 탐닉·보상 수요를 밀어 올려요.
statement_en: On the map Psychological Ambivalence negatively influences Conscious Control of Accumulation and positively drives Desire to Resolve Tension, which in turn drives Demand for Indulgence or Compensation.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class Attachments › Obesity Causal Loop Map › Psychological / energy-balance core
refs: UK Government Office for Science (2007). Foresight: Tackling Obesities - Obesity System Map.

statement_ko: Core Learning Path는 여덟 개의 핵심 모듈로 이뤄져 있고, 총 5시간 과정을 통과하면 CME 4학점, CPD 4학점, SCOPE 포인트 4점을 받아요.
statement_en: The Core Learning Path consists of eight core modules and learners who pass earn 4 CME credits, 4 CPD credits and 4 SCOPE points, with a total duration of 5 hours.
source: SCOPE Core Learning Path › Class overview › Class overview
refs: SCOPE Core Learning Path (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만은 만성콩팥병의 새로운 발생과 진행 위험을 모두 높여요.
statement_en: Obesity is associated with an increased risk for incident chronic kidney disease and for chronic kidney disease progression.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 1 Introduction › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 대사적으로 건강한 비만이라도 만성콩팥병 위험은 올라가요.
statement_en: Even metabolically healthy obesity is associated with an increased risk for chronic kidney disease.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 1 Introduction › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 임상에서는 비만의 부수 효과인 고혈압·당뇨병·죽상경화를 주로 치료하고, 만성콩팥병으로 이어지는 근본 원인인 비만과 대사 이상 자체는 잘 다루지 않아요.
statement_en: Clinicians typically treat the side effects of obesity - hypertension, diabetes and atherosclerosis - rather than the underlying obesity and metabolic disarray that links to chronic kidney disease.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 2형당뇨병이나 고혈압이 없던 사람도 20세에 과체중이었다면 만성콩팥병 위험이 3배 높았어요.
statement_en: Patients without type 2 diabetes or hypertension had a threefold increase in risk of chronic kidney disease if they were overweight at age 20.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Chertow, Hsu, Johansen (2006)
Ejerblad et al. (2006)
Hsu et al. (2006)
Fox et al. (2004)

statement_ko: 기저 BMI가 높을수록 혈압과 2형당뇨병을 보정한 뒤에도 말기신질환의 독립적 위험인자로 남았어요.
statement_en: Higher baseline BMI remained an independent risk factor for end-stage renal disease even after adjustment for blood pressure and type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Chertow, Hsu, Johansen (2006)
Ejerblad et al. (2006)
Hsu et al. (2006)
Fox et al. (2004)

statement_ko: 비만은 미세알부민뇨 위험을 70% 높여요.
statement_en: Obesity is associated with a 70% increased risk of microalbuminuria.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Chertow, Hsu, Johansen (2006)
Ejerblad et al. (2006)
Hsu et al. (2006)
Fox et al. (2004)

statement_ko: 대사증후군의 구성요소와 만성콩팥병은 강하고 일관되게 연결돼요.
statement_en: Components of the metabolic syndrome and chronic kidney disease are strongly and consistently linked.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Chertow, Hsu, Johansen (2006)
Ejerblad et al. (2006)
Hsu et al. (2006)
Fox et al. (2004)

statement_ko: 비만은 만성콩팥병과 울혈성 심부전의 독립적 위험인자예요.
statement_en: Obesity is an independent risk factor for chronic kidney disease and congestive heart failure.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Vimaleswaran et al. (2013)
Chertow et al. (2006)
Wickman, Kramer (2013)
Kwakernaak (2014)

statement_ko: 대사적으로 건강한 비만이든 대사적으로 건강하지 않은 비만·대사증후군이든 모두 만성콩팥병의 위험인자예요.
statement_en: Both metabolically healthy obesity and metabolically unhealthy obesity or metabolic syndrome are risk factors for chronic kidney disease.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Vimaleswaran et al. (2013)
Chertow et al. (2006)
Wickman, Kramer (2013)
Kwakernaak (2014)

statement_ko: 비만 자체가 고혈압·2형당뇨병·울혈성 심부전의 원인이 돼요.
statement_en: Obesity itself is a cause of hypertension, type 2 diabetes and congestive heart failure.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Vimaleswaran et al. (2013)
Chertow et al. (2006)
Wickman, Kramer (2013)
Kwakernaak (2014)

statement_ko: 비만은 이미 있는 만성콩팥병의 진행을 더 빠르게 만들어요.
statement_en: Obesity enhances progression of pre-existing chronic kidney disease.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 4
refs: Vimaleswaran et al. (2013)
Chertow et al. (2006)
Wickman, Kramer (2013)
Kwakernaak (2014)

statement_ko: BMI와 말기신질환의 연관을 본 Kaiser Permanente 분석에는 성인 320,252명이 포함됐어요.
statement_en: The Kaiser Permanente analysis of the association of BMI with end-stage renal disease included 320,252 adults.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 5
refs: Hsu et al. (2006)

statement_ko: Kaiser Permanente 코호트에서 말기신질환 오즈비는 특히 BMI 30 이상에서 뚜렷하게 올라갔어요.
statement_en: In the Kaiser Permanente cohort the odds ratio for end-stage renal disease rises substantially especially from a BMI of 30 and above.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 5
refs: Hsu et al. (2006)

statement_ko: WHO의 대사증후군 정의는 2형당뇨병·공복혈당장애·내당능장애 또는 인슐린 클램프로 확인한 인슐린 저항성을 전제로 하고, 여기에 추가 기준 2개 이상을 요구해요.
statement_en: The World Health Organization definition of the metabolic syndrome requires insulin resistance - identified by type 2 diabetes, impaired fasting glucose, impaired glucose tolerance or insulin clamp - plus two or more further criteria.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 6
refs: Cirillo et al. (2006)

statement_ko: WHO 대사증후군 정의의 비만 기준은 BMI 30 kg/m2 초과 그리고/또는 허리엉덩이둘레비 남성 0.9 초과·여성 0.85 초과예요.
statement_en: In the WHO metabolic syndrome definition the adiposity criterion is BMI > 30 kg/m2 and/or waist:hip ratio > 0.9 in men and > 0.85 in women.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 6
refs: Cirillo et al. (2006)

statement_ko: NCEP ATP III 정의는 다섯 가지 위험인자 가운데 3개 이상을 요구해요.
statement_en: The NCEP ATP III definition requires three or more of five risk factors.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 6
refs: Cirillo et al. (2006)

statement_ko: NCEP ATP III의 허리둘레 기준은 여성 88 cm 초과, 남성 102 cm 초과예요.
statement_en: The NCEP ATP III waist circumference criterion is > 88 cm in women and > 102 cm in men.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 6
refs: Cirillo et al. (2006)

statement_ko: NCEP ATP III의 지질 기준은 중성지방 150 mg/dL 이상, HDL 콜레스테롤 남성 40 mg/dL 미만·여성 50 mg/dL 미만이에요.
statement_en: The NCEP ATP III lipid criteria are triglycerides >= 150 mg/dL and HDL cholesterol < 40 mg/dL in men and < 50 mg/dL in women.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 6
refs: Cirillo et al. (2006)

statement_ko: NCEP ATP III 정의는 혈압 130/85 mmHg 이상, 공복혈당 110 mg/dL 이상을 기준으로 써요.
statement_en: The NCEP ATP III definition uses blood pressure >= 130/85 mmHg and a fasting glucose level >= 110 mg/dL.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 6
refs: Cirillo et al. (2006)

statement_ko: IDF 정의는 인종별 기준의 허리둘레로 확인한 중심비만을 필수로 하고, 추가 기준 2개 이상을 요구해요.
statement_en: The International Diabetes Federation definition requires central obesity by ethnicity-specific waist circumference plus two or more further criteria.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 6
refs: Cirillo et al. (2006)

statement_ko: 미국 성인에서 대사증후군과 만성콩팥병의 관계를 본 분석은 NHANES III의 6,217명을 대상으로 했어요.
statement_en: The analysis of metabolic syndrome and chronic kidney disease in US adults used a cohort of 6,217 people from NHANES III.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 7
refs: Chen et al. (2004)

statement_ko: 대사증후군 구성요소 개수가 늘수록 신규 만성콩팥병의 오즈비가 뚜렷하게 올라가요.
statement_en: As the number of metabolic syndrome components rises, the odds ratio for incident chronic kidney disease rises substantially.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 7
refs: Chen et al. (2004)

statement_ko: 대사적으로 건강한 비만을 본 강북삼성 건강연구 분석은 평균 36.1세, 평균 eGFR 80.9 ml/min/1.73m2인 62,249명의 전향 코호트였어요.
statement_en: The Kangbuk Samsung Health Study analysis of metabolically healthy obesity was a prospective cohort of 62,249 participants with a mean age of 36.1 years and a mean eGFR of 80.9 ml/min/1.73m2.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 8
refs: Chang et al. (2016)

statement_ko: 이 연구에서 대사적으로 건강하다는 기준은 HOMA-IR 2.5 미만이면서 대사증후군 구성요소가 하나도 없는 상태였어요.
statement_en: In that study metabolically healthy was defined as HOMA-IR < 2.5 together with the absence of any component of the metabolic syndrome.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 8
refs: Chang et al. (2016)

statement_ko: 신규 만성콩팥병은 eGFR 60 ml/min/1.73m2 미만으로 정의했어요.
statement_en: Incident chronic kidney disease was defined as an eGFR below 60 ml/min/1.73m2.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 8
refs: Chang et al. (2016)

statement_ko: 이 코호트는 369,088 환자-년을 추적해 만성콩팥병 906건이 새로 생겼어요.
statement_en: The cohort accrued 369,088 patient years of follow-up and 906 incident cases of chronic kidney disease.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 8
refs: Chang et al. (2016)

statement_ko: 대사적으로 건강한 참가자에서 정상체중 대비 5년 누적 만성콩팥병 발생률 차이는 과체중 범위인 BMI 23.0~24.9 kg/m2에서 3.5(0.9~6.1)였어요.
statement_en: Among metabolically healthy participants the multivariable adjusted difference in 5-year cumulative incidence of chronic kidney disease compared with normal weight was 3.5 (0.9 to 6.1) for the overweight range BMI 23.0 to 24.9 kg/m2.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 8
refs: Chang et al. (2016)

statement_ko: 같은 보정 5년 차이는 비만 범위인 BMI 25.0 kg/m2 초과에서 6.7(3.0~10.6)이었어요.
statement_en: The same adjusted 5-year difference was 6.7 (3.0 to 10.6) for the obesity range BMI above 25.0 kg/m2.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 2 Epidemiology and relationships › slide 8
refs: Chang et al. (2016)

statement_ko: 중심성 지방분포, 아디포카인 불균형, 인슐린 저항성, 지질 독성, 장내미생물 변화, 만성 염증이 모두 비만에서 만성콩팥병 발생 위험을 높여요.
statement_en: Central body fat distribution, adipokine imbalance, insulin resistance, lipid toxicity, altered gut microbiota and chronic inflammation all increase the risk of developing chronic kidney disease in obesity.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만에서 만성콩팥병과 심혈관질환으로 가는 병태생리 경로에는 아디포카인 불균형, 비만관련 사구체병증, 인슐린 저항성, 지질 독성, 교감신경계와 레닌-안지오텐신-알도스테론계 과활성, 국소 지방조직 RAAS, 수면호흡장애, 과당이 많은 식사, 장내미생물 변화와 만성 염증이 있어요.
statement_en: Potential pathophysiology pathways of chronic kidney disease and cardiovascular disease in obesity include adipokine imbalance, obesity-related glomerulopathy, insulin resistance, lipid toxicity, sympathetic nervous system and renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system overactivity, local adipose tissue RAAS, sleep-disordered breathing, a fructose-rich diet, and altered gut microbiota with chronic inflammation.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 중심성 지방분포, 특히 내장비만은 사구체 고혈압 증가·사구체 비대·발세포 밀도 감소·족돌기 증가와 연관돼요.
statement_en: Central body fat distribution, particularly visceral obesity, is associated with increased glomerular hypertension, glomerular hypertrophy, decreased podocyte density and increased foot processes.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 11
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 이런 사구체 변화는 단백뇨로 이어지고, 단백뇨는 콩팥 안의 반흔과 섬유화로 진행할 수 있어요.
statement_en: These glomerular changes lead to proteinuria, which can lead to scarring and fibrosis within the kidney.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 11
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 사람은 태어날 때 사구체 필터를 80만~100만 개 가지고 있어요.
statement_en: Humans are born with between 800,000 and 1,000,000 glomerular filters.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 라플라스 법칙에 따라 사구체 필터가 지나치게 커지면 벽 장력이 올라가 사구체 모세혈관 고혈압과 손상이 생겨요.
statement_en: By the Law of LaPlace an over-large glomerular filter raises wall tension, producing glomerular capillary hypertension and injury.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 발세포가 소실되고 상피 족돌기가 융합되면 알부민뇨가 늘어나요.
statement_en: Loss of podocytes and epithelial foot-process fusion increase albuminuria.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소변 미세알부민이 늘수록 심혈관 위험이 커지고, eGFR이 떨어지는 것 자체도 심혈관 위험 증가를 뜻해요.
statement_en: Increasing urinary microalbumin correlates with increasing cardiovascular risk, and any decline in eGFR carries increased cardiovascular risk.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 허리엉덩이둘레비가 높을수록, BMI가 높을수록 사구체 여과분율이 각각 올라가고, 이는 사구체 모세혈관 고혈압과 알부민뇨 위험을 키울 수 있어요.
statement_en: Higher waist:hip ratio and higher BMI are each associated with a higher glomerular filtration fraction, which could raise the risk of glomerular capillary hypertension and albuminuria.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 13
refs: Kwakernaak et al. (2014)

statement_ko: 허리엉덩이둘레비와 BMI를 함께 보면 여과분율 상승 경향이 더 커지고, 사구체 필터를 손상시켜 단백뇨와 결국 사구체경화증으로 이어질 수 있어요.
statement_en: Combining waist:hip ratio and BMI shows an even greater propensity for increased filtration fraction, which could damage glomerular filters and promote proteinuria and ultimately glomerulosclerosis.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 14
refs: Kwakernaak et al. (2014)

statement_ko: 신경호르몬 활성화는 RAAS 활성, 교감신경계 활성, TGF-beta 상승, 산화 스트레스 방어력 저하를 통해 염증과 콩팥 손상을 키워요.
statement_en: Neuro-hormonal activation increases inflammation and kidney damage through RAAS activation, SNS activation, rising TGF-beta levels and reduced overall protection against oxidative stress.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 아디포넥틴은 알부민뇨와 반비례하고, 실험 모델에서 아디포넥틴을 투여하면 발세포의 알부민 투과성과 발세포 기능이상이 줄어요.
statement_en: Adiponectin is inversely related to albuminuria, and administering adiponectin in experimental models reduces podocyte permeability to albumin and podocyte dysfunction.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 16
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이나 과체중인 사람은 렙틴이 높고, 실험적으로 렙틴을 주입하면 단백뇨와 사구체경화증이 늘면서 콩팥 섬유화·산화 스트레스·교감신경 활성도 함께 올라가요.
statement_en: People with obesity or overweight have higher leptin, and experimentally infused leptin increases proteinuria and glomerulosclerosis while enhancing renal fibrosis, oxidative stress and sympathetic nervous system activity.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 16
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 아디포넥틴은 줄고 렙틴은 느는 불균형이 비만 관련 콩팥병에서 가장 큰 걱정거리예요.
statement_en: An imbalance between adiponectin and leptin - reduced adiponectin with higher leptin - is a major concern in obesity-related kidney disease.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 16
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 역학 자료는 고과당 시럽 섭취를 새로운 고혈압 발생, 요산 증가, 혈압의 염분 감수성 증가, 통풍·고혈압·2형당뇨병 증가와 연결지어요.
statement_en: Epidemiological data correlate high-fructose syrup ingestion with incident hypertension, increased uric acid, increased blood pressure salt sensitivity, and increased gout, hypertension and type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 3 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (1) › slide 17
refs: Johnson, Sanchez-Lozada, Nakagawa (2010)
Johnson et al. (2013)

statement_ko: 대사증후군이 있는 사람은 자세와 관계없이 알도스테론이 높고, 그 결과 혈장 레닌 활성도는 억제돼요.
statement_en: Aldosterone levels are higher regardless of posture in people with metabolic syndrome, which suppresses plasma renin activity.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 4 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (2) › slide 21
refs: Kidambi et al. (2007)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 사람은 야간 혈압 하강이 적고, 그 결과 압력 나트륨이뇨가 떨어지고 염분 감수성이 커지는데 이는 알도스테론 과잉 활성과 관련이 있을 가능성이 커요.
statement_en: People living with obesity have less blood pressure dipping at night, which leads to impaired pressure natriuresis and more salt sensitivity, probably related to excess aldosterone activity.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 4 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (2) › slide 22
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 인종이 다양한 인구집단에서 수면무호흡 경향은 알도스테론-레닌 비와 상관관계를 보여요.
statement_en: The propensity for sleep apnoea correlates with the aldosterone:renin ratio in an ethnically diverse population.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 4 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (2) › slide 23
refs: Sim et al. (2011)

statement_ko: eGFR이 떨어질수록 수면호흡장애가 잦아지고, 무호흡-저호흡지수는 콩팥기능 저하와 상관관계를 보여요.
statement_en: As eGFR declines sleep-disordered breathing becomes more frequent, with the apnoea-hypopnoea index correlating with reduced kidney function.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 4 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (2) › slide 24
refs: Sakaguchi et al. (2011)

statement_ko: 스피로놀락톤으로 알도스테론을 차단하자 저항성 고혈압과 중등도-중증 폐쇄성 수면무호흡이 있는 사람의 무호흡-저호흡지수가 좋아졌어요.
statement_en: Blocking aldosterone with spironolactone improved the apnoea-hypopnoea index in people with resistant hypertension and moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnoea.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 4 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (2) › slide 25
refs: Yang et al. (2016)

statement_ko: 지질 독성은 비알코올 지방간질환 발생과 이어지고, 유리지방산이 조직에 이소성으로 쌓이면서 생기는 혈관 손상이 콩팥 문제와 알부민뇨로 이어질 수 있어요.
statement_en: Lipotoxicity ties into the development of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and ectopic tissue accumulation of free fatty acids with vascular injury potentially leads to kidney problems and albuminuria.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 4 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (2) › slide 27
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지방세포가 주도하는 고알도스테론증은 염증 상태, 인슐린 저항성, 산화 스트레스, 콩팥 세뇨관의 나트륨 재흡수, 염분 민감성 고혈압을 모두 키워요.
statement_en: Adipocyte-driven hyperaldosteronism enhances a pro-inflammatory state, insulin resistance, oxidative stress, renal tubular sodium reabsorption and salt-sensitive hypertension.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 4 Mechanisms and pathophysiological pathways (2) › slide 28
refs: Sowers, Whaley-Connell, Epstein (2009)
Bogaert, Linas (2009)

statement_ko: 저열량 식사는 사구체여과율과 알부민뇨의 개선과 연관돼요.
statement_en: Low calorie diets are associated with improved glomerular filtration rate and albuminuria.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 5 Treatment options › slide 32
refs: Kiortsis, Christou (2012)
Ricardo et al. (2013)

statement_ko: 앉아서 지내는 생활습관은 만성콩팥병 유병과 연관돼요.
statement_en: A sedentary lifestyle is associated with prevalent chronic kidney disease.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 5 Treatment options › slide 32
refs: Kiortsis, Christou (2012)
Ricardo et al. (2013)

statement_ko: ACE 억제는 비만이 없는 환자보다 비만과 만성콩팥병을 함께 가진 환자에서 콩팥 사건 발생을 더 효과적으로 줄였어요.
statement_en: ACE inhibition reduced the rate of renal events in patients living with obesity and chronic kidney disease more effectively than in patients living without obesity.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 5 Treatment options › slide 33
refs: Mallamaci et al. (2011)

statement_ko: 미네랄로코르티코이드 수용체 차단제도 효과가 있을 수 있고, SGLT2 억제제와 GLP-1 수용체 작용제는 체중 감량과 그에 따른 이득과 연관돼요.
statement_en: Mineralocorticoid receptor blockers may also be effective, and SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 receptor agonists are associated with weight loss and its associated benefits.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 5 Treatment options › slide 33
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 규모가 작고 대조군이 없는 경우가 많은 비만대사수술 연구들에서 알부민뇨·고혈압·염증 지표가 줄었어요.
statement_en: Evidence from small, often uncontrolled studies of bariatric surgery shows reduced albuminuria, reduced hypertension and reduced measures of inflammation.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 5 Treatment options › slide 34
refs: Sjstrm et al. (2012)
Alexander et al. (2009)
Hou et al. (2013)

statement_ko: 지방량이 늘면 직접 기전과 간접 기전 양쪽으로 콩팥병을 촉진해요.
statement_en: Increased fat mass promotes kidney disease through both direct and indirect mechanisms.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 6 Conclusions › slide 35
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지방량 증가가 콩팥병으로 이어지는 주요 직접 기전은 고혈압·당뇨병·죽상경화예요.
statement_en: The major direct mechanisms linking increased fat mass to kidney disease are hypertension, diabetes and atherosclerosis.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 6 Conclusions › slide 35
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 주요 간접 기전은 알도스테론을 통한 혈관 독성, RAAS와 교감신경계 활성, 산화 스트레스, 염증, 아디포넥틴 감소와 렙틴 증가예요.
statement_en: The major indirect mechanisms are vasculotoxicity via aldosterone, RAAS and SNS activation, oxidative stress, inflammation, less adiponectin and more leptin.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 6 Conclusions › slide 35
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 중심부 지방량이 늘면 사구체 모세혈관 고혈압, 알부민뇨, 사구체경화증과 연관돼요.
statement_en: Increased central fat mass is associated with glomerular capillary hypertension, albuminuria and glomerulosclerosis.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 6 Conclusions › slide 35
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 그 밖의 중요한 치료 고려사항은 폐쇄성 수면무호흡 평가, RAAS 억제와 미네랄로코르티코이드 수용체 길항제를 통한 혈압 조절, 식이 염분 감소, 2형당뇨병과 이상지질혈증 치료, SGLT2 억제제와 GLP-1 수용체 작용제예요.
statement_en: Other important treatment considerations are evaluation for obstructive sleep apnoea, control of blood pressure with RAAS inhibition and mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists, dietary salt reduction, treatment of type 2 diabetes and dyslipidaemia, and SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1 receptor agonists.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 6 Conclusions › slide 37
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: APOL1 유전자 다형성은 비만과 만성콩팥병을 잇는 주요 인자에 들어가지 않고, 고혈압·당뇨병·죽상경화가 주요 인자예요.
statement_en: APOL1 gene polymorphism is not among the main factors that link obesity with chronic kidney disease, whereas hypertension, diabetes and atherosclerosis are.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 7 Assessment › slide 38
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 메산지움 세포과다증식은 중심성 지방분포와 연관된 사구체 변화에 들어가지 않아요.
statement_en: Increased mesangial hypercellularity is not among the glomerular changes associated with central body fat distribution.
source: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease › Page 7 Assessment › slide 38
refs: SCOPE Obesity and Chronic Kidney Disease (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 자궁 내 시기와 신생아 초기가 소아 비만에 미치는 장기 영향은 첫 1,000일 가설로 정리돼요.
statement_en: The long-term effects of intrauterine and early neonatal life on childhood obesity are summarised as the first 1,000 days hypothesis.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 1
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 입양 연구를 보면 입양된 사람의 체중은 양부모가 아니라 생물학적 부모를 닮아요.
statement_en: Adoption studies show that adopted individuals resemble their biological, not their adoptive, parents in body weight.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 3
refs: Stunkard, A. J. et al. (1986). An adoption study of human obesity. New England Journal of Medicine, 314(4), pp. 193-8.

statement_ko: 따로 자란 일란성 쌍둥이도 체중이 비슷하게 늘어, 체질량지수에 유전 배경이 크게 작용한다는 걸 보여줘요.
statement_en: Monozygotic twins raised apart gain weight similarly, indicating a strong genetic background to body mass index.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 3
refs: Stunkard, A. J. et al. (1990). The Body-Mass Index of Twins Who Have Been Reared Apart. New England Journal of Medicine, 322, pp. 1483-1487.

statement_ko: 장기 과식 실험에서 일란성 쌍둥이는 서로 비슷한 정도로 체중이 늘었어요.
statement_en: Overfed identical twins gain weight similarly to each other in long-term overfeeding experiments.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 3
refs: Bouchard, C. et al. (1990). The response to long-term overfeeding in identical twins. New England Journal of Medicine, 322(21), pp. 1477-82.

statement_ko: 유전자는 환경 요인에 따라 발현되거나 침묵하고, 이런 후성유전 변화는 다음 세대로 전달될 수 있어요.
statement_en: Genes are expressed or silenced by environmental factors, and these epigenetic changes can be transmitted to the next generation.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 4
refs: Junien, C. (2015). Epigenetics In Transgenerational Responses To Environmental Impacts: Facts And Gaps. In M.L. Frelut (Ed.), The ECOG's eBook on Child and Adolescent Obesity.

statement_ko: 신체 진찰에서 거대설은 베크위트-비데만 증후군의 표지예요.
statement_en: Macroglossia on physical examination is a marker for Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 손발이 작고 눈이 아몬드 모양이면 프라더-윌리 증후군을 시사해요.
statement_en: Small hands and feet with almond-shaped eyes are markers for Prader-Willi syndrome.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 태아기의 소아 비만 위험요인은 산모 비만이나 임신 중 과도한 체중 증가, 임신당뇨병, 태아 자궁내성장지연이에요.
statement_en: Foetal-life risk factors for childhood obesity are maternal obesity and/or excessive weight gain during pregnancy, gestational diabetes and intrauterine growth retardation of the foetus.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 부당경량아로 태어난 아기는 생후 2년 동안 체중이 빠르게 늘면 장기적인 대사 위험을 안게 돼요.
statement_en: For the small-for-gestational-age infant, rapid weight gain in the first two years carries long-term metabolic risk.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 출생 체중이 정상이거나 큰 아기에게는 모유수유, 초기 수유 방식, 이유식 도입과 다양화 시점이 중요한 조절 요인이에요.
statement_en: For the normal or large birth-weight infant, breastfeeding, early feeding practices and the timing of food introduction and diversification are the important regulators.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 만 2세 이후에는 가족의 생활습관이 아이 개인의 생물학적 배경이 어떻게 발현될지를 좌우해요.
statement_en: Beyond two years of age, family lifestyle shapes the expression of the child's personal biological background.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체지방을 가늠하는 가장 좋은 임상 지표는 체질량지수로, 체중(kg)을 키(m)의 제곱으로 나눠 구해요.
statement_en: The best clinical index of adiposity is body mass index, calculated as the weight in kilograms divided by the square of the height expressed in metres.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 8
refs: Rolland-Cachera, M. F., Akrout, M., Peneau, S. (2015). History And Meaning Of The Body Mass Index. Interest Of Other Anthropometric Measurements. In M.L. Frelut (Ed.), The ECOG's eBook on Child and Adolescent Obesity.

statement_ko: 소아에서 과체중과 비만의 기준값은 성별과 연령에 따라 달라져요.
statement_en: Cut-off values for overweight and obesity in childhood differ according to sex and age.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 8
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체중과 신장은 반드시 함께 평가해야 하고, 체중 속도는 빨라지는데 신장 속도가 느리면 곧바로 정밀검사를 해야 해요.
statement_en: Weight and height must be assessed simultaneously, and increased weight velocity together with low height velocity is an indication for urgent investigation.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 허리둘레가 늘고 허리엉덩이둘레비가 커지면 중심비만을 뜻하고, 이는 대사 위험 증가와 연관돼요.
statement_en: Increased waist circumference and increased waist-to-hip ratio indicate central obesity, which is associated with increased metabolic risk.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 6세 무렵에 나타나는 BMI 곡선의 가장 낮은 지점을 지방 재증가(adiposity rebound)라고 불러요.
statement_en: The lowest point of the BMI curve, which occurs at the age of six years, is named the adiposity rebound.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 이른 지방 재증가는 성인 비만의 조기 위험인자이자 지표로, 재증가가 뚜렷하게 빠른 아이는 성인이 되어도 과체중이나 비만 범위에 머무는 경향이 있어요.
statement_en: Early adiposity rebound is an early risk factor and indicator of adult obesity, with children showing a significant early rebound tending to stay in the overweight or obesity range in adulthood.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지방 재증가가 늦은 아이는 청소년 후기에 평균 BMI로 돌아오는 경향을 보여요.
statement_en: Children with a late adiposity rebound tend to return to average BMI in late adolescence.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: IOTF의 BMI 곡선은 소아청소년의 비만 기준을 성인 기준과 연속되게 이어주며, 역학 목적으로만 써야 해요.
statement_en: The International Obesity Task Force BMI curves bring continuity between the obesity threshold in children and adolescents and that of adults, and should be used for epidemiological purposes only.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 11
refs: Cole, T. J., Lobstein, T. (2012). Extended international (IOTF) body mass index cut-offs for thinness, overweight and obesity. Pediatric Obesity, 7, pp. 284-294.

statement_ko: 키·체중·BMI에 대한 WHO 성장곡선은 임상 현장에서 쓰도록 제안돼요.
statement_en: The WHO growth charts for height, weight and BMI are proposed for use in clinical settings.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 11
refs: De Onis, M. (2015). World Health Organization Reference Curves. In M.L. Frelut (Ed.), The ECOG's eBook on Child and Adolescent Obesity.

statement_ko: 키·체중·BMI에 대한 CDC 성장곡선은 미국 인구의 성장 양상을 반영해요.
statement_en: The CDC growth charts for height, weight and BMI reflect the USA population growth pattern.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 11
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아에서는 성장 저해(발육부진)가 비만과 함께 나타날 수 있어요.
statement_en: In children, growth stunting may be associated with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 다유전자성으로 보이는 흔한 비만에서는 키가 50백분위수를 따라가고 12개월에 이른 지방 재증가가 나타나 꺾이지 않으며, 체중 속도가 빨라져 36개월에 3 표준편차를 넘어요.
statement_en: In common obesity of likely polygenic origin the height follows the 50th percentile, an early adiposity rebound appears at 12 months and does not level off, and weight velocity accelerates to above 3 SDs at 36 months.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 심인성 비만에서는 36개월까지 50백분위수로 자라다가 6개월 안에 체중이 +3 표준편차를 넘고 9세까지 3 표준편차 위를 유지하며, 키는 +1 표준편차로 자라요.
statement_en: In common obesity of psychogenic origin the child grows on the 50th percentile until 36 months, then weight accelerates above +3 SDs within six months and continues above 3 SDs to nine years while height grows at +1 SD.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 갑상선기능저하증에서는 12개월 동안 신장 속도가 느려지고 체중 속도는 빨라져, 키는 0.5 표준편차 내려가고 체중은 1 표준편차 올라가요.
statement_en: In hypothyroidism height velocity slows for 12 months while weight velocity accelerates, with height decreasing by 0.5 SDs and weight increasing by 1 SD.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 16
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 성장호르몬 결핍에서는 성장 속도가 점점 떨어져 키가 0 표준편차에서 -2 표준편차 아래로 내려가고, 체중은 늘어 BMI가 -1 표준편차에서 +1 표준편차로 올라가요.
statement_en: In growth hormone deficiency a progressive fall in growth velocity takes height from 0 SDs to below -2 SDs while progressive weight gain takes BMI from -1 SD to +1 SD.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 17
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 프라더-윌리 증후군에서는 24개월부터 BMI가 매우 가파르게 올라가, BMI z-점수가 12개월의 -3 표준편차에서 48개월에 +3 표준편차 위로 이동해요.
statement_en: In Prader-Willi syndrome BMI accelerates very robustly from 24 months, with the BMI z-score moving from -3 SDs at 12 months to more than +3 SDs at 48 months.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 렙틴 수용체 이중 변이에서는 12개월부터 체중이 이미 95백분위수에 있고, 체중 속도가 계속 빨라져 6세에 +4 표준편차를 넘어요.
statement_en: In a double mutation of the leptin receptor, weight is already at the 95th percentile from 12 months and weight velocity progressively increases to higher than +4 SDs at six years.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 19
refs: Nunziata, A. et al. (2018). Functional and phenotypic characteristics of human leptin receptors mutations. Journal of the Endocrine Society, 3(1), pp. 27-41.

statement_ko: 임신 기간과 생후 2년 사이에 있었던 일을 꼼꼼히 읽어내면 중요한 정보를 얻고, 과도한 체중 증가를 막을 조기 계획을 세울 수 있어요.
statement_en: Critical reading of the events during pregnancy and the first two years of life can give important information and help to establish an early plan to prevent excessive weight gain.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 20
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 성장 양상을 평가할 때는 WHO 성장곡선이 가장 적절한 도구이고, 무료로 쓸 수 있으며 전 세계 모든 아이에게 적용돼요.
statement_en: WHO growth charts are the most appropriate tool for assessing growth patterns, are free to access, and apply to all children around the world.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 20
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아청소년기 전체에 통하는 단일한 비만 진단 BMI 기준값은 없고, 성별과 연령에 따라 달라져요.
statement_en: There is no single BMI cut-off for the diagnosis of obesity across childhood and adolescence, since it varies according to sex and age.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 3 Early Risk Factors and Interpretation of Growth Charts › slide 20
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만은 섭취와 소비의 단순한 에너지 불균형이 아니라 복합 질환이어서, 식사 치료를 하려면 과식으로 이끄는 기전부터 이해해야 해요.
statement_en: Obesity is a complex disease rather than a mere energy imbalance between intake and expenditure, so dietary treatment requires understanding the mechanisms that lead to overeating.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 식사 접근의 목표는 에너지 섭취를 낮추는 지속 가능한 식습관이고, 아이 혼자서는 이룰 수 없으니 가족이 꾸준하고 분명하게 함께해야 해요.
statement_en: The goal of the dietary approach is lasting dietary habits that lower energy intake, and the family must take part because a child cannot reach that goal without lasting, clear support.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 가족끼리 1인분 크기를 비교해 보면 아이가 어른보다 적게 먹는 게 당연하다는 걸 이해하게 돼요.
statement_en: Comparing serving sizes among family members helps a child understand that eating less than an adult is normal.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 만 10세 무렵까지는 실제 상황에 빗댄 비교로 설명하고, 그 이후에야 조금 더 이론적인 정보를 줄 수 있어요.
statement_en: In children up to about 10 years of age, explanations should use comparisons based on practical situations, and only later can more theoretical information be given.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 대표적인 2주 동안 집에서 작성하는 간단한 설문으로 지금의 가족 식습관을 파악해요.
statement_en: A simple questionnaire completed at home over two representative weeks describes current family eating habits.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 소아청소년에게는 포만감 저하가 흔해서, 먹는 양에 한계가 거의 없거나 정상 식사 직후에도 다시 먹고 싶어 해요.
statement_en: Low satiety is common in children and adolescents with obesity, who show little or no limit to the amount eaten or ask to eat again soon after a normal meal.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 아이가 원하는 만큼 먹게 하는 시험 식사로 포만감 저하 정도를 객관적으로 확인할 수 있어요.
statement_en: A test meal in which the child may eat as much as he or she likes can objectify the low satiety level.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 갈증에는 물만 주어 아이가 갈증과 배고픔을 구분하도록 가르치고, 연령에 맞는 양과 질의 우유를 빼면 열량이 있거나 단 음료는 금지해요.
statement_en: Children should be taught to distinguish thirst from hunger by being given only water for thirst, and calorific or sweet beverages should be banned except milk in an amount and quality suited to the child's age.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 부피가 크고 섬유질이 있는 음식은 먹는 속도를 늦추지만, 과일과 채소의 천연 섬유질은 수프나 콤포트, 주스로 갈아버리지 않아야 효과가 있어요.
statement_en: The rate of ingestion is slowed with bulky, fibre-containing food, but natural fibre in fruit and vegetables works only if they are not reduced to soups, compote or juices.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 쓴맛에 민감하면 주로 채소가 아주 옅은 농도에서도 불쾌하게 쓰게 느껴지니, 그 민감성을 존중해 시금치처럼 피하는 채소는 껍질콩처럼 잘 먹는 채소로 바꿔줘요.
statement_en: High sensitivity to bitterness makes mostly vegetables taste unpleasantly bitter even at small concentrations, so the sensitivity should be respected and avoided vegetables such as spinach replaced with well-tolerated ones such as green beans.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 단맛 민감도가 낮은 것은 유전적 특성이라 기분 좋은 단맛을 느끼려면 설탕이 더 많이 필요해서 섭취량이 커져요.
statement_en: Low sensitivity to sugar is a genetic feature meaning more sugar must be present for a pleasant sweet taste, so high amounts are consumed.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 열량이 없는 단 음료도 단 음식에 대한 식욕을 유지시키므로 아이에게는 금지하고 이후에도 피해야 해요.
statement_en: Calorie-free sweet beverages maintain the appetite for sweet foods and should be banned in children and avoided later on.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 지방의 에너지 함량은 당의 약 두 배이고, 지방 맛에 둔감하면 많은 양을 먹으면서도 알아차리지 못해요.
statement_en: The energy content of fat is about twice as high as that of sugar, and low sensitivity to the taste of fat allows high amounts to be eaten without detecting it.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 새로운 음식을 맛보기 거부하는 식품 신기피증은 생리적인 현상으로 두 살 무렵 시작해 열 살 무렵 끝나요.
statement_en: Food neophobia, in which children refuse to taste new foods, is physiological and starts around two years of age and ends at around 10.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 음식에는 긴장을 푸는 효과가 있어 어떤 아이는 계속 간식을 찾는데, 증상일 뿐인 식사 행동을 압박하기보다 불안과 그 유형을 먼저 찾아 치료해야 해요.
statement_en: Food has a relaxing effect and some children seek it by snacking continuously, so the anxiety and its type must be identified and treated first rather than pressuring the eating behaviour, which is only a symptom.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 16
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 폐쇄성 수면무호흡은 비만이 있는 아이에게 불안을 일으킬 수 있어요.
statement_en: Obstructive sleep apnoea can generate anxiety in a child with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 16
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 폭식은 청소년기 이전에는 드물게 진단되고, 객관적으로 많은 양을 먹고 죄책감을 느끼는 이 조절 상실은 효과가 없는 다이어트로 치료하면 안 돼요.
statement_en: Binge eating is rarely diagnosed before adolescence, and this loss of control over eating with objectively large amounts eaten and a feeling of guilt should not be treated by dieting, which is inefficient.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 17
refs: Decaluwe, V., Braet, C., Fairburn, C. G. (2003). Binge eating in obese children and adolescents. International Journal of Eating Disorders, 33(1), pp. 78-84.

statement_ko: 폭식이 있는 청소년은 전문 심리사나 정신과 의사에게 의뢰해야 해요.
statement_en: Adolescents with binge eating should be referred to a specialised psychologist or psychiatrist.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 17
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 필요한 수준을 넘어선 에너지 제한은 체중을 빨리 빼지만 식사를 멈추면 더 빨리 되돌아오게 만들어요.
statement_en: Energy restrictions beyond the level required cause rapid weight loss and even quicker regain once the diet stops.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 소아청소년에게 균형이 깨진 식단은 모두 금지해야 해요.
statement_en: Unbalanced diets should all be prohibited in children and adolescents with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 초저열량 식사는 극히 예외적인 경우에만 적응증이 되고 전문 기관에서만 관리해야 해요.
statement_en: Very low calorie diets have exceptional indications and should be managed only in reference units.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만대사수술 뒤의 식사는 유능한 팀이 평생에 걸쳐 엄격히 관리해야 해요.
statement_en: The post-bariatric-surgery diet must be strictly supervised by competent teams as a lifelong process.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 연령·성별·신체활동에 맞는 수준보다 더 낮춘 제한 식사는 이르고 심한 재발로 이어져요.
statement_en: Restrictive diets below the level appropriate for age, sex and physical activity lead to early and severe relapse.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아 비만의 식사 관리에서 어떤 음식도 완전히 금지해서는 안 돼요.
statement_en: No food should be completely prohibited in the dietary management of childhood obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 아이나 청소년에게 정확한 체중 목표를 정해주지 말고, 긍정적인 생활습관 목표를 세운 뒤 정기적으로 따라가야 해요.
statement_en: Precise weight objectives should not be assigned to a child or adolescent; positive lifestyle goals should be set instead, with regular follow-up.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 4 The Nutritional Management of Obesity › slide 19
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 안정대사율은 총에너지소비의 약 70%를 차지하고, 몸의 기능을 유지하는 데 필요한 최소 에너지예요.
statement_en: Resting metabolic rate accounts for approximately 70% of total energy expenditure and is the minimal energy needed to maintain bodily functions.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 음식의 열효과는 총에너지소비의 5~10%를 더 차지하며, 섭취·소화·영양소 저장에 쓰이는 에너지예요.
statement_en: The thermic effect of food accounts for an additional 5-10% of total energy expenditure, covering ingestion, digestion and storage of nutrients.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 신체활동으로 쓰는 에너지는 총에너지소비의 약 25%인데, 구성요소 가운데 가장 바꾸기 쉬운 부분이에요.
statement_en: Physical activity-induced energy expenditure is about 25% of total energy expenditure and is the most modifiable component.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 신체활동은 골격근 수축으로 생기는 모든 활동과 움직임 가운데 에너지 소비를 안정대사율 위로 올리는 것을 말해요.
statement_en: Physical activity is all activity and movement generated by contraction of skeletal muscles that elevates energy expenditure above resting metabolic rate.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 6세 미만 아이는 발달 단계에 맞고 재미있는 활동적 놀이나 신체활동을 하루 180분 채워야 해요.
statement_en: Children younger than six years should accumulate 180 minutes per day of active play or physical activity, fun and appropriate to their developmental stage.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 5~18세 소아청소년은 중등도-고강도 신체활동을 하루 최소 60분 채워야 해요.
statement_en: Children and adolescents aged five to 18 years should accumulate at least 60 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity per day.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 중등도 강도는 놀거나 운동하면서 말하기가 슬슬 힘들어지는 지점으로 판단해요.
statement_en: Moderate intensity is identified as the point when it starts to be difficult to speak while playing or exercising.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 점프·줄넘기·달리기처럼 근육과 뼈를 튼튼하게 하는 고강도 활동은 주 3회 이상 해야 해요.
statement_en: Vigorous-intensity activities, including those that strengthen muscle and bone such as jumping, skipping and running, should be done at least three times per week.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 5세 미만 아이의 화면 시간은 하루 최대 1시간이어야 해요.
statement_en: Screen time for children under five years should be a maximum of one hour per day.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아청소년의 화면 시간은 휴대전화·태블릿·TV·컴퓨터를 합쳐 하루 2시간을 넘지 않아야 해요.
statement_en: Screen time for children and adolescents should not exceed two hours per day, counting cell phones, tablets, TV and computers.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 화면 시간 연구는 아직 초기 단계라, 우선은 신체활동을 늘리는 데 초점을 둬야 해요.
statement_en: As screen-time research is in its infancy, the primary focus should be on increasing physical activity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 신체 비활동은 신체활동의 반대말이 아니라, 그 나이에 권고되는 활동량 기준에 도달했는지로 정의해요.
statement_en: Physical inactivity is not the opposite of physical activity but is defined by whether an individual reaches the threshold amount of physical activity recommended for his or her age.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: Sedentary Behaviour Research Network에 따르면 좌식행동은 에너지 소비가 제한된 행동으로, 1.5 대사당량 미만의 모든 활동을 포함해요.
statement_en: Sedentary behaviours, per the Sedentary Behaviour Research Network, are behaviours with limited energy expenditure, including all activities below 1.5 metabolic equivalents.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 4
refs: Tremblay, M. S. et al. (2011). Systematic review of sedentary behaviour and health indicators in school-aged children and youth. International Journal of Behavioral Nutrition and Physical Activity, 8, 98.

statement_ko: MET은 활동 중 에너지 소비율을 안정 시 소비율로 나눈 값이라, 1 MET은 안정 시의 에너지 소비율이에요.
statement_en: A MET is the ratio of the rate of energy expended during an activity to the rate expended at rest, so 1 MET is the rate of energy expenditure while at rest.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 가속도계로 7일 동안 객관적으로 측정했더니, 비만이 있는 청소년은 평일에도 주말에도 비만이 없는 또래만큼 움직이지 않았어요.
statement_en: Physical activity measured objectively with an accelerometer over a seven-day period showed that adolescents with obesity were not as physically active as those without obesity on weekdays or weekend days.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 6
refs: Page, A. et al. (2005). Physical activity patterns in nonobese and obese children asessed using minute-by-minute accelerometry. International Journal of Obesity, 29(9), pp. 1070-1076.

statement_ko: 아이가 신체활동에 쓰는 시간에 영향을 주는 요인은 체력 수준, 움직이는 걸 즐기는지와 함께 놀 사람이 있는지, 그리고 활동할 때 자신감을 느끼는지예요.
statement_en: Factors which might influence the time a child spends in physical activity are how physically fit the child is, whether the child enjoys being active or has someone to play with, and whether he or she feels confident being active.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있고 체력이 낮은 아이는 또래보다 얼굴이 빨리 붉어지고 숨이 더 차며, 느리다는 게 창피해서 활동을 피하게 될 수 있어요.
statement_en: A child with obesity and low fitness may get red in the face sooner and feel more out of breath than peers, and embarrassment at being slower can lead to avoidance of activity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 체력은 통증이나 지나친 피로 없이 일상 활동과 기능을 해내는 능력으로, 심폐체력과 근골격체력으로 나뉘어요.
statement_en: Physical fitness is the ability of an individual to complete daily activities and functions without experiencing pain or excessive fatigue, and it divides into cardiorespiratory fitness and musculoskeletal fitness.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 8
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아청소년에서 최대산소섭취량 도달 기준은 주관적 탈진, 분당 195회를 넘는 심박수, 1.02를 넘는 호흡교환율, 또는 산소섭취량의 고원 현상이에요.
statement_en: In children and adolescents the criteria for achieving VO2max are subjective exhaustion, a heart rate above 195 beats per minute and/or a respiratory exchange ratio above 1.02 and/or a plateau of VO2.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 9
refs: Thivel, D., Aucouturier, J. (2015). Cardiorespiratory Fitness Evaluation In Obese Youth. In M.L. Frelut (Ed.), The ECOG's eBook on Child and Adolescent Obesity.

statement_ko: 체중으로 보정하면 비만이 있는 아이의 심폐 수행능력이 낮아 보이지만 제지방량으로 보정하면 그 차이가 사라지므로, 운동 검사를 비교할 때는 체성분을 꼭 고려해야 해요.
statement_en: Corrected for body mass children with obesity appear to have lower cardiorespiratory performance, but adjusted for fat-free mass these differences disappear, so body composition must be considered when comparing exercise tests.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 9
refs: Thivel, D., Aucouturier, J. (2015). Cardiorespiratory Fitness Evaluation In Obese Youth. In M.L. Frelut (Ed.), The ECOG's eBook on Child and Adolescent Obesity.

statement_ko: 소아 심폐체력의 현장 검사로는 20 m 왕복오래달리기, 6분 걷기 검사, 스파르타쿠스 검사가 있어요.
statement_en: Field tests of cardiorespiratory fitness in children include the 20 metre shuttle run, the six-minute walk test and the Spartacus test.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 10
refs: Thivel, D. et al. (2017). Reproducibility of the intermittent Spartacus run test in adolescents with obesity. Journal of Sports Medicine and Physical Fitness, 57(9), pp. 1083-1088.

statement_ko: 무릎 각도 60도에서 등척성 다이나모미터로 잰 무릎 신전근 최대 수의 수축 토크는 절대값으로는 비만 청소년이 유의하게 높았지만, 체중 단위로 환산하면 오히려 유의하게 낮았어요.
statement_en: Knee-extensor maximum voluntary contraction torque measured with an isometric dynamometer at a knee angle of 60 degrees was significantly higher in absolute terms in adolescents with obesity, but expressed per unit of body mass the findings were significantly lower in those with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 11
