refs: Abdelmoula, A. et al. (2012). Knee extension strength in obese and nonobese male adolescents. Applied Physiology, Nutrition, and Metabolism, NRC Research Press (Canadian Science Publishing), 37(2), pp.269-275.

statement_ko: 709명의 아이가 체력 검사를 받은 2006년 연구에서 정상체중 아이는 제자리멀리뛰기와 윗몸일으키기 성적이 비만 아이보다 좋았고, 비만 아이는 민첩성도 떨어졌어요.
statement_en: In a 2006 study in which 709 children completed fitness testing, normal-weight children had higher performance on the standing broad jump and on sit up testing than those with obesity, and agility performance was also impaired in those with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 12
refs: Tokmakidis, S. P., Kasambalis, A., Christodoulos, A. D. (2006). Fitness levels of Greek primary schoolchildren in relationship to overweight and obesity. European Journal of Pediatrics, 165(12), pp. 867-874.

statement_ko: 7~11세 아이 2,000명 이상에서 비만이 있는 아이는 지구력 달리기·속도·민첩성·균형 검사 성적이 유의하게 낮았지만 악력·던지기·유연성에서는 차이가 없었어요.
statement_en: In over 2,000 children aged 7-11 years, children with obesity had significantly lower physical fitness for endurance running, speed and agility and balance tests, with no differences for handgrip, throwing and flexibility.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 7세 아이들에서 지구력 시간은 비만군 147.4 ± 15.0초, 정상체중군 116.0 ± 21.2초로 p < 0.05 수준의 유의한 차이였어요.
statement_en: Among 7-year-olds, endurance time was 147.4 +/- 15.0 seconds in the obesity group versus 116.0 +/- 21.2 seconds in the normal weight group, a significant difference at p < 0.05.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 12
refs: Ceschia, A. et al. (2015). Deleterious effects of obesity on physical fitness in pre-pubertal children. European Journal of Sport Science, 16(2), pp. 271-278.

statement_ko: 7세 아이들의 악력은 비만군 118.0 ± 22.0 N, 정상체중군 110.1 ± 21.3 N으로 체중 범주 간 유의한 차이가 없었어요.
statement_en: Handgrip strength did not differ significantly between weight categories in 7-year-olds, at 118.0 +/- 22.0 N in the obesity group and 110.1 +/- 21.3 N in the normal weight group.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 12
refs: Ceschia, A. et al. (2015). Deleterious effects of obesity on physical fitness in pre-pubertal children. European Journal of Sport Science, 16(2), pp. 271-278.

statement_ko: 신체활동은 체력을 좌우하는 가장 바꾸기 쉬운 결정요인이고, 하루 180분의 즐거운 활동을 채우지 못한 5세 아이는 체력 발달이 나빠질 가능성이 커요.
statement_en: Physical activity is the key modifiable determinant of physical fitness, and a five-year-old not reaching the recommended 180 minutes of fun activity per day is more likely to have adversely affected fitness development.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 13
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 운동이나 활동적 놀이 처방의 첫 목표는 나이에 맞고 동반질환을 악화시키거나 관절을 다치게 하지 않으며 즐겁게 느껴지는 것이어야 하고, 그다음에야 시간과 강도를 올려요.
statement_en: The first goals of an exercise or active-play prescription must be age-appropriate, free of adverse effects such as exacerbating comorbidities or causing joint injury, and perceived as enjoyable, and only then should time and intensity increase.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 구조화된 운동 훈련은 구체적·측정 가능·달성 가능·관련성 있고 기한이 있는 SMART 목표 설정을 쓰고, 가족과 함께 현재 체력과 가정·학교·사회 맥락을 고려해 정해요.
statement_en: Structured exercise training uses a SMART goal-setting approach - specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-based - set with the family and accounting for current fitness and the home, school and social context.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 기본 움직임 기술은 특정 종목에 매이지 않는 일상·놀이·스포츠의 기초 운동 기술로, 이동·물체 조작·자세 조절로 나뉘어요.
statement_en: Fundamental movement skills are non-sport-specific basic motor skills for daily life, play or sport, categorised into locomotion, object manipulation and postural control.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 17
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 발표된 운동 프로그램 17건을 분석했더니, 달리기 과제나 장애물 코스 중심의 전통적 프로그램은 과체중·비만 아이의 균형이나 차기·받기 같은 물체 조작에는 효과가 없었어요.
statement_en: An analysis of 17 published exercise programmes found traditional programmes of running tasks and/or obstacle courses were not effective for balance or object manipulation such as kicking or catching in children with overweight or obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 17
refs: Han, A. et al. (2018). Effectiveness of exercise intervention on improving fundamental movement skills and motor coordination in overweight/obese children and adolescents: A systematic review. Journal of Science and Medicine in Sport, 21, pp. 89-102.

statement_ko: 운동 과제는 구체적이고 구조화된 방식으로 처방해야 하고, 그냥 던지기가 아니라 바구니에 공 넣기처럼 목표 지향적이어야 하며 반복해서 적용해야 해요.
statement_en: Motor tasks must be prescribed specifically and in a structured way, goal-oriented such as throwing a ball into a basket rather than just throwing, and applied repetitively.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 17
refs: Han, A. et al. (2018). Effectiveness of exercise intervention on improving fundamental movement skills and motor coordination in overweight/obese children and adolescents: A systematic review. Journal of Science and Medicine in Sport, 21, pp. 89-102.

statement_ko: 과체중·비만이 있는 11~13세 남아를 대상으로 한 12주 프로그램은 체육 수업 2회에 축구나 고강도 인터벌 훈련 3회를 주당 더해 구성했고, 한 회기는 60분이었어요.
statement_en: In 11 to 13-year-old boys with overweight or obesity, each 12-week programme consisted of two physical education classes plus three additional sessions of soccer or high-intensity interval training per week, with each session lasting 60 minutes.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 18
refs: Cvetkovic, N. et al. (2018). Exercise training in overweight and obese children: Recreational football and high-intensity interval trainind provide similar benefits to physical fitness. Scandinavian Journal of Medicine and Science in Sports, 28(1), pp. 18-32.

statement_ko: 축구와 고강도 인터벌 훈련은 둘 다 민첩성과 지구력을 유의하게 좋아지게 했지만 다리 근력에는 영향을 주지 않았어요.
statement_en: Both soccer and high-intensity interval training significantly improved agility and endurance, while leg strength was not affected.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 18
refs: Cvetkovic, N. et al. (2018). Exercise training in overweight and obese children: Recreational football and high-intensity interval trainind provide similar benefits to physical fitness. Scandinavian Journal of Medicine and Science in Sports, 28(1), pp. 18-32.

statement_ko: 10~48주 동안 대개 주 3회, 평균 60분으로 진행한 운동 중재 연구 12건의 메타분석이 유산소와 저항 운동을 함께 한 경우와 유산소만 한 경우를 비교했어요.
statement_en: A meta-analysis of twelve studies of exercise interventions lasting 10 to 48 weeks, mostly three exercise sessions per week averaging 60 minutes, compared concurrent aerobic plus resistance training with aerobic training alone.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 19
refs: Garcia-Hermoso, A. et al. (2018). Concurrent aerobic plus resistance exercise versus aerobic exercise alone to improve health outcomes in paediatric obesity: a systematic review and meta-analysis. British Journal of Sports Medicine, 52, pp. 161-166.

statement_ko: 건강상의 이득은 24주 이상 이어진 장기 중재에서 가장 잘 나타났고, 체성분·저밀도지단백 혈중 농도·아디포넥틴 농도가 유의하게 좋아졌어요.
statement_en: Health benefits were most likely after longer-term interventions of at least 24 weeks, with significant beneficial improvements in body composition, low-density lipoprotein blood concentration and adiponectin concentration.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 19
refs: Garcia-Hermoso, A. et al. (2018). Concurrent aerobic plus resistance exercise versus aerobic exercise alone to improve health outcomes in paediatric obesity: a systematic review and meta-analysis. British Journal of Sports Medicine, 52, pp. 161-166.

statement_ko: 미취학·학령기 아이에게는 기본 움직임 기술이나 스포츠 게임 같은 목표 지향 과제가 운동 기술 수준을 올려, 신체활동·놀이·스포츠에 참여할 바탕을 만들어줘요.
statement_en: In preschool and school-age children, goal-oriented tasks such as fundamental movement skills or sports games improve motor skill level as a prerequisite of engagement in physical activity, play and sports.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 20
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 청소년에게는 유산소 운동과 저항 운동을 함께 하는 것이 체력과 체성분을 좋아지게 해요.
statement_en: In youth, a combination of aerobic and resistance training improves physical fitness and body composition.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 5 Physical Fitness in Children and Adolescents › slide 20
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만은 여전히 에너지 균형이 서서히 무너진 결과로 정의되고, 여기에는 소비를 넘어서는 섭취, 지방 저장에 대한 유전적 민감성, 심리 요인이 모두 중요하게 작용해요.
statement_en: Obesity is still defined as the result of a gradual failure of one's energy balance, in which energy intake exceeding expenditure, genetic sensitivity for fat storage, and psychological factors are all important.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 과체중이면 식이 제한으로 체중을 조절하려는 시도가 흔히 뒤따르고 아이는 배고픔과 포만의 생리 신호에 기대지 말라고 배우는데, 이 인지적 조절은 대개 너무 엄격하고 무너지기도 쉬워요.
statement_en: Being overweight often induces efforts to control weight through dietary restraint, and children are encouraged to stop relying on physiological cues of hunger and satiety, but this cognitive control is often too strict and extremely vulnerable to disruption.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 식이 제한의 악순환에서는 사회적 압력이 제한을 낳고 아이가 감정이 격하거나 피곤하거나 너무 배고플 때 조절이 무너지는데, 이 실패를 폭식이라 불러요.
statement_en: In the vicious circle of dietary restraint, social pressure leads to restraint, breakdowns occur when the child is emotional, tired or too hungry, and these failures are defined as binges.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 폭식은 괴로움을 낳고 이는 낮은 자존감으로 이어져 더 엄격한 다이어트를 다시 부르기 때문에, 식이 제한은 치료를 방해하는 중요한 심리 요인이에요.
statement_en: Binges cause distress, which promotes low self-esteem and is likely to trigger new, even stricter dieting, so dietary restraint is an important psychological factor that can hinder treatment.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 4
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 식이 제한은 DEBQ, EDE-Q 설문, 또는 면담 형식인 EDE로 측정할 수 있고, 이 도구들로 신경성 폭식증에 전형적인 폭식 후 보상 행동도 확인해요.
statement_en: Dietary restraint can be measured with the DEBQ, the EDE-Q questionnaire or the interview format EDE, which also allow a check for compensatory behaviour after a binge, typical of bulimia nervosa.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 감정 유발 섭식은 배고프지 않은데도 먹는 것으로, 당과 지방이 많아 에너지 밀도가 높은 위안 음식을 특히 찾으며 스트레스 대처 방식으로 보고돼요.
statement_en: Emotion-driven eating is eating in the absence of hunger with specific preference for comfort food, defined as energy-dense food due to high sugar and fat content, reported as a way of coping with stress.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 감정적 섭식 앞에는 신체 불만이나 사회적 고립처럼 부정적 정서를 부르는 사소한 일상 문제가 놓여 있고, 그것이 식사 중 과식이나 간식으로 이어져요.
statement_en: Emotional eating is often preceded by minor daily problems causing negative affect, for example body dissatisfaction or social isolation, which lead to overeating during meals or via snacking.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 가벼운 스트레스 상황에서는 성인과 청소년의 30~43%가 더 먹고, 그 결과 건강하지 않은 음식 선택과 과체중으로 이어져요.
statement_en: Under mild stress, more eating is observed in 30-43% of adults and adolescents, leading to unhealthy food choices and overweight.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 7
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만 클리닉 연구 두 편에서 감정적 섭식의 유병률은 45~47%로 비슷했어요.
statement_en: Two obesity-clinic studies found comparable prevalence rates for emotional eating of 45-47%.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 9
refs: Braet, C., Beyers, W. (2009). Subtyping children and adolescents who are overweight: Different symptomatology and treatment outcomes. Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, 77(5), pp. 814-824.

statement_ko: 식이 제한과 감정적 섭식을 함께 보인 복합군은 두 연구 모두 22%였고, 식이 제한만 단독으로 나타난 사례는 없었어요.
statement_en: A combined group showing both dietary restraint and emotional eating accounted for 22% in both studies, with no independent instances of dietary restraint found.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 9
refs: Braet, C., Beyers, W. (2009). Subtyping children and adolescents who are overweight: Different symptomatology and treatment outcomes. Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, 77(5), pp. 814-824.

statement_ko: 도움을 청하지 않은 과체중 학령기 아이에서도 같은 아형이 나타났지만 비율은 달라, 감정적 섭식 아형은 14%, 복합군은 30%였어요.
statement_en: In schoolchildren with overweight who were not seeking help the same subtypes emerged but rates differed, with an emotional eating subtype of 14% and a combined group of 30%.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 치료에서 심리사는 아이가 먹는 대신 다른 방식으로 감정을 다루도록 가르치고 정서 문제와 그 해결에 더 주의를 기울이게 하며, 다이어트에 매이지 않는 건강한 생활습관을 익히게 해요.
statement_en: In treatment a psychologist teaches the child to cope with emotions in another way instead of eating, with more attention to emotional problems and how to solve them, and how to adopt a healthy lifestyle which is not focused on dieting.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 사례 연구의 스티브는 12세 남아이고 아버지도 과체중이라, 지방을 빨리 저장하는 유전적 소인이 있다고 판단해요.
statement_en: In the case study, Steve is a 12-year-old boy whose father also has overweight, so he is judged genetically predisposed to quick fat storage.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 각 문항이 최대 6점, 최소 0점인 제한 문항 다섯 개에서 스티브의 총점은 21점이고 평균은 4.2점으로, 높은 식이 제한 점수예요.
statement_en: On the five restraint items, each scored a maximum of 6 and a minimum of 0, Steve's total score is 21, giving a mean of 4.2 which is a high restraint score.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: CBCL에서 스티브는 정서 문제 점수는 낮지만 외현화 행동 문제 점수는 높았어요.
statement_en: On the CBCL, Steve's scores are low for emotional problems but high for externalising behaviour problems.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 심리 요인은 찾아낼 수 있지만, 그것이 비만 문제의 원인인지 결과인지 가려내기는 어려운 경우가 많아요.
statement_en: Psychological factors can be identified, but it is often impossible to determine whether they are causes or consequences of the obesity problem.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 11
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 음식을 쓰지 않는 감정 조절 방법으로는 마음을 가라앉히거나 감정을 말하는 행동에 대한 점수제·별표판 보상, 가족 활동이나 부모와 단둘이 보내는 시간이라는 보상, 간단한 호흡 연습, 그림이나 놀이 활동, 문제해결 접근이 있어요.
statement_en: Non-food strategies for emotion regulation include point-based or star chart reward systems for behaviours such as calming down or talking about feelings, family activities or time alone with a parent as rewards, simple breathing exercises, drawing or play exercises, and a problem-solving approach.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 12
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 연구는 비만에서의 행동과 충동적 행동으로 특징지어지는 ADHD 사이의 유사성을 제시하고 ADHD와 폭식장애의 연결 가능성을 강조했으며, 어떤 경우에는 ADHD가 진단되지 않은 채 남아 있을 수 있어요.
statement_en: Research proposes parallels between behaviour in obesity and ADHD, characterised as impulsive behaviour, and a potential link between ADHD and binge eating disorder has been highlighted, with ADHD possibly undiagnosed in some cases.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 14
refs: Cortese, S. (2007). Association between symptoms of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder and bulimic behaviors in a clinical sample of severely obese adolescents. International Journal of Obesity (London), 31, pp. 340-346.

statement_ko: 충동적으로 억제가 풀린 섭식을 보이는 아이는 두 가지 문제를 함께 안고 있는데, 기질에서 비롯됐을 강한 보상 민감성과 뇌의 억제 조절이 아직 미숙해 생긴 자기조절 기술 부족이에요.
statement_en: Children showing impulsive disinhibited eating suffer from two problems - a strong sensitivity to reward, probably temperament-based, and a lack of self-regulation skills, probably related to immature controlling brain inhibition processes.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이가 있는 가정에 단일한 심리 유형은 없어서, 심리 경로마다 다른 지침을 적용해야 해요.
statement_en: There is no single psychological type in families with a child with obesity, so different guidelines apply to the different psychological pathways.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 아이에게 부정적 정서와 정서 문제가 있으면 표준 치료만으로는 부족해 심리 치료를 포함한 다학제 팀이 필요하고, 제한 의도가 폭식으로 이어지는 아이에게는 집중 치료가 필요해요.
statement_en: If children have negative affect and emotional problems a standard treatment approach will not do and a multidisciplinary team including psychological treatment is needed, while children who also show restrained intentions leading to binge eating require intensive treatment.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 6 Psychological Assessment of Children and Adolescents › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이 가운데 체중 증가의 바탕에 내분비나 유전 원인이 있는 경우는 5% 미만이에요.
statement_en: Less than 5% of children with obesity have an underlying endocrine or genetic cause for their weight gain.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 2
refs: Kumar, S., Kelly, A. S. (2017). Review of childhood obesity. Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 92(2), pp. 251-265.

statement_ko: 비만은 체지방이 과도한 상태로 정의되는 만성 질환이고, 비만이 있는 아이 대부분은 성장과 신체 발달이 정상이거나 빠른 일차성(단순) 비만이에요.
statement_en: Obesity is a chronic condition defined by an excess amount of body fat, and most children with obesity have primary or simple obesity with normal or rapid growth and physical development.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 진찰 알고리즘에서 6세 이전에 시작하고 정신운동 발달과 골연령이 모두 지연됐다면 프라더-윌리, 바르데-비들, 취약X 같은 유전 증후군을 의심해요.
statement_en: In the examination algorithm, early beginning before six years of age with delayed psychomotor development and delayed bone age should raise suspicion of a genetic syndrome such as Prader-Willi, Bardet-Biedl or Fragile X.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 2
refs: Kaur, Y. (2017). A systematic review of genetic syndromes with obesity. Obesity Reviews, 18, pp. 603-634.

statement_ko: 6세 이전에 시작했지만 정신운동 발달이 정상이라면 렙틴·렙틴 수용체·MC4R처럼 식욕 조절 경로 유전자의 변이를 의심해요.
statement_en: Early beginning before six years of age with normal psychomotor development should raise suspicion of a gene mutation of the appetite regulation pathway such as leptin, the leptin receptor or MC4R.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이는 여러 합병증 위험이 높고, 그 위험은 비만의 정도와 지속 기간에 따라 커져요.
statement_en: Children with obesity are at high risk for multiple complications, and the risk increases with the degree and duration of obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 16~19세에 평가받은 약 230만 명을 대상으로 청소년기 BMI 백분위수에 따른 심혈관 사망률을 44년 동안 추적했어요.
statement_en: Death rates from cardiovascular causes were followed over 44 years by BMI percentile in adolescence among approximately 2,300,000 participants assessed between the ages of 16 and 19 years.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 4
refs: Twig, G. et al. (2016). Body-Mass Index in 2.3 Million Adolescents and Cardiovascular Death in Adulthood. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(25), pp. 2430-2460.

statement_ko: 이 코호트에는 관상동맥질환·뇌졸중·원인 불명 급사로 인한 사망 2,918건이 포함됐고, 연구 40~44년 사이에 심혈관 사망 242건이 더 발생했어요.
statement_en: In that cohort 2,918 deaths from coronary artery disease, stroke and sudden deaths of unknown cause were included, with an additional 242 cardiovascular deaths occurring between 40 and 44 years of the study.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 4
refs: Twig, G. et al. (2016). Body-Mass Index in 2.3 Million Adolescents and Cardiovascular Death in Adulthood. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(25), pp. 2430-2460.

statement_ko: 청소년기 BMI가 높은 군의 심혈관 사망률은 건강 체중군보다 훨씬 높았고, 모형은 성별·검사 시 연령·출생연도·교육·거주지 사회경제수준·출신국·키로 보정했어요.
statement_en: The cardiovascular death rate was much higher in the high adolescent BMI category than in the healthy weight group, with the model adjusted for sex, age at examination, birth year, education, residential socioeconomic status, country of origin and height.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 4
refs: Twig, G. et al. (2016). Body-Mass Index in 2.3 Million Adolescents and Cardiovascular Death in Adulthood. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(25), pp. 2430-2460.

statement_ko: 소아 비만의 심리사회적 합병증에는 사회적 낙인, 낮은 건강 관련 삶의 질, 낮은 자존감, 불안, 우울, ADHD 또는 ADD, 섭식장애가 있어요.
statement_en: Psychosocial complications of childhood obesity include social stigmatisation, low health-related quality of life, poor self-esteem, anxiety, depression, ADHD or ADD, and eating disorders.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아 비만의 호흡기 합병증에는 천식, 저환기, 폐쇄성 수면무호흡, 운동 불내성이 있어요.
statement_en: Respiratory complications of childhood obesity include asthma, hypoventilation, obstructive sleep apnoea and exercise intolerance.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아 비만의 대사·심혈관 합병증에는 만성 염증, 인슐린 저항성, 이상지질혈증, 죽상경화, 고혈압, 뇌졸중, 심장 재형성과 기능이상, 고요산혈증이 있어요.
statement_en: Metabolic and cardiovascular complications of childhood obesity include chronic inflammation, insulin resistance, dyslipidaemia, atherosclerosis, hypertension, stroke, cardiac remodelling and dysfunction, and hyperuricaemia.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 모듈이 제시한 소아 비만의 콩팥 합병증은 사구체경화증이에요.
statement_en: The renal complication of childhood obesity listed in the module is glomerulosclerosis.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아 비만의 내분비 합병증에는 2형당뇨병, 조기 또는 지연 사춘기, 월경 불규칙, 선형 성장 가속, 다낭성난소증후군, 성선기능저하증이나 여성형유방, 가성 여성형유방이 있어요.
statement_en: Endocrine complications of childhood obesity include type 2 diabetes, early onset or delayed puberty, menstrual irregularities, accelerated linear growth, polycystic ovary syndrome, hypogonadism or gynaecomastia, and pseudogynaecomastia.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 5
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 소아청소년은 고혈압, 인슐린 저항성과 그에 뒤따르는 2형당뇨병, 이상지질혈증, 비알코올 지방간질환 같은 심장대사 위험인자 유병률이 높고, 비만은 대사증후군의 조기 발병으로 이어질 수 있어요.
statement_en: Children and adolescents with obesity have a high prevalence of cardiometabolic risk factors including hypertension, insulin resistance and subsequently type 2 diabetes, dyslipidaemia and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and obesity can result in early onset of metabolic syndrome.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 6
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 혈관내피 기능이상은 심혈관 위험 증가의 이른 신호이고, 비만이 있는 아이에게 비만 정도와 인슐린 저항성 정도에 비례해 나타나요.
statement_en: Endothelial dysfunction is an early sign of increased cardiovascular risk and occurs in children with obesity relative to the level of obesity and degree of insulin resistance.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 7
refs: Bruyndonckx, L. et al. (2016). Childhood obesity-related endothelial dysfunction: an update on pathophysiological mechanisms and diagnostic advancements. Pediatric Research, 79(6), pp. 831-837.

statement_ko: 갱신된 정의에서 1세부터 13세 미만 아이의 정상 혈압은 90백분위수 미만이에요.
statement_en: In the updated definitions, normal blood pressure in children aged 1 to under 13 years is below the 90th percentile.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 8
refs: Flynn, J. T. et al. (2017). SUBCOMMITTEE ON SCREENING AND MANAGEMENT OF HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE IN CHILDREN: Clinical Practice guidline for screening and management of high blood pressure in children and adolescents. Pediatrics, 140(3), pp. 1-73.

statement_ko: 갱신된 정의에서 13세 이상 아이의 정상 혈압은 120/80 mmHg 미만이에요.
statement_en: In the updated definitions, normal blood pressure in children aged 13 years and over is below 120/80 mm Hg.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 8
refs: Flynn, J. T. et al. (2017). SUBCOMMITTEE ON SCREENING AND MANAGEMENT OF HIGH BLOOD PRESSURE IN CHILDREN: Clinical Practice guidline for screening and management of high blood pressure in children and adolescents. Pediatrics, 140(3), pp. 1-73.

statement_ko: 혈압은 매 방문마다 크기가 맞는 커프로 재야 하고, 값은 성별·연령·키 백분위수에 따라 평가해요.
statement_en: Blood pressure should be measured with an appropriately sized cuff at every visit, and values evaluated according to sex, age and height centiles.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이에게 인슐린 저항성과 연결된 전형적 임상 소견은 흑색가시세포증, 다낭성난소증후군, 비알코올 지방간질환, 그리고 중성지방 증가·HDL 콜레스테롤 감소·작고 조밀한 LDL 콜레스테롤 입자 같은 지질 이상이에요.
statement_en: Typical clinical features linked to insulin resistance in children with obesity are acanthosis nigricans, polycystic ovary syndrome, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and lipid abnormalities including increased triglycerides, decreased HDL-cholesterol and small, dense LDL-cholesterol particles.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 11
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: ISPAD 지침에 따르면 위험인자가 있는 아이는 사춘기가 시작된 뒤나 만 10세 이후 가운데 먼저 오는 시점부터 당뇨병 선별검사를 고려해야 해요.
statement_en: Per the ISPAD guidelines, testing to identify children with diabetes should be considered after the onset of puberty or after 10 years of age, whichever occurs earlier, in children with risk factors.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 12
refs: Zeitler, P. et al. (2018). ISPAD Clinical Practice Consensus Guidelines 2018: Type 2diabetes mellitus in youth. Pediatric Diabetes, 19(27), pp. 28-46.

statement_ko: 아이에게 당뇨병 검사를 시작하게 하는 위험인자는 비만, 자궁내성장지연, 직계 가족의 2형당뇨병력, 임신 중 어머니의 당뇨병이나 임신당뇨병, 고위험 인종, 다낭성난소증후군이에요.
statement_en: The risk factors triggering diabetes testing in children are obesity, intrauterine growth retardation, a first-degree family history of type 2 diabetes, a maternal history of diabetes or gestational diabetes during the child's gestation, high-risk ethnicity, and polycystic ovary syndrome.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 12
refs: Zeitler, P. et al. (2018). ISPAD Clinical Practice Consensus Guidelines 2018: Type 2diabetes mellitus in youth. Pediatric Diabetes, 19(27), pp. 28-46.

statement_ko: 비만의 전형적 이상지질혈증은 LDL 콜레스테롤 입자 수 증가, 고중성지방혈증, HDL 콜레스테롤 감소로, 비만·인슐린 저항성·2형당뇨병 이상지질혈증의 특징이에요.
statement_en: The typical obesity dyslipidaemia profile is an elevated number of LDL-cholesterol particles, hypertriglyceridaemia and decreased HDL-cholesterol, the hallmarks of the dyslipidaemia of obesity, insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 14
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비알코올 지방간질환은 이제 비만이 있는 아이에게 만성 간질환을 일으키는 가장 흔한 원인이에요.
statement_en: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease is now the most frequent cause of chronic liver disease in children with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 15
refs: Nobili, V. (2015). Non Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease In Children. In M.L. Frelut (Ed.), The ECOG's eBook on Child and Adolescent Obesity.

statement_ko: 체중 감량은 비알코올 지방간질환을 좋아지게 하고, 특히 인슐린 저항성이 있는 비만 청소년에게 효과가 커요.
statement_en: Weight loss improves non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, especially in adolescents with obesity who have insulin resistance.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 15
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만 청소년에게 대사증후군이 있으면 비알코올 지방간질환과 2형당뇨병을 예측할 수 있고, 2형당뇨병은 지방간질환이 섬유화로 진행하는 것을 독립적으로 예측해요.
statement_en: The presence of metabolic syndrome in adolescents with obesity predicts non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and type 2 diabetes, and type 2 diabetes independently predicts progression of fatty liver disease to fibrosis.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 16
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 대사증후군은 비만이 있는 아이에게서도 이미 확인되지만, 성장과 사춘기가 참고값에 영향을 주어 연령별 기준값이 여러 개 필요하기 때문에 소아 정의에 대한 합의는 아직 없어요.
statement_en: Metabolic syndrome is already detectable in children with obesity, but there is no general consensus on the paediatric definition because the effects of growth and puberty on reference values require diverse age-dependent cut-off points.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 17
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아기 내내 진단이 크게 흔들린다는 점은 대사증후군 분류가 소아 연령의 위험 확인에 그다지 쓸모 있지 않을 수 있음을 시사하므로, 예방과 치료는 진단 자체보다 확립된 위험인자에 집중해야 해요.
statement_en: High diagnostic inconsistency through childhood suggests metabolic syndrome classification may not be a valuable method for risk identification in the paediatric age group, so prevention and treatment should focus more on established risk factors than on the diagnosis itself.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 17
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아 대사증후군의 IDF 정의에서 과잉 지방은 허리둘레 90백분위수 이상이에요.
statement_en: In the IDF definition of paediatric metabolic syndrome, excess adiposity is a waist circumference at or above the 90th percentile.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 17
refs: Zimmet, P. et al. (2007). International Diabetes Federation Task Force on Epidemiology and Prevention of Diabetes: The metabolic syndrome in children and adolescents. Lancet, 369(9579), pp. 2059-2061.

statement_ko: 비만은 성장과 성 발달에 영향을 줄 수 있고, 남아에게는 사춘기를 늦추고 일부 여아에게는 앞당길 수 있어요.
statement_en: Obesity can affect growth and sexual development, and may delay puberty in boys and advance puberty in some girls.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 청소년 여아는 고안드로겐증과 다낭성난소증후군 위험이 더 높아요.
statement_en: Adolescent girls with obesity have a higher risk of hyperandrogenism and polycystic ovary syndrome.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 폐쇄성 수면무호흡 발생률은 비만이 있는 소아청소년에서 비만이 없는 경우보다 4~6배 높아요.
statement_en: The incidence of obstructive sleep apnoea is four to six times higher in children and adolescents with obesity than in those without.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 19
refs: Ehsan, Z., Ishman, S. L. (2016). Pediatric Obstructive Sleep Apnea. Otolaryngologic Clinics of North America, 49(6), pp. 1449-1464.

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이의 수면호흡장애는 인슐린 저항성과 심장대사 위험에 연관돼 있고, 비만은 천식 위험도 높여요.
statement_en: Sleep-disordered breathing in children with obesity has been associated with insulin resistance and cardiometabolic risk, and obesity also increases the risk of asthma.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 19
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 발견되지 않고 치료되지 않은 폐쇄성 수면무호흡은 거의 모든 주요 장기계에 영향을 주어 주간 피로, 성장 지연, 심혈관 기능이상, 고혈압, 행동장애, 인지 저하를 일으킬 수 있어요.
statement_en: Unrecognised and untreated obstructive sleep apnoea may affect nearly every major system, causing daytime fatigue, growth delay, cardiovascular dysfunction, hypertension, behaviour disorders and cognitive impairment.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 21
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만이 있는 아이에게 더 흔한 정형외과 질환은 페르테스병(무혈성 괴사), 대퇴골두 골단 분리증, 블런트병, 다리 축의 정렬 이상, 편평족이에요.
statement_en: Orthopaedic conditions that present more commonly in children with obesity are Perthes' disease or avascular necrosis, slipped capital femoral epiphysis, Blount's disease, misalignment of the leg's axis, and flat foot.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 22
refs: Weghuber, D., O'Malley, G. (2015). Orthopaedic Complications. In M.L. Frelut (Ed.), The ECOG's eBook on Child and Adolescent Obesity.

statement_ko: 블런트병은 근위 경골 성장판에 생기는 발달 장애로 새 뼈를 만드는 속도가 느려지거나 멈추게 하고, 60%에서는 양쪽 다리를 함께 침범해요.
statement_en: Blount's disease is a developmental disorder affecting the growth plate of the proximal tibial physis, causing it to slow or stop making new bone, and in 60% of cases it affects both legs.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 24
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아 비만의 심리사회적 합병증은 흔해서 낮은 자존감, 불안, 우울, 삶의 질 저하가 포함되고, 병력이 있는 아이는 정신건강 전문가에게 의뢰해야 해요.
statement_en: Psychosocial complications of childhood obesity are common and include poor self-esteem, anxiety, depression and decreased quality of life, and children with a positive history should be referred to a mental health specialist.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 7 Complications of Childhood Obesity › slide 27
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아청소년의 영양 이중부담은 영양결핍과 영양과잉이 개인·가구·인구 수준에서 함께 나타나는 것을 말해요.
statement_en: The double burden of malnutrition among children and adolescents refers to the coexistence of under- and overnutrition that can happen at the individual, household or population level.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 영양결핍은 다량영양소나 미량영양소의 섭취 부족으로, 영양과잉은 다량영양소의 과잉 섭취로 특징지어져요.
statement_en: Undernutrition can be characterised by deficient intake of macronutrients or micronutrients, while overnutrition is characterised by an excess intake of macronutrients.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 2
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 인구 기반 평가에서는 인체계측 자료의 분석과 제시에 Z-점수를 널리 쓰고, 영양 상태는 성장곡선·표·WHO 소프트웨어나 통계 프로그램으로 계산할 수 있어요.
statement_en: For population-based assessment the Z-score is widely used for analysis and presentation of anthropometric data, and nutritional status can be calculated using growth charts, tables, WHO software or statistical-software programs.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 발육부진은 체중과 키 지표에 근거하고, 출생부터 5세까지는 연령별 신장이 -2SD~-3SD 미만, 5~19세는 연령별 키가 -2SD~-3SD 미만일 때예요.
statement_en: Stunting is based on weight and height indices, with a length or height-for-age below -2SD to -3SD from birth to 5 years and height-for-age below -2SD to -3SD from 5 to 19 years.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소모는 체중과 키 지표에 근거해 출생부터 5세까지 신장별 체중이 -2SD~-3SD 미만인 상태이고, 이환율과 사망률을 높여요.
statement_en: Wasting is based on weight and height indices, with a weight-for-height below -2SD to -3SD from birth to 5 years, and it increases morbidity and mortality.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 마름은 BMI에 근거해 5~19세에서 연령별 BMI가 -2~-3 SD 미만인 상태이고, 성숙 지연과 근력 저하, 이후 삶의 골밀도 감소로 이어져요.
statement_en: Thinness is based on BMI, with a BMI-for-age below -2 to -3 SD from 5 to 19 years, and leads to delayed maturation, poor muscle strength and reduced bone density later in life.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 과체중은 BMI에 근거해 출생부터 5세까지는 연령별 BMI나 신장별 체중이 2SD 초과, 5~19세는 연령별 BMI가 1SD 초과이며, 19세의 BMI 25 kg/m2에 해당해요.
statement_en: Overweight is based on BMI, with BMI-for-age or weight-for-height above 2SD from birth to 5 years and BMI-for-age above 1SD from 5 to 19 years, equivalent to a BMI of 25 kg/m2 at 19 years.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만은 BMI에 근거해 출생부터 5세까지는 연령별 BMI나 신장별 체중이 3SD 초과, 5~19세는 연령별 BMI가 2SD 초과이며, 19세의 BMI 30 kg/m2에 해당해요.
statement_en: Obesity is based on BMI, with BMI-for-age or weight-for-height above 3SD from birth to 5 years and BMI-for-age above 2SD from 5 to 19 years, equivalent to a BMI of 30 kg/m2 at 19 years.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 소아 비만의 건강 결과로 제시된 것은 인슐린 저항성, 공복혈당장애나 내당능장애, 2형당뇨병, 성조숙증, 고혈압, 이상지질혈증, 비알코올 지방간질환, 나쁜 심리 건강, 근골격 문제예요.
statement_en: The health consequences listed for obesity in childhood are insulin resistance, impaired fasting glucose or glucose tolerance, type 2 diabetes, precocious puberty, hypertension, dyslipidaemia, non-alcoholic fatty liver disorder, poor psychological health and musculoskeletal problems.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 청소년기에 발육부진과 비만이 함께 있으면 소아기와 이후 성인기의 건강 문제가 겹쳐 커질 가능성이 높아요.
statement_en: The consequences of concurrent stunting and obesity in adolescents are likely to compound health issues in children and later in adulthood.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 3
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 저소득·중소득 국가의 16%, 곧 57개국 가운데 9개국은 영양결핍과 영양과잉 유병률이 모두 평균을 웃돌아요.
statement_en: 16%, or nine out of 57, of low-income and middle-income countries have above average undernutrition and overnutrition prevalence.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 5
refs: Caleyachetty, R. et al. (2018). The double burden of malnutrition among adolescents: analysis of data from the Global School-Based Student Health and Health Behavior in School-Aged Children surveys in 57 low- and middle-income countries. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 108(2), pp. 414-424.

statement_ko: 마름 유병률은 동남아시아 지역에서 가장 높고, 과체중이나 비만 유병률은 서태평양 지역에서 가장 높아요.
statement_en: Thinness prevalence is highest in the South-East Asia region, and overweight or obesity prevalence is highest in the Western Pacific region.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 5
refs: Caleyachetty, R. et al. (2018). The double burden of malnutrition among adolescents: analysis of data from the Global School-Based Student Health and Health Behavior in School-Aged Children surveys in 57 low- and middle-income countries. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 108(2), pp. 414-424.

statement_ko: 5세 미만 아동에서 아프리카는 발육부진 30.0%, 소모 8.0%, 과체중 4.9%를 보여요.
statement_en: Among children under five, Africa shows 30.0% stunted, 8.0% wasted and 4.9% overweight.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 5
refs: UNICEF / WHO / World Bank Group Joint Child Malnutrition Estimates 2019 edition

statement_ko: 5세 미만 아동에서 아시아는 발육부진 22.7%, 소모 9.4%, 과체중 5.2%를 보여요.
statement_en: Among children under five, Asia shows 22.7% stunted, 9.4% wasted and 5.2% overweight.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 5
refs: UNICEF / WHO / World Bank Group Joint Child Malnutrition Estimates 2019 edition

statement_ko: 5세 미만 아동에서 오세아니아는 발육부진 38.2%, 소모 9.4%, 과체중 9.1%를 보여요.
statement_en: Among children under five, Oceania shows 38.2% stunted, 9.4% wasted and 9.1% overweight.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 5
refs: UNICEF / WHO / World Bank Group Joint Child Malnutrition Estimates 2019 edition

statement_ko: 저소득·중소득 국가 청소년에서 과체중이나 비만 유병률은 서태평양 33.7%(21.0~47.7), 아메리카 27.6%(24.5~30.9)였어요.
statement_en: Among adolescents in low- and middle-income countries, overweight or obesity prevalence was 33.7% (21.0 - 47.7) in the Western Pacific and 27.6% (24.5 - 30.9) in the Americas.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 7
refs: Caleyachetty, R. et al. (2018). The double burden of malnutrition among adolescents: analysis of data from the Global School-Based Student Health and Health Behavior in School-Aged Children surveys in 57 low- and middle-income countries. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 108(2), pp. 414-424.

statement_ko: 같은 청소년 자료에서 동남아시아의 발육부진은 19.8%(13.9~26.5), 마름은 15.0%(9.5~21.4)로 여섯 지역 가운데 가장 높았어요.
statement_en: Among the same adolescents, stunting was 19.8% (13.9 - 26.5) and thinness 15.0% (9.5 - 21.4) in South-East Asia, the highest of the six regions.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 7
refs: Caleyachetty, R. et al. (2018). The double burden of malnutrition among adolescents: analysis of data from the Global School-Based Student Health and Health Behavior in School-Aged Children surveys in 57 low- and middle-income countries. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 108(2), pp. 414-424.

statement_ko: 비만은 지방량이 늘어난 상태로 정의되고 그 안에 지용성 비타민 같은 영양소가 저장될 수 있으며 가벼운 만성 염증도 함께 있어서, 실제 상태를 평가하려면 대리 지표를 써야 해요.
statement_en: Obesity is defined by an increased fat mass in which nutrients such as fat-soluble vitamins may be stored, with a mild chronic inflammation also present, so proxies must be used to evaluate actual status.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 9
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 철 결핍은 비만이 있는 아이에게 가장 흔한 무기질 결핍이에요.
statement_en: Iron deficiency is the most common mineral deficiency in children with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 10
refs: Hutchinson, C. (2016). A review of iron studies in overweight and obese children and adolescents: a double burden in the young? European Journal of Nutrition, 55(7), pp. 2179-2197.

statement_ko: 소아 비만과 연관해 보고되는 결핍은 비타민 A·E·D이고 비타민 K는 아니며, 비타민 D 상태는 섭취와 햇빛 노출에 달려 있고 나머지 비타민은 식이 섭취에 달려 있어요.
statement_en: Vitamin A, E and D deficiencies, but not vitamin K, are reported in association with childhood obesity, and vitamin D status is linked to intake and sun exposure while all other vitamin statuses depend on dietary intake.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 10
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 비만에서는 가벼운 염증이 순환 헵시딘과 페리틴 합성을 늘려 철 상태 해석이 애매해지므로, 페리틴 하나가 아니라 여러 표지자를 함께 봐야 해요.
statement_en: Interpretation of iron status is equivocal in obesity because mild inflammation increases circulating hepcidin and ferritin synthesis, so a combination of markers rather than ferritin alone should be used.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 12
refs: Frelut, M. L. et al., Committee on Nutrition of the French Society of Paediatrics (2018). Impact of obesity on biomarkers of iron and vitamin D status in children and adolescents: The risk of misinterpretation. Archives de Pediatrie, 25(1), pp. 3-5.

statement_ko: 비타민 D 결핍은 보통 25-하이드록시 비타민 D 농도로 평가하는데, 농도가 낮은 이유는 진짜 결핍일 수도 있고 지방조직에 저장이 늘고 방출이 줄어 생긴 겉보기 결핍일 수도 있어요.
statement_en: Vitamin D deficiency is commonly assessed on 25-hydroxy-vitamin D concentrations, and low concentrations may arise from genuine deficiency or from apparent deficiency caused by increased storage into and reduced release from adipose tissue.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 13
refs: Pereira-Santos, M. et al. (2015). Obesity and vitamin D deficiency: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Obesity Reviews, 16, pp. 341-349.

statement_ko: 여러 연구는 비만이 있는 아이에서 비타민 D 결핍이 인슐린 저항성 표지자와 상관관계를 보인다고 시사해요.
statement_en: Several studies suggest vitamin D deficiency correlates with markers of insulin resistance in children with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 14
refs: Ekbom, K., Marcus, C. (2016). Vitamin D deficiency is associated with prediabetes in obese Swedish children. Acta Paediatrica, 105(10), pp. 1192-1197.

statement_ko: 생검으로 확인한 연구들에서 비타민 D 결핍은 간섬유화를 동반한 가장 심한 형태의 비알코올 지방간질환에서 더 흔했고 인슐린 저항성 표지자와 독립적으로 상관관계를 보였어요.
statement_en: Biopsy-confirmed studies showed vitamin D deficiency is more common in the most severe form of non-alcoholic fatty liver disease with liver fibrosis and independently correlated to markers of insulin resistance.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 15
refs: Nobili, V. et al. (2014). Vitamin D levels and liver histological alterations in children with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. European Journal of Endocrinology, 170(4), pp. 547-553.

statement_ko: 대조 시험에서 비타민 D 치료가 비만 청소년의 인슐린 저항성 수준을 낮췄어요.
statement_en: Controlled trials showed treatment with vitamin D decreases the insulin resistance level in adolescents with obesity.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 15
refs: Belenchia, A. M. et al. (2013). Correcting vitamin D insufficiency improves insulin sensitivity in obese adolescents: a randomized controlled trial. American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 97(4), pp. 774-781.

statement_ko: 감미료로 쓰이는 과당을 많이 먹는 것은 소아 비알코올 지방간질환에 해로울 가능성이 크고, 비타민 E와 다불포화지방산 조합, 콜린은 대조 시험에서 이로운 역할을 보였어요.
statement_en: High intakes of fructose used as a sweetener are likely deleterious in paediatric non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, while vitamin E, combinations of polyunsaturated fatty acids and choline showed beneficial roles in controlled trials.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 15
refs: Panera, N. et al. (2018). A review of the pathogenic and therapeutic role of nutrition in pediatric nonalcoholic fatty liver disease. Nutrition Research, 58, pp. 1-16.

statement_ko: 엽산은 비타민 B12와 함께 에너지 대사의 핵심 기여자이자 심혈관 위험과 비만의 후성유전적 결정요인이고, 엽산 상태를 평가하려면 적혈구 내 함량을 분석해야 해요.
statement_en: Folate with vitamin B12 is a key contributor to energy metabolism and an epigenetic determinant of cardiovascular risk and obesity, and evaluation of folate status requires analysis of its red blood cell content.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 17
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 만 2세를 넘은 아이는 BMI 기준으로 저체중(마름)·과체중·비만으로 분류하고, 2세 미만 아이는 신장별 체중으로 체중 상태를 평가해요.
statement_en: Children over two years are classified as either underweight (thin), overweight or obese by BMI thresholds, while weight-for-length is used to assess the weight status of children under two years.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 과체중이나 비만이 있는 아이에게 가장 흔한 영양소 결핍은 지용성 비타민 A·D·E, 수용성 비타민 B9·B12, 그리고 철이에요.
statement_en: The most common nutrient deficiencies in children with overweight or obesity are the fat-soluble vitamins A, D and E, the water-soluble vitamins B9 and B12, and iron.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)

statement_ko: 과체중과 비만은 지용성 비타민이 저장될 수 있는 커진 지방량과 페리틴 과잉 합성을 부르는 가벼운 염증으로 특징지어지므로, 지용성 비타민과 철의 영양 상태를 해석할 때는 신중해야 해요.
statement_en: Overweight and obesity are characterised by an enlarged fat mass in which fat-soluble vitamins may be stored and a mild inflammation inducing ferritin oversynthesis, so caution is required when interpreting the nutritional status of fat-soluble vitamins and iron.
source: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment › Module 8 The Double Burden of Malnutrition › slide 18
refs: SCOPE Childhood Obesity: From Diagnosis to Treatment (원저 미기재)
